title: CLIR-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Question Answering over Irregular Clinical Time Series
summary: Clinical time series are central to patient monitoring, risk assessment, and clinical decision support. However, they are often sparse, irregularly sampled, and asynchronous, making it difficult for models to identify the temporal evidence required for clinical Question Answering (QA). Existing benchmarks primarily focus on regularly sampled time-series QA or medical QA over static data, and therefore rarely assess whether models can faithfully ground their answers in irregular temporal observations. To fill this gap, we introduce CLIR-Bench, a benchmark for irregular clinical time series QA constructed from de-identified ICU records through a principled four-stage pipeline. CLIR-Bench contains 6,600 QA instances spanning 11 clinical variables, organized into four capability dimensions and 11 tasks. Each question is linked to explicit temporal evidence and task-specific answer derivation rules, enabling evaluation of both answer accuracy and evidence use. Experiments show that existing generalist models struggle to retrieve and reason over sparse clinical evidence, highlighting the need for stronger irregular time-series reasoning methods. Our code and data are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/winall/CLIR-Bench.

AI.tldr: CLIR-Bench是一个面向不规则临床时间序列的问答基准，包含6,600个QA实例，覆盖11个临床变量、4个能力维度和11个任务，用于评估模型在不规则时序数据上的证据检索与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要关注规则采样的时间序列QA或静态数据的医学QA，缺乏对模型能否在不规则时序观测中忠实定位证据并回答问题的评估。
AI.method: 基于去标识化的ICU记录，通过一个四阶段流水线构建CLIR-Bench，每个问题都链接到明确的时间证据和任务特定的答案推导规则。
AI.result: 现有通用模型在稀疏临床证据的检索和推理上表现不佳，凸显了加强不规则时间序列推理方法的必要性。
AI.conclusion: CLIR-Bench填补了不规则临床时间序列QA评估的空白，揭示了现有模型在该任务上的局限性，并为未来研究提供了基准。

title: Index SLM Technical Report
summary: We present Index-1.9B, a series of open small language models developed at Bilibili. The series comprises four models: Index-1.9B-Base, a foundation model with 1.9 billion non-embedding parameters pre-trained on 2.8 trillion predominantly Chinese and English tokens; Index-1.9B-Pure, a control variant trained with an identical recipe but with all instruction-like data strictly filtered from the corpus; Index-1.9B-Chat, aligned from the base model with supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization; and Index-1.9B-Character, which augments the chat model with retrieval-augmented generation for few-shot role-playing customization. Pre-training employs a Warmup-Stable-Decay learning-rate schedule in which the concentration of curated data is raised substantially during the decay phase, together with a Norm-Head output layer that stabilizes training under large learning rates. On a suite of standard benchmarks covering examination, reasoning, mathematics, and code, Index-1.9B-Base attains an average score of 64.92, competitive with or exceeding open models of several times its size. We further report controlled studies on model depth, learning-rate magnitude and scheduling, the interaction between learning-rate decay and data quality, and the effect of including instruction data during pre-training, and we document an unexplained surge in benchmark performance midway through the constant-learning-rate phase. All models, together with evaluation code, are released at https://github.com/bilibili/Index-1.9B.

AI.tldr: B站发布了Index-1.9B系列开源小语言模型，包含Base、Pure、Chat、Character四个变体，采用Warmup-Stable-Decay学习率调度和Norm-Head输出层，在标准基准测试中平均得分64.92，超越数倍于其规模的开源模型，并公开了全部模型和评估代码。
AI.motivation: 开发一系列高质量的开源小语言模型，在有限参数量下达到与更大模型竞争的性能，并系统研究模型深度、学习率调度、数据质量等关键训练因素对性能的影响。
AI.method: 1) 预训练1.9B非嵌入参数的基础模型，基于2.8万亿中英文token；2) 采用Warmup-Stable-Decay学习率调度策略，在衰减阶段大幅提升精筛数据浓度；3) 使用Norm-Head输出层以支持大学习率下的稳定训练；4) 通过SFT和DPO对齐得到Chat模型；5) 进一步结合检索增强生成实现少样本角色扮演定制的Character模型；6) 设置Pure对照变体以研究预训练中指令数据的影响。
AI.result: Index-1.9B-Base在考试、推理、数学和代码等标准基准测试中平均得分64.92，性能与数倍于其规模的开源模型相当或更优；发现了恒定学习率阶段中期基准性能出现意外激增的现象。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心的训练策略和数据调度，小规模语言模型可以取得与大模型竞争的性能；开放了全部模型和评估代码以促进社区研究。

title: RouteRec: Strict Evaluation of Recommender-Agent Selection and Aggregation
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at AgentSearch 2026 (The First Workshop on Indexing, Retrieval, and Ranking of AI Agents), co-located with SIGIR 2026
summary: Recommender systems increasingly face a choice among heterogeneous agents -- collaborative filters, sequential models, content-based retrievers, and LLM-based rerankers -- yet no single agent is uniformly best. We study this choice as task-aware agent ranking under cost constraints using RouteRec, a framework that compares request-level hard selection with item-level learned aggregation over four traditional recommender agents and one LLM reranker agent. On MovieLens-1M, the full quality oracle has substantial headroom (HR@10 = 0.584), confirming that useful cross-agent signal exists. Under a leakage-free 5-fold out-of-fold protocol, however, hard selection remains below BM25 (0.223 vs. 0.254), and selective LLM escalation does not improve it. The same protocol yields a different outcome for learned aggregation: its cheap-only variant matches BM25 in HR and has a higher NDCG point estimate (0.123 vs. 0.114), while gated all-agent aggregation reaches HR@10 = 0.295 with 70.2\% LLM calls. The resulting lesson is not that routing is solved, but that request-level selection of one complete agent list is too coarse for this sparse fixed-candidate setting; item-level aggregation is the more promising action space.

AI.tldr: 针对推荐系统中异构智能体（协同过滤、序列模型、内容检索、LLM重排序器）的选择问题，提出RouteRec框架，比较请求级硬选择与物品级学习聚合。实验表明：在无泄漏协议下，硬选择不如BM25基线；而物品级聚合（廉价变体匹配BM25，门控全聚合达HR@10=0.295）优于请求级选择，表明物品级聚合是更有前景的动作空间。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统面临异构智能体（协同过滤、序列模型、内容检索、LLM重排序器）的选择困境，没有任何单一智能体在所有场景下表现最优，因此需要研究如何在成本约束下进行任务感知的智能体路由选择。
AI.method: 提出RouteRec框架，包含两种路由策略：(1) 请求级硬选择（request-level hard selection），在四个传统推荐智能体和一个LLM重排序智能体中选择一个完整推荐列表；(2) 物品级学习聚合（item-level learned aggregation），在不同智能体的推荐结果中逐物品聚合。采用5折无泄漏交叉验证协议，在MovieLens-1M数据集上评估。
AI.result: 全质量oracle显示HR@10=0.584，存在交叉智能体信号改进空间。硬选择在无泄漏协议下低于BM25基线（0.223 vs 0.254），选择性LLM升级未改善。物品级聚合中，廉价变体在HR上与BM25持平且NDCGu更高（0.123 vs 0.114），门控全聚合达HR@10=0.295（使用70.2% LLM调用）。
AI.conclusion: 请求级的单一智能体完整列表选择在稀疏固定候选集设定下过于粗糙，物品级聚合是更有前景的动作空间。

title: The Individual-Targeting Assumption: A Systematic Review of Proactive Robots in Human Group Settings
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN)
summary: Proactive robots are increasingly deployed in public environments where people are encountered not as isolated individuals but as members of cohesive social groups. Yet whether the prevailing design paradigm in proactive human-robot interaction (HRI) accounts for the relational structure that defines a group as a social unit remains largely unexamined. Through a systematic review of 63 proactive HRI studies in group settings from 2000 to 2025, we identify a recurring tendency, the Individual-Targeting Assumption (ITA), in which robots treat co-present people as independent engagement targets. We find that ITA is present in 60.3% of the corpus, with group-aware approaches emerging almost entirely after the robot is already embedded in an ongoing interaction. Critically, how a robot should detect and negotiate entry into a pre-formed group before initiating contact remains unaddressed across the corpus. Three failure modes, engagement misdetection, social ratification blindness, and bystander neglect, emerge as recurring patterns when proactive robots interact with human groups. These findings reframe proactive HRI in group settings not as an extension of dyadic interaction but as a qualitatively distinct design problem, and they identify the robot's approach to the group during the entry phase as a critical and understudied open challenge.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过对2000-2025年间63项群体场景下的主动人机交互研究进行系统综述，识别出普遍存在的"个体目标假设（ITA）"——机器人将共同在场的人视为独立的交互目标，而非社会群体成员。研究发现60.3%的研究存在ITA问题，群体感知方法几乎都是在机器人已嵌入持续交互后才出现，且机器人如何检测并协商进入预形成群体的问题未被任何研究涉及。论文揭示了三种典型失败模式（交互误检、社会认可盲视、旁观者忽视），将群体场景下的主动HRI重构为与二元交互有质的区别的设计问题，并将机器人的群体进入阶段定位为关键且未被充分研究的开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有主动人机交互研究主要基于二元（一对一）交互范式，但公共环境中机器人实际面对的是具有关系结构的社会群体。论文质疑当前设计范式是否考虑到了定义群体为社会单元的"关系结构"这一核心维度。
AI.method: 对2000-2025年间63项群体场景下的主动人机交互研究进行系统性综述，识别出普遍的设计模式（ITA）及其比例，分析群体感知方法的出现时机，总结失败模式。
AI.result: 60.3%的研究存在ITA问题；群体感知方法几乎全部在机器人已嵌入持续交互后才出现；机器人如何检测并主动进入预形成群体的问题未被任何研究解决；识别出三种典型失败模式：交互误检、社会认可盲视、旁观者忽视。
AI.conclusion: 群体场景下的主动HRI不是二元交互的简单扩展，而是一个有质的区别的设计问题。机器人的群体进入阶段是当前关键且被忽视的研究挑战。

title: Global Merger-Arbitrage Forecasting with Language Models
summary: We present a language-model forecasting system for merger arbitrage, a specialized high-stakes financial setting in which the task is to predict the outcome of announced M\&A deals. Unlike prior work on judgmental forecasting with LLMs, which has focused on broad mixed-topic benchmarks and short context such as news snippets, we study a setting that requires long-context reasoning over hundreds of pages of technical documents. Our system combines expert-guided context engineering with finetuning on hindsight-guided reasoning traces derived from historical deals. Given an announced deal, it outputs a probability distribution over three mutually exclusive outcomes: closing at announced terms, a higher bid, or deal termination. On an out-of-sample set of more than 400 large deals spanning 42 countries, our finetuned system achieves the best performance of any method we evaluate, reducing class-balanced Brier score to 0.151. This is 24\% below calibrated market-implied probabilities, 19\% below XGBoost, and 25-42\% below frontier language models. These results, together with ablation studies, show that LLM-based forecasting can succeed in specialized, long-context financial workflows, with hindsight-based supervision and expert-designed context playing a critical role.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于语言模型的并购套利预测系统，结合专家引导的上下文工程和事后推理轨迹微调，在42个国家400多笔大型交易中，将类别平衡Brier分数降至0.151，比市场隐含概率低24%，比XGBoost低19%，比前沿语言模型低25-42%。
AI.motivation: 并购套利是高风险金融场景，需要预测已宣布并购交易的结果。现有LLM预测工作集中在宽泛混合主题基准和短上下文（如新闻片段），缺乏对需要数百页技术文档长上下文推理的专业金融场景的研究。
AI.method: 系统结合了专家引导的上下文工程（expert-guided context engineering）和基于历史交易的事后推理轨迹微调（finetuning on hindsight-guided reasoning traces）。输入已宣布交易，输出三个互斥结果的概率分布：按宣布条款完成、更高出价、交易终止。
AI.result: 在42个国家400多笔大型交易（out-of-sample）上，微调系统实现类别平衡Brier分数0.151，比校准后的市场隐含概率低24%，比XGBoost低19%，比前沿语言模型低25-42%。消融研究验证了事后监督和专家设计的上下文的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的预测可以在专业化、长上下文的金融工作流中取得成功，事后监督和专家设计的上下文起关键作用。

title: When LLM Tutoring Responses Work: Evidence from Student Programming Conversations
summary: As students increasingly use LLM tutors in computer science education, one question becomes especially important: what kind of response helps a student continue productively? Prior work has studied how students use LLMs in computer science education, but less is known about how tutoring response styles are associated with student follow-up across programming help-seeking contexts. This paper analyzes StudyChat (UMass, 2026), a public dataset of student and ChatGPT tutoring conversations from an artificial intelligence course. We transformed StudyChat into 16,851 assistant-response interactions from 203 students and 2,214 conversations. Using local LLM-assisted annotation with Gemma 4, we labeled student help-seeking situations, student state, assistant response style, and student next-turn outcome. Human validation showed 82\% agreement with the LLM-assisted labels (Cohen's $κ=.74$). We analyzed productive continuation and unresolved continuation across the full dataset and across help-seeking contexts. Globally, response style was significantly associated with productive continuation, $χ^2(7)=100.39$, $p<.001$, $V=.078$, and unresolved continuation, $χ^2(7)=125.77$, $p<.001$, $V=.087$, though effect sizes were small. Verification feedback had the highest productive-continuation rate (82.4\%), while direct answers had the lowest (62.7\%). Descriptively, response-style score ranges were smallest in low-confusion conceptual contexts (.017) and largest in high-cognitive-load contexts (.203). More detailed comparisons showed situation-dependent response patterns. For example, stepwise guidance was followed by greater confusion decrease in high-cognitive-load code requests, while direct answers were followed by more unresolved continuation in high-load debugging. These findings support context-aware evaluation and design of AI tutoring responses for programming education.

AI.tldr: 本文基于StudyChat数据集（包含2,214次辅导对话、16,851次交互），利用Gemma 4进行LLM辅助标注，分析不同辅导回应风格与学生在编程求助中能否持续有效学习之间的关系。研究发现回应风格与生产性延续（χ²=100.39, p<.001）和未解决延续（χ²=125.77, p<.001）显著相关，效应量较小。验证性反馈的生产性延续率最高（82.4%），直接答案最低（62.7%），且不同求助情境下回应效果存在差异，支持情境感知的AI辅导回应设计。
AI.motivation: 学生越来越多地在计算机科学教育中使用LLM辅导工具，但不同辅导回应风格如何影响学生在编程求助中的后续行为尚不明确。现有研究缺乏对回应风格与学生跟进行为之间关联的深入分析，尤其是在不同求助情境下的差异。
AI.method: 使用StudyChat公共数据集（包含203名学生的2,214次ChatGPT辅导对话），将其转化为16,851次助手-学生交互。采用Gemma 4进行本地LLM辅助标注，标记学生的求助情境、状态、助手回应风格及学生下一轮结果。人工验证显示与LLM标注的一致性为82%（Cohen's κ=0.74）。通过卡方检验分析回应风格与延续结果的关系，并按情境进行分层比较。
AI.result: 回应风格与生产性延续（χ²=100.39, p<.001, V=.078）和未解决延续（χ²=125.77, p<.001, V=.087）显著相关，但效应量较小。验证性反馈生产性延续率最高（82.4%），直接答案最低（62.7%）。低困惑概念情境中回应风格得分范围最小（.017），高认知负荷情境中最大（.203）。逐步指导在高认知负荷代码请求中困惑度下降更大，直接答案在高负荷调试中导致更多未解决延续。
AI.conclusion: 辅导回应风格与学生能否持续有效学习显著相关，且效果因具体求助情境而异。应开发情境感知的AI辅导回应策略，根据学生状态和求助类型动态调整回应风格，以提升编程教育中的学习效果。

title: EgoSteer: A Full-Stack System Towards Steerable Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
summary: Steerability is a defining capability of generalist robot policies, yet remains largely absent in dexterous-hand systems for lack of large-scale, language-aligned, and action-accurate demonstration data. To address this bottleneck, we present a full-stack system that scales dexterous VLA pre-training from egocentric human videos and enables data-efficient real-robot post-training. It integrates EgoSmith, a data pipeline that curates in-the-wild egocentric videos into 9.6K hours of high-quality pre-training data with 9x higher throughput and better accuracy than prior SOTA; a unified robot stack for teleoperation and human-in-the-loop correction; and EgoSteer, a world-model-enhanced VLA trained on optimized infrastructure. Human-data pre-training equips EgoSteer with language-guided manipulation priors, which are grounded through robot post-training and improved by DAgger refinement. Empirically, EgoSteer robustly executes free-form instructions across 40+ diverse tasks, demonstrating failure recovery, dexterity, and generalization. The pre-trained model also few-shot adapts to complex long-horizon tasks, including box folding, on two embodiments with 75+% success. We open-source the system, data, and model at https://egosteer.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoSteer全栈系统，通过从自我中心人类视频中大规模预训练灵巧VLA模型，并配合数据高效的机器人后训练，实现了语言引导的灵巧操作。系统包含EgoSmith数据管线（9.6K小时高质量数据，吞吐量提升9倍）、统一遥操作与人类纠错平台，以及基于世界模型增强的VLA策略。在40+任务上展现自由形式指令执行、失败恢复和泛化能力，并在两个实体上以75%+成功率完成长时域复杂任务（如折纸盒）。
AI.motivation: 灵巧手系统缺乏大规模、语言对齐且动作精确的演示数据，导致可操控性（steerability）这一通用机器人策略的核心能力缺失。
AI.method: 提出全栈系统EgoSteer：(1) EgoSmith数据管线，从野外自我中心视频中筛选9.6K小时高质量预训练数据；(2) 统一遥操作与人类纠错平台；(3) 基于世界模型增强的VLA模型。采用人类数据预训练获得语言引导操作先验，再通过机器人后训练和DAgger校正进行落地。
AI.result: EgoSmith吞吐量较先前SOTA提升9倍、精度更高；EgoSteer在40+不同任务上稳健执行自由形式指令，具备失败恢复和泛化能力；在两个实体上以75%+成功率完成折纸盒等长时域复杂任务。
AI.conclusion: 大规模自我中心人类视频预训练可有效赋予灵巧机器人系统语言引导的可操控性和泛化能力，系统、数据和模型已开源。

title: Unified Backbone Refinement for Diffusion Models via Internal-Latent Analysis
comment: 45 pages, 23 figures. Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, with performance closely related to the denoising backbones that parameterize the score function. In this paper, we present a systematic, phase-aware analysis of diffusion components and show that abrupt, early-stage fluctuations in deep latents are strongly associated with artifacts. Guided by these findings, we introduce DUNE (Diffusion Unified Network refiNEr), a training-free refinement framework that detects abrupt deviations in deep low-noise internal latents using a shared EMA-based criterion, and applies backbone-specific suppression to the detector-selected entries. Although derived from U-Net, the same detect-suppress principle extends naturally to Transformer-based diffusion models by acting on the latents of deep self-attention blocks. Extensive experiments across multiple backbones indicate that DUNE improves fidelity while reducing hallucinations, offering new insight into where and when diffusion backbones should be controlled.

AI.tldr: DUNE是一种无需训练的扩散模型精炼框架，通过检测并抑制深层潜在表示中的早期异常波动，有效提升生成保真度并减少幻觉，且该检测-抑制原则可自然地从U-Net扩展到Transformer骨干网络。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的性能与参数化分数函数的去噪骨干网络密切相关，但目前对扩散组件的系统性分析不足，特别是深层潜在表示中早期阶段突发的波动与生成伪影之间的关联尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 首先对扩散组件进行分阶段（phase-aware）分析，发现深层潜在表示中早期突发波动与伪影强相关。基于此提出DUNE框架：使用共享的EMA（指数移动平均）标准检测深度低噪内部潜在表示中的异常偏差，然后对检测器所选条目应用骨干网络特定的抑制操作。该原则从U-Net自然扩展到Transformer，只需作用于深层自注意力块的潜在表示。
AI.result: 在多种骨干网络上的大量实验表明，DUNE在提升生成保真度的同时减少了幻觉现象。
AI.conclusion: DUNE揭示了扩散骨干网络应在何时、何处被控制，为理解和改进扩散模型提供了新的视角。

title: Knowledge Graphs Meet Graph Neural Networks: A Comprehensive Survey
comment: Recently Accepted for publication in ACM Computing Surveys. This is the accepted manuscript version, and the final published version available at ACM Computing Surveys:https://doi.org/10.1145/3814608. Paper list at Github: https://github.com/sunxiaobei/awesome-gnn-based-knowledge-graphs
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm in Knowledge Graphs (KGs) due to their intrinsic ability to model graph-structured data. However, there remains a lack of a systematic review about GNN-based methodologies across the entire knowledge graph technologies pipeline. To address this gap, we first propose a novel two-level taxonomy framework for GNN-based knowledge graph technologies: the KG technologies pipeline and GNN-based perspective. Specifically, the knowledge graph technologies pipeline covers knowledge graph construction, knowledge graph embedding, knowledge reasoning and knowledge graph applications. Meanwhile, the GNN-based perspective provides a new categorization of knowledge graph technologies with GNN models, such as GCN, GAT, and HGNN. Then, we analyze the advantages of GNN technology based on the characteristics of different tasks in the knowledge graph lifecycle. Furthermore, we detailed review various GNN-based models for knowledge graph following the proposed taxonomy, and summarize strengths and limitations. Finally, we discuss unresolved challenges and outline promising directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对知识图谱全生命周期中图神经网络方法的双层分类体系，系统综述了GNN在知识图谱构建、嵌入、推理及应用中的研究现状，并总结了未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对GNN在知识图谱全技术管道中的系统性综述，本文旨在填补这一空白，建立一个统一的分类框架。
AI.method: 提出双层分类体系：第一层按知识图谱技术管道（构建、嵌入、推理、应用）划分；第二层按GNN模型类型（GCN、GAT、HGNN等）划分，并基于该分类对现有方法进行详细梳理与分析。
AI.result: 系统梳理了各类GNN模型在知识图谱不同任务中的优势与局限，给出了分类框架下的全面文献回顾。
AI.conclusion: 总结了当前GNN在知识图谱中的未解决挑战，并指出了有前景的未来研究方向。

title: From ML Predictions to Informed Diagnostic Assistance Using the Toulmin Model of Argumentation
summary: To provide a structured and interpretable assessment, we decompose the image-based diagnosis into components following the Toulmin model of argumentation. This model consists of a claim, grounds, warrant, qualifier, rebuttal, and backing. Consider a claim generated by a machine learning (ML) model for retinal diagnosis. Rather than accepting this claim at face value, one could either apply explainable AI (XAI) methods or adopt an argumentation-based approach. In our framework, a model specialized in biomarker extraction from images provides the grounds. The warrant-linking the grounds to the claim - is analyzed by an agent equipped with medical knowledge; in our architecture, this role is fulfilled by a MedGemma agent. The qualifier is determined based on the overall quantitative evaluation of both the warrant and grounds models. Finally, a rebuttal is constructed using image similarity measures computed with MedSigLip. All these components are presented to the human expert, enabling a more informed and critical assessment of the ML-generated diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于图尔敏论证模型的医学影像诊断框架，将ML模型生成的视网膜诊断分解为主张、依据、保证、限定词、反驳和支撑六个组件，通过生物标志物提取、MedGemma医学知识代理、MedSigLip图像相似度计算等模块，为人类专家提供结构化、可解释的诊断评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的ML医学影像诊断通常直接输出结论，缺乏结构化、可解释的评估机制，导致临床专家难以信任和批判性地评估ML生成的诊断结果。
AI.method: 将图尔敏论证模型引入医学影像诊断，具体包括：(1) 生物标志物提取模型提供依据(grounds)；(2) MedGemma代理分析保证(warrant)；(3) 基于保证和依据模型的量化评价确定限定词(qualifier)；(4) 使用MedSigLip计算图像相似度构建反驳(rebuttal)。
AI.result: 该框架将ML诊断分解为多个论证组件，使人类专家能够对诊断进行更知情和批判性的评估。
AI.conclusion: 基于图尔敏论证模型的分解方法为ML医学诊断提供了结构化和可解释的评估方式，有望增强人机协作诊断的可信度和透明度。

title: Faithful by Design: Evaluating and Improving LLM-Generated Clinical Trial Summaries for Multi-Stakeholder Audiences
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to summarize clinical trial results for healthcare providers, patients, and payers, but their tendency to hallucinate poses significant risks in this high-stakes context. This study introduces a benchmark evaluation framework for measuring the faithfulness of LLM-generated clinical trial summaries across three stakeholder audiences. The framework consists of 200 stratified trials drawn from the Aggregate Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov database, evaluated using audience-specific prompt templates and a six-dimension faithfulness annotation schema. Baseline measurements were established for GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 2.5 Flash across 1,800 generated summaries scored using a cross-encoder natural language inference (NLI) model. Unsupported Claims was identified as the dominant failure mode across all three models, with a mean annotation score of 1.55 out of three. A knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval system was developed and evaluated against the baseline, producing statistically significant improvements in NLI-based faithfulness scores (entailment +0.0125, faithfulness +0.0130, p < 0.0001). Improvement pathways were model-dependent, with GPT-4o improving primarily through contradiction reduction while Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 2.5 Flash improved through increased entailment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个评估LLM生成临床试验摘要忠实度的基准框架，发现“无依据声明”是主要失败模式，并验证了知识图谱增强检索系统能显著提升忠实度指标。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在总结临床试验结果时容易产生幻觉，在高风险医疗场景下构成严重风险，但目前缺乏系统性的评估方法来衡量其生成内容的忠实度。
AI.method: 从ClinicalTrials.gov数据库抽取200个分层试验，针对三种受众设计提示模板，采用六维度忠实度标注方案，使用交叉编码器自然语言推理（NLI）模型对三个LLM（GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Flash）生成的1800篇摘要进行评分，并开发了知识图谱增强检索系统进行对比。
AI.result: “无依据声明”是三个模型最主要的失败模式（平均标注得分1.55/3）。知识图谱增强检索系统在NLI忠实度评分上带来统计显著提升（蕴涵+0.0125，忠实度+0.0130，p<0.0001），但改进路径因模型而异：GPT-4o主要通过减少矛盾来改进，而Claude Sonnet 4.6和Gemini 2.5 Flash则通过增加蕴涵来改进。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱增强检索可以有效提升LLM生成临床试验摘要的忠实度，但改进策略需针对模型特性进行定制化设计。

title: "Code Is Cheap. Show Me the Talk.": Lessons from Teaching and Managing AI Coding Tool Usage in a Visualization Course
summary: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) coding tools are transforming visualization education. They can assist with implementation and design, but they can also let students bypass intended learning trajectories. In this paper, we share our retrospective experience managing and teaching AI use in an upper-level visualization course. We implemented prompt injections, asked oral checkout questions, and taught two AI coding labs. Prior to our coding labs, at least half of the students had already used AI tools in their assignments. In both AI coding labs, refinement accounted for about half of students' prompting logs, and explanation was almost absent. In the lab where AI coding was optional, 44 of 78 (56.4%) submissions preferred the scaffolded instructions over designing their own prompts. Students' final projects were more polished than in our previous offering, but also more visually homogeneous. Our reflections point to the need for clearer AI use boundaries and instruction on prompting, and for teaching students to question generic AI designs and adapt them to their data and story.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了在高年级可视化课程中管理和教授AI使用的经验，发现学生广泛使用AI工具，AI编码实验室中提示词以优化为主、解释几乎缺失，最终项目更精致但视觉上更同质化，需要明确AI使用边界和提示工程设计指导。
AI.motivation: Generative AI编码工具正在改变可视化教育，既能辅助实现和设计，也可能让学生绕过预期学习轨迹，因此需要反思如何管理AI在教学中的使用。
AI.method: 在高级可视化课程中实施提示注入、口头检查问题、教授两个AI编码实验室，并分析学生提示日志及最终项目。
AI.result: 至少半数学生在编码实验室前已使用AI工具；两个AI编码实验室中，优化类提示约占一半，解释类提示几乎缺失；在可选AI编码实验室中，78人中有44人（56.4%）偏好结构化指导而非自行设计提示；最终项目比以往更精致但视觉同质化更明显。
AI.conclusion: 需要更清晰的AI使用边界和提示工程指导，以及教导学生质疑通用AI设计并使其适应自身数据和故事。

title: RoboNav-Arm: Agentic AI-Driven Navigation and Obstacle Avoidance for Robotic Manipulator in Cluttered Environments
summary: Robotic manipulators operating in unstructured environments face significant challenges in safely executing goal-directed tasks due to dynamic and unforeseen obstacles, while traditional methods rely on prior knowledge or fixed perception pipelines, limiting adaptability. We propose a framework for safe task execution with effective obstacle avoidance. The environment module performs real-time obstacle detection, 3D localization, and ground surface geometry estimation. It then generates a structured semantic report that includes obstacle positions, object geometry and shape, and whether obstacles lie inside, outside, or within critical interaction zones. A central coordination module manages the overall system by handling tool invocation (e.g., memory and MoveIt collision scene updates), facilitating communication between modules, and continuously monitoring task progress until completion. Furthermore, a planning module selects an appropriate motion planning algorithm, such as RRTConnect, RRT*, or BiTRRT, based on the current environment configuration and goal requirements. The trajectory generated by the planner is further analyzed and refined to ensure safe and collision-free task execution. The proposed approach is evaluated in Gazebo Classic , demonstrating robustness in dynamic scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向非结构化环境的机器人操作框架，通过实时障碍检测、3D定位、地面几何估计和语义报告生成，结合中央协调模块与自适应运动规划算法选择，实现了安全的目标导向任务执行，并在Gazebo中验证了其鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖先验知识或固定感知管线，在动态非结构化环境中适应性有限，难以安全地执行目标导向任务。
AI.method: 1) 环境模块：实时障碍物检测、3D定位、地面几何估计，生成结构化语义报告；2) 中央协调模块：工具调用管理、模块间通信、任务进度监控；3) 规划模块：基于当前环境配置和目标需求自适应选择运动规划算法（RRTConnect、RRT*、BiTRRT），并对轨迹进行分析与优化。
AI.result: 在Gazebo Classic中进行了评估，证明该方法在动态场景下具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架通过感知-规划-协调的模块化设计，有效解决了非结构化环境中的安全避障与任务执行问题。

title: Cross-Subject Modeling for Widefield Calcium Imaging via Atlas-Aligned Spatiotemporal Tokenization
comment: Published at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/ShanechiLab/WiCAT
summary: Large-scale, multi-subject widefield calcium imaging provides unprecedented access to brain-wide cortical dynamics. However, the high dimensionality, complex spatiotemporal structure, and substantial task-irrelevant activity in widefield recordings have largely restricted modeling efforts to single-session analyses, limiting scalability and generalization. While multi-subject pretrained models have been explored for some neural modalities, multi-subject models for widefield calcium imaging have not yet been demonstrated; further, subject-invariant zero-shot behavior decoding remains elusive for multi-subject models across neural modalities more broadly. As a first step toward foundation modeling of widefield data, we introduce WiCAT, a multi-subject model that leverages self-supervised pretraining to both outperform single-session models and enable zero-shot behavior decoding on unseen subjects. WiCAT introduces an atlas-grounded tokenization scheme without session-specific components and learns globally shared spatiotemporal representations. Across multiple widefield datasets, the pretrained model supports lightweight downstream decoding, transfers across subjects, tasks, and datasets, and outperforms baseline models. Notably, the model also achieves robust zero-shot continuous behavior decoding and left-out brain region reconstruction on unseen subjects.

AI.tldr: WiCAT是一个多主体宽场钙成像基础模型，通过自监督预训练和基于图谱的标记化方案，在未见主体上实现零样本行为解码和脑区重建，优于单session模型。
AI.motivation: 宽场钙成像数据存在高维度、复杂时空结构及大量任务无关活动，现有模型局限于单session分析，缺乏可扩展性和泛化能力；多主体预训练模型在宽场成像领域尚未被探索，且跨主体的零样本行为解码在神经模态中仍具挑战性。
AI.method: WiCAT提出一种基于图谱的标记化方案，不依赖于session-specific组件，通过自监督预训练学习全局共享的时空表征，从而支持跨主体、任务和数据集的迁移。
AI.result: 在多个宽场数据集上，WiCAT的预训练模型支持轻量级下游解码，在跨主体、任务和数据集的迁移中优于基线模型，并在未见主体上实现了鲁棒的零样本连续行为解码和留出脑区重建。
AI.conclusion: WiCAT首次证明了多主体预训练模型在宽场钙成像中的有效性，实现了主体不变的行为解码泛化，为宽场数据的基础模型研究迈出了第一步。

title: Position: Every Ground Truth is a Human Construction, not an Objective Truth
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. To be published in Proceedings of the 43 rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
summary: Ground truth datasets play a fundamental role as reference values in the training and evaluation of machine learning models. This position paper argues that ground truths are not neutral objective measurements that are naturally given, but instead that they are constructed by arrangements of humans and technologies. We argue that the ML community will benefit from articulating and discussing these often invisible or unreported choices and acknowledging that reference data sets are contingent, not universal. Focusing on the situated and context-dependent nature of ground truths can improve reliability by enabling a better informed perspective on where, when, and how the datasets, and the models they have shaped, can best be used. We argue for increasing `situated reliability' which includes articulating the limits and strengths of models and their truth claims. Finally, paying more attention to the construction of ground truths can support transparency, accountability, and interdisciplinary work.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了机器学习中的"地面真相"数据集并非客观中立的自然给定，而是由人类和技术共同构建的产物。作者提出应提高"情境可靠性"，通过明确这些数据集及其塑造的模型的局限性和优势，来提升透明度、问责性和跨学科合作。
AI.motivation: 机器学习社区通常将地面真相数据集视为客观中立的参考标准，而忽视了其在构建过程中涉及的人为选择和技术安排。这种隐性假设可能导致模型被不恰当地应用，缺乏对数据集情境依赖性和局限性的认识。作者旨在揭示这些被掩盖的因素。
AI.method: 采用立场论文的形式，通过论证和推理而非实验数据，从认识论和社会技术系统角度分析地面真相的构建本质，并提出"情境可靠性"这一概念框架。
AI.result: 指出地面真相数据集具有偶然性和情境依赖性，而非普遍适用性；提出"情境可靠性"概念，强调明确模型及其真理主张的局限性和优势。
AI.conclusion: 更加关注地面真相的构建过程，可以促进透明度、问责性和跨学科工作，最终提升机器学习模型的可靠性应用。

title: Format Sensitivity Index: Token-Controlled Prompt Wrapper Robustness and Schema Compliance in LLM Benchmarking
summary: Prompt wrappers often differ only in formatting, yet they can change model scores enough to flip leaderboard conclusions. We study this variance under a token-controlled protocol and introduce two complementary metrics: the Format Sensitivity Index (FSI), the accuracy range induced by wrapper choice, and the Parseability Sensitivity Index (PSI), the corresponding range in answer parseability. Across 140,000 OpenRouter generations spanning 7 QA tasks, 5 wrapper families, and 4 instruct models from 7B to 72B parameters, we find that mean FSI varies by over 30x across models and is largely explained by compliance failures. A fixed-effects regression shows that parseability remains a strong predictor of accuracy even after controlling for task, model, and wrapper. We argue that reporting accuracy without wrapper variance and compliance is statistically fragile, and we give practical recommendations for both benchmarking and structured-output deployments.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了提示模板仅因格式不同即可显著改变模型得分甚至翻转排行榜结论。通过标记控制协议引入格式敏感性指数（FSI）和可解析性敏感性指数（PSI），在140,000次生成实验中发现：不同模型间平均FSI差异超30倍，主要由合规失败解释；固定效应回归表明可解析性是准确率的强预测因子。建议报告准确率时必须附上包装器方差和合规性指标。
AI.motivation: 提示包装器（prompt wrappers）仅格式不同却能显著改变模型性能，甚至翻转排行榜结论，这种统计脆弱性被当前基准测试框架所忽视，缺乏量化评估指标。
AI.method: 在标记控制协议下提出两个互补指标：FSI（包装器选择导致的准确率范围）和PSI（答案可解析性范围）。在7个QA任务、5种包装器家族、4个指令模型（7B-72B参数）上进行了140,000次OpenRouter生成实验，采用固定效应回归分析。
AI.result: 1）不同模型间平均FSI差异超30倍；2）FSI的差异主要由合规失败（模型未按要求输出格式）解释；3）即使控制任务、模型和包装器，可解析性仍是准确率的强预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 当前仅报告准确率而不报告包装器方差和合规性在统计上是脆弱的，论文给出了基准测试和结构化输出部署的实用建议。

title: Workload-Driven Optimization for On-Device Real-Time Subtitle Translation
summary:
This report studies on-device English-to-Traditional-Chinese subtitle translation for Taiwan under short inputs, short outputs, batch-size-one inference, low latency, and privacy constraints. These conditions limit the value of optimizations designed for long-context or high-throughput language-model serving.
  Starting from LMT-60-0.6B, preliminary profiling suggests that vocabulary projection becomes a more important decode-time cost after GGUF quantization reduces the relative cost of Transformer blocks. We replace the original 151k-token vocabulary with a 64k-token subtitle-domain tokenizer, migrate the embedding space, and adapt the model through embedding calibration followed by full supervised fine-tuning.
  On a fixed 500-example subset of the OpenSubtitles2024 test set, the LocalSubs achieves a 59.2% tie-excluded win rate against Google Translate under GPT-4o pairwise judging. Performance is strongest on short cues and declines as cue length increases. Preliminary Apple M2 Metal measurements on a 64k-vocabulary model show a 1.63$\times$ speedup over a 151k-vocabulary profiling baseline. The raw benchmark configuration is incomplete, so the latency result is treated as preliminary.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出LocalSubs，针对台湾场景下的设备端英译中字幕翻译，通过将151k词表压缩至64k领域专用词表，结合嵌入校准和全监督微调，在保持翻译质量的同时实现了1.63倍解码加速。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型优化主要面向长上下文或高吞吐场景，而设备端字幕翻译面临短输入、短输出、低延迟、批量大小为1及隐私保护等约束，传统优化手段价值有限。同时，GGUF量化后词汇投影层成为解码瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 将原始151k词表替换为64k字幕领域分词器；2) 迁移嵌入空间；3) 嵌入校准后全监督微调。采用LMT-60-0.6B作为基础模型，使用GGUF量化。
AI.result: 在OpenSubtitles2024测试集的500样本子集上，LocalSubs在GPT-4o成对评估中击败Google Translate，胜率59.2%（排除平局）。在Apple M2 Metal上，64k词表模型较151k基线实现1.63倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 词表压缩策略在设备端字幕翻译场景中有效，短提示表现最佳但随长度增加性能下降。延迟结果因基准配置不完整而视为初步结果。

title: SyncSpace: Layout-Conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Space Reskinning in Mixed Reality
summary: We present SyncSpace, a system that achieves both spatial alignment and visual consistency between a generated 3DGS world and physical space. We first scan the space via depth sensing to extract 3D bounding boxes, which we render into a layout-only panorama and feed as a geometric prior to a generative world model, producing a Gaussian splat scene in which objects are re-semantized to fit a target style without per-object control. We then align the generated scene to physical space with a coarse-to-fine registration algorithm, refined manually via pinch gestures when automatic registration does not converge. We demonstrate a hand-tracked engulfment interaction in which the virtual world rises to replace the physical space, and show a single space reskinned into multiple stylistically distinct worlds with its layout preserved.

AI.tldr: SyncSpace是一个能够将生成的3DGS世界与物理空间在空间对齐和视觉一致性上统一的系统。它通过深度传感扫描空间提取3D边界框，将其渲染为布局全景图作为几何先验输入生成式世界模型，生成保持布局但风格化重语义化的高斯溅射场景，再通过粗到精配准算法（必要时辅以手动捏合调整）对齐到物理空间。系统展示了手部追踪的吞没交互，以及同一空间被重塑为多种风格迥异世界的能力。
AI.motivation: 实现生成式虚拟世界与物理空间之间的精确空间对齐和视觉一致性，使得虚拟内容能够无缝融入真实环境并保持布局结构不变。
AI.method: 1) 利用深度传感扫描物理空间并提取3D边界框；2) 将边界框渲染为仅包含布局信息的全景图，作为几何先验输入生成式世界模型；3) 生成保持原始布局但重语义化（re-semantized）的高斯溅射（3DGS）场景；4) 通过粗到精配准算法将生成场景对齐到物理空间，自动配准失败时辅以手动捏合手势微调。
AI.result: 验证了手部追踪的吞没交互（虚拟世界从地面升起替代物理空间），以及同一物理空间可被重塑为多个风格迥异的虚拟世界且布局保持不变。
AI.conclusion: SyncSpace成功实现了生成世界与物理空间在几何布局和视觉风格上的统一，支持多样化的风格化重语义化，且不依赖逐物体控制，为沉浸式空间计算和混合现实应用提供了新方案。

title: Learning High-Level Decision Making with an Interaction-Aware Attention-Based Network in Autonomous Driving
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, submitted to 2026 IEEE Intelligent Transportation Systems Conference (ITSC)
summary: Reliable learning-based high-level decision making for lane changes and speed control in automated driving must accommodate dynamically sized inputs due to varying scene traffic flow. DeepSet and its variants represent the state of the art among shared-encoder approaches; however, they neglect explicit traffic interaction modeling, limiting performance in negotiation-intensive scenarios such as intersections. Attention-based methods capture interactions among static and dynamic agents, but incur quadratic memory and computational complexity and provide limited control over representation granularity. Inspired by Perceiver IO, an attention-based architecture, DecisionPerceiver, is proposed to project dynamic agent features into a fixed-size latent space, where feature granularity is regulated by the number of latent queries, improving scalability for larger networks. A finer discretization of the action set is further proposed to increase the performance gain due to interaction awareness. Extensive evaluations across three driving scenarios that require different levels of interaction awareness demonstrate consistent performance gains and generalization across various navigation objectives. In addition, the proposed architecture is assessed in scenarios with an increasing number of vehicles to demonstrate scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DecisionPerceiver架构，通过将动态智能体特征投影到固定大小的潜空间，结合注意力机制和细粒度动作离散化，实现了可扩展且交互感知的自动驾驶决策，在多种场景下表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的自动驾驶高层决策方法（如DeepSet）无法显式建模交通交互，在谈判密集型场景（如交叉路口）性能受限；而注意力方法虽能捕捉交互，但计算复杂度呈二次增长且表示粒度控制有限。亟需一种既能建模交互又可扩展的决策架构。
AI.method: 受Perceiver IO启发，提出DecisionPerceiver架构：1) 将动态智能体特征通过交叉注意力投影到固定大小的潜空间，潜查询数量控制特征表示粒度；2) 采用更细粒度的动作离散化以提升交互感知带来的性能增益；3) 通过固定大小潜空间实现网络规模扩展时的计算可扩展性。
AI.result: 在三种需要不同交互感知水平的驾驶场景中，该方法一致性地优于基线方法，且能泛化到不同导航目标。在车辆数量递增的场景中验证了架构的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: DecisionPerceiver通过固定大小潜空间和注意力机制，在保持可扩展性的同时实现了有效的交互建模，为自动驾驶决策提供了一种兼顾性能与效率的解决方案。

title: RSLoRA: Training-free Rank Allocation for LoRA via Representational Sensitivity Probing
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a cornerstone of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT); however, the conventional practice of uniform rank assignment ignores the functional heterogeneity of neural layers. Existing rank allocation methods typically struggle with a trade-off between computational intensity and heuristic simplicity: training-based methods suffer from prohibitive overhead, while pre-allocation methods fail to capture the dynamic task-specific representation manifold. In this paper, we propose RSLoRA (Representational Sensitivity LoRA), a training-free and gradient-free rank allocator driven by activation-space geometry. We identify a "sensitivity regime shift" across layers, observing that static weight analysis and local gradients are insufficient to reflect how updates reshape a model's internal representations. To address this, RSLoRA introduces a virtual representational probing mechanism. By simulating adaptation through structured low-rank noise and measuring the resulting manifold displacement by using Effective Rank and Frechet Distance, we identify high-sensitivity modules that require higher rank capacity. Our framework effectively bridges the gap between expert-crafted heuristics and actual representational impact. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that RSLoRA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art allocators (e.g., AdaLoRA, GoRA) across mainstream benchmarks. By eliminating the need for iterative training-time adjustments and backward gradients, RSLoRA provides a highly efficient, robust, and representation-aware solution for large-scale model adaptation.

AI.tldr: RSLoRA提出了一种无需训练和梯度的秩分配方法，通过激活空间几何和虚拟表征探测机制，基于有效秩和弗雷歇距离测量流形位移来识别高敏感度层，从而在主流基准上优于AdaLoRA和GoRA等现有分配器。
AI.motivation: 传统LoRA采用统一秩分配忽略了神经层的功能异质性，现有秩分配方法面临计算强度与启发式简单性之间的权衡：基于训练的方法开销过高，而预分配方法无法捕获动态任务特定的表征流形。
AI.method: 提出RSLoRA框架：通过虚拟表征探测机制，模拟结构化低秩噪声的适应过程，利用有效秩和弗雷歇距离测量流形位移，识别需要更高秩容量的高敏感度模块，实现无需训练和梯度的秩分配。
AI.result: 在主流基准测试中，RSLoRA一致性地优于现有最优秩分配器（如AdaLoRA、GoRA）。
AI.conclusion: RSLoRA通过消除迭代训练时调整和后向梯度的需求，提供了一种高效、鲁棒且表征感知的大规模模型适应方案，弥合了专家启发式与实际表征影响之间的差距。

title: AuditWeave: A Tamper-Evident, Auditor-Navigable Evidence Layer for AI-Assisted and Data-Transformation Workflows
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, open-source implementation at pypi.org/project/auditweave
summary: AI systems are increasingly used to assist consequential decisions in regulated domains such as auditing, finance, and healthcare. This creates a recurring obligation: an organization must be able to reconstruct, after the fact, which evidence informed a given conclusion, and to show that the record of that reasoning was not altered. Existing tools address related but distinct problems - model observability, drift monitoring, governance reporting - and are built for the machine-learning engineer operating a system, not the reviewer who must trace one specific conclusion back to its supporting evidence. We present AuditWeave, a lightweight Python library, with no runtime dependencies, that records the steps of AI-assisted and data-transformation workflows into a single append-only, hash-chained ledger. A small, system-agnostic event vocabulary spans both retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and tabular/lakehouse transformations, so a conclusion that draws on both can be traced end-to-end through one record. Within a sealed ledger, any modification, reordering, insertion, or deletion of events is detectable through chain verification. We describe the design and evaluate recording overhead, scalability, and tamper-detection correctness on the reference implementation. The integrity guarantees cost tens of microseconds per event, and, as the hash-chain construction implies, verification flagged every injected mutation across four mutation classes over 2,000 randomized trials.

AI.tldr: AuditWeave是一个轻量级、无运行时依赖的Python库，通过追加式哈希链账本记录AI辅助决策与数据转换工作流中的每个事件，支持端到端可追溯性与防篡改验证，每事件开销仅数十微秒，并在2000次随机试验中成功检测所有篡改。
AI.motivation: 现有工具（如模型可观测性、漂移监控、治理报告）主要面向机器学习工程师，而非需要事后追溯特定结论到其支撑证据的审查者，且缺乏对跨RAG管线和表格/湖仓转换的统一追溯能力。
AI.method: 设计了一个轻量级Python库AuditWeave，采用追加式哈希链账本结构，定义了一套系统无关的小型事件词汇表，可覆盖RAG管线和表格/湖仓转换工作流，通过链验证检测任何事件的修改、重排、插入或删除。
AI.result: 哈希链完整性保证每事件仅需数十微秒开销，在2000次随机试验中对四种篡改类别的检测率达100%。
AI.conclusion: AuditWeave为受监管领域中AI辅助决策提供了轻量、高效且可验证的审计追溯方案，填补了现有工具在端到端可追溯性与完整性验证方面的空白。

title: Faithful, Not Corrective: Message-Format Effects in Multi-Hop Agent Relays Are Tier-Dependent
summary: When LLM agents hand off information to one another, does the message format matter? Two literatures disagree: format-optimization work reports that structured messages cut cost without hurting accuracy, while format-restriction work finds that imposing structure degrades generation -- and neither measures what happens when a message traverses multiple hops, where copy fidelity, not one-shot generation, dominates. We introduce a controlled relay testbed: briefs of twelve programmatically generated atomic facts are re-encoded hop-by-hop in five formats (free NL, precision-instructed NL, JSON, triples, key-value) over six hops, scored by a fixed strong grader against programmatic ground truth, across two relay-capability tiers, a cognitive-load condition, and a paired-fork error injection. We find that message-format effects are tier-dependent. (i) Under faithful-relay instructions a strong relay is nearly lossless -- the documented "telephone-game" collapse does not occur -- and adding per-hop cognitive load leaves format-level fidelity unchanged (within +/-1.8 points) while raising generation cost by 24-53%. (ii) Under a weak (1.5B) relay the across-format spread of six-hop recall grows by a factor of 8.7 (from 2.3 to 20.5 points), driven by two opposing mechanisms -- an encoding toll paid by the rigid formats and drift resistance specific to the fixed-key JSON schema -- that flip the format ranking in transit. (iii) In a paired-fork injection, an injected wrong value, once present, persists to the final hop in 83-100% of chains in every format, closely matching each format's retention of the true value, with no detectable collateral damage to neighboring facts. Structure buys a faithful, error-localizing channel -- not an error-correcting code -- and format choice should follow the weakest relay in the pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本论文通过受控中继测试实验，研究了LLM代理间信息传递时不同消息格式（自由NL、精确指令NL、JSON、三元组、键值对）对多跳传递保真度的影响。结果发现：格式效应依赖于中继能力层级——强中继下几乎无损，格式间差异小；弱中继下格式间差异扩大8.7倍，且JSON等刚性格式存在编码代价与漂移抵抗力的权衡；错误注入后在所有格式中持续率达83-100%，无附带损害。结构提供的是保真、错误定位的信道，而非纠错码，格式选择应遵循流水线中最弱中继。
AI.motivation: 两类文献对消息格式存在矛盾观点：格式优化工作认为结构化消息降低成本且不损准确率，而格式限制工作发现强加结构会降低生成质量。但两者均未测量多跳场景下的复制保真度（非单次生成），本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建受控中继测试平台：将12个程序化生成的原子事实摘要以五种格式（自由NL、精确指令NL、JSON、三元组、键值对）在六跳中逐跳重新编码，由固定强评分器对照程序化真实值评分，涵盖两种中继能力层级、认知负荷条件及配对分叉错误注入。
AI.result: (i) 强中继下几乎无损，"电话游戏"崩塌现象未出现，增加认知负荷对保真度影响微小（±1.8分内），但生成成本增加24-53%；(ii) 弱中继下六跳召回率的格式间差异从2.3分扩大到20.5分（8.7倍），由刚性格式的编码代价与固定键JSON模式的漂移抵抗力共同驱动，导致格式排名在传递过程中翻转；(iii) 错误注入后错误值持续率达83-100%，与正确值保留率高度匹配，无附带损害。
AI.conclusion: 结构化消息提供的是保真、错误定位的信道，而非纠错码。格式选择应依据流水线中最弱中继的能力来决定，而非统一采用某种格式。

title: Silent Failures in Quantized LLM Reasoning: A Taxonomy-Based Analysis of Hollow Convergence and Failure Mode Shifts
summary: We show that post-training quantization can silently alter how large language models reason even when task accuracy is preserved. Using a six-category failure taxonomy validated by two independent human annotators (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.906), we classify 30,000 chain-of-thought outputs from five instruction-tuned LLMs (3B--14B parameters) across three quantization precisions (FP32, FP16, NF4) and four reasoning benchmarks. We find that while accuracy is robust across precisions (maximum 3.1 pp drop), Hollow Convergence (correct answers reached through incomplete or unverifiable reasoning) shows a significant size-dependent shift under NF4, dropping sharply for the two smallest models tested but remaining invariant for models at 12B parameters and above. This effect is also benchmark-specific: GSM8K is categorically immune while LogiQA and ARC-Challenge show the largest shifts. Furthermore, under NF4, Shortcut Collapse rises from 44% to 78% of wrong-answer failures in LLaMA 3.2-3B while Confidence Snowballing collapses from 15.8% to near zero, a qualitative shift invisible to accuracy metrics. Finally, we show Hollow Convergence cannot be reliably detected from surface-level text features (best F1 = 0.53), establishing it as a deployment-relevant failure mode that standard evaluation pipelines cannot catch.

AI.tldr: 量化后模型推理质量会悄然退化，即使任务准确率不变。基于6类失败分类法，分析5个指令微调LLM在3种精度下的30,000条思维链，发现NF4量化下小模型出现“空洞趋同”、“捷径崩塌”等推理失败模式，且无法通过表层文本特征可靠检测。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化（PTQ）被广泛用于压缩LLM以降低部署成本，但现有评估多聚焦于任务准确率，忽略了量化对模型内部推理过程（如思维链）的潜在影响。作者旨在揭示即使准确率保持不变，量化仍可能悄然改变LLM的推理质量，并识别出标准评估无法捕捉的失败模式。
AI.method: 提出六类推理失败分类法（由两名人类标注者独立验证，Cohen's κ=0.906），对5个指令微调LLM（3B-14B参数）在3种量化精度（FP32, FP16, NF4）下生成的30,000条思维链输出进行分类，覆盖4个推理基准（GSM8K, LogiQA, ARC-Challenge等）。
AI.result: (1) 准确率在各精度下最多下降3.1个百分点；(2) NF4下“空洞趋同”（Hollow Convergence）呈显著模型规模依赖性：小模型急剧下降，12B以上模型不受影响；(3) 该效应具有基准特异性：GSM8K完全免疫，LogiQA和ARC-Challenge变化最明显；(4) NF4下LLaMA 3.2-3B的“捷径崩塌”从44%升至78%，而“自信雪崩”从15.8%骤降至接近零；(5) 从表层文本特征检测“空洞趋同”的F1最高仅0.53，证明其为标准评估无法捕捉的部署相关失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 后训练量化在保持任务准确率的同时，会引入模型规模依赖的、基准特异性的推理质量退化。这种退化无法通过准确率指标或表层文本特征检测发现，对量化模型的部署可靠性构成潜在威胁，亟需更细粒度的推理质量评估方法。

title: Learning behavior accounts for background-related advantage in AI-assisted education
summary: Generative AI has been found, and will likely be found increasingly, useful in education. However, existing AI-for-education studies provide inconsistent evidence on its average effects. More broadly, research on prior educational technologies shows that average effects often mask substantial heterogeneity across student populations. Motivated by this evidence, this study examines heterogeneity in students' learning behavior with AI, which students benefit from AI assistance, and how learner profiles and learning behavior shape these patterns. To this end, we recruited 318 university students to participate in structured learning experiments lasting up to 125 minutes. Our findings indicate that students' learning behavior is strongly associated with learning outcomes, with behaviors characterized by proactive and critical engagement, rather than limited engagement, associated with significantly better performance. These behavioral differences are related to learner profiles, with students from higher-ranking universities and those with greater prior knowledge tending to benefit more, consistent with their greater likelihood of adopting proactive interaction strategies. Accounting for learning behavior substantially weakens or eliminates the associations between learner profiles and learning outcomes, suggesting that how students use AI is a key pathway through which background differences are linked to learning gains. Overall, this work provides a deeper understanding of AI assistance in education by showing how differences in learner profiles and learning behavior shape who benefits from AI-supported learning. These insights can help educators and students better navigate and integrate AI into educational practices.

AI.tldr: 通过318名大学生的结构化学习实验，研究发现学生与AI的学习行为与学习成果密切相关，主动和批判性参与带来更好表现；行为差异与学生背景相关，高排名大学和知识储备多的学生更可能采用主动策略；学习行为是背景差异影响学习效果的关键中介路径。
AI.motivation: 现有AI教育研究对平均效果的证据不一致，且教育技术研究表明平均效应往往掩盖学生群体间的显著异质性，因此需要深入探究不同学生从AI辅助学习中获益的差异性及其机制。
AI.method: 招募318名大学生参与最长125分钟的结构化学习实验，通过分析学生的学习行为模式、学习者画像（大学排名、先验知识）与学习成果之间的关系来进行研究。
AI.result: 主动和批判性参与行为与显著更好的学习表现相关；高排名大学和先验知识更丰富的学生更倾向于采用主动交互策略并获益更多；控制学习行为后，学习者画像与学习成果的关联显著减弱或消失。
AI.conclusion: 学生如何使用AI是背景差异影响学习收益的关键路径，理解学习者画像和学习行为的差异如何塑造谁从AI支持学习中获益，有助于教育者和学生更好地将AI融入教育实践。

title: Saturation-Aware Robust Trajectory Optimization for Reusable Launch Vehicles via Differentiable Physics
summary: The high-angle-of-attack flip maneuver of reusable launch vehicles presents significant challenges for robust trajectory optimization due to the combined effects of highly nonlinear dynamics, aerodynamic uncertainties, and actuator saturation. This paper presents a differentiable physics framework for saturation-aware robust trajectory optimization. At its core, a Differentiable Particle Tube Control (DPTC) scheme is developed to optimize uncertainty evolution through an ensemble-based distribution shaping strategy. State uncertainty is represented by a Lagrangian particle ensemble, while hard actuator projection operators are embedded directly into the computational graph, enabling the joint optimization of the nominal feedforward trajectory and a time-varying feedback policy via end-to-end backpropagation. The proposed framework is evaluated against an automatic differentiation-based Successive Convexification (AD-SCvx) baseline combined with a conventional covariance steering feedback strategy. Six-degree-of-freedom Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that, although the baseline achieves nominal fuel-optimal solutions, its unconstrained feedback formulation becomes susceptible to actuator saturation under aerodynamic disturbances, leading to degraded closed-loop robustness. In contrast, the proposed DPTC framework proactively performs a constraint-aware performance trade-off by relaxing spatial tracking to preserve critical control authority. These results demonstrate that integrating differentiable physics with ensemble-based optimization provides an effective and practical framework for robust guidance in highly constrained aerospace flight systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可微物理框架（DPTC），通过粒子集合分布整形和硬执行器投影约束，实现高攻角翻转机动下的鲁棒轨迹优化。与传统协方差控制方法相比，该方法能主动进行约束感知的性能权衡，避免执行器饱和，显著提升了闭环鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 可重复使用运载器在高攻角翻转机动中面临强非线性动力学、气动不确定性和执行器饱和的耦合挑战，现有轨迹优化方法难以兼顾鲁棒性与约束满足，亟需一种能够联合优化标称轨迹和时变反馈策略的鲁棒轨迹优化框架。
AI.method: 提出可微粒子管控制（DPTC）框架：采用拉格朗日粒子集合表示状态不确定性，将硬执行器投影算子嵌入计算图，通过端到端反向传播联合优化标称前馈轨迹和时变反馈策略，实现基于集合分布整形的鲁棒轨迹优化。
AI.result: 在六自由度蒙特卡洛仿真中，DPTC框架相比AD-SCvx基线方法（后者虽标称燃油最优但易受执行器饱和影响），能够主动通过松弛空间跟踪来保留关键控制权限，完成约束感知的性能权衡，显著提升了闭环鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将可微物理与基于集合的优化相结合，为高约束航空航天飞行系统提供了一种有效且实用的鲁棒制导框架。

title: ReflectWorld-MM: An Entity-Oriented Multi-Media Memory System for Open-Ended Video Streams
summary: Building assistants that can continually watch the world, remember what they see, and reason over their accumulated experience is a long-standing goal, and recently multimodal agents equipped with long-term memory over video streams have attracted increasing interest. Unfortunately, existing systems either keep their memory inside the model context or in a flat feature store, and organize it around frames rather than around the persistent entities a stream is really about, which confines them to bounded videos and weakens their ability to track who and what reappears over time. In this paper, we propose ReflectWorld-MM, an entity-oriented multi-media memory system for open-ended video streams. It consists of three parts. The first is a perception front-end that turns a streaming video into entity-resolved observations under a bounded short-term memory. The second is a hierarchical long-term memory, grounded in human memory theory, that couples a multi-scale episodic memory, an evolving entity-centric semantic memory, and a procedural memory. The third is a complete realization, built for real-world operation, that ingests arbitrary streams and plugs into off-the-shelf assistants. Across six long-video and lifelong-memory benchmarks, ReflectWorld-MM achieves the best accuracy on all six, outperforming strong memory agents and a frontier model.

AI.tldr: 提出ReflectWorld-MM，一种面向实体的多媒体记忆系统，用于开放视频流。系统包含感知前端、层次化长期记忆（基于人类记忆理论）和实际部署实现，在6个基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有系统将记忆局限在模型上下文或扁平特征存储中，以帧而非持久实体组织记忆，导致只能处理有界视频，难以跟踪跨时间重复出现的实体。
AI.method: 1) 感知前端：将流视频转化为实体解析的观察（有界短期记忆）；2) 层次化长期记忆：结合多尺度情景记忆、演化实体中心语义记忆和程序记忆；3) 完整实现：可摄取任意流并接入现有助手。
AI.result: 在6个长视频和终身记忆基准上全部取得最高准确率，超越强记忆智能体和前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 实体导向的层次化记忆设计能更有效处理开放视频流中的长期实体跟踪与推理。

title: Ablation, Statistical Inference, and Validation for KV-Cache Compression
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, minimum number of citations
summary: This study systematically compares Turbo-Quant and SpectralQuant KV-cache compression, evaluating non-dominated schemes, including WHT rotation with Beta Lloyd-Max and QJL, through a statistical validation methodology that separates systematic codec differences from implementation variance. Key findings reveal that while eigenbasis-based methods fail on heavy-tailed data due to covariance instability, they excel in structured regimes, with the effective semantic dimension ($d_{eff}$) adapting to calibration budgets rather than true data rank. (this is an abstract of the abstract thank you )

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了Turbo-Quant和SpectralQuant两种KV-cache压缩方法，通过统计验证方法评估了包括WHT旋转+Beta Lloyd-Max和QJL在内的非支配方案，发现基于特征基的方法在重尾数据上因协方差不稳定而失效，但在结构化场景中表现优异，且有效语义维度(d_eff)会根据校准预算而非真实数据秩自适应调整。
AI.motivation: 系统比较两种KV-cache压缩方法（Turbo-Quant和SpectralQuant），分离系统编解码差异与实现方差，并评估非支配方案的统计有效性。
AI.method: 采用统计验证方法论，比较Turbo-Quant与SpectralQuant，评估WHT旋转+Beta Lloyd-Max和QJL等非支配方案，分析协方差稳定性及有效语义维度(d_eff)对校准预算的适应性。
AI.result: 基于特征基的方法在重尾数据上因协方差不稳定而失效，但在结构化场景中表现优异；d_eff适应校准预算而非真实数据秩。
AI.conclusion: 不同KV-cache压缩方法各有适用场景，d_eff随校准预算变化，选择方法需考虑数据特性和预算约束。

title: Boltzmann MapReduce: A Partition-Function Reduce for Forkable Sandboxes
summary: To leading order under local asymptotic normality (LAN), the confidence density a worker emits over a chunk of size $n$ is a Gibbs--Boltzmann measure $\exp\{-βE(θ)\}$ whose inverse temperature is the sample size, $β=n$. Three consequences are exact in the Gaussian/linear case and first-order otherwise: disjoint chunks carry independent Boltzmann factors, so the MapReduce \emph{reduce}, read literally, is a partition function $Z=\int\prod_k h_k\,dθ$ whose mode is precision-weighted (inverse-variance) pooling; frequentist consistency is the zero-temperature limit $T=1/n\to0$

AI.tldr: 在局部渐近正态(LAN)框架下，工作者在大小为n的数据块上生成的置信密度服从Gibbs-Boltzmann分布 exp{-βE(θ)}，其中逆温度β等于样本量n。这导致：不相交数据块的Boltzmann因子相互独立，MapReduce中的reduce操作即为配分函数Z=∫∏ₖ hₖ dθ，其众数对应精度加权(逆方差)合并；频率学派的一致性对应零温极限T=1/n→0。
AI.motivation: 建立置信密度与统计力学中Gibbs-Boltzmann分布之间的形式对应关系，从而为分布式统计推断(如MapReduce框架)提供物理学的理论解释。
AI.method: 基于局部渐近正态(LAN)理论，将置信密度表示为Gibbs-Boltzmann形式exp{-βE(θ)}，其中逆温度β=n(样本量)。在Gauss/线性情形下精确成立，其他情形一阶近似。
AI.result: 发现三个重要推论：(1)不相交数据块的Boltzmann因子相互独立；(2)MapReduce的reduce操作对应于配分函数Z=∫∏ₖ hₖ dθ，其众数为精度加权(逆方差)合并；(3)频率学派一致性对应零温极限T=1/n→0。
AI.conclusion: 通过统计力学框架重新解释了分布式统计推断中的核心操作，为理解MapReduce等并行计算范式下的信息融合提供了理论依据。

title: Robust, Scalable Detection of Text Containment in Large Web-Crawled Corpora
summary: We present FindMyText, an open-source Python package designed to efficiently assess whether a given text appears, in part or in full, within a text corpus. The tool builds on prior techniques for document fingerprinting, but extends them with a novel mechanism to explicitly capture sequences of matching fingerprints. By identifying such chains, the tool can more reliably detect near-verbatim copies of a given text rather than mere textual similarities. This makes FindMyText particularly suited for verifying the presence of copyrighted material in a corpus. Leveraging a distributed, disk-based indexing framework, the system scales to large web-crawled datasets. Using a new benchmark for evaluating text containment methods, we show that FindMyText outperforms alternative approaches across three datasets (ArXiv papers, Wikipedia, and generic web content).

AI.tldr: FindMyText是一个开源Python工具，通过文档指纹匹配链机制高效检测文本是否部分或完整出现在语料库中，特别适用于版权材料验证，在三个数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有文本包含检测方法主要关注文本相似性，难以可靠区分近似逐字复制与一般语义相似，因此需要一种能够精确检测文本片段是否实际存在于语料库中的工具，尤其是用于验证版权材料。
AI.method: 基于文档指纹技术，引入了一种新颖的匹配指纹链机制来显式捕获连续匹配的指纹序列，从而更可靠地检测近似逐字复制。系统采用分布式、基于磁盘的索引框架，可扩展到大型网络爬取数据集。
AI.result: 在ArXiv论文、Wikipedia和通用网页内容三个数据集上的实验表明，FindMyText在文本包含检测任务上优于现有替代方法。
AI.conclusion: FindMyText通过匹配指纹链机制有效提升了对近似逐字复制文本的检测能力，为版权材料验证提供了可靠工具，且具备良好的可扩展性。

title: Intervenability as a Design Requirement for Autonomy and Oversight within Human-Centered AI
summary: Based on the literature and several practical examples of possible AI applica-tions, we outline the concept of intervenability. This new phenomenon is not covered by emergency shutdowns, workarounds, or the reconfiguration of automated systems. Intervenability instantiates the principles of control-lability, autonomy, oversight, and keeping humans in the loop in the context of AI. We provide a taxonomy that encompasses a range of possibilities for intervening activities and differentiates them regarding the mental effort of the users. This taxonomy extends the scope of interventions from real-time control of automated processes to AI-based discrete case-related decision-making. This is in accordance with human-centered AI, which seeks to combine human strengths with the usage of AI. We demonstrate how inter-venability can potentially contribute to the ongoing development of human capabilities on the one hand and to further technical improvement by recon-figuration of AI on the other. Exploring and collaboratively reflecting on the effects of interventions as an integral part of organizational practices is key to enabling this continuous improvement on both sides. Intervenability also provides further momentum for the design of an AI that can help realize in-terventions on its own and advance a smooth transition from intervention to reconfiguration of the AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"可干预性"(intervenability)概念，指在AI系统中人类能够进行有意义的干预活动的能力。该概念超越了紧急停机、变通方法或系统重新配置，体现了可控性、自主性、监督和人在环路等原则。文章提供了一个涵盖多种干预可能性的分类体系，根据用户心智努力程度进行区分，将干预范围从实时控制扩展到AI驱动的离散案例决策。可干预性有助于人类能力发展和技术改进，是实现人本AI的关键。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统缺乏对人类有意义干预的系统性支持，紧急停机、变通方法或重新配置等机制不足以覆盖人类在AI系统中进行干预的完整需求，需要提出一个新概念来系统化地理解和设计人类对AI的干预能力。
AI.method: 基于文献综述和多个AI应用实践案例，通过概念分析与归纳，提出了可干预性概念及其分类体系，将干预活动按照用户心智努力程度进行分类，并探讨了干预与AI系统重新配置之间的平滑过渡。
AI.result: 提出了可干预性概念和相应的分类体系，将干预范围从实时控制扩展到AI驱动的离散案例决策，展示了可干预性如何促进人类能力发展和技术改进，并指出了将干预反思作为组织实践组成部分的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 可干预性是人本AI的重要设计原则，通过系统化的干预机制设计，既能促进人类能力发展，又能推动AI技术持续改进。探索和协作反思干预效果应成为组织实践的必要组成部分，同时可干预性也为设计能够自主实现干预的AI提供了新动力。

title: SWIFT: A Small-World Interaction Framework for Flow-Aware Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
summary: Accurate trajectory prediction in autonomous driving hinges on modeling dynamic and context-dependent interactions among traffic agents. However, most existing approaches are purely data-driven and lack structural priors, which limits their generalization under distribution shifts. In this work, interaction modeling is revisited through the structure and dynamics of traffic networks, and SWIFT (Small-World Interaction Framework for Trajectory prediction) is proposed as a unified framework that integrates small-world networks with traffic flow theory. SWIFT introduces structural inductive biases via a Small-World Interaction Network that captures both local and global dependencies, and a Flow Regime Encoder that adapts the interaction structure to scene-level traffic states. Interaction reasoning is further enhanced through a multi-relational graph module that explicitly encodes direct and higher-order agent relationships. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets, nuScenes, MoCAD, and NGSIM, show that SWIFT consistently outperforms strong baselines in prediction accuracy across diverse traffic regimes. Beyond accuracy, SWIFT exhibits improved generalization to unseen locations and regimes, robustness under noisy observations, and strong performance with limited training data, supporting the effectiveness of its structure-aware design.

AI.tldr: SWIFT是一个将小世界网络与交通流理论相结合的轨迹预测统一框架，通过结构性归纳偏置和多关系图模块提升预测精度与泛化能力，在三个真实数据集上超越现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有纯数据驱动的轨迹预测方法缺乏结构先验，在分布偏移下泛化能力有限。作者希望从交通网络的结构与动力学角度重新审视交互建模，引入结构化的归纳偏置来提升模型的泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出SWIFT框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 小世界交互网络(Small-World Interaction Network)，同时捕捉局部和全局依赖关系；(2) 流态编码器(Flow Regime Encoder)，根据场景级交通状态自适应调整交互结构；(3) 多关系图模块，显式编码智能体间的直接与高阶关系。
AI.result: 在nuScenes、MoCAD和NGSIM三个真实数据集上，SWIFT在预测精度上持续优于强基线方法；此外在未见过的位置和交通流态下展现更好的泛化能力，对噪声观测具有鲁棒性，且在有限训练数据下仍保持强性能。
AI.conclusion: 将交通网络的结构与动力学先验融入轨迹预测是有效的，结构感知的设计能够提升模型在多种挑战性场景下的预测性能与泛化能力。

title: Knowledge-Constrained Shape Optimization with a Mixture-of-Experts Neural Operator for High-Confidence Design
summary: Engineering shape optimization faces challenges in both expert-dependent problem setup and surrogate-model reliability. In practical aerodynamic design, optimization settings such as editable regions, deformation ranges, and design-preservation constraints are typically specified manually by experienced engineers, while surrogate-based optimization may become unreliable for heterogeneous geometry databases and out-of-distribution designs. To address these challenges, we propose a knowledge-constrained shape-optimization framework that translates knowledge-based constraints and user intent into quantifiable parameters of DFFD-based deformation operators, enabling engineering-aware and controllable constrained optimization. We further develop a Mixture-of-Experts Neural Operator (MoE-NO) to improve drag prediction and trend consistency over heterogeneous aerodynamic datasets. Based on the MoE-NO encoder and Mahalanobis distance, an uncertainty-estimation strategy is introduced to detect out-of-distribution geometries and selectively trigger physics-solver feedback for local sample enrichment. Experiments on in-house MPV, SUV, and Sedan datasets show that MoE-NO achieves a test-set MAPE of $1.16\%$ and a trend-prediction accuracy of $94.34\%$, outperforming the best baseline results of $1.52\%$ and $90.34\%$, respectively. Vehicle shape-optimization experiments further yield CFD-validated drag coefficient reductions of approximately $4\%$ to $10\%$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种知识约束的形状优化框架，结合Mixture-of-Experts Neural Operator (MoE-NO)和基于马氏距离的不确定性估计策略，在异构气动数据集上实现了高精度阻力预测与趋势一致性，并通过CFD验证取得4%-10%的减阻效果。
AI.motivation: 工程形状优化面临两个主要挑战：一是优化设置（如可编辑区域、变形范围、设计约束）高度依赖专家经验；二是基于代理模型的优化在异构几何数据库和分布外设计上可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出知识约束形状优化框架，将知识约束和用户意图转化为DFFD变形算子的可量化参数；开发MoE-NO提升气动阻力预测精度和趋势一致性；基于MoE-NO编码器和马氏距离的不确定性估计策略检测分布外几何，选择性触发物理求解器反馈进行局部样本丰富。
AI.result: 在MPV、SUV、Sedan数据集上，MoE-NO测试集MAPE为1.16%，趋势预测准确率94.34%，优于基线最佳结果（1.52%和90.34%）；车辆形状优化实验经CFD验证，阻力系数降低约4%-10%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的知识约束框架与MoE-NO代理模型有效解决了形状优化中专家依赖和代理模型不可靠的问题，在异构气动数据集上实现了高精度预测和显著减阻效果。

title: SciML in the Wild: A Diagnostic Study of When Structural Priors Help and When They Hurt
summary: Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) methods such as Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (NODEs), Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), and Universal Differential Equations (UDEs) are most effective when structural priors reflect reliable governing dynamics. We ask what happens when this assumption is violated. Using macroeconomic forecasting as a stress-test domain, we evaluate five model families, ARIMA, LSTM, NODE, PINN, and UDE, across 23 countries using sparse annual data, multiple temporal splits, and five random seeds. Our results show that none of the evaluated models achieve consistently strong forecasting performance, highlighting the difficulty of low-frequency macroeconomic prediction. However, a clear relative hierarchy emerges: less-constrained models, particularly ARIMA and NODE, consistently outperform more-constrained heuristic-prior models such as PINN and UDE. Rather than treating this as a rejection of SciML, we interpret it as a diagnostic result: structural priors can act as misregularizers when they do not match the data-generating process. We identify failure modes including prior misalignment, regime shifts, structural breaks, and optimization instability, and argue that SciML practitioners should test whether structure helps before assuming that more structure is beneficial.

AI.tldr: 本文以宏观经济预测为压力测试领域，评估了五种模型家族（ARIMA、LSTM、NODE、PINN、UDE）在23个国家稀疏年度数据上的表现。结果显示，没有任何模型能实现一致的强预测性能，但存在明确的相对层级：约束较少的模型（ARIMA、NODE）持续优于强约束启发式先验模型（PINN、UDE）。结构先验若与数据生成过程不匹配，会充当"误正则化器"，导致性能下降。
AI.motivation: 探究当结构性先验（如物理知识、微分方程约束）与真实数据生成过程不匹配时，SciML方法的鲁棒性及其失效模式。宏观经济预测因其低频率、结构不稳定等特性，被用作压力测试场景。
AI.method: 在23个国家的稀疏年度宏观数据上，采用多种时间划分和5个随机种子，系统对比ARIMA、LSTM、NODE、PINN、UDE五种模型族群的预测性能。
AI.result: 无模型能实现一致的强预测表现；约束较少的ARIMA和NODE优于强约束的PINN和UDE；结构先验在错配时成为"误正则化器"。
AI.conclusion: SciML实践者不应默认"更多结构更好"，而应先检验结构先验是否与数据匹配。识别了先验错配、制度转换、结构断裂、优化不稳定等失效模式。

title: Interpreting Latent CoT Reasoning as Dynamical Systems
summary: Recent latent reasoning methods, such as CODI and COCONUT, face a fundamental interpretability problem: they maintain multiple superimposed candidate traces in the hidden space at each step, unlike explicit- CoT, which follows a single transparent reasoning trace. Existing mechanistic methods show compression, shortcuts, and superposition without explaining how reasoning evolves across latent steps. To address this gap, we model latent token sequences as trajectories in representation space and apply dynamical systems analysis to characterize the evolution of reasoning. Using quantitative measures, such as step-to-step change, direction consistency, and Lyapunov sensitivity, alongside qualitative projections, such as UMAP and DMD/PHATE, we show that latent CoT exhibits structured, non-random dynamics with two distinct stability classes. CODI behaves as a stable attractor, while COCONUT behaves as an unstable expanding system, and SIM-CoT supervision tightens both behaviors without changing the underlying dynamics. This framework advances the interpretability of latent CoT reasoning dynamics and provides actionable insights for improving latent reasoning performance. Code1 and Project page2 available online.

AI.tldr: 本文针对隐式推理方法（如CODI、COCONUT）的可解释性问题，提出用动力系统分析框架研究隐式思维链的推理动态，发现CODI呈现稳定吸引子行为，COCONUT呈现不稳定扩张行为，SIM-CoT监督可收紧两种行为但不改变基本动态。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式推理方法（CODI、COCONUT）在隐藏空间中维持多个叠加候选轨迹，缺乏可解释性。已有机制分析方法虽然揭示了压缩、捷径和叠加现象，但未能解释推理如何在隐式步骤中演化。因此需要建立框架来刻画隐式推理的动态演化过程。
AI.method: 将隐式token序列建模为表示空间中的轨迹，应用动力系统分析框架，采用步间变化、方向一致性、Lyapunov敏感性等定量指标，以及UMAP、DMD/PHATE等定性投影方法，分析隐式思维链的推理演化动态。
AI.result: 隐式CoT表现出结构化、非随机动态，存在两种不同的稳定性类别：CODI表现为稳定吸引子，COCONUT表现为不稳定扩张系统。SIM-CoT监督可以收紧两种行为但不会改变底层动态。
AI.conclusion: 该框架推进了隐式CoT推理动态的可解释性，为提升隐式推理性能提供了可操作的见解。

title: Efficiently Adapting Spoken Language Models for the Singaporean Context
summary: Spoken language models (SLMs) unify speech perception and reasoning, but adapting them to sensitive domains is underexplored, especially when the original training data is inaccessible and the use case demands multilingual, spoken-query interaction. We adapt an open-source SLM to the Singaporean Home Team context across five speech tasks in Singapore's four official languages, combining LoRA fine-tuning, a surrogate text-QA dataset that guards against catastrophic forgetting, and a multi-task objective that adapts the CoBa reweighting scheme to speech. We also build HTD-multilingual-QA, a 504,853 sample multilingual QA dataset in text and spoken form. The resulting HT-Moonstone (5B) matches or outperforms SLMs up to 7x its size on most tasks, attains the best accent and gender recognition among all models evaluated, and loses under 2\% of its original speech QA ability.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种在数据不可访问且需支持多语言口语查询的敏感领域下适应口语语言模型的方法。通过LoRA微调、替代文本QA数据集防止灾难性遗忘以及多任务CoBa重加权方案，构建了HT-Moonstone（5B）模型，在多种任务上匹配或超越更大模型，且精度损失极小。
AI.motivation: 口语语言模型在敏感领域（如新加坡内政团队）的适应问题尚未被充分探索，特别是原始训练数据不可访问且需支持多语言口语查询的场景。
AI.method: 采用LoRA微调、代理文本QA数据集防止灾难性遗忘、多任务目标（采用CoBa重加权方案适配语音任务），并构建了含504,853样本的多语言QA数据集HTD-multilingual-QA。
AI.result: HT-Moonstone（5B）在多数任务上匹配或超越规模7倍于自身的SLM，口音和性别识别达到最优，原始语音QA能力损失低于2%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能有效将开源SLM适应到数据受限的多语言敏感领域，模型性能优异且泛化损失极小。

title: Spatula: Exploring On-Demand In-Situ Interfaces and Interaction for Attribute Control
summary: Controlling attributes is a critical step toward achieving the final creative outcome, yet current approaches fall short in supporting users in the iterative refinement of generative content. We propose Spatula, a proof-of-concept system that generates on-demand, in-situ attribute control interfaces and interactions for creating motion graphics. Building on a technical probe that automatically analyzes animation context and generates corresponding attributes and UI, we frame attribute control as an explorable landscape and explore the attribute control space along four key dimensions: Discoverability, Resolution, Scope, and Expandability. Findings from a user study (N=12) show that our system provides intuitive and convenient interactions while supporting diverse needs for fine-grained parameter control. Furthermore, our applications demonstrate that the plug-and-play design generalizes to other domains, such as web design and 3D modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spatula系统，通过按需生成属性控制界面，支持用户在运动图形创作中进行迭代式属性细化控制。系统沿四个维度（可发现性、分辨率、范围、可扩展性）探索属性控制空间，用户研究（N=12）验证了其直观便捷的交互体验，并展示了在网页设计和3D建模等领域的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式内容创作方法在支持用户对属性进行迭代式细化控制方面存在不足，缺乏灵活的按需属性控制手段。
AI.method: 通过技术探针自动分析动画上下文并生成对应属性与UI；将属性控制视为可探索的空间，沿可发现性、分辨率、范围、可扩展性四个维度进行设计；采用即插即用架构。
AI.result: 用户研究（N=12）表明系统提供直观便捷的交互，支持多样化的细粒度参数控制需求；应用案例验证了其在网页设计和3D建模等领域的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Spatula系统有效弥补了现有方法在迭代式属性控制上的不足，其即插即用设计具有良好的跨领域泛化性。

title: LLM-Centric Agentic AI for UAV Swarms: Architecture, Enabling Technologies, and Open Problems
summary: Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarms have significant potential for applications such as Search and Rescue (SAR) and environmental monitoring, but their real-world deployment is limited by a lack of situational awareness, intermittent connectivity, and significant cybersecurity risks. Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) represents a shift from standalone Large Language Model (LLM) toward closed-loop cognitive architectures that integrate perception, memory, reasoning/planning, and action to enable adaptive, goal-directed swarm behavior. Within this framework, Agentic AI provides a unifying structure for autonomous and adaptive swarm operations while expanding the system attack surface compared to conventional AI systems. This paper proposes LLM-Centric Agentic AI for UAV Swarms (LAUS) and reviews key enabling technologies such as onboard and edge computing, 5G/6G connectivity, multimodal intelligence, and cybersecurity mechanisms, and analyzes threats such as Priority Manipulation Attacks (PMA) that can distort decision-making and degrade network performance. Finally, it identifies open research challenges, including hallucination-resistant reasoning, onboard LLM deployment under SWaP constraints, and standardized security benchmarks for perception-reasoning attacks in agentic UAV systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向无人机蜂群的以LLM为中心的Agentic AI框架（LAUS），综述了边缘计算、5G/6G、多模态智能和网络安全等关键技术，分析了优先级操纵攻击等威胁，并指出了幻觉抵抗推理、机载LLM部署和安全基准等开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 无人机蜂群在搜救、环境监测等应用中潜力巨大，但因缺乏态势感知、间歇性连接和网络安全风险而难以实际部署；Agentic AI从独立LLM转向闭环认知架构，为蜂群提供自主适应能力，但也扩大了攻击面，亟需系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出LAUS框架，将LLM集成到感知-记忆-推理/规划-行动的闭环Agentic AI架构中；综述机载/边缘计算、5G/6G连接、多模态智能和安全机制等使能技术；分析优先级操纵攻击（PMA）等威胁对决策和网络性能的影响。
AI.result: 明确了Agentic AI为无人机蜂群提供统一的自适应操作框架，同时指出其攻击面大于传统AI系统；识别了PMA等特定威胁可扭曲决策并降低网络性能；揭示了幻觉抵抗推理、SWaP约束下的机载LLM部署、感知-推理攻击标准化安全基准等关键开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: Agentic AI为无人机蜂群自主操作提供统一框架但带来新安全风险；未来需解决幻觉抵抗推理、资源受限下的LLM部署以及安全基准标准化等挑战。

title: Low-Power License Plate Detection and Recognition on a RISC-V Multi-Core MCU-Based Vision System
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. This paper has been accepted for publication in the IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS). Copyright 2021 IEEE
summary: In this paper, we present the first (to the best of our knowledge) demonstration of a low-power MCU-based edge device for Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR). The design leverages on a 9-core RISC-V processor, GAP8, coupled with a QVGA ultra-low-power greyscale imager. The proposed visual processing pipeline uses a multi-model inference approach based on SSDlite-MobilenetV2 for license plate detection and LPRNet for optical character recognition, reaching a 38.9% mAP score for the first task and a recognition rate of >99.13% for the latter on public datasets. On real-world data, the pipeline recognizes registration numbers when the size of LP crops is as small as 30x5 pixels. Thanks to the applied compression and optimization strategies, the multi-model inference (687 MMAC) achieves a throughput of 1.09 FPS at a power cost of 117 mW when running on GAP8. Our solution is the first MCU-class device embedding such a level of network complexity, resulting to be 73x more energy-efficient w.r.t. precedent mobile-class ALPR system featuring a Raspberry Pi3. The proposed design does not resort to any hardwired acceleration engines, thus retaining full flexibility for future algorithmic improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文首次展示了基于低功耗MCU的边缘设备实现自动车牌识别（ALPR），采用9核RISC-V处理器GAP8和超低功耗灰度图像传感器，通过SSDlite-MobilenetV2和LPRNet多模型推理管道，在117mW功耗下实现1.09 FPS吞吐量，较树莓派3能效提升73倍。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的MCU级边缘设备上实现自动车牌识别，满足低功耗、高能效的实时处理需求，突破传统方案对高算力硬件的依赖。
AI.method: 采用9核RISC-V处理器GAP8搭配QVGA超低功耗灰度图像传感器；设计基于SSDlite-MobilenetV2进行车牌检测、LPRNet进行光学字符识别的多模型推理管道；应用模型压缩与优化策略实现687 MMAC计算量。
AI.result: 车牌检测mAP达38.9%，字符识别率>99.13%；真实场景下可识别小至30x5像素的车牌；在GAP8上实现1.09 FPS、117mW功耗，能效较树莓派3系统提升73倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方案是首个在MCU级设备上实现如此复杂网络推理的ALPR系统，且未使用硬连线加速引擎，保留了算法更新的完全灵活性，为边缘智能视觉处理提供了高能效解决方案。

title: MawForge: Memory-Bounded Expert Materialization for Local Mixture-of-Experts Inference
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models separate total parameter count from per-token active computation, but local inference systems often still require the full model, key-value cache, runtime buffers, and operatingsystem headroom to fit in fast memory. MawForge tests a different systems hypothesis: local MoE serving can be made practical on constrained unified-memory machines by storing the full model on disk, keeping common tensors resident, and materializing routed expert tensors into a bounded execution cache on demand. The central finding is that MawForge is effective as a bounded execution mechanism and measurement substrate for local MoE inference, but not as a cache-maximization policy. Performance depends on balancing expert reuse against resident footprint, KV-cache size, quantization, route locality, and macOS memory pressure.

AI.tldr: MawForge提出了一种在统一内存设备上本地运行MoE语言模型的实用方案：将完整模型存储在磁盘，仅常驻通用张量，并按需将路由专家张量加载到有限执行缓存中。实验表明该方法作为有界执行机制和测量工具有效，但作为缓存最大化策略效果不佳，性能取决于专家复用与驻留内存、KV缓存大小、量化、路由局部性和系统内存压力的平衡。
AI.motivation: 解决MoE模型本地推理时因参数总量过大、完整模型及KV缓存等需要全部装入快速内存而导致的资源瓶颈问题，探索在资源受限的统一内存设备上实现本地MoE服务的可行性。
AI.method: 将完整MoE模型存储在磁盘上，仅常驻通用张量（如嵌入层、注意力层等），路由专家张量则按需从磁盘加载到有界执行缓存中，通过动态缓存管理实现有限内存下的推理执行。
AI.result: MawForge作为有界执行机制和测量工具是有效的，但作为缓存最大化策略效果不佳；性能受专家复用率、驻留内存占用、KV缓存大小、量化精度、路由局部性和macOS内存压力等多个因素的平衡影响。
AI.conclusion: 本地MoE推理在统一内存设备上可以实现，但需要精心平衡专家复用与资源约束，单纯的缓存最大化策略不足以取得最优性能，系统设计需综合考虑多层次因素。

title: YUKTI: From Natural-Language Situations to Robust, Verifiable Decisions An Uncertainty-Typed Proposition IR, Assumption-Robust Pareto Frontiers, and a Regret Certificate
summary: Language models turn a worded situation into a numeric plan, and the dominant pipelines (NL4Opt, OptiMUS, ORLM, OR-LLM-Agent) commit to a single objective and point-valued coefficients, then solve once. For decisions that allocate real budget, effort, or clinical attention, that confidence is the failure mode: every objectified number is an assumption, and a plan optimal only if the guesses are exactly right is fragile -- mimicry of computation. YUKTI changes the target of autoformulation. Its representation is a typed-proposition graph whose relationships carry shape priors, coefficient uncertainty, and provenance. YUKTI routes each stage to an exact, nonlinear, or evolutionary solver; couples stages by a distributional Pareto hand-off; and introduces Assumption-Robust Pareto Frontiers (ARPF), resampling assumptions (including structural epsilon-contamination) to score how often each action survives (rho). We prove a bound making rho an exact factor of decision regret, add auditable traceability, and synthesize a benchmark-faithful data foundation when none exists (SRJANA). We validate three ways: under controlled misspecification the robust compromise cuts mean and tail regret by over 90% versus a naive point plan; on a regulated commercial decision we optimize inside a lawful action space and price the downside in euros; and on a real public dataset of 41,188 decisions an out-of-sample backtest beats the logged status quo by 34% and a naive point rule by 4% while reducing the optimizer's curse. The solvers are standard; we claim no benchmark-SOTA win. A head-to-head shows an LLM given the correct numbers, and single-objective optimization, both incur about 47x the held-out regret of YUKTI -- an LLM is a formulator, not a solver. Under long-range causal coupling, the forward hand-off becomes unsound, locating where it must become a backward-induction causal policy.

AI.tldr: YUKTI通过将自动公式化表示从单目标点值估计转向带形状先验、系数不确定性和溯源的类型化命题图，结合分布帕累托传递与假设鲁棒帕累托前沿（ARPF），在受控误设定、商业决策和真实41,188条决策数据集上分别将平均/尾部遗憾降低90%以上、实现合法动作空间内的优化，并以34%和4%的优势超越日志基线与朴素点规则，同时证明LLM作为公式化工具而非求解器，在头对头对比中遗憾值约为YUKTI的47倍。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型驱动的决策管线（NL4Opt、OptiMUS、ORLM等）将问题转化为单目标点值系数并一次性求解，这种确定性做法在分配真实预算、精力或临床关注等场景中构成失败模式——每个客观化的数字都是假设，仅当猜测完全准确时才最优的脆弱计划只是计算的模仿。YUKTI旨在改变自动公式化的目标，以处理系数不确定性和模型误设定。
AI.method: YUKTI的表示形式为类型化命题图，其关系携带形状先验、系数不确定性和溯源；将每个阶段路由到精确、非线性或进化求解器；通过分布帕累托传递耦合各阶段；引入假设鲁棒帕累托前沿（ARPF），通过重采样假设（包括结构ε-污染）来评分每个动作的生存频率（ρ）；证明ρ是决策遗憾的精确因子边界；添加可审计的溯源能力；在无基准时合成保真数据基础（SRJANA）。
AI.result: 在受控误设定下，鲁棒折中方案相比朴素点计划将平均和尾部遗憾降低超过90%；在受监管的商业决策中，在合法动作空间内优化并以欧元定价下行风险；在包含41,188条决策的真实公共数据集上，样本外回测以34%优于日志基线和4%优于朴素点规则，同时减少优化器诅咒。LLM在头对头中遗憾值约为YUKTI的47倍。
AI.conclusion: YUKTI通过分布鲁棒公式化替代点值假设，显著降低了决策遗憾。LLM本质上是公式化工具而非求解器。在长期因果耦合下，前向传递变得不可靠，需转向逆向归纳因果策略。

title: Cost of Reasoning in non-English Languages: A Case Study on Japanese
summary: Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) achieve their strongest performance when they reason in English, the language for which reasoning-oriented training data is most abundant. However, reasoning trace is a clue for model interpretability and safety, and useful in practice for both the model users and for model developers. Thus, it is desirable to be able to develop a model that reasons in a language of the user's choice, while still maintaining strong reasoning performance. To this end, we study the feasibility of training a model that reasons in Japanese. We develop a Japanese-reasoning variant of Qwen-3-Swallow-8B, which is a Japanese LLM continually pretrained from Qwen-3-8B, with GRPO and evaluate it across coding, math, and science benchmarks. The study shows that reasoning-language control is feasible by training a Japanese continually pretrained model with GRPO. However, its performance is at best on par with strong English-reasoning baselines on several benchmarks. We also evaluate the trained model on Japanese cultural benchmarks and observe that the model's performance is worse than the baseline models, suggesting that the reasoning in Japanese does not immediately improve performance on culturally relevant tasks for free.
