AI.tldr: 本研究探索了训练日文推理语言模型的可行性，基于Qwen-3-Swallow-8B（从Qwen-3-8B持续预训练的日文LLM）使用GRPO方法进行训练。结果表明推理语言控制是可行的，但性能最多与强英文推理基线持平，且日文推理并未自动提升日本文化相关任务的表现。
AI.motivation: 推理轨迹是模型可解释性和安全性的线索，对用户和开发者都有实用价值。当前RLM在英文推理上表现最强，但用户可能希望模型用自己选择的语言进行推理，同时保持强推理性能。因此需要研究训练非英文推理模型的可行性。
AI.method: 使用Qwen-3-Swallow-8B（从Qwen-3-8B持续预训练的日文LLM）作为基础模型，采用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）方法进行训练，在编程、数学和科学基准上评估日文推理变体的性能。
AI.result: 日文推理训练是可行的，但在多个基准上性能最多与强英文推理基线持平。在日本文化基准上，日文推理模型的表现甚至低于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 推理语言控制通过持续预训练+GRPO是可行的，但日文推理并不能自动提升文化相关任务的表现，性能仍需进一步提升以匹敌英文推理模型。

title: How Data Narratives Go Wrong: A Taxonomy of Issues Across the Data Communication Process
summary: Data narratives increasingly shape public understanding, but their failures are rarely just isolated factual errors or deceptive charts. Instead, they emerge through a broader meaning-making process in which quantitative evidence is transformed into claims, representations, and arguments. While prior work has examined these failures across disparate fields (e.g., statistics, visualization, and fact-checking), the community lacks a holistic lens to explain how these issues arise, propagate, and compound. To address this gap, we introduce TIC, a Taxonomy of Issues in Data Communication, synthesized from prior literature and refined through the qualitative annotation of 700 real-world data narratives from fact-checking sites, research datasets, and controversial media. TIC organizes recurring breakdowns across six dimensions-data, analysis, visual encoding, text, reasoning, and interpretation-and situates them within a framework spanning analysis, narrative construction, and audience reception. Alongside the taxonomy and process framework, we contribute a qualitatively annotated case corpus with coding justifications and an interactive browsing interface. Collectively, these contributions provide a structured lens for diagnosing problematic data narratives and informing future sociotechnical support for trustworthy data communication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了数据沟通问题分类体系（TIC），该体系从六个维度（数据、分析、视觉编码、文本、推理、解释）系统梳理数据叙事中的失败模式，并构建了一个涵盖分析、叙事构建与受众接收的过程框架。研究基于对700个真实世界数据叙事的定性标注，同时提供了标注案例库和交互浏览界面，旨在为诊断有问题的数据叙事和设计可信数据沟通的社会技术支持提供结构化视角。
AI.motivation: 数据叙事在公共理解中日益重要，但其失败往往不限于孤立的事实错误或误导性图表，而是源于更广泛的意义构建过程中定量证据被转化为主张、表征和论证时出现的系统性问题。现有研究分散于统计、可视化和事实核查等不同领域，缺乏一个整体性视角来解释这些问题如何产生、传播和复合叠加。
AI.method: 研究者综合已有文献，通过对来自事实核查网站、研究数据集和有争议媒体中的700个真实世界数据叙事进行定性标注，归纳提炼出TIC分类体系。该体系涵盖数据、分析、视觉编码、文本、推理和解释六个维度，并将其置于一个涵盖分析、叙事构建和受众接收的过程框架中。
AI.result: 形成了TIC分类体系及过程框架，并构建了包含编码理由的定性标注案例库和交互浏览界面。
AI.conclusion: 这些贡献为诊断有问题的数据叙事提供了结构化视角，并为未来设计支持可信数据沟通的社会技术工具奠定了基础。

title: OmniSCS: Omni Safety-Critical Scenario Synthesis for Autonomous Driving via a Fully Editable Driving World
summary: The synthesis of safety-critical scenarios (SCS) and their evaluation through closed-loop simulations are crucial for developing robust autonomous driving systems. A key aspect of this process involves editing agent states in both appearance and trajectory levels within existing scenes. However, current methods struggle to preserve data fidelity after scene editing and fail to efficiently generate high-quality SCS through such modifications. To overcome these limitations, we propose OmniSCS, an innovative system that generates photorealistic SCS with high physical fidelity while enabling closed-loop testing in synthetic environments. OmniSCS comprises two key modules: 1) A Fully Editable Driving World Construction module that maintains high-fidelity agent appearance and background during scene editing via dual-strategy agent reconstruction and depth-refinement background reconstruction methods. 2) A SCS Synthesis module that facilitates object insertion and agent trajectory editing to synthesize diverse SCS while preserving data fidelity. Experiments on nuScenes, Waymo, and KITTI datasets show that OmniSCS outperforms state-of-the-art methods in edited scene fidelity. We further validate its ability to enhance autonomous driving algorithms and support real-time (13Hz) closed-loop testing. Overall, OmniSCS provides a safer, more effective, and cost-efficient solution for SCS optimization and testing in autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: OmniSCS是一个创新的自动驾驶安全关键场景合成系统，包含全可编辑驾驶世界构建模块和安全关键场景合成模块，能够在保持高保真度的同时实现场景编辑和闭环测试，在nuScenes、Waymo和KITTI数据集上优于现有方法，并支持实时（13Hz）闭环测试。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在编辑自动驾驶场景时难以保持数据保真度，且无法高效生成高质量的安全关键场景，因此需要一种既能进行高保真场景编辑又能支持闭环测试的系统。
AI.method: 提出OmniSCS系统，包含两个核心模块：1）全可编辑驾驶世界构建模块，通过双策略智能体重建和深度细化背景重建方法保持场景编辑中的高保真度；2）安全关键场景合成模块，支持物体插入和智能体轨迹编辑，合成多样化安全关键场景同时保持数据保真度。
AI.result: 在nuScenes、Waymo和KITTI数据集上，OmniSCS在编辑场景保真度方面优于现有方法，并能增强自动驾驶算法性能，支持实时（13Hz）闭环测试。
AI.conclusion: OmniSCS为自动驾驶安全关键场景优化和测试提供了更安全、更有效且更具成本效益的解决方案。

title: Time Imprint: Learning Time-Aware Representations in Multi-Modal Knowledge Graphs
summary: Multi-Modal Knowledge Graphs (MMKGs) enrich entities with multiple modalities such as text and images, yet entities with highly similar multi-modal features remain difficult to distinguish. Temporal information of an entity can serve as an additional modality to disambiguate such entities, but existing approaches rarely treat time as a separate modality alongside text and images due to two major challenges: (1) sparse temporal semantics, which hinder alignment with richer modalities, and (2) multiple timestamps, which introduce noise or reduce robustness in representation learning. To address these challenges, we propose Time Imprint, a framework that treats time as an entity-level modality and jointly aligns temporal, textual, and visual representations via a three-view contrastive objective. Additionally, to mitigate multi-timestamp ambiguity, Time Imprint studies a compact timestamp subset selection design space and aggregates the selected timestamps into a discriminative temporal embedding with attention pooling, balancing temporal specificity and robustness. Experiments on three MMKG benchmarks demonstrate that Time Imprint achieves state-of-the-art link prediction performance, improving Hits@1 by up to 6.07\% overall and yielding up to 58\% gains on the subset of the top-1\% ambiguity samples. We further examine different fusion strategies and the sensitivity to timestamp availability and quality, clarifying when and why time-as-modality is most beneficial, while adding only modest training overhead. We release our code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Time-Imprint.

AI.tldr: 提出Time Imprint框架，将时间作为实体级模态，通过三视图对比学习对齐时间、文本和视觉表示，并设计紧凑时间戳子集选择与注意力池化机制，在MMKG链接预测任务中达到SOTA，尤其是在高模糊性样本上提升显著（Hits@1最高提升6.07%，top-1%模糊样本提升58%）。
AI.motivation: 多模态知识图谱中具有高度相似多模态特征的实体难以区分，现有方法很少将时间作为独立模态来处理，主要面临两个挑战：(1) 时间语义稀疏性导致难以与丰富模态对齐；(2) 多时间戳引入噪声或降低表示鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出Time Imprint框架：将时间作为实体级模态，通过三视图对比学习目标联合对齐时间、文本和视觉表示；设计紧凑时间戳子集选择空间与注意力池化机制聚合选定时间戳为判别性时间嵌入，平衡时间特异性与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在三个MMKG基准数据集上，Time Imprint在链接预测任务上达到SOTA，Hits@1整体提升最高6.07%，top-1%模糊样本提升58%；分析了不同融合策略和对时间戳可用性及质量的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 将时间作为独立模态能有效提升多模态知识图谱中高相似实体判别能力，时间戳子集选择与注意力池化可缓解多时间戳歧义问题，且仅增加适度训练开销。

title: Prioritizing Search Space Regions in the Low Autocorrelation Binary Sequences Problem
summary: Low autocorrelation binary sequences problem (LABS) is a hard combinatorial optimization challenge with important applications in communications, signal processing, and satellite navigation. This paper proposes a hybrid search framework that combines Thompson sampling with parallel self-avoiding walks to adaptively allocate computational effort across restriction classes of the LABS search space. By modeling partitions as arms in a multi-armed bandit setting, the proposed method dynamically shifts search resources toward partitions that empirically produce higher merit factors while maintaining exploration of less-sampled regions. The approach is further accelerated through GPU-parallel execution, shared posterior updates, efficient neighborhood evaluation, and a Bloom filter for cycle prevention. In addition, we use a two-stage optimization strategy that first searches constrained partitioned skew-symmetric spaces and then refines the best candidates in the unrestricted space. Experiments on long binary sequences show that the proposed method improves the previously best-known results for 35 sequence lengths in the range $450 \le L \le 527$ and for $L=573$. In particular, we report a new longest sequence with merit factor exceeding $8.0$, obtained for $L=451$. The results also show that Thompson sampling effectively prioritizes partitions with better observed performance, confirming the value of online, data-driven resource allocation in LABS optimization. Overall, the proposed framework provides a scalable and effective strategy for high-performance merit factor maximization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合Thompson采样与并行自避走法的混合搜索框架，通过多臂老虎机建模动态分配计算资源，在GPU加速下求解低自相关二元序列问题，在450≤L≤527范围内35个序列长度和L=573处取得最优结果，并首次得到L=451时品质因子超过8.0的最长序列。
AI.motivation: 低自相关二元序列问题（LABS）是通信、信号处理和卫星导航中的重要组合优化难题，现有方法在大规模序列上求解质量有限，亟需可扩展的高效搜索策略来提升品质因子。
AI.method: 提出混合搜索框架：1）将搜索空间按限制类别划分为多臂老虎机中的臂，用Thompson采样动态分配计算资源；2）结合并行自避走法进行局部搜索；3）GPU并行加速执行、共享后验更新、高效邻域评估及布隆过滤器防环；4）两阶段优化策略，先搜索约束的偏斜对称空间，再在无限制空间中精炼最佳候选。
AI.result: 在450≤L≤527范围内的35个序列长度和L=573处改进了此前最优结果；首次获得L=451时品质因子超过8.0的最长序列；Thompson采样有效优先分配资源到性能更优的划分。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了可扩展且有效的高品质因子最大化策略，验证了在线数据驱动资源分配在LABS优化中的价值。

title: GES-TSP: Graph Edge Sparsification for TSP
summary: Solving large-scale instances of the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) exactly is computationally expensive. Researchers often employ graph sparsification methods to improve computational efficiency. Traditional sparsification methods typically rely on fixed heuristics and fail to fully exploit instance-specific structural information. In this paper, we propose Graph Edge Sparsification (GES), a learning-based sparsification approach for Euclidean TSP. By incorporating geometric structural information and combinatorial optimization technology, our proposed method adaptively generates a sparsification graph for different instances, significantly reducing the graph size and accelerating the solving process. Experimental results demonstrate that our sparsification method can prune up to 95% of edges on the MATILDA dataset, while keeping the solution gap within 1% of the optimal value. Moreover, our approach exhibits strong generalization capability on the TSPLIB benchmark.In some large-scale instances, the pruning rate exceeds 99%, while the optimality gap remains below 1%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于学习的图边稀疏化方法(GES)，用于欧几里得TSP问题。该方法结合几何结构信息和组合优化技术，为不同实例自适应生成稀疏化图，在MATILDA数据集上可剪枝高达95%的边且解间隙保持在1%以内，在TSPLIB基准上展现出强泛化能力，大规模实例剪枝率超99%而最优间隙仍低于1%。
AI.motivation: 精确求解大规模TSP计算成本高昂，传统图稀疏化方法依赖固定启发式规则，未能充分利用实例特定的结构信息，导致效率提升有限。
AI.method: 提出GES方法，一种基于学习的自适应边稀疏化方法。通过融入几何结构信息（欧几里得距离等）和组合优化技术，为不同TSP实例自适应生成稀疏化图，而非使用固定启发式规则。
AI.result: 在MATILDA数据集上可剪枝高达95%的边，解间隙保持在1%以内；在TSPLIB基准上展现出强泛化能力，大规模实例剪枝率超过99%，最优间隙仍低于1%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的学习驱动稀疏化方法能显著减少图规模并加速求解过程，同时保持接近最优的解质量，具有良好的泛化性能。

title: Instruction Set and Language for Hypergraphs
summary: We present IsalHG, a method for representing the structure of any finite, connected hypergraph of bounded hyperedge arity as a string over a compact instruction alphabet $Σ_{\mathrm{HG}}$. The encoding is executed by a small virtual machine comprising a sparse hypergraph, a circular doubly-linked list (CDLL) of node references, and $k$ traversal pointers, where $k$ bounds the hyperedge arity. Instructions either move a pointer through the CDLL or insert a hyperedge, optionally together with new nodes, into the hypergraph. Every string over $Σ_{\mathrm{HG}}$ decodes to a valid hypergraph; the alphabet is closed. A greedy \emph{HypergraphToString} (h2s) algorithm encodes any connected hypergraph into a string; a backtracking variant seeded at nodes of lexicographically maximal structural tuple produces a \emph{canonical string} $w^{*}$, which we conjecture to be a complete isomorphism invariant. Canonical-string equality then decides hypergraph isomorphism natively, without the standard reduction to the Levi incidence graph followed by a graph-isomorphism engine. We verify the round-trip property $s2h(h2s(H)) \cong H$ on 150 connected random uniform hypergraphs and on named combinatorial designs, and we benchmark the canonical algorithm against the three practically available exact baselines -- nauty, Traces, and bliss operating on the 2-coloured Levi graph -- across a $(n, c)$ grid with ten seeds per cell. All four methods agree on every one of 600 isomorphism verdicts, consistent with the completeness conjecture. On wall-clock time the Levi baselines dominate every tested cell by three to five orders of magnitude (geometric-mean ratio $311\times$ to $117{,}672\times$), which we report as measured. We contribute the representation framework, a conjecture of canonical completeness, and the first native-versus-Levi benchmark for hypergraph isomorphism.

AI.tldr: 提出IsalHG方法，将任意有限连通超图编码为紧凑指令字母表上的字符串，通过小型虚拟机执行编码/解码，并给出一个猜想：规范字符串是完全同构不变量。实验验证了往返性质，并在600个超图同构判定上与Levi图基线方法结果完全一致，但运行时间慢3-5个数量级。
AI.motivation: 传统超图同构判定需要通过Levi关联图归约为图同构问题，缺乏原生方法。本文旨在提出一种直接将超图结构表示为字符串的框架，并探索利用规范字符串判定超图同构的可行性。
AI.method: 设计一台小型虚拟机，包含稀疏超图、循环双链表（CDLL）和k个遍历指针；指令可移动指针或插入超边（可选同时插入新节点）。提出贪心HypergraphToString (h2s)算法编码连通超图，回溯变体在字典序最大结构元祖的节点上生成规范字符串w*。解码器s2h保证任意字符串都能解码为有效超图。
AI.result: 在150个随机均匀超图和组合设计上验证了往返性质s2h(h2s(H)) ≅ H。在(n, c)网格上（每格10个种子）600个同构判定中，所有四种方法（IsalHG规范算法、nauty、Traces、bliss）结果完全一致。但Levi基线方法在墙上时间上比IsalHG快311倍至117,672倍（几何均值比）。
AI.conclusion: 贡献了超图编码表示框架、规范完备性猜想以及首个原生vs Levi基线的超图同构基准测试。虽然IsalHG在性能上远不及Levi归约方法，但提供了理论上自洽的原生同构判定途径。规范完备性猜想仍需进一步证明。

title: Motif: Discovering and Automating Personal Web Workflows
summary: Recent advances in LLMs and existing work on programming by demonstration have made it possible for end users to create automations by explicitly demonstrating their behavior to LLMs. However, these approaches rely on the assumption that users know what to automate and what is capable of being automated. Additionally, automation via LLM agents is often expensive compared with programs. We introduce Motif, a system that passively observes everyday browser activity to discover recurring interaction patterns that are programmable, makes recommendations to users whenever a pattern is discovered and generate a program to install after user confirmation. Users can review, and refine the program using natural language. We evaluated Motif in a multi-day study, comparing its ambient discoveries against automations users attempted to build via ``vibe coding.'' With eight participants, Motif discovered more automatable patterns than users recognized. Most of them matched participants' routines and were useful. Follow-up surveys showed most would continue using Motif-generated programs.

AI.tldr: Motif是一个通过被动观察用户日常浏览器活动来发现可编程的重复交互模式，并向用户推荐自动化方案的系统。相比传统方法（用户需已知晓自动化目标），Motif能发现用户自身未意识到的可自动化模式，并在用户确认后生成可审查和自然语言优化的程序。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的编程示范方法要求用户事先知道什么可以被自动化，且LLM代理成本较高。为了降低自动化门槛，需要一种无需用户主动思考就能发现自动化机会的系统。
AI.method: Motif被动观察用户日常浏览器活动，发现可编程的重复交互模式，主动向用户推荐，用户确认后生成程序，并允许用户通过自然语言审查和优化。
AI.result: 在8名参与者的多日研究中，Motif发现的可自动化模式数量超过用户自身通过"vibe coding"识别出的模式，且多数与用户日常习惯匹配且有用。后续调查显示大多数用户愿意继续使用Motif生成的程序。
AI.conclusion: 被动观察和主动推荐的方式能有效发现用户未意识到的自动化机会，降低了编程自动化门槛，验证了该范式在真实场景中的实用性和用户接受度。

title: A Risk-Field Enhanced Closed-Loop Digital Twin Framework for Autonomous Driving Safety Validation
summary: Autonomous driving systems require reliable safety validation before real-world deployment. However, large-scale road testing is costly, difffcult to reproduce, and inefffcient for exposing rare safety-critical scenarios. Conventional simulation improves repeatability, but an offfine simulator alone cannot continuously connect physical trafffc states, virtual reconstruction, algorithm evaluation, and scenario evolution. This paper proposes a risk-ffeld enhanced closed-loop digital twin framework for autonomous driving safety validation. The framework integrates physical data acquisition, data synchronization, virtual twin reconstruction, risk-aware scenario generation, autonomous driving algorithm evaluation, and safety analysis. A driving risk ffeld is introduced as a uniffed intermediate representation to describe obstacle, lane-departure, road-boundary, time-to-collision, and comfort-related risks around the ego vehicle. The risk ffeld ranks high-risk scenarios in the digital twin scenario library and provides dense safety guidance for reinforcement learning-based driving policies. A simulation-style evaluation protocol is designed to compare conventional reinforcement learning baselines, risk-penalty baselines, and the proposed risk-ffeld guided method. The study indicates that embedding explicit risk structure into digital twins can make autonomous driving validation more targeted, interpretable, and reusable, while its practical effectiveness remains bounded by model ffdelity, risk calibration, and sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种风险场增强的闭环数字孪生框架，用于自动驾驶安全验证，该框架将物理数据采集、虚拟重建、风险感知场景生成和算法评估集成在一起，通过驾驶风险场作为统一中间表示来识别高风险场景并指导强化学习策略。
AI.motivation: 大规模道路测试成本高昂、难以复现且无法高效暴露罕见的关键安全场景；传统离线模拟器无法持续连接物理交通状态、虚拟重建、算法评估和场景演化之间的闭环。
AI.method: 构建风险场增强的闭环数字孪生框架，包含物理数据采集、数据同步、虚拟孪生重建、风险感知场景生成、自动驾驶算法评估和安全分析；引入驾驶风险场作为统一中间表示，涵盖障碍物、车道偏离、道路边界、碰撞时间和舒适性风险；利用风险场对高风险场景排序并为强化学习策略提供稠密的安全引导。
AI.result: 与常规强化学习基线和风险惩罚基线相比，所提出的风险场引导方法在仿真评估协议下表现更优；将显式风险结构嵌入数字孪生可使自动驾驶验证更具目标性、可解释性和可重用性。
AI.conclusion: 风险场增强的数字孪生框架提升了自动驾驶安全验证的针对性和可解释性，但其实际有效性受限于模型保真度、风险校准和仿真到现实的迁移能力。

title: A Generalized Deep Non-negative Matrix Factorization Approach for SAR Automatic Target Recognition
summary: The deep nonnegative matrix factorization (DNMF) technique is proposed to address the low interpretability of deep learning-based methods in extracting multilayer features from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) target samples. However, existing DNMF methods employ a layer-by-layer decomposition strategy, which is prone to causing error accumulation and local optimum, thereby hindering a consistent improvement in recognition accuracy as the number of layer increases. In this paper, a robust multilayer feature extraction method, termed generalized deep non-negative matrix factorization (G-DNMF), is proposed to address the above challenges in SAR automatic target recognition (ATR). The G-DNMF aims global optimality and derives the update rules for each parameter using lagrangian multiplier method. The new update formula indicates that both the DNMF method based on the encoding matrix and the mixing matrix are special cases of the proposed method, theoretically demonstrating the universality of proposed method. In general, the proposed method discards the layer-by-layer decomposition strategy, thereby effectively mitigating the risk of local optima and eliminating error accumulation, leading to a significant improvement in DNMF's multi-layer feature extraction capability. The experimental results, by presenting the feature images extracted from each layer by G-DNMF and the reconstructed original images, verified the proposed method's pure additive understanding of multi-layer features and demonstrated its interpretability. The experimental results based on MSTAR and OpenSARship datasets show that G-DNMF outperforms existing DNMF algorithms and their derivatives in terms of stability and recognition performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种广义深度非负矩阵分解（G-DNMF）方法，用于解决SAR目标识别中深度非负矩阵分解（DNMF）因逐层分解策略导致的误差累积和局部最优问题。G-DNMF通过拉格朗日乘子法推导全局最优更新规则，统一了基于编码矩阵和混合矩阵的DNMF方法，实验表明其在MSTAR和OpenSARship数据集上显著提升了多层特征提取的稳定性和识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有DNMF方法采用逐层分解策略，容易导致误差累积和局部最优，使得随着层数增加识别精度无法持续提升；同时深度学习方法的可解释性不足，亟需一种兼具可解释性和全局最优性的多层特征提取方法用于SAR自动目标识别。
AI.method: 提出广义深度非负矩阵分解（G-DNMF），舍弃逐层分解策略，使用拉格朗日乘子法全局推导各参数的更新规则；新更新公式表明基于编码矩阵和混合矩阵的DNMF方法均为其特例，从而在理论上证明该方法的通用性。
AI.result: 在MSTAR和OpenSARship数据集上的实验表明，G-DNMF在稳定性和识别性能上均优于现有DNMF算法及其衍生方法；通过各层提取的特征图像和重构图像直观验证了该方法对多层特征的纯加性理解及其可解释性。
AI.conclusion: G-DNMF通过摒弃逐层分解策略，有效缓解了局部最优和误差累积问题，显著提升了DNMF的多层特征提取能力，为SAR自动目标识别提供了一种更稳定、可解释性更强的鲁棒特征提取方法。

title: What Context Does a Coding Agent Actually Need to Act?
summary: A modern coding agent can hold an entire repository in its context window. Most of its reading is wasted -- and the interesting question is not how much context an agent can use, but what it actually \emph{needs}. We study that question at the moment it matters most: when the agent must \emph{edit} code. Separating \emph{finding} the work site from \emph{acting} on it, we hold localization fixed with an oracle, vary only how the code is represented, and score context against real issue resolution on SWE-bench Verified. The answer is starkly minimal. The signal lives in the code being edited itself: natural-language summaries of it answer almost none of the behavioral questions that the source answers ($4/45$ vs.\ $27/45$, held-out repositories, independent judge), and the gap belongs to the representation, not the summarizer -- a frontier model's summaries score exactly as poorly as a 3B model's. The surrounding context hardly matters either: across every multi-file instance in Verified, under a protocol frozen before any data, rendering a file's remainder as UML skeletons and signatures resolves no more issues than deleting that remainder outright ($N{=}70$, exact McNemar $p{=}0.75$). That was our registered hypothesis, and it failed. Compressed context, meanwhile, matches whole files at a third of the tokens: a resolved issue costs $19$K context tokens, not $94$K. The instrument also yielded a finding the field should keep: temperature-0 API inference flips ${\sim}9\%$ of per-instance outcomes between byte-identical runs. That is a noise floor under every small effect reported on this benchmark, including ours. We release the instrument -- gold-validated environments, per-instance proof that every reference edit is expressible from every arm's context, deterministic patch construction, and pre-registered hypotheses whose nulls we publish.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了代码编辑智能体在上下文窗口中的信息需求，发现真正需要的信号仅存在于被编辑的代码本身，自然语言摘要和周围上下文几乎无用。通过压缩上下文可以显著降低token消耗（从94K降至19K），同时发现温度0的API推理存在约9%的噪声底限。
AI.motivation: 现有研究过度关注智能体能利用多少上下文，而忽略了它真正需要什么信息来完成代码编辑任务。作者希望分离"定位"和"执行"两个阶段，精准测量代码表示方式对编辑效果的影响。
AI.method: 在SWE-bench Verified基准上，使用oracle固定定位阶段（即让智能体已知编辑位置），仅变化代码的表示方式（完整文件、自然语言摘要、UML骨架、压缩上下文等），对比不同表示下真实issue的解决率。实验协议在数据之前冻结，使用独立评判者评估，并进行了严格的统计检验（McNemar检验）。
AI.result: 1) 自然语言摘要几乎无法回答源代码中的行为性问题（4/45 vs 27/45），且前沿模型摘要与3B模型摘要表现一样差；2) 将周围上下文替换为UML骨架与直接删除无显著差异（p=0.75），注册假设失败；3) 压缩上下文用三分之一的token匹配完整文件效果，每个已解决issue仅需19K而非94K上下文token；4) 温度0的API推理在字节相同的运行间翻转约9%的实例结果，这是所有小效应报告的噪声底限。
AI.conclusion: 代码编辑智能体真正需要的信号高度集中在被编辑的代码本身，自然语言摘要和周边上下文提供的信息增益极为有限。压缩上下文是高效且有效的替代方案。同时，实验方法论上必须考虑温度0推理的噪声底限问题。作者发布了包含金标准验证环境、确定性补丁构建和预注册假设的评测工具。

title: The Verifier is the Curriculum: Execution-Gated Self-Distillation for Cross-Family Game Generation
summary: Post-training a code generator against a learned judge can optimize proxy features that raise the score without improving the artifact. We study the opposite signal: a deterministic, judge-free, ungameable filter -- whether a generated project launches cleanly under a headless engine (strict-launch). Under this gate, rejection-sampling self-distillation compounds out-of-family generalization. On GameCraft-Bench (mapping a natural-language brief to a complete Godot project), a 14B model (Qwen3-14B+LoRA) distilled under strict-launch raises clean generation on four unseen game families from 8.8% to 42.2% per-candidate and best-of-K coverage from 18/25 to 25/25 (the gold ceiling) over three rounds, each a significant gain (p=0.0019, p<1e-4, p<1e-4). The gain is not from merely adding data: an exactly-matched gold-duplication control regresses below the base model (5.6% vs. 8.8%, p=0.019), while a count-matched decomposition splits the round-1-to-2 jump into comparable quality (+8.8pp) and quantity (+8.5pp) channels. Most directly, rerunning the loop with only the filter swapped -- the lenient BUILD check, which passes 99.9% of generations, in place of the launch gate -- erases the gain entirely (back to base, p=1e-3 vs. the launch-gated round), isolating verifier precision rather than the optimizer. A second ungameable signal, headless execution grounding, rises monotonically across rounds and yields far more grounded candidates than gold-duplication at a matched budget (16 vs. 5), confirming the gains are functional, not launch-but-empty. Game generation is a verifiable testbed for one lesson: the verifier is the curriculum -- what it certifies is what the model learns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于确定性、不可博弈的过滤器（严格启动检测）的拒绝采样自蒸馏方法，用于提升代码生成模型在未见游戏家族上的泛化能力。在GameCraft-Bench基准上，14B模型经过三轮蒸馏后，干净生成率从8.8%提升至42.2%，最佳K覆盖从18/25提升至25/25（达到天花板）。通过多种对照实验（金标准复制、分解分析、弱过滤器替换）验证了收益源于验证器的精确性而非数据量或优化器本身。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用学习型评判器对代码生成器进行后训练，但模型容易优化那些能提高评分却不改善实际质量的代理特征。需要一种不可博弈的确定性信号来替代可学习的评判器，从而真正提升生成代码的功能性质量。
AI.method: 使用严格启动检测（strict-launch）作为确定性、不可博弈的过滤器，在Godot引擎的headless模式下检测生成项目能否干净启动。采用拒绝采样自蒸馏循环：仅选通过严格启动检测的生成结果作为下一轮训练数据。使用Qwen3-14B+LoRA在GameCraft-Bench（自然语言需求到Godot项目的映射）上进行多轮蒸馏。
AI.result: 三轮蒸馏后：干净生成率从8.8%提升至42.2%（每候选），最佳K覆盖从18/25提升至25/25（金标准天花板）。所有轮次增益显著（p=0.0019, p<1e-4, p<1e-4）。金标准复制控制实验回归至5.6%（低于基线8.8%），分解分析显示质量和数量渠道贡献相当，弱过滤器（BUILD检查）替换后增益完全消失。
AI.conclusion: 验证器即课程：模型学到的是验证器所认证的内容。精确的、不可博弈的验证信号是提升代码生成模型功能质量的关键，而不仅仅是训练数据的数量或优化器本身。

title: Equal Accuracy, Unequal Evidence: Search APIs as Decision Surfaces for Tool-Using Agents
summary: Search APIs are the fundamental retrieval layer for many agents and are often their most frequently used tool. Traditional search APIs provide URLs, titles, and snippets that preview website contents. Because full-page retrieval is token-intensive, agent retrieval architectures increasingly use progressive disclosure: the agent first sees snippets and then chooses whether to fetch full pages. In such systems, search API performance is often evaluated primarily by answer accuracy. We argue that a commercial search API is better understood as a decision surface: the ranked snippets, URLs, and metadata that determine whether an agent answers immediately, searches again, or spends tokens opening pages. We test this claim with one frozen GPT-5.4 agent, two tools (search_web and fetch_page), and 100 questions from SEALQA-HARD, varying only the search provider (Brave, Tavily, Firecrawl). A Kimi-K2.6 oracle labels every content element visible to the agent (URL, title, snippet, and fetched page, when fetched), producing 6,869 valid per-URL judgments. We use an audited correct-answer label, semantic match, which preserves exact matches while accepting harmless formatting and naming variants. Under this measure, the providers remain close (25, 25, 26 / 100), but their evidence economies differ sharply: Brave offers gold-answer-rich snippets, Tavily concentrates gold-supporting URLs at rank 1, and Firecrawl is associated with broader exploration under this fixed agent policy. We also introduce a surface contradiction-to-gold URL ratio, which varies from 0.92 to 2.59. Provider choice is therefore a retrieval-budget and policy decision, not merely a recall decision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了搜索API作为智能体检索层时的决策面特性，通过固定GPT-5.4智能体、三个搜索提供商（Brave、Tavily、Firecrawl）和100个SEALQA-HARD问题，发现不同提供商的证据经济性差异显著——Brave提供富含答案的片段、Tavily将高支持度URL集中在排名第一、Firecrawl促成更广泛探索，且表面矛盾-黄金URL比率从0.92到2.59不等，表明提供商选择是检索预算和策略决策，而非单纯召回决策。
AI.motivation: 传统上搜索API的性能主要由答案准确率评估，但作者认为在智能体渐进式披露架构中，搜索API应被理解为决策面（decision surface）——排序的片段、URL和元数据决定了智能体是立即回答、再次搜索还是花费token打开页面，因此需要新的评估视角。
AI.method: 使用单一冻结的GPT-5.4智能体、两个工具（search_web和fetch_page）和100个SEALQA-HARD问题，仅改变搜索提供商（Brave、Tavily、Firecrawl）。Kimi-K2.6 oracle对智能体可见的每个内容元素（URL、标题、片段和获取的页面）进行标注，生成6,869个有效逐URL判断。使用经审计的正确答案标签“语义匹配”（semantic match），保留精确匹配并接受无害的格式和命名变体。
AI.result: 三个提供商的答案准确率接近（分别为25、25、26/100），但证据经济性差异显著：Brave的片段富含黄金答案；Tavily将黄金支持URL集中在排名第一；Firecrawl在固定智能体策略下促成更广泛的探索。表面矛盾-黄金URL比率（surface contradiction-to-gold URL ratio）从0.92到2.59不等。
AI.conclusion: 搜索提供商的选择是检索预算和策略决策，而非单纯的召回决策。不同的提供商在片段质量、URL排序和矛盾信息比例上有本质差异，这直接影响智能体的行为路径和token消耗。

title: Navigating the Open-Source Model Ecosystem: An Empirical Study of Creator Practices in Artistic Image Generation
comment: Accepted to MM'26: The 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia
summary: The open-sourcing of powerful image generation models has created a vibrant ecosystem where creators curate and combine a vast array of community-contributed models. This practice stands in sharp contrast to using closed-source tools like Midjourney. Yet, little is known about these emerging creative workflows. To bridge this gap, this paper presents the first large-scale empirical study of creator model usage behavior within this open-source image generation ecosystem. We construct a novel dataset of 6 million images with their embedded generation metadata -- a detailed recipe of the creation process, including the models used and the prompts. By linking the usage of 22.4K base models and 154K LoRA models to the images, our findings underscore the ecosystem's unique strengths and its inherent obstacles. This provides valuable insights for making this ecosystem more sustainable and innovative. Moreover, we make our dataset publicly available, providing creators with practical references for producing better artworks and researchers to facilitate further studies.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对开源图像生成生态系统中的创作者模型使用行为进行了大规模实证研究，通过分析600万张图像及其元数据，揭示了该生态系统的独特优势和固有障碍，并公开了数据集以促进进一步研究。
AI.motivation: 开源图像生成模型的兴起创造了丰富的创作生态，但学界对其中新兴的创意工作流知之甚少，缺乏大规模实证研究来理解创作者的行为模式。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含600万张图像及其生成元数据（包括模型和提示词）的新颖数据集，关联了22.4K个基础模型和154K个LoRA模型的使用情况，进行了大规模实证分析。
AI.result: 揭示了开源图像生成生态系统的独特优势（如社区贡献模型的多样性和组合性）以及其固有的障碍（如模型管理复杂性、质量控制问题）。
AI.conclusion: 研究为提升该生态系统的可持续性和创新性提供了宝贵见解，并且公开的数据集可为创作者提供实践参考，为研究人员提供研究基础。

title: Maximizing Human Efficiency in Large-Scale Robot Post-Training via VLAC-Cut Guided Pipeline
summary:
When adapting Vision Language Action (VLA) models to downstream tasks, multiple rounds of post training are required because a single round of data cannot resolve all issues, making continuous iterations necessary to progressively address the weaknesses exposed in previous rounds. In this report, we aim to maximize human efficiency during post-training, defined as the policy improvement and task throughput achieved per unit of human labor and time.
  We propose a human-efficient post-training pipeline that enables a small number of human operators to supervise multiple robots. The pipeline is built around a specialized division of labor: a trained Teleoperator focuses on high-value remote interventions and recovery demonstrations, while a Floor Operator monitors multiple robots, triggers takeovers, and performs physical resets. This role specialization reduces task switching, lowers operator training costs, and allows limited human labor to supervise more robot interaction across a larger fleet. To improve data utilization efficiency, we introduce VLAC-CUT as an automatic rollout curation tool. It segments autonomous robot trajectories into progress-making, idle, failure-inducing, and recovery portions, preserving useful segments while filtering harmful or uninformative ones. The curated rollout data are combined with Human-in-the-Loop data for the next post-training round. We validate the proposed pipeline on four real-world manipulation tasks. Across iterative post-training rounds, the final policies achieve 80\%--95\% success rates and improve task throughput by 1.7$\times$--4.2$\times$ over the base model. Under the same human-intervention budget, VLAC-CUT guided rollout reuse outperforms HITL-only training in both success rate and throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的人工后训练流程，通过角色分工（远程操作员+现场操作员）和自动 rollout 筛选工具 VLAC-CUT，在少量人力下监督多台机器人完成连续多轮后训练。在四个真实操作任务上，最终策略达到 80%-95% 成功率，任务吞吐量提升 1.7-4.2 倍。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型在下游任务适配中需要多轮后训练迭代来逐步解决上一轮暴露的问题，但一轮数据无法解决所有问题。现有流程人力效率低下，亟需最大化单位人工投入下的策略改进和任务吞吐量。
AI.method: 提出人机协作的后训练流程：Teleoperator 负责高价值远程干预和恢复演示，Floor Operator 监控多台机器人、触发接管和物理重置；引入 VLAC-CUT 自动将机器人轨迹分割为进展、空闲、失败诱导和恢复四类，保留有用片段、过滤有害或无效片段，与人在回路数据混合用于下一轮训练。
AI.result: 在四个真实操作任务上多轮迭代后，最终策略达到 80%-95% 成功率；任务吞吐量较基础模型提升 1.7-4.2 倍；在相同人力干预预算下，VLAC-CUT 引导的 rollout 重用优于仅使用 HITL 数据的训练。
AI.conclusion: 通过角色专业分工和自动数据筛选，可以有效减少任务切换、降低操作员培训成本、提高数据利用效率，使得有限人力能够监督更大规模的机器人集群进行多轮后训练迭代。

title: Towards Real-World Wearable Motion Reconstruction
summary: The modern-day surge in popularity of wearable devices poses a fundamentally unique motion capture problem: reconstructing full-body movement from any set of sensing hardware worn at a given moment. Yet, most research efforts assume fixed sensor configurations (e.g. IMU suits or HMD-centric rigs) and cannot generalize across them. In contrast, we argue that motion capture should prioritize unobtrusive and lightweight devices such as smartphones, smartwatches, smart glasses, and smart insoles, and study the interplay between them. To this end, we make three contributions. First, we present a large-scale multi-modal dataset synchronizing these consumer-grade sensors with ground-truth 3D motion, spanning 50 diverse activities including everyday tasks, sports, and social interactions. Second, we propose WHIP, a baseline generative model that reconstructs motion from arbitrary subsets of available sensors, robustly handling missing modalities and producing physically plausible motions. Third, we conduct a systematic study of sensor complementarity, quantifying how different modalities complement one another. Code and dataset are available at https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/WHIP/

AI.tldr: 本文提出WHIP模型，基于多模态消费者级传感器（智能手机、手表、眼镜、鞋垫）的任意子集进行全身运动捕捉，并发布了包含50种活动的多模态数据集，系统研究了传感器的互补性。
AI.motivation: 现有运动捕捉方法依赖固定传感器配置（如IMU套装或HMD中心配置），无法泛化到不同穿戴设备组合。本文主张优先使用智能手机、智能手表、智能眼镜和智能鞋垫等轻量无扰设备，研究它们之间的协同作用。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模多模态数据集，同步消费者级传感器与3D地面真值；2) 提出WHIP生成式基线模型，可从任意可用传感器子集重建运动，鲁棒处理缺失模态并生成物理合理的运动；3) 系统量化不同传感器模态之间的互补性。
AI.result: WHIP模型能够从任意传感器子集重建全身运动，有效处理缺失模态；数据集涵盖50种多样化活动；传感器互补性分析揭示了不同模态之间的协同关系。
AI.conclusion: 运动捕捉应优先采用消费者级轻量设备，WHIP模型为无约束传感器配置下的全身运动重建提供了有效基线，为实际可穿戴运动捕捉应用奠定了基础。

title: Reference-Based Distillation Detection in LLMs
summary: Model distillation -- training on outputs from stronger third-party models -- is widely used to boost performance, but raises concerns about unfair advantages and policy violations. This motivates a fundamental question: can we detect whether a model was distilled from another? We show that, while identifying a teacher model from a student in isolation is highly challenging, it becomes tractable in a reference-based setting: given a model and an earlier-generation checkpoint from the same lineage, we can identify the teacher model used to train the later checkpoint. We introduce a distillation detection method based on reference-based membership inference. By comparing how strongly a student model preferentially aligns with outputs from different candidate teachers relative to a reference checkpoint, our method identifies the most likely teacher and detects evidence of distillation. To handle unknown distillation pipelines such as hidden prompts, we infer proxy prompt templates directly from model outputs. We additionally identify a distinctive glyph-level signal specific to o1/o3 models. Evaluating distillation detection is challenging because modern model lineages are already heavily entangled. To address this, we develop a hybrid evaluation spanning both controlled distillation experiments and real-world models. Across both settings, our approach recovers the true teacher with near-perfect accuracy in single-teacher distillation scenarios, even when the underlying distillation pipeline is largely unknown. We further introduce statistical tests for both teacher attribution and distillation detection, and extend our framework to open-world settings where no teacher is guaranteed to be present among the candidates. Applying our method to contemporary models yields new evidence regarding potential distillation relationships involving QwQ, DeepSeek-R1, and GPT-OSS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于参考的成员推理方法，通过比较学生模型对不同候选教师模型输出的偏好程度来检测模型是否经历了知识蒸馏，并在单教师蒸馏场景下实现了近乎完美的教师模型识别准确率。
AI.motivation: 模型蒸馏被广泛使用但引发不公平优势和违反策略的担忧，因此需要检测一个模型是否是从另一个模型蒸馏得来的。
AI.method: 提出基于参考的成员推理检测方法，通过比较学生模型对不同候选教师输出的偏好程度来识别教师；对未知蒸馏流程采用代理提示模板推断；识别了o1/o3模型特有的字形级信号。
AI.result: 在受控蒸馏实验和真实模型场景中，单教师蒸馏下几乎完美恢复真实教师；对QwQ、DeepSeek-R1和GPT-OSS等当代模型提供了新的蒸馏关系证据。
AI.conclusion: 基于参考的成员推理可以有效检测模型蒸馏关系，即使在蒸馏流程未知的情况下也能准确识别教师模型。

title: Closed-Loop Control with Rule-Aligned Small Language Models and Multi-Agent Self-Correction
summary: A key step toward autonomous industrial operation is the ability to create and reconfigure control policies from natural-language requirement specifications, with minimal or no manual redesign. In this setting, policy generation by AI agents can be a credible path when paired with a plant-aware validator (e.g., a digital twin) that can check generated candidate actions before execution. However, practical deployment is constrained by inference latency and compute footprint: large cloud-based models are often too slow, opaque, or data-sensitive for edge closed-loop use. This work investigates whether a compact Small Language Model (SLM) can be retrained for control reasoning and embedded in a validator-guided correction loop. We use a Qwen2.5-1.5B model aligned via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), combined with (i) an action agent, (ii) a symbolic/digital-twin-style validation layer, and (iii) a reprompting agent that iteratively steers outputs toward valid actions. In randomized thermal-control simulations (30 experiments with 500 steps each), the framework achieves 91.5% average action-alignment accuracy (86.3%--100% across cases) at 3.84\,s mean inference latency. Under symbolic re-mapping, it maintains a 95% in-range rate, indicating robust physical regulation despite reduced token-level agreement. These results support SLM+validator architectures as a practical path toward reconfigurable autonomous control at the edge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于小型语言模型（SLM）与验证器结合的边缘自主控制架构，使用Qwen2.5-1.5B模型通过GRPO对齐，结合动作智能体、数字孪生验证层和重新提示智能体，在热控制仿真中实现91.5%的动作对齐准确率和3.84秒平均推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 实现从自然语言需求规格自动创建和重构控制策略，减少人工重新设计，解决云端大模型在边缘闭环控制中推理延迟高、不透明、数据敏感等实际部署问题。
AI.method: 使用Qwen2.5-1.5B小型语言模型，通过Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)进行对齐，构建包含动作智能体、符号/数字孪生验证层和重新提示智能体的迭代校正循环架构，由验证器引导生成有效动作。
AI.result: 在30次随机热控制仿真实验（每次500步）中，平均动作对齐准确率91.5%（范围86.3%-100%），平均推理延迟3.84秒；在符号重映射下保持95%的范围内比率。
AI.conclusion: SLM+验证器架构是实现边缘可重构自主控制的实用路径，兼具低延迟、高准确率和鲁棒的物理调控能力。

title: Consensus vs. Dissent: Dynamic LLM Modeling of Subjective Preferences in Group Recommenders
comment: Full paper accepted at the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys 2026)
summary:
Previous work in group recommender systems has demonstrated a sensitivity to the distribution of preferences within a group. Specifically, the selection of the preference aggregation strategy benefits from considering such group configurations. In this paper, we study whether LLMs are able to mimic this sensitivity and to select the ideal aggregation strategy (and corresponding recommendation) according to nuanced human perceptions of fairness, satisfaction, and consensus.
  We do this by fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on human survey data to serve as real-time judgmental models within the recommendation pipeline. Using a reasoning dataset distilled from DeepSeek-V3.1 and human ground truth assessments, we develop Judgmental Llama and Judgmental OLMo to simulate group assessments. Our pipeline successfully generates multiple recommendation candidates based on social choice-based aggregation strategies and dynamically selects the one that maximizes these predicted human-like evaluations. We further validate these suggestions in a user study (n=284) and find that our methodology achieved the highest scores for satisfaction and group consensus. Furthermore, we find that LLM judgments are most aligned with human perceptions of fairness, satisfaction and consensus when we also consider interaction effects between our LLM-based method and group configuration (e.g., minority or coalition). These findings give further support for dynamically adapting aggregation strategies to specific within-group preference distributions, and highlight the advantage of using LLMs for an adaptation that is aligned with subjective human judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微调LLM来动态选择群体推荐中的偏好聚合策略，使其与人类对公平、满意度和共识的感知对齐，实验表明该方法在用户满意度与群体共识方面表现最优，且LLM判断与人类感知的一致性受群体配置（如少数派或联盟）的交互影响。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明群体推荐系统对群体内偏好分布敏感，聚合策略的选择应考虑群体配置，但现有方法缺乏与人类主观感知（公平、满意、共识）的对齐能力。
AI.method: 使用DeepSeek-V3.1蒸馏的推理数据集及人工标注的真实评估数据微调LLaMA和OLMo，使其作为推荐流水线中的实时判断模型，基于社会选择聚合策略生成多个候选推荐，并动态选择最大化预测人类评估的推荐。
AI.result: 用户研究（n=284）表明该方法在满意度和群体共识上得分最高；LLM判断与人类感知的对齐程度受群体配置（如少数派、联盟）与LLM方法的交互效应影响。
AI.conclusion: 进一步支持根据群体内偏好分布动态调整聚合策略的必要性，并凸显了使用LLM进行与人类主观判断对齐的自适应推荐的优势。

title: U-Lens: Supporting User Uncertainty Management in Long-Form LLM Responses
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate long-form answers for knowledge-intensive tasks, but users often struggle to decide which parts of a response deserve scrutiny, why they may be unreliable, and what to do next. Prior work on uncertainty communication has largely focused on making uncertainty visible through cues such as confidence scores, leaving less support for the broader process of managing uncertainty distributed across a long response. Through a formative study, we examine how users manage such uncertainty across three stages: interpretation, evaluation, and decision. Based on these insights, we derive design guidelines that address both stage-specific and cross-stage needs: uncertainty target representation, evaluative explanation, response guidance, and interactive presentation. We instantiate these guidelines in U-Lens, an uncertainty-management support system that organizes uncertain information in long-form responses into contextual inspection targets, prioritizes them for attention, and connects each target with evaluative context and response options. We evaluated U-Lens in a controlled within-subjects study with 18 participants, comparing it against a confidence-cue baseline. Our results show that U-Lens improved verification efficiency and effort allocation, lowered perceived workload, and strengthened perceived support across interpretation, evaluation, and decision stages. This work reframes uncertainty support for generative AI from presenting isolated, text-centered cues toward supporting the user-centered process of interpreting, evaluating, and acting on uncertain information.

AI.tldr: 本文通过形成性研究探索用户在长文本LLM回答中管理不确定性的三阶段（理解、评估、决策）需求，提出设计指南并构建了U-Lens系统。该系统将不确定信息组织为可检视的目标，优先排序并关联评估语境与响应选项。用户实验（N=18）表明，相比置信度基线，U-Lens提升了验证效率、努力分配，降低了感知工作负荷，并在各阶段增强了感知支持。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性沟通研究主要关注通过置信度分数等线索使不确定性可见，缺乏对用户在整个长文本回答中管理不确定性过程的系统性支持。
AI.method: 通过形成性研究理解用户在三阶段（理解、评估、决策）中的不确定性管理行为，据此设计U-Lens系统，并在18人受试者内实验中将U-Lens与置信度基线进行对比评估。
AI.result: U-Lens相比置信度基线显著提升了验证效率和努力分配，降低了感知工作负荷，并在理解、评估、决策各阶段均增强了感知支持。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将生成式AI的不确定性支持从呈现孤立的文本中心线索，转向支持用户中心的对不确定信息进行理解、评估和行动的过程。

title: A Comprehensive Survey and Systematic Real-World Evaluation of Embodied Vision-and-Language Navigation
comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE TASE 2026
summary: Navigation is a fundamental capability of autonomous systems, yet most existing approaches rely on highly structured models and strong prior assumptions, limiting their robustness in open and uncertain real-world environments. Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) offers a promising direction by enabling robots to integrate natural language understanding with visual perception in a data-driven manner. Although VLN has attracted increasing research attention, systematic methodological taxonomy and real-world validation remain limited. This survey presents a comprehensive review of VLN research. Specifically, state-of-the-art methods are organized along two orthogonal dimensions: action paradigms, including hierarchical and monolithic frameworks, and model paradigms, including discriminative and generative approaches. A critical analysis of their respective strengths and limitations is provided. Additionally, we conduct a systematic real-world evaluation of representative VLN system configurations on a physical robotic platform. Experiments across ten diverse real-world scenes show a substantial performance gap between simulation and real-world deployment under the tested configurations: a representative monolithic RGB-only method achieves 61% success in simulation but drops to 22% in real-world deployment, while a hierarchical framework achieves a higher real-world success rate of 51%, suggesting stronger robustness in our evaluation setting. Finally, we highlight key challenges in perception, decision-making, and control that must be addressed in future research.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了视觉-语言导航（VLN）的研究现状，从动作范式（层次化与整体化）和模型范式（判别式与生成式）两个维度对现有方法进行分类和批判性分析，并通过真实物理机器人平台在10个真实场景中的实验揭示了模拟与真实部署间的显著性能差距（如单块RGB方法成功率从61%降至22%），最后指出了感知、决策和控制方面的关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有自主导航系统大多依赖高度结构化的模型和强先验假设，在开放不确定的真实环境中鲁棒性有限。VLN通过数据驱动方式将自然语言理解与视觉感知结合，提供了一种有前景的方向，但缺乏系统的方法学分类和真实世界验证。
AI.method: 论文从两个正交维度组织最新方法：(1) 动作范式——层次化框架与整体化框架；(2) 模型范式——判别式方法与生成式方法。同时，在物理机器人平台上对代表性VLN系统配置进行了系统性真实世界评估。
AI.result: 在10个真实场景的实验表明，代表性单块RGB方法在模拟中成功率61%，真实部署中降至22%；而层次化框架在真实环境中成功率达51%，表明其在评估设置中具有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 模拟与真实部署之间存在显著性能差距，未来研究需重点解决感知、决策和控制方面的关键挑战。

title: Compression Asymmetry and Trajectory Binding in Noise-Anchored Diffusion Inversion
summary: Real-image diffusion inversion is governed by a tight quality-cost trade-off, with costs incurred in computation, storage, or per-image optimization. We study this trade-off through the forward Gaussian noise anchor that defines a diffusion trajectory and isolate two mechanisms behind effective stored-noise inversion. First, diffusion noise exhibits an element-wise compression asymmetry: int8 full-dimensional anchors preserve reconstruction, whereas low-dimensional subspace summaries are much less reliable, often collapsing even at comparable or smaller payloads; the element-wise over subspace ordering persists across five stored-noise inversion methods. Second, inversion is trajectory-bound and score-prior coupled: the matched forward anchor and a trained score network are both necessary, arguing against a purely algebraic-identity explanation. Together, these findings specify what to store and how to use it. They lead to Noise-Anchored Reverse Correction (NARC), a training-free inversion primitive that stores a single int8 latent anchor and reuses it with a fixed, noise-level-dependent anchor-weight schedule: strong anchoring when the reverse trajectory is noise-dominated, then relaxed anchoring as image detail emerges. On PIE-Bench++ with Stable Diffusion 1.5, NARC outperforms five modern non-exact baselines and improves PSNR by +3.24 dB over PnP DirectInv while using about 400x less inversion storage than PnP DirectInv. The compression asymmetry, anchor specificity, and editing plug-in also transfer to SDXL 1024^2.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了真实图像扩散反转中的质量-成本权衡，发现了两种关键机制：元素级压缩不对称性和轨迹绑定/分数先验耦合。基于这些发现，提出了NARC方法，该方法通过存储单个int8潜在锚点并使用噪声级依赖的锚点权重调度，在PIE-Bench++上以约400倍更少的存储成本实现了比PnP DirectInv高3.24 dB的PSNR提升。
AI.motivation: 真实图像扩散反转面临严格的质量-成本权衡，现有方法在计算、存储或逐图像优化方面成本高昂。作者旨在理解有效存储噪声反转背后的机制，并开发一种训练免费、存储高效的反转方法。
AI.method: 首先分析了扩散反转中的两种机制：(1) 元素级压缩不对称性——int8全维度锚点保持重建质量，而低维子空间摘要不可靠；(2) 轨迹绑定和分数先验耦合——需要匹配的前向锚点和训练好的分数网络。基于这些发现提出了NARC方法，存储单个int8潜在锚点，采用噪声级依赖的锚点权重调度：在噪声主导阶段强锚定，图像细节出现时放松锚定。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench++上使用Stable Diffusion 1.5，NARC优于五种现代非精确基线方法，PSNR比PnP DirectInv高3.24 dB，同时存储成本降低约400倍。压缩不对称性、锚点特异性和编辑插件能力也迁移到了SDXL 1024^2。
AI.conclusion: 元素压缩不对称性表明存储全维度锚点比子空间摘要更有效；轨迹绑定和分数先验耦合表明反转需要匹配的前向锚点和训练好的分数网络；NARC方法实现了高质量、低存储、训练免费的反转，在多个模型和分辨率上具有泛化能力。

title: Depth-Entropy Guided Sampling for Training-Free LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become the dominant paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but it requires expensive training, curated data, and reward signals. Recent work shows that sampling from sharpened base-model distributions at test time recovers much of the RL gain, yet existing methods rely solely on output-layer likelihoods and ignore the transformer's internal forward-pass dynamics. We introduce Depth-Entropy Guided Sampling (DEGS), a training-free, test-time method that exploits layer-wise entropy collapse as an intrinsic quality signal. We observe that stronger reasoners -- including RL-posttrained variants -- exhibit a distinctive "late collapse": logit-lens decoded entropy stays elevated until deeper layers before converging. We define a per-sequence collapse depth $D(\mathbf{x})$ and a joint objective $π(\mathbf{x}) \propto p(\mathbf{x})^α\exp(βD(\mathbf{x}))$ that combines sequence likelihood with this depth-entropy structure, instantiated inside an MCMC power-sampling framework (DEGS-MCMC). Across three open-weight models and four reasoning benchmarks, this near-chance per-candidate signal compounds over the sampling trajectory into state-of-the-art training-free accuracy, with gains largest out of domain and on the harder splits -- exactly where likelihood alone falls short -- at single-digit-percent wall-clock overhead. DEGS narrowly trails an in-house GRPO reference on the math splits GRPO was trained for, yet surpasses it out of domain on GPQA for all three models, without any training, reward model, or labeled data.

AI.tldr: DEGS是一种无需训练、仅依赖测试时采样的方法，通过利用Transformer层间熵崩溃的深度信号（而非仅输出层似然）来提升推理能力，在多个基准上接近甚至超越RL后训练的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时采样方法仅利用输出层似然，忽略了Transformer内部前向传播的动力过程；同时RL虽有效但需要昂贵训练、精心策划的数据和奖励信号，因此探索无需训练、利用内部表征的测试时方法。
AI.method: 提出Depth-Entropy Guided Sampling (DEGS)，利用层间熵崩溃作为内在质量信号，定义每个序列的崩溃深度D(x)，并构建联合目标π(x) ∝ p(x)^α exp(βD(x))，在MCMC幂采样框架（DEGS-MCMC）中实例化。
AI.result: 在三个开放权重模型和四个推理基准上，DEGS实现了无需训练的最高准确率，在域外和困难子集上增益最大；在数学分项上略逊于GRPO，但在GPQA上三个模型均超越GRPO，且仅增加个位数百分比的耗时。
AI.conclusion: 利用层间熵崩溃深度作为近随机的单候选信号，在采样轨迹中累积为显著的训练无关准确率提升，证明了内部前向动态可作为有效的测试时推理增强信号。

title: Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems in Continuous Time
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Extends arXiv:2603.11560 to continuous time. Code: github.com/stevefatz95/fcms-continuous
summary: The Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems (FCMS) architecture formalizes closed-loop coordination through four abstract operators, two of which - the agent update operator $f_i$ and the environmental update operator $Ψ$ - are left axiomatically undefined in the original framework. To address this, $f_i$ is defined by Mechanism-Based Intelligence (MBI), where agents update locally through a decentralized price mechanism and economic principles, and $Ψ$ is defined by the Coupled Memory Graph Process (CMGP), a non-Markovian framework where the environment is treated as a physical substrate that records and responds to trajectory history coherently without external forcing. The resulting continuous-time FCMS instantiation achieves Lyapunov global dissipativity governed by the computable threshold $4β^2 < 2ημγ^2$. This generalizes both the discrete FCMS stability condition $4ηβ^2 < γ$ and CMGP's physical bifurcation threshold $α_c = 1/K$, confirming that memory dissipation must outpace feedback gain as a universal organizing principle. Numerical simulation with $N=2$ agents and mean-field validation at $N=10^6$ confirm the stability threshold and the self-reinforcing coordination cascade that emerges when it is violated.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了反馈耦合记忆系统(FCMS)架构，通过机制智能(MBI)定义代理更新算子$f_i$，通过耦合记忆图过程(CMGP)定义环境更新算子$\Psi$，建立了连续时间FCMS的Lyapunov全局耗散性，推导出可计算阈值$4\beta^2 < 2\eta\mu\gamma^2$，并通过数值模拟验证了记忆耗散须超过反馈增益这一普适组织原则。
AI.motivation: 原FCMS框架中代理更新算子$f_i$和环境更新算子$\Psi$被公理化地未定义，本文旨在填补这一理论空白，给出这两个算子的具体定义，并建立连续时间FCMS的稳定性条件。
AI.method: 采用机制智能(MBI)通过去中心化价格机制和经济原则定义$f_i$；采用耦合记忆图过程(CMGP)这一非马尔可夫框架将环境视为物理基质来记录和响应轨迹历史，从而定义$\Psi$。
AI.result: 推导出连续时间FCMS的Lyapunov全局耗散性阈值$4\beta^2 < 2\eta\mu\gamma^2$，该条件统一了离散FCMS稳定条件$4\eta\beta^2 < \gamma$和CMGP物理分岔阈值$\alpha_c = 1/K$；$N=2$和$N=10^6$均值的数值模拟确认了稳定性阈值及违反时涌现的自增强协调级联。
AI.conclusion: 记忆耗散必须超过反馈增益是一普适组织原则，该原则适用于离散和连续时间FCMS及CMGP框架。

title: PTEI: Integrating Personality Traits to Enhance Emotional Intelligence in Large Language Models
summary: Despite advances in Emotional Intelligence (EI), Large Language Models (LLMs) still significantly underperform humans in complex emotional reasoning. This gap originates partly from the limited incorporation of individual differences, particularly personality traits, which are fundamental to human emotional inference. To address this, we propose PTEI, a novel framework for integrating Personality Traits into Emotional Intelligence tasks using LLMs. In PTEI, MBTI and OCEAN personality traits are first extracted directly from the given emotional scenarios and then utilized as contextual knowledge within personality-aware prompts, guiding LLMs to accurately infer emotions and their underlying causes. To ensure optimal contextual grounding, we employ Contrastive Learning to construct an optimized retrieval system that surfaces emotionally and personally aligned scenarios, enhancing reasoning quality. Extensive experiments on established EI benchmarks show that PTEI enhances the Emotional Understanding (EU) capabilities of various LLMs, with the strongest improvement observed in GPT models. Combining PTEI with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning yields an additional 4 percent increase in accuracy. These findings underscore PTEI's contribution toward advancing AI systems with more sophisticated social and psychological grounding.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型在复杂情感推理中表现不足的问题，本文提出PTEI框架，通过整合MBTI和OCEAN人格特质，利用对比学习构建检索系统，以人格感知提示引导LLM进行情感理解。实验表明该方法显著提升了多种LLM的情感理解能力，结合CoT推理后准确率进一步提升4%。
AI.motivation: LLM在复杂情感推理任务中显著落后于人类，现有情感智能方法未能充分融入个体差异（尤其是人格特质），而人格特质是人类情感推断的基础。
AI.method: 提出PTEI框架：(1) 从情感场景中直接提取MBTI和OCEAN人格特质；(2) 将提取的特质作为上下文知识构建人格感知提示；(3) 采用对比学习构建优化的检索系统，检索情感和人格对齐的场景以增强推理质量。
AI.result: 在多个情感智能基准测试中，PTEI显著增强了多种LLM的情感理解能力，其中GPT模型提升最为明显；结合CoT推理后准确率额外提升4%。
AI.conclusion: PTEI通过融合人格特质的检索增强方法，有效弥补了LLM在情感推理中缺乏个体差异考量的不足，为构建具备更深层社会和心理学基础的AI系统做出了贡献。

title: Lottery and Sprint Arcade: Enabling Player-Driven Game Editing with Generative AI
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Published in The Journal of the Society for Art and Science, Vol. 25, No. 2, 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are shifting game generation from offline automation toward play-driven modification through natural language interaction. In this work, we present a play-driven game editing system that enables players to modify a retro Space Invaders - style arcade game through voice-based natural-language commands during play. Spoken instructions are interpreted by an LLM and translated into structured updates of internal configuration parameters, allowing iterative play - edit - feedback cycles in an invader-style game environment without exposing underlying system details. The game includes approximately 100 editable configuration fields controlling mechanics, visuals, interaction patterns, and audio behavior, enabling gameplay transformation through incremental parameter changes. To investigate how users experience play-driven AI-mediated editing (RQ1) and how emergent editing patterns relate to variations in player experience (RQ2), we conducted a user study combining subjective evaluations, workload measures, and log-based analysis of editing behavior. Participants were able to modify gameplay with generally positive experiences and moderate workload, and interaction outcomes did not strongly depend on prior programming experience. Editing-log analysis revealed distinct experiential tendencies: adjustments to immediately perceptible parameters were associated with higher usability, whereas edits affecting core gameplay structures were more closely associated with enjoyment. Post-session reflections further identified diverse editing strategies, including exploratory experimentation, goal-driven structural modification, and iterative parameter tuning. These findings demonstrate that voice-driven editing can support accessible, play-driven human - AI co-creation within a structured invader-style arcade game environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于语音自然语言交互的游玩驱动游戏编辑系统，允许玩家在玩《太空侵略者》风格游戏时通过语音指令修改约100个可编辑配置参数，实现人机共创。用户研究表明该系统具有良好体验和适中工作量，且编辑模式与玩家体验存在关联。
AI.motivation: 探索大型语言模型如何使游戏创作从离线自动化转向自然语言驱动的、游玩过程中的交互式修改，让不具备编程背景的玩家也能参与游戏定制。
AI.method: 构建基于LLM的语音驱动游戏编辑系统，将玩家语音指令翻译为结构化参数更新；通过用户研究（主观评估、工作量测量、日志分析）评估体验，并分析编辑模式与体验的关系。
AI.result: 参与者的编辑体验总体积极，工作量适中；编辑效果不强烈依赖于编程经验；即时感知参数调整与更高可用性相关，核心机制修改与更高享受度相关；用户呈现探索式实验、目标驱动结构修改和迭代参数调整等多样化编辑策略。
AI.conclusion: 语音驱动的自然语言编辑能够在结构化街机游戏环境中实现可访问的、游玩驱动的人机共创，为游戏修改提供了新的交互范式。

title: A Biomimetic Myoelectric Tentacle Prosthesis with Sensorless Object Detection and Vibrotactile Feedback
summary: This paper presents the design and evaluation of a myoelectric tentacle-shaped prosthesis integrating electromyographic (EMG) control, sensorless object detection, and vibrotactile feedback. The objective was to develop a responsive and intuitive assistive device that adapts to various object shapes while providing sensory feedback to the user. The system relies on EMG signals to control the motion of a flexible, biomimetic structure whose curling geometry follows a logarithmic spiral, enabling it to coil around objects. To ensure stable control, the EMG signal is normalized and filtered, and a threshold-based method identifies user intention. Object contact is detected through a slope-based analysis of motor current, eliminating the need for external sensors, and a haptic feedback strategy based on cumulative vibrotactile stimulation conveys spatial information about the tentacle's configuration. The system was evaluated through quantitative and qualitative tests. The results demonstrate a low response time (77 ms on average), enabling smooth real-time interaction; an object-detection success rate above 90%, confirming robustness despite EMG variability; and an effective haptic feedback strategy that allowed users to reliably identify the folding zone of the tentacle. The proposed biomimetic design promotes further investigation of expressive artificial limbs by prioritizing expressive functionality over adherence to a predefined, anthropomorphic form factor.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并评估了一种肌电触手状假肢，集成EMG控制、无传感器物体检测和振动触觉反馈，实现了低延迟（平均77ms）、90%以上物体检测成功率和有效触觉反馈，展示了超越传统仿人形态的表达性假肢设计潜力。
AI.motivation: 开发一种响应迅速、直观的辅助设备，能够适应不同物体形状并提供感官反馈，同时探索超越传统仿人形态假肢的表达性功能设计。
AI.method: 基于对数螺旋曲线的柔性仿生触手结构，通过EMG信号归一化与阈值方法控制运动；利用电机电流斜率分析实现无外部传感器的物体接触检测；采用累积振动触觉刺激策略传递触手构型空间信息。
AI.result: 平均响应时间77ms，实时交互流畅；物体检测成功率超过90%，对EMG变异性具有鲁棒性；用户可可靠识别触手折叠区域，触觉反馈策略有效。
AI.conclusion: 仿生设计优先考虑表达性功能而非预设的拟人形态，为未来表达性假肢的进一步研究提供了方向。

title: Lifelong Representations: A Survey on Continual Self-Supervised Learning for Vision Models
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE EAIS 2026
summary: Traditionally, continual learning has assumed access to labeled data, yet many real-world applications -- such as lifelong robotics -- require models to adapt continuously from unlabeled streams. This has led to the development of continual self-supervised learning (CSSL), a rapidly growing area that lacks a dedicated, systematic review. In this work, we present a comprehensive survey of CSSL for vision, with connections to emerging vision-language settings. First, we analyze existing evaluation protocols and highlight inconsistencies that hinder fair comparison. We then examine why self-supervised objectives exhibit improved robustness to catastrophic forgetting, relating this to task-agnostic representations and smoother loss landscapes. Next, we organize existing methods into a unified taxonomy based on their forgetting-mitigation strategies, including distillation, replay, regularization, architectural approaches, model merging, and objective-level adaptation. Finally, we identify open challenges such as scalability and the need for fast adaptability. We argue that advancing CSSL requires moving beyond small-scale benchmarks towards continual pre-training paradigms for large-scale systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了视觉领域的持续自监督学习（CSSL），分析了评估协议的不一致性、自监督目标抗遗忘的原因、现有方法的统一分类，并指出了未来挑战，主张应转向大规模持续预训练范式。
AI.motivation: 传统持续学习假设有标签数据，但实际应用（如机器人）需要从无标签流中连续适应，而CSSL领域缺乏系统性的综述。
AI.method: 通过分析现有评估协议的一致性、自监督目标抗遗忘的机制（任务无关表征、平滑损失景观），构建基于遗忘缓解策略的统一分类法（蒸馏、回放、正则化、架构方法、模型合并、目标层适应）。
AI.result: 揭示了当前CSSL评估协议存在不一致性，解释了自监督目标对灾难性遗忘更具鲁棒性的原因，并系统分类了现有方法。
AI.conclusion: CSSL需要从小规模基准转向大规模系统的持续预训练范式，以解决可扩展性和快速适应性等开放挑战。

title: Low-Rank Attention Residuals
summary: Attention Residuals replace the fixed residual sum with depthwise attention over previous sub-layer outputs in large language models (LLMs), but use each output as both a full-dimensional key and value. This couples routing with representation and makes depth-routing scores scale with the hidden width $d$. We propose Low-Rank Attention Residuals (LR-AttnRes), which keep full-dimensional residual values while using $r$-dimensional keys, with $r \ll d$, for routing. Projected LR-AttnRes emits learned low-rank keys from existing output projections, decoupling routing from residual content and achieving the best validation loss among the variants tested. Sliced LR-AttnRes uses the last $r$ dimensions of each value as the routing key, removing the auxiliary key-projection path and reducing residual-side FLOPs while still improving performance. Comprehensive sweeps show that depthwise routing can be effective with far fewer dimensions than the model width. We release code and models to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: 提出低秩注意力残差（LR-AttnRes），通过使用低维键（r维）进行深度路由，解耦路由与残差内容，在全维残差值上实现高效深度注意力。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力残差（AttnRes）将每个子层输出同时作为全维度的键和值，导致路由与表征耦合，且深度路由分数随隐藏宽度d缩放，效率低下。
AI.method: 提出LR-AttnRes：保持全维残差值，使用r维键（r<<d）进行路由。两种变体：Projected LR-AttnRes从现有输出投影中学习低秩键；Sliced LR-AttnRes使用每个值最后r维作为路由键，消除辅助投影路径。
AI.result: Projected LR-AttnRes在验证损失上达到最佳；Sliced LR-AttnRes在减少残差侧FLOPs的同时仍提升性能。实验证明深度路由只需要远小于模型宽度的维度即可有效。
AI.conclusion: 低秩键足以支撑有效的深度路由，解耦路由与残差内容可提升LLM性能，且Sliced变体在计算效率上更有优势。

title: AGM-like Paraconsistent Partial Meet Abductive Expansion Operation
summary: In his 1996 doctoral thesis, Maurice Pagnucco created the first AGM-like abductive expansion operation. Taking his operation as a basis, as well as a taxonomy -- inspired by Atocha Aliseda -- responsible for highlighting and formalizing the main components of abductive reasoning, the main aim of this paper is to present a new paraconsistent AGM-like abductive expansion operation -- capable of assimilating contradictory explanatory hypotheses without trivialization and the consequent absurd epistemic state -- with its postulates and its transitively relational partial meet construction. To a large extent, the formal development presented in this paper was only made possible by the recent creation of the paraconsistent logic RCbr, an LFI (Logics of Formal Inconsistencies) that establishes properties especially relevant to belief revision contexts, in particular, the ability to be self-extensional -- i.e., to satisfy the replacement property. This is the first of two papers: the paraconsistent abductive expansion operation announced here -- which is part of a new system called AGMpabd -- despite bringing many interesting features, does not assign any relevant epistemic role to the paraconsistent operators of negation and consistency. Only in a second paper will an analogous paraconsistent abductive expansion operation -- which is part of another new system, AGMcircabd -- be enhanced in this direction. Nevertheless, to the best of my knowledge, the operation developed in this paper is the first of its kind in the AGM literature.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Maurice Pagnucco的博士论文和Atocha Aliseda的分类学，提出了一种新的次协调AGM式溯因扩展操作（AGMpabd系统），能在不导致平凡化和认知荒谬状态的前提下吸收矛盾性解释假设，并给出了其公设和传递关系偏交构造。
AI.motivation: 现有AGM式溯因扩展操作在处理矛盾性解释假设时会导致平凡化和认知荒谬状态，缺乏能够容纳不一致解释假设的次协调版本。
AI.method: 基于Pagnucco的溯因扩展操作和Aliseda的分类学，利用新创立的次协调逻辑RCbr（一种LFI，满足自外延性/替换性质），构建了传递关系偏交构造，并制定了相应的公设。
AI.result: 提出了首个次协调AGM式溯因扩展操作（AGMpabd系统），该操作能够吸收矛盾性假设而不导致平凡化，但尚未赋予次协调否定算子和一致性算子相关的认知角色。
AI.conclusion: 本文是两部分工作中的第一部分；所提出的操作是AGM文献中首个此类操作，为后续在AGMcircabd系统中增强否定和一致性算子的认知角色奠定了基础。

title: One mechanism for many mental spaces: a shared router over a value slot in language models
summary: Language builds discourse contexts other than the actual: a painting, a belief, a memory, a hypothetical. Each is a mental space in which the same entity can take a different value, as when a flower is red in reality but purple in a portrait. Formal semantics keeps these contexts apart because their logics differ (modal, temporal, doxastic, depictive); Fauconnier's mental-space theory treats them as one space-building operation. We ask which of these a transformer language model implements, and find a mechanistic version of Fauconnier's unification. The model uses one router/slot format across the inventory: a reusable value slot stores attributed content, and a causally manipulable router (the space index) selects which space is read. A subspace trained with Distributed Alignment Search to control one space type, counterfactual, belief, fictional, or temporal, also controls the others, well above a random floor, on three model families; belief, which formal semantics marks as a distinct case, is not specially separated. The router is low-rank, composes additively with entity identity, and acts through a few late-layer heads. Two further results show the mechanism drives inference and composes: a subspace trained on a rule-derived conclusion flips what the model infers while dissociating from what it reports, and composing space-builders mints a fresh router over the shared slot. This paper establishes the cross-type generality. A companion paper develops belief in depth, because of its special status in philosophy, psychology, and linguistics (epistemology, theory of mind, and propositional attitude reports).

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformer语言模型在机制上实现了Fauconnier的“空间建构”统一理论：模型使用一个可复用的价值槽（value slot）存储归因内容，并通过一个因果可操纵的路由器（空间索引）来选择读取哪个心理空间。跨反事实、信念、虚构、时间等多种空间类型，模型共享同一路由/槽格式，且信念在机制上并未被特殊区分。路由器是低秩的、与实体身份加法组合，并通过少数后层注意力头发挥作用。
AI.motivation: 形式语义学将不同语境（模态、时间、信念、描绘等）分开处理，因为它们具有不同的逻辑；而Fauconnier的心理空间理论认为它们共享同一空间建构操作。本文想知道Transformer语言模型实现了哪种方案，即模型是否在机制上统一了不同类型的心理空间。
AI.method: 使用Distributed Alignment Search训练一个子空间来控制单一空间类型（如反事实、信念、虚构、时间），然后测试该子空间能否控制其他空间类型；分析路由器的低秩结构、与实体身份的加法组合方式，以及其在后层注意力头中的实现位置。
AI.result: 针对某一空间类型训练的子空间，在其他空间类型上也有显著控制能力（远高于随机基线），信念并未被特殊分离；路由器是低秩的，与实体身份加法组合，通过少数后层注意力头实现；该机制驱动推理：基于规则训练的子空间能翻转模型推断结果，且与模型报告的内容可分离；空间建构操作可以组合产生新的路由器。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在机制上实现了Fauconnier式的统一空间建构，而非形式语义学的分类型处理。这为理解语言模型如何处理反事实推理、信念归因、虚构理解等能力提供了机制层面的解释。信念在哲学、心理学和语言学中有特殊地位，将在后续论文中深入探讨。

title: FaciliTrain: Practicing Facilitation Skills through AI-Simulated Group Dialogue
summary: Skilled facilitation supports inclusive small-group dialogue, but deliberate practice is hard to scale: it depends on expert coaches, live practice partners, and iterative feedback. We present FaciliTrain, a voice-based training system in which learners step into the facilitator role of an AI-simulated multi-participant conversation, apply five evidence-based techniques, and receive structured AI feedback to support reflection. We report findings from a mixed-methods study with 24 participants, conducted as a formative study (N = 12) and a controlled pilot (N = 12; 6 treatment, 6 control). Both conditions achieved comparable accuracy on a live evaluation task, though treatment participants' self-rated comfort declined significantly while control participants' comfort improved (p = .018). Reflexive thematic analysis identifies four themes: the taxonomy externalizes implicit facilitation intuitions; Making Connections is the most cognitively demanding technique; voice acts as a deliberate-response forcing function; and participants overwhelmingly preferred AI feedback over self-practice. We discuss design implications for voice-based, AI-supported interpersonal skill training at scale.

AI.tldr: FaciliTrain是一个基于语音的培训系统，让学习者扮演AI模拟多人对话中的 facilitator 角色，应用五种循证技巧并接收结构化AI反馈。24人混合方法研究（12人形成性+12人对照实验）显示，两组在实时评估任务上准确率相当，但治疗组自评舒适度显著下降而对照组提升（p=.018）。主题分析识别出四个主题：分类法外化隐性促动直觉、建立连接是最认知密集的技巧、语音作为深思熟虑回应的强制函数、参与者压倒性偏好AI反馈而非自我练习。讨论了大规模AI支持的人际技能语音培训的设计启示。
AI.motivation: 专家促进式的小组对话培训依赖专业教练、实时练习伙伴和迭代反馈，难以规模化。研究者希望开发一种可扩展的、基于AI的语音训练系统，让学习者无需真人专家也能练习促进技巧。
AI.method: 开发了FaciliTrain语音训练系统，学习者扮演AI模拟的多人对话中的facilitator，应用五种循证促进技巧（如建立连接、平衡参与等），系统提供结构化AI反馈。采用混合方法：形成性研究（N=12）和对照实验（N=12，6治疗+6对照），治疗组使用FaciliTrain，对照组进行自我练习，随后进行实时评估任务和反思性主题分析。
AI.result: 两组在实时评估任务上的准确率相当。治疗组自评舒适度显著下降（p=.018），而对照组舒适度提升。主题分析发现：分类法帮助外化隐性促动直觉；"建立连接"是认知要求最高的技巧；语音环境迫使学习者深思熟虑后再回应；参与者压倒性偏好AI反馈而非自我练习。
AI.conclusion: FaciliTrain展示了AI支持的语音训练在人际技巧培训中的潜力，但自评舒适度下降提示需要进一步优化反馈设计以维持学习信心。研究为大规模部署AI辅助的语音式人际技能培训提供了设计启示。

title: RASR: Range-Aware Scale Recovery for Metric UAV Navigation
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Technical report for the UAVM 2026 PairUAV Challenge
summary: Under Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) denial, a UAV controller still needs a distance and heading command it can execute, making accurate metric last-meter navigation essential. Dense pair-geometry foundation models transfer relative structure well, yet the distance scale of their raw metric outputs remains poorly calibrated. Under the relative error metric of PairUAV, correcting only the average scale can still leave costly, distance-dependent residuals near the goal. To address this scale mismatch, Range-Aware Scale Recovery (RASR) separates a transferable scale-recovery core from a protocol-specific calibration module in a per-pair system fixed at inference. The core compresses frozen Matching And Stereo 3D Reconstruction (MASt3R)-style geometry into a compact descriptor and uses global calibration to recover the dominant metric signal. Range-bucket residual correction and command-grid alignment stay inside the calibration module, so they match the command format and evaluation protocol of PairUAV. On the UAVs in Multimedia 2026 PairUAV online evaluation, RASR reaches a total score of 0.003189. Under the PairUAV protocol, frozen pair geometry thus yields stable per-pair distance and heading estimates, while every protocol-specific adjustment stays confined to a calibration module fixed before inference. Code and materials are available at https://github.com/lht-research/rasr-pairuav.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Range-Aware Scale Recovery (RASR)方法，解决GNSS拒止环境下UAV末端导航中深度基础模型距离尺度校准问题，通过分离可迁移的尺度恢复核心与协议特定校准模块，在PairUAV评测中取得0.003189总分。
AI.motivation: 在GNSS拒止环境下，UAV控制器仍需精确的距离和航向指令，但现有稠密配对几何基础模型的距离尺度校准不良，仅校正平均尺度会在目标附近留下代价高昂的距离相关残差。
AI.method: RASR将尺度恢复核心与协议特定校准模块分离：核心利用冻结的MASt3R风格几何特征压缩为紧凑描述子，通过全局校准恢复主导度量信号；校准模块包含距离桶残差校正和指令网格对齐，适配PairUAV的指令格式与评估协议。
AI.result: 在Multimedia 2026 PairUAV在线评测中，RASR达到0.003189的总分，验证了冻结配对几何在每对距离和航向估计上的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的配对几何能够产生稳定的逐对距离和航向估计，协议特定调整可完全限定在推理前固定的校准模块内，实现了可迁移的尺度恢复。

title: Adversarially Guided Diffusion for LiDAR Range Image Synthesis
comment: Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Secure and Trustworthy AI (STAI 2026), co-located with the European Conference on Machine Learning and Principles and Practice of Knowledge Discovery in Databases (ECML PKDD 2026)
summary: LiDAR semantic segmentation is a key perception task in autonomous driving, where false predictions can affect downstream planning and safety-critical decision-making. Although adversarial attacks, and specifically adversarial examples, have been widely studied for image classification and 3D point cloud segmentation, unrestricted adversarial examples remain largely unexplored in the space of 2D range images, which are projections of 3D point clouds. The proposed method is, to the best of our knowledge, the first diffusion-based unrestricted adversarial attack against 2D range-image segmentation, using adversarial guidance from a segmentation loss. By applying guidance directly during sampling, the method produces unrestricted adversarial examples that remain close to the learned LiDAR data manifold while inducing structured segmentation errors. Experiments on the SemanticKITTI dataset using RangeNet++ and CENet segmentation networks demonstrate that the attack provides adjustable degradation across guidance strengths and transfers across segmentation architectures. Compared with norm-bounded FGSM and SegPGD baselines, the proposed attack offers a distinct effectiveness-realism trade-off, achieving controllable white-box and transfer degradation while maintaining competitive distributional and visual realism.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出基于扩散模型的无限制对抗攻击方法，针对2D距离图像语义分割任务，通过分割损失引导采样生成位于LiDAR数据流形上的对抗样本，实现可控且可迁移的分割性能下降。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击研究主要集中在图像分类和3D点云分割，而针对2D距离图像（3D点云投影）的无限制对抗攻击几乎空白；同时，此类攻击可能影响自动驾驶的规划和安全性决策。
AI.method: 基于扩散模型，在采样过程中直接施加分割损失作为对抗引导，生成位于LiDAR学习数据流形上的无限制对抗样本，诱导产生结构化的分割错误。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI数据集上使用RangeNet++和CENet网络进行实验，该攻击方法实现了随引导强度可调的降质效果，并在不同分割架构间具有可迁移性；与基于范数约束的FGSM和SegPGD基线相比，提供了有效性与真实性之间的可控权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该扩散引导的无限制对抗攻击在白盒和迁移场景下均能实现可控的降质，同时保持竞争性的分布真实性和视觉真实性。

title: FedCausal-Dyn: A Causal-Dynamic Paradigm for Federated Learning under Dynamic Feature Drift
summary: This paper addresses the challenging problem of dynamic feature drift in federated learning, where data distributions evolve across clients and over time -- a common scenario in real-world applications like financial technology. Existing approaches often assume static drift, limiting their effectiveness in non-stationary environments. To overcome this, we propose \textbf{FedCausal-Dyn}, a novel federated learning framework built on a causal-dynamic paradigm. Its key innovation is \textit{causal-domain feature separation}, which disentangles domain-invariant causal features from spurious, domain-specific variations via specialized projection heads and adversarial training. This enables \textit{reliable and dynamic prototype aggregation}, weighting local class prototypes by estimated reliability before global aggregation. We further introduce \textit{causal-feature guided collaborative regularization}, unifying prototype contrastive alignment and domain invariance into a cohesive objective. Extensive experiments on three federated domain generalization benchmarks demonstrate that FedCausal-Dyn consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with the highest average accuracy and the most stable results. Ablation studies confirm each component's critical contribution. Our work provides a robust and principled solution for federated learning under dynamic feature drift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedCausal-Dyn，一种基于因果-动态范式的联邦学习框架，通过因果域特征分离、动态原型聚合和因果特征引导的协同正则化，有效解决动态特征漂移问题，在多个基准上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习方法通常假设静态漂移，在非平稳环境（如金融科技）中效果有限，无法有效处理客户端间及随时间演变的动态特征分布变化。
AI.method: FedCausal-Dyn包含三个核心创新：(1) 因果域特征分离：通过专用投影头和对抗训练，将域不变因果特征与伪相关的域特定变异分离；(2) 可靠的动态原型聚合：在全局聚合前根据估计的可靠性加权局部类原型；(3) 因果特征引导的协同正则化：将原型对比对齐与域不变性统一为连贯的优化目标。
AI.result: 在三个联邦域泛化基准上的实验表明，FedCausal-Dyn持续达到最先进性能，具有最高的平均准确率和最稳定的结果。消融研究证实了每个组件的关键贡献。
AI.conclusion: 本文为动态特征漂移下的联邦学习提供了一个稳健且原理性的解决方案，实证验证了因果-动态范式的有效性。

title: Coresets Before Score Sets: Evaluation-Unsupervised Prompt Subset Selection for LLM Benchmarks
summary: We study LLM benchmark coreset selection: selecting a small subset of prompts over multiple benchmarks whose induced model scores and rankings approximate those obtained from the full benchmark suite. In evaluation-unsupervised benchmark coreset selection (our approach), the selection algorithm uses no model evaluation outcomes, and operates on a fine granularity by producing subsets of prompts over multiple benchmarks rather than producing a sub-collection of entire benchmarks. We use submodular subset selection, and we develop and evaluate many different submodular functions for this purpose, including determinantal point process (DPP) based approaches, submodular mutual information functions, and facility location-based functions. On a new large-scale suite of 35 heterogeneous benchmarks spanning five different capability categories, 18 frontier LLMs, and over 61K prompts, we find that the facility location (FL) function operating exclusively on inexpensive semantic prompt embeddings preserves LLM scores better than twelve separate score-based and diversity-based baselines, across a range of coreset budgets. Moreover, we show our proposed objective is not limited to the evaluation-unsupervised regime: in the setting where only a handful of whole benchmarks must be selected and a large amount of model scores are available, the same objective matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the MMLU and MTEB leaderboards, while being substantially cheaper to compute. Together, our results suggest that submodularity, in general, is a strong and reliable tool for benchmark compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督评估的LLM基准测试核心集选择方法，利用子模子集选择（特别是基于设施定位的函数）在仅依赖语义嵌入的情况下，从35个异构基准、18个前沿LLM和超过6.1万个提示中选出子集，其模型得分和排名逼近全量基准结果，且在计算效率上优于12种基线方法。
AI.motivation: LLM评估成本高昂，现有基准测试规模庞大，亟需一种高效的核心集选择方法，在不进行模型评估的情况下压缩基准测试规模，同时保留模型得分的排序准确性。
AI.method: 采用评估无监督的基准核心集选择范式，利用子模子集选择，对比了多种子模函数（包括基于行列式点过程、子模互信息和设施定位的函数），并基于廉价语义嵌入完成选择。
AI.result: 在35个异构基准、18个LLM和6.1万提示的大规模实验中，设施定位函数在多个核心集预算下均优于12种基线方法；在少量整基准选择的场景下，该方法以更低计算成本匹配或超越MMLU和MTEB榜单的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 子模性是一种强大且可靠的基准压缩工具，设施定位函数在无监督核心集选择中表现出色。

title: Which Languages Transfer Best to Warlpiri? A Similarity-Based Study for Low-Resource ASR
summary: This paper investigates how language similarity can improve cross-lingual transfer for automatic speech recognition (ASR) in extremely low-resource settings. Warlpiri, an Australian Aboriginal language, has very limited transcribed speech data, making transfer learning essential. We propose a framework combining acoustic similarity from pre-trained speech models with linguistic similarity based on typology, phoneme inventories, grammatical, and syntactic features to rank high-resource source languages and evaluate their effectiveness for ASR transfer to Warlpiri. Experiments with Whisper show that acoustically and typologically similar languages outperform monolingual and multilingual baselines. Assamese and Hindi achieve substantial reductions in word and character error rates. Correlation analysis further indicates that acoustic similarity is the strongest predictor of fine-tuning performance, while phoneme inventory and typological similarity better explain zero-shot transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结合声学相似度与语言类型学相似度（包括音素库、语法和句法特征）的方法，为极低资源语言Warlpiri筛选高资源源语言进行ASR迁移学习。在Whisper上的实验表明，声学和类型学相似的源语言优于单语和多语基线，其中声学相似度是微调性能的最强预测因子，而音素库和类型学相似度更能解释零样本迁移表现。
AI.motivation: Warlpiri（澳大利亚原住民语言）的标注语音数据极度稀缺，现有跨语言迁移方法未能充分利用语言相似性信息，需要更有效的源语言选择策略来提升极低资源场景下的ASR性能。
AI.method: 提出一个双维度框架：(1) 利用预训练语音模型计算声学相似度；(2) 基于类型学特征（语言类型、音素库、语法和句法特征）计算语言相似度。综合二者对高资源源语言排序，并评估其对Warlpiri的ASR迁移效果，使用Whisper模型进行实验。
AI.result: 声学和类型学相似的源语言（如阿萨姆语和印地语）在词错误率和字符错误率上显著优于单语和多语基线。相关性分析表明，声学相似度是微调性能的最强预测因子，而音素库相似度和类型学相似度更能解释零样本迁移表现。
AI.conclusion: 在极低资源ASR迁移中，声学相似度和类型学相似度对不同迁移范式（微调 vs. 零样本）的贡献存在差异，综合多维语言相似性可有效指导源语言选择，缓解数据稀缺问题。

title: What to Distinguish and How? Opportunities and Challenges of Augmenting Multiple, Cluttered Objects in Complex Scenes for People with Low Vision
comment: 24 pages, 11 figures. Accepted to ASSETS '26 (28th International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility)
summary: People with low vision (PLV) struggle to perceive complex scenes like busy kitchens and crowded streets, which contain many objects, visual clutter, and dynamic elements. Prior AR systems for low vision either enhance low-level visual features or augment task-relevant objects for single tasks in simple settings, leaving multi-object augmentation in complex scenes underexplored. Informed by a formative study characterizing important objects and their perceived importance for PLV, we built SceneGlance, a wearable AR system that recognizes important objects and visually distinguishes them by importance level. Through a controlled lab study with 12 PLV in a mock-up kitchen scene and a free-form think-aloud study with 13 PLV navigating an outdoor route, we found that AR distinction on object importance shifted PLV's attention toward objects of higher importance, and supported perception strategies such as building mental snapshots from the augmentation distribution and hierarchical scanning by importance. However, this attention shift came with a tradeoff, as augmenting many objects reduced overall scene recall.
