The studies also surfaced challenges posed by AR augmentations in complex scenes, such as adjacent augmentations blending or interfering with each other, yielding design implications for more practical AR vision enhancement systems in the complex real world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SceneGlance，一种可穿戴AR系统，通过识别并按照重要性级别视觉区分场景中的物体，帮助低视力用户在复杂场景中感知环境。实验表明该方法能引导注意力到重要物体，但多物体增强会降低整体场景回忆。
AI.motivation: 低视力用户在复杂场景（如拥挤厨房、繁忙街道）中感知困难，现有AR系统要么增强低层视觉特征，要么针对单一任务增强特定物体，缺乏在复杂场景中对多物体进行重要性增强的研究。
AI.method: 通过前期形成性研究确定重要物体及其感知重要性，构建SceneGlance可穿戴AR系统，识别场景中物体并按重要性级别进行视觉区分增强。
AI.result: 在12名低视力用户的厨房场景受控实验和13名低视力用户的户外路线出声思维研究中发现：AR重要性区分将注意力引向高重要性物体，支持了通过增强分布构建心理快照和按重要性分层扫描的感知策略；但增强多物体降低了整体场景回忆，且复杂场景中存在邻近增强融合或干扰的问题。
AI.conclusion: 基于物体重要性的AR增强能有效引导低视力用户注意力，但存在注意力转移与场景回忆之间的权衡，需要解决复杂场景中增强间的相互干扰问题，为实际AR视觉增强系统提供了设计启示。

title: TS-Mask VLA: 2D Temporal-Spatial Masking for Vision-Language-Action Model with Effective Bridging
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to understand natural-language instructions and visual observations, and to generate and execute corresponding actions as embodied agents. Recently, autoregressive token-based action generation has driven the development of many representative VLA models. However, this paradigm often reduces action generation to next-token prediction, thereby lacking explicit modeling of the spatiotemporal structure of action sequences and the disentanglement between vision-language representations and actions, which can limit performance in long-horizon and complex scenarios. In this paper, we propose TS-Mask VLA, a vision-language-action framework for robot manipulation. TS-Mask VLA is built upon two key designs: (1) a Discrete Diffusion Action Expert equipped with a Bridge Attention conditioning bridge, which enables multi-layer conditioning from the VLM and facilitates more accurate and stable action generation; and (2) a temporal-spatial 2D masking strategy for discrete action tokens that strengthens the model's understanding of cross-time dependencies and inter-dimensional coupling, leading to more structurally consistent action sequences. We conduct extensive experiments on simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks. On LIBERO, TS-Mask VLA achieves a 95.7 percent average success rate with only 0.5B parameters, outperforming significantly larger models. On CALVIN, it attains the best average sequence length of 4.19 and strong long-horizon performance. Comprehensive analyses and ablations further validate the effectiveness of our design.

AI.tldr: TS-Mask VLA提出了一种基于离散扩散动作专家和时空2D掩码策略的视觉-语言-动作框架，在机器人操作任务中以0.5B参数实现95.7%的成功率，超越更大模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的自回归token-based动作生成范式将动作生成简化为下一个token预测，缺乏对动作序列时空结构的显式建模以及视觉-语言表示与动作之间的解耦，限制了模型在长时域和复杂场景下的性能。
AI.method: (1) 离散扩散动作专家（Discrete Diffusion Action Expert）结合桥接注意力（Bridge Attention）条件桥接，实现VLM的多层条件注入，提升动作生成的准确性和稳定性；(2) 时空2D掩码策略（temporal-spatial 2D masking），增强模型对跨时间依赖和跨维度耦合的理解，生成结构一致的动作序列。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上以0.5B参数达到95.7%平均成功率，超越显著更大的模型；在CALVIN上获得最佳平均序列长度4.19，展现强长时域性能。
AI.conclusion: TS-Mask VLA通过扩散模型和时空掩码设计有效提升了VLA模型在机器人操作中的动作生成质量，特别是在长时域和复杂任务上表现优异。

title: MVMGNN;Multi-View Masked Graph Neural Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis using Structural MRI
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a common neurodegenerative disorder, and early diagnosis is of great significance for delaying disease progression and enabling timely intervention. Mild cognitive impairment (MCI), which represents an intermediate clinical stage between cognitively normal aging and AD. Structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI) provides detailed characterization of anatomical structures and plays an important role in AD-related brain analysis. However, existing sMRI-based brain network methods typically rely on a single graph construction strategy, limiting their ability to jointly capture spatial relationships and morphological similarities between brain regions. To address these issues, this paper proposes an sMRI-based multi-view masked graph neural network model (MVMGNN) for AD diagnosis. A joint node-edge masking mechanism is proposed to simultaneously select radiomics feature dimensions and structural connections, reducing redundancy during graph learning. Furthermore, a patient-level cross-view gated fusion mechanism is proposed to integrate multi-view representations. Experimental results on the ADNI dataset demonstrate that MVMGNN outperforms several competing approaches in AD classification. Interpretability analysis further demonstrates that MVMGNN is able to identify key brain regions associated with AD, providing useful insights into discriminative patterns in sMRI-based brain networks.Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/chenzhao2023/MVMGNN_AD

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于sMRI的多视图掩码图神经网络模型（MVMGNN），通过联合节点-边掩码机制和跨视图门控融合机制，用于阿尔茨海默病的早期诊断，在ADNI数据集上取得了优于现有方法的分类性能。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病早期诊断至关重要，但现有基于sMRI的脑网络方法通常依赖单一图构建策略，无法同时捕捉脑区之间的空间关系和形态相似性，限制了诊断能力。
AI.method: 提出MVMGNN模型，包含两个核心模块：(1) 联合节点-边掩码机制，同时选择影像组学特征维度和结构连接，减少图学习中的冗余；(2) 患者级跨视图门控融合机制，整合多视图表示。
AI.result: 在ADNI数据集上，MVMGNN在AD分类任务中优于多个对比方法，且可解释性分析表明模型能够识别与AD相关的关键脑区。
AI.conclusion: MVMGNN有效提升了sMRI脑网络的AD诊断性能，为理解AD的判别性模式提供了有用见解。

title: Mitigating Early Training Collapse in CTR Models
summary: Deep neural models for click-through rate prediction often exhibit a sharp decline in validation performance immediately after the first training epoch despite continued improvement in training loss. This instability restricts effective learning and limits model performance. In this study, we analyze this behavior using large-scale industrial datasets and evaluate practical mitigation strategies. While reducing the learning rate provides only incremental gains, controlling feature sparsity yields substantial improvements. Removing highly sparse features and aggregating infrequent feature values stabilizes training, extends useful learning beyond a single epoch, and improves both offline evaluation metrics and online system performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了点击率预测深度模型在首个训练轮次后验证性能骤降的问题，发现控制特征稀疏性（去除高稀疏特征、聚合低频特征值）能有效稳定训练、延长有效学习周期，并提升离线与在线性能，而降低学习率效果有限。
AI.motivation: 深度CTR模型在首个epoch后验证性能骤降，限制了有效学习与模型表现，亟需分析原因并寻求实用缓解策略。
AI.method: 利用大规模工业数据集分析该行为，对比降低学习率与控制特征稀疏性两种策略，后者包括去除高稀疏特征与聚合低频特征值。
AI.result: 降低学习率仅带来增量改进；控制特征稀疏性显著稳定训练，使模型能在单epoch后继续有效学习，并提升离线评估指标与在线系统性能。
AI.conclusion: 特征稀疏性是导致CTR模型训练不稳定的关键因素，通过控制特征稀疏性可有效缓解验证性能骤降问题，从而提升模型最终表现。

title: A Dynamic Scene Interaction Reasoning Framework for Scene-level Lane-Change Intention and Trajectory Prediction of Multiple Interacting Vehicles
summary: Safe motion planning in advanced driver-assistance systems and autonomous vehicles requires an accurate understanding of how the surrounding traffic scene is likely to evolve. However, many existing lane-change prediction methods remain centered on a single target vehicle, while multi-agent forecasting approaches often describe scene evolution only through future positions and provide limited explicit information about the maneuver associated with each vehicle. This study proposes a dynamic scene graph attention framework that predicts the lane-change intention and future trajectory of every relevant vehicle within a local traffic scene. The scene is represented as a time-varying interaction graph in which vehicles are modeled as nodes and their spatial and kinematic relationships are encoded through explicit edge features. Temporal graph-attention message passing captures evolving inter-vehicle dependencies and pre-maneuver cues, while an intention-guided decoder links each predicted maneuver to its corresponding future motion. A scene-level consistency objective further encourages compatible multi-vehicle futures. Experiments on the NGSIM I-80, NGSIM US-101, and highD datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over competing baselines. DSiGAT achieves intention prediction accuracies of 90.12% and 90.97% on NGSIM I-80 and US-101, respectively, and reduces trajectory RMSE by up to 52.94% relative to the strongest baseline. It also produces lower inter-agent collision rates and joint displacement errors, indicating more coherent scene-level predictions. Ablation, sensitivity, robustness, and qualitative analyses further validate the contribution of the proposed components and the effectiveness of the scene-focused formulation.

AI.tldr: 提出动态场景图注意力框架(DSiGAT)，通过图神经网络同时预测交通场景中所有车辆的换道意图和未来轨迹，在NGSIM和highD数据集上达到90%以上的意图预测准确率，轨迹RMSE降低最多52.94%。
AI.motivation: 现有换道预测方法多聚焦单一目标车辆，而多智能体轨迹预测方法仅预测未来位置，缺乏对每个车辆具体机动意图的显式建模。
AI.method: 构建时变交互图（车辆为节点，空间/运动学关系为边特征），通过时序图注意力消息传递捕捉车辆间动态依赖和预机动线索，再通过意图引导解码器将预测的机动与未来运动关联，并引入场景级一致性损失促进多车未来轨迹的兼容性。
AI.result: 意图预测准确率在NGSIM I-80达90.12%、US-101达90.97%；轨迹RMSE相比最强基线降低最多52.94%；碰撞率和联合位移误差更低，场景级预测更一致。
AI.conclusion: DSiGAT通过显式建模场景级交互和意图-轨迹联合预测，显著优于现有方法，消融和鲁棒性分析验证了各组件的有效性。

title: Language Re-generation: An investigation into information locality effects on reconstruction
summary: Information locality, the tendency for syntactically related words to appear close together, shapes both human language processing and language model learning. While prior work has examined whether language models can acquire impossible languages, it remains unclear whether they can recover natural language from such input and what this reveals about their inductive biases. We address this by complementing learnability-based approaches with a reconstruction framework: fine-tuning GPT-2 models pre-trained on impossible languages to reconstruct natural English from three perturbation types. Our findings show that the recovered structures exhibit shorter dependency lengths than the original text, mirroring the locality preference observed in unconstrained language model generation and providing a quantitative signature of an architectural bias that learnability experiments alone do not reveal. Recovery difficulty increases with the degree of locality disruption. Structural recovery (dependency Triple F1) dissociates from surface recovery (Exact Match), while fluency dissociates from faithful reconstruction under global shuffling. Sentence length further modulates performance: longer sentences facilitate recovery when local structure is preserved but lead to complete collapse under global shuffling. Finally, recovery difficulty tracks learnability difficulty across perturbation types, suggesting that information locality is the shared constraint governing both.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过重构框架（在无法学习自然语言上预训练的GPT-2模型再微调以重建自然英语）发现，信息局部性（句法相关词倾向于邻近出现）是语言模型处理的核心约束，即使从破坏局部性的输入中也能恢复出更短的依存距离结构，且恢复难度与局部性破坏程度成正比，恢复与学习难度在不同扰动类型间呈现一致模式。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽考察了语言模型能否习得不可能语言，但尚不清楚它们是否能从这类输入中恢复自然语言，以及这揭示了何种归纳偏置。本文希望超越仅依赖可学习性的方法，通过重构框架揭示模型内在的架构偏置。
AI.method: 采用重构框架：在三种扰动类型（破坏信息局部性）的"不可能语言"上预训练GPT-2模型，再微调以重建自然英语。通过分析重建结构的依存距离、精确匹配率、依存三元组F1等指标，评估恢复难度及与可学习性的关系。
AI.result: 1) 恢复的结构比原始文本具有更短的依存距离，反映了局部性偏好；2) 恢复难度随局部性破坏程度增加而增加；3) 结构恢复（依存三元组F1）与表面恢复（精确匹配）分离，流畅性与忠实重建在全局打乱下分离；4) 句长调节恢复效果：保留局部结构时长句更易恢复，全局打乱下则完全崩溃；5) 恢复难度与学习难度在不同扰动类型间呈一致趋势。
AI.conclusion: 信息局部性是同时支配语言模型学习与重构的共享约束。重构框架能够揭示可学习性实验单独无法提供的定量特征（如依存距离偏好），为理解语言模型的归纳偏置提供了新视角。

title: When Context Dominates: Multimodal Signatures of Takeover Readiness Under Varying Hazard and Cognitive Load Conditions
summary: Semi-automated driving systems promise to reduce crashes by assisting with perception and control, yet they simultaneously introduce additional human factors challenges by requiring drivers to monitor automation and rapidly resume control when failures occur. Prolonged passive monitoring can degrade vigilance, delay reactions, and increase takeover risk, but the extent to which distraction, hazard context, and drivers' underlying cognitive and physiological states jointly shape takeover performance remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates these interacting factors using a controlled, within-subjects driving simulator experiment that crosses two hazard types (dynamic pedestrian and static crash events) with three levels of secondary task engagement (no task, conversation, and working memory load). Driver responses were assessed using a multimodal sensing framework that integrates vehicle-dynamics measures, subjective workload ratings, autonomic physiology (electrodermal activity and heart rate variability), and prefrontal cortical activation measured with functional near-infrared spectroscopy. Results show that hazard context is the primary determinant of takeover behavior, with pedestrian events producing longer and more variable maneuvers and crash events yielding faster and more stable responses. Secondary tasks exerted smaller effects on objective vehicle control, while internal-state measures showed more variable task-related patterns. These findings highlight the importance of jointly considering environmental context and human state when evaluating takeover readiness and designing driver monitoring systems. This study lays the groundwork for adaptive, context-aware strategies that support safer human-automation collaboration in semi-automated vehicles.

AI.tldr: 本文通过驾驶模拟实验，研究了半自动化驾驶中分心任务、危险情境（行人事件与碰撞事件）以及驾驶员认知和生理状态对接管表现的交互影响。结果表明，危险情境是接管行为的主要决定因素，分心任务影响较小，为设计自适应驾驶员监控系统提供了依据。
AI.motivation: 半自动化驾驶系统虽有望减少碰撞，但要求驾驶员监控自动化并在故障时接管，这引入了人为因素挑战。长时间被动监控会降低警觉性、延迟反应并增加接管风险。然而，分心、危险情境以及驾驶员认知和生理状态如何共同影响接管表现，目前尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用受试者内设计的驾驶模拟器实验，交叉两个因素：两种危险情境（动态行人事件和静态碰撞事件）与三种次级任务参与水平（无任务、对话任务、工作记忆负荷任务）。通过多模态传感框架评估驾驶员反应，整合了车辆动力学测量、主观工作负荷评分、自主神经生理指标（皮肤电活动和心率变异性）以及前额叶皮层激活（功能近红外光谱）。
AI.result: 危险情境是接管行为的主要决定因素：行人事件导致更长、更多变的接管操作，碰撞事件则产生更快、更稳定的响应。次级任务对客观车辆控制的影响较小，而内部状态指标表现出更可变的任务相关模式。
AI.conclusion: 强调了在评估接管准备度和设计驾驶员监控系统时，需同时考虑环境情境和人类状态的重要性。该研究为开发适应性的、情境感知的策略以支持半自动驾驶车辆中更安全的人机协作奠定了基础。

title: More Structure, Not More Capacity: Object-Centric Representations for Visuomotor Imitation Learning
summary: Robotic manipulation policies rely on pre-trained vision models that give either a global scene embedding or a dense patch grid. Both mix task-relevant and task-irrelevant features. Object-centric slot representations are a structured alternative: they group features into a few per-object slots. We test what this structure buys on ManiSkill3 PickCube-v1, with a frozen encoder and a held-out-seed evaluation. Holding the policy, goal token, rendering, and calibration fixed and changing only the encoder, a frozen object-centric SPOT representation (DINO ViT-B/16 + Slot Attention) reaches 55.0$\pm$2.9% success, 22.4% above a dense DINO global-feature baseline (32.6 $\pm$ 1.5%), with the same trainable policy and no encoder fine-tuning. More tokens alone do not help: a dense patch grid with 16x the tokens performs no better than the global feature. Adding an explicit 2D spatial goal and native-resolution rendering raises the full system to 68.7$\pm$4.2%, just below a privileged 3D-oracle upper bound (71.7$\pm$4.1%). An automated kinematic failure taxonomy then separates spatial-precision (Near-Miss) failures from object-tracking (No-Grasp) failures: spatial grounding reduces Near-Miss while leaving No- Grasp unchanged. The same taxonomy transfers to the harder StackCube-v1 and points to occlusion as the main bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 在ManiSkill3 PickCube-v1任务中，使用冻结的物体中心化SPOT表示（DINO ViT-B/16 + Slot Attention）达到55.0%成功率，比密集DINO全局特征基线高22.4%，且无需微调编码器；结合2D空间目标和原生分辨率渲染后达到68.7%，接近3D oracle上限71.7%。运动学失败分类揭示了空间精度误差（Near-Miss）和目标追踪误差（No-Grasp）的不同性质。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人操作策略依赖的预训练视觉模型（全局场景嵌入或密集补丁网格）会混合任务相关与无关特征，缺乏结构化表示。本文探索物体中心化的slot表示是否能通过将特征分组为每个物体单独的表征来提升操作性能。
AI.method: 在ManiSkill3 PickCube-v1基准上，固定策略、目标token、渲染和校准，仅改变编码器。比较冻结的物体中心化SPOT表示（DINO ViT-B/16 + Slot Attention）与密集DINO全局特征基线、密集补丁网格。随后引入显式2D空间目标和原生分辨率渲染提升系统。使用自动运动学失败分类法（Near-Miss vs No-Grasp）分析失败模式。
AI.result: SPOT表示达55.0±2.9%成功率，比密集DINO全局特征基线（32.6±1.5%）高22.4%；密集补丁网格虽多16倍token但性能无提升。完整系统达68.7±4.2%，接近3D oracle上限71.7±4.1%。空间接地（spatial grounding）减少Near-Miss但No-Grasp不变。该分类法迁移至StackCube-v1，指出遮挡是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 物体中心化的slot表示在无需编码器微调的情况下显著优于全局特征和密集补丁网格；空间接地对提升空间精度有效但对物体追踪无帮助；遮挡是更复杂堆叠任务的主要瓶颈。

title: Detangled: A Framework for Creating, Editing, and Inferencing Feature Rich Hair Strands
summary: We present a framework for understanding and generating feature rich hair strands. Drawing upon both scientific and cultural expertise, we define strand texture as the various distinctive patterns (curling, switchbacks, twist, etc.) that are formed by forces internal to a hair strand. We begin by proposing a novel five-dimensional parameter space, intended to be a bijection with naturally occurring hair strand textures. This encoding is both qualitatively accessible, allowing users to readily locate their own hair in the parameter space, and quantitatively precise, allowing the generation of individual strands from texture inputs. Importantly, strand texture should be independent from the overall strand direction. In order to disentangle strand texture from the overall strand direction, we identify centerline geometry and use it to map strands into a canonical space (a strand texture space). We construct centerlines using a novel method that cleanly distills complex hair grooms, separating the strand texture from the overall style (parameterized by style guides). We enable the creation of new strands conforming to our parametric description of texture via a generative artificial intelligence approach supervised by a separate neural network trained to label candidate strands according to our five-parameter description. The ability to create new strands conforming to any desired texture enables groom editing using either texture transfer or user-provided inputs. We demonstrate results on a variety of hair types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个五维参数空间框架，用于理解和生成具有丰富纹理的发丝。通过中心线几何将发丝纹理与整体发型解耦，并利用生成式AI根据五维参数描述创建新发丝，实现了发丝纹理的编辑和生成。
AI.motivation: 现有毛发建模方法缺乏对发丝纹理（卷曲、扭结、扭转等由发丝内部力形成的独特图案）的系统性理解和生成框架，且纹理与整体发型方向相互耦合，难以独立控制。
AI.method: 提出五维参数空间与自然发丝纹理一一对应；通过中心线几何将发丝映射到规范空间（纹理空间）以解耦纹理与整体方向；采用新方法从复杂毛发梳理中提取中心线；使用生成式AI（由监督神经网络标注）创建符合参数描述的新发丝。
AI.result: 在多种发质类型上验证了方法的有效性，能够通过纹理迁移或用户输入实现发丝纹理编辑。
AI.conclusion: 该框架兼具定性可访问性和定量精确性，实现了发丝纹理的独立控制与生成，为毛发建模和编辑提供了新途径。

title: Safe responses matter: Output-aware safety guardrail mitigate over-refusal in MLLMs
summary: Existing safety mechanisms for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) face a fundamental trade-off between safety and utility. Model fine-tuning achieves robust safety but compromises general utility. Input-side safety guardrails offer a lightweight alternative, yet they suffer from severe over-refusal, indiscriminately blocking benign queries or those the model could have safely answered through refusal or advisory responses. We identify that the root cause of over-refusal lies in the input-aware paradigm: safety guardrails make safety decisions without considering whether the model itself is capable of generating safe responses. Usually, MLLMs already possess intrinsic safety mechanisms that can transform harmful inputs into harmless outputs, but input-side safety guardrails override this capability, degrading user experience. Motivated by this insight, we propose a paradigm shift toward output-aware safety guardrails. Our method operates within the model's hidden state space to predict whether the forthcoming generation will be unsafe before it is fully produced. By training a lightweight classifier via multi-instance contrastive learning on hidden state representations, our approach distinguishes between inputs that will lead to unsafe outputs and those that will not, even when the inputs themselves contain risky elements. This enables precise intervention only when the model's actual response would be harmful. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our output-aware safety guardrail matches the safety performance of existing methods while drastically reducing over-refusal, preserving the model's utility and built-in safety capabilities. Code is available at: https://github.com/kunzhan/OutGuard

AI.tldr: 提出输出感知安全护栏（OutGuard），通过在MLLM隐空间训练轻量分类器预测即将生成的输出是否安全，在保持安全性能的同时大幅减少过度拒绝对用户请求的误拦截。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM安全机制存在安全与效用的根本性权衡：微调虽安全但损害通用能力，输入侧安全护栏虽轻量但存在严重的过度拒绝问题，会误拦截模型本可以安全回应的良性查询。根本原因是输入感知范式在决策时未考虑模型自身是否具备安全生成能力。
AI.method: 提出输出感知安全护栏范式转变：在模型隐状态空间中，通过多实例对比学习训练轻量分类器，在生成完成前预测输出是否不安全，区分那些输入有风险但模型能安全回答的情况与真正会产生有害输出的情况。
AI.result: 输出感知安全护栏在安全性能上与现有方法相当，同时大幅降低过度拒绝率，保留了模型的效用和内置安全能力。
AI.conclusion: 从输入感知范式向输出感知范式的转变是解决安全与效用权衡的有效途径，通过利用模型自身的安全生成能力，实现更精准的安全干预。

title: Scaffolding the Strategist: Architecture-Dependent Reasoning Interventions in Hotelling Spatial Markets
comment: 26 pages (11 main + 15 appendix), 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on LLM Reasoning
summary: We investigate whether structured reasoning interventions improve the strategic economic reasoning of large language models, and whether their effects depend on model architecture. Using Hotelling's linear city model as a diagnostic vehicle, we evaluate GPT-4.1-mini (a standard instruction-following model) and GPT-5-mini (a reasoning-optimized model) under five conditions - an unscaffolded baseline and four reasoning interventions - across eight questions spanning deductive and abductive reasoning, three prompt framings, and three repetitions per condition, yielding 720 individually judged responses. We find a statistically significant crossover interaction between scaffolding type and model architecture ($t(7) = 4.79$, $p = 0.002$, $d = 1.69$): commitment scaffolding improves the standard model ($+0.21$) while degrading the reasoning model ($-0.63$), and principled separation shows the opposite pattern ($-0.40$ vs. $+0.31$). Both crossovers are individually significant (commitment: $p = 0.040$; separation: $p = 0.002$) and hold across all eight questions with 7/8 directional consistency. Adversarial stress-testing harms both models, with $2.6\times$ greater degradation for the reasoning model ($-1.47$ vs. $-0.57$; $p = 0.038$), and the damage correlates negatively with baseline difficulty ($R^2 = 0.36$, $p = 0.014$). We further document a persistent declarative-procedural gap in which both models identify correct strategies at rates far exceeding their ability to execute them; separation fully closes this gap for the reasoning model while no intervention helps the standard model.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过Hotelling线性城市模型，系统评估了结构化推理干预对GPT-4.1-mini（标准模型）和GPT-5-mini（推理优化模型）策略性经济推理能力的影响。发现干预效果与模型架构存在显著交互作用：承诺脚手架提升标准模型但降低推理模型表现，原则分离呈现相反模式。对抗性压力测试对两模型均有损害，且推理模型受损更严重。同时观察到两模型均存在陈述性-程序性知识差距，原则分离可消除推理模型的这一差距。
AI.motivation: 探究结构化推理干预是否能够提高大语言模型的策略性经济推理能力，以及这种影响是否依赖于模型架构（标准指令跟随模型 vs. 推理优化模型），旨在理解不同推理范式与模型设计之间的交互机制。
AI.method: 以Hotelling线性城市模型为诊断工具，在5种条件（1个无脚手架基线+4种推理干预）下，评估GPT-4.1-mini和GPT-5-mini在8个问题（涵盖演绎与溯因推理）、3种提示框架、每种条件重复3次上的表现，共收集720个独立评判的响应。采用统计分析方法检验脚手架类型与模型架构的交互效应。
AI.result: 发现脚手架类型与模型架构存在显著交叉交互作用（t(7)=4.79, p=0.002, d=1.69）：承诺脚手架使标准模型提升0.21但使推理模型下降0.63；原则分离使标准模型下降0.40但使推理模型提升0.31。对抗性测试使推理模型降幅是标准模型的2.6倍（-1.47 vs. -0.57, p=0.038），损害程度与基线难度负相关（R²=0.36, p=0.014）。两模型均存在陈述性-程序性知识差距，原则分离可完全消除推理模型的这一差距。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理干预的效果高度依赖于模型架构，不存在通用的最优策略。承诺脚手架更适合标准模型而原则分离更适合推理优化模型。对抗性压力测试对推理模型具有更强的破坏性。陈述性-程序性知识差距是普遍存在的挑战，但推理优化模型可通过特定干预（原则分离）弥合这一差距。

title: PolyInterview: An LLM-based Platform for Immersive Mock Interview Practice with Comprehensive Multimodal Assessment
summary: Preparing for job interviews is important for securing desired positions, yet realistic practice remains difficult to access: real interviews are infrequent, expert mock coaching is costly, and self-practice offers neither adaptive dialogue nor structured assessment. Existing systems typically address only parts of this need through fixed question sequences, limited communication channels, or feedback with little supporting evidence. We present PolyInterview, an LLM-based platform for immersive mock interview practice with comprehensive multimodal assessment. PolyInterview uses the target job description and CV to generate questions tailored to the role and candidate, conducts multi-turn spoken interviews with a lip-synced digital human interviewer that asks answer-aware follow-up questions, and evaluates response content, vocal delivery, and non-verbal behavior. Four parallel evaluators produce 13 behavior-level features that are aggregated into 10 assessment aspects and two competency tracks. Guided by the KSA and STAR frameworks, the report links each score to behavioral evidence and actionable recommendations. PolyInterview is publicly accessible. Its current all-account snapshot contains 101 accounts, 1,564 interview sessions, 7,665 generated questions, and 1,422 five-stage question sets. Generated questions are more closely aligned with their matched job description than with cross-role job descriptions in 93.7% of sessions. An evaluation by ten experts found strong question plans and actionable feedback.

AI.tldr: PolyInterview是一个基于LLM的沉浸式模拟面试平台，支持多模态评估，通过生成适配职位和候选人的问题、多轮语音对话及对内容、语音和非语言行为的评估，提供结构化反馈。系统包含101个账户、1564次面试会话，93.7%的生成问题与职位描述高度匹配，专家评估表明问题规划和反馈质量良好。
AI.motivation: 真实面试机会少，专家模拟辅导成本高，自我练习缺乏自适应对话和结构化评估，现有系统只解决部分需求，且反馈缺乏证据支持。
AI.method: 利用目标职位描述和简历生成定制化问题；进行多轮语音面试，包含唇形同步的数字人类面试官并支持答案感知的追问；通过四个并行评估器产生13个行为级特征，聚合为10个评估维度和两个能力轨道；基于KSA和STAR框架，将分数与行为证据和可操作建议关联。
AI.result: 系统包含101个账户、1564次会话、7665个生成问题、1422套五阶段问题集。93.7%的会话中生成问题与匹配职位描述的对齐度高于跨角色职位描述。十位专家评估表明问题规划和可操作反馈质量强。
AI.conclusion: PolyInterview通过多模态评估和自适应对话，有效弥补了现有模拟面试系统的不足，为求职者提供了可访问、结构化且证据驱动的面试练习平台。

title: Same Stories, Different Journeys: From Social Comparison to Sensemaking in AI-Mediated Peer Career Exploration
summary: Young job seekers frequently turn to social media to compare themselves with peers and make sense of career possibilities. However, passive feed browsing creates a paradox: the authentic peer content that provides emotional grounding also triggers potentially detrimental upward social comparison and cognitive overload. Previous work has either structured online user-generated content to reduce noise without changing the passive browsing modality, or built AI-powered career exploration systems that disregard authentic human experiences. To address this gap, we developed JobMate, an interactive system that transforms real social media career posts into persona-grounded conversational AI agents, shifting the interaction from passive scrolling to active, personalized dialogue. We conducted a between-subjects study ($N$ = 24, three disciplines) comparing JobMate with native RedNote browsing. Our study shows that JobMate's AI-mediated dialogue redirected social comparison from potentially detrimental upward comparison toward constructive self-reframing, while promoting sensemaking through active conversational engagement. However, users still relied on the authenticity of real peer content for emotional grounding. We discuss design implications for AI systems that augment authentic online user-generated content consumption across social comparison contexts.

AI.tldr: JobMate 将社交媒体职业帖转化为对话式AI代理，将被动浏览转为主动对话，引导向上社会比较转向建设性自我重构，同时保留真实内容的情绪支撑作用。
AI.motivation: 青年求职者在社交媒体上浏览同龄人职业内容时陷入两难：真实内容提供情感支撑，但被动浏览引发不利的向上社会比较和认知过载。现有工作要么结构化内容但未改变被动浏览模式，要么构建AI系统却忽略真实人类经验。
AI.method: 开发了JobMate系统，将社交媒体职业帖转化为基于人设的对话式AI代理；通过24人（三个学科）的组间实验，对比JobMate与原生RedNote浏览体验。
AI.result: JobMate的AI中介对话将社会比较从潜在有害的向上比较转向建设性自我重构，并通过主动对话参与促进意义建构；但用户仍依赖真实同伴内容获得情感支撑。
AI.conclusion: 为AI系统设计提供启示，指出AI可增强而非替代真实用户生成内容的消费，特别是在社会比较情境下应平衡主动交互与内容真实性。

title: Robo-ValueRL: Reliable Value Estimation for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
comment: Please refer to our website: https://gewu-lab.github.io/Robo-ValueRL/
summary: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning is promising for generalizable robotic manipulation, yet its full-stack complexity obscures reproduction and diagnosis. Within such systems, value estimation plays a central role in prioritizing heterogeneous data for policy improvement. Despite its importance, the central question remains underexplored: how value-function reliability shapes policy optimization in offline-to-online reinforcement learning. To answer this question, we propose Robo-ValueRL, a unified framework that enables reliable value estimation and systematically traces its downstream effects on policy pretraining and online improvement. Concretely, Robo-ValueRL learns a history-conditioned value estimator and evaluates its reliability through global-progress and local-preference metrics. These resulting value estimates are propagated into quality-conditioned consistency-policy pretraining and a residual adaptation module on online rollouts, providing a unified testbed for analyzing how value reliability shapes downstream policy performance. Across 240 hours of offline demonstrations and over 3,000 online rollout trajectories, our extensive experiments show that downstream performance is strongly associated with value reliability. Reliable value functions provide better action-quality estimates, allowing value-guided offline RL to scale more effectively than quality-agnostic behavior cloning, and stabilize online improvement by prioritizing high-quality rollout data. Integrating reliable value guidance through offline pretraining with online improvement, our system achieves 86% success on millimeter-level precise chip insertion and 84% on generalizable block disassembly. We hope these findings highlight the importance of value-guided data utilization for effective policy improvement from heterogeneous robotic experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Robo-ValueRL框架，通过历史条件价值估计和可靠性评估（全局进展+局部偏好指标），将可靠价值信号传播到质量条件一致性策略预训练和在线残差自适应模块中。实验表明，价值函数可靠性与下游策略性能强相关，在毫米级芯片插入任务上达到86%成功率，在可泛化模块拆卸任务上达到84%成功率。
AI.motivation: 离线到在线强化学习在全栈复杂性下难以复现和诊断，价值估计在优先级数据利用中起核心作用，但价值函数可靠性如何影响策略优化的根本问题尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出Robo-ValueRL框架：(1) 学习历史条件价值估计器，通过全局进展和局部偏好指标评估可靠性；(2) 将可靠价值估计传播到质量条件一致性策略预训练；(3) 在线微调阶段引入残差自适应模块，利用价值信号优先选择高质量轨迹数据。
AI.result: 在240小时离线数据和3000+在线 rollout 轨迹上实验：可靠价值估计与下游性能强相关；价值引导的离线RL优于质量无关的行为克隆；在线改进中价值优先的高质量数据稳定了策略提升；毫米级芯片插入86%成功率，可泛化模块拆卸84%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 可靠价值函数能提供更好的动作质量估计，使价值引导的离线RL比行为克隆更有效地扩展，并通过优先高质量 rollout 数据稳定在线改进。研究强调了价值引导的数据利用对于从异构机器人经验中实现有效策略改进的重要性。

title: Memory-Conditioned Tool Calling for Camera-First Visual Agents
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Equal contribution: Xiaofan Wu, Xi Zeng. Corresponding author: xiaofan@chance.vision
summary: Recognition tells an agent what is in an image; personal memory affects what is worth looking up next. In a camera-first setting the user can send only an image, so the agent must form the lookups. We study whether personal visual memory improves agent-side tool choice and tool arguments, and thereby more user-aligned multi-tool lookups. The design uses a three-layer personal visual memory (profile, short-term focus, observations) that is loaded on each turn to condition an LLM tool-calling loop under camera-first intake, and includes conflict-aware write-back intended to refresh the user model for later captures. On 800 images paired with synthetic memory blocks constructed for controlled ablation, removing the full three-layer memory block reduces tool-query relevance by 0.47 points absolute (4.21 -> 3.74 on a 5-point scale; 11.2% relative) and end-to-end utility by 0.082 absolute (0.842 -> 0.760; 9.7% relative). These results measure memory conditioning of tool policy under image-only intake with fixed synthetic blocks, not multi-session write-back from live user histories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种三层个人视觉记忆架构（个人资料、短期焦点、观察记录），在仅接收图像的相机优先场景中，基于该记忆条件化LLM工具调用循环，实现更符合用户偏好的多工具查询。在800张图像上的消融实验表明，移除完整记忆模块导致工具查询相关性降低0.47（4.21→3.74，5分制，相对下降11.2%），端到端效用降低0.082（0.842→0.760，相对下降9.7%）。
AI.motivation: 在相机优先设置中，用户仅发送图像，智能体需要自主决定查询什么信息。现有方法缺乏个人视觉记忆来指导智能体的工具选择和参数设定，导致工具查询结果与用户真实需求不一致。
AI.method: 设计三层个人视觉记忆架构：个人资料（profile）、短期焦点（short-term focus）和观察记录（observations）。每轮加载该记忆以条件化LLM工具调用循环，并包含冲突感知写回机制用于更新用户模型。
AI.result: 在800张图像配对的合成记忆块消融实验中，移除完整三层记忆块使工具查询相关性从4.21降至3.74（5分制，相对下降11.2%），端到端效用从0.842降至0.760（相对下降9.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 个人视觉记忆能显著提升智能体在相机优先场景中的工具选择和参数对齐效果，但当前结果仅限于固定合成记忆块，尚未验证实时用户历史的多会话写回效果。

title: Quantum-Inspired Contextual Learning for Sparse-Ring Fraud Detection in Dynamic Transaction Graphs
summary: We present an exploratory benchmark and quantum-inspired modeling prototype for fraud screening in dynamic financial transaction graphs. Coordinated fraud may not be visible from individual transactions alone, but may emerge as a multi-period relational pattern. We focus on sparse-ring fraud, a stylized pattern in which a completed directed cycle is distributed across several days, requiring models to integrate evidence across both time and graph structure. We study this problem using a synthetic transaction simulator with completed sparse-ring injections and broken-ring decoys. Daily directed transaction graphs are aggregated into rolling windows and represented using raw graph features, persistent-homology summaries, or hybrid feature vectors that combine both. We compare a gated recurrent unit (GRU) baseline with quantum-inspired Contextual Machine Learning (CML) as sequence-level classifiers. Because the benchmark uses synthetic data, a modest sample size, and sequence-level labels, the results are exploratory. Within this scope, topology-only summaries are too compressed to solve the supervised ring-completion task by themselves, largely because they remove account-pair identity and edge direction. The strongest results come from hybrid representations that combine identity-preserving graph features with topological summaries. These findings suggest that topology is most useful as a contextual layer over dynamic graph features, and that CML is a promising candidate model for fraud patterns whose evidence is distributed across temporal and relational context.

AI.tldr: 本文针对动态金融交易图中的欺诈筛查问题，提出了一个探索性基准测试和量子启发建模原型。重点研究"稀疏环欺诈"模式——跨越数天分布的定向循环，需要模型同时整合时间和图结构信息。通过合成交易模拟器生成数据，比较了GRU基线和量子启发式上下文机器学习（CML）模型，发现混合表示（图特征+拓扑摘要）效果最佳，且拓扑最适合作为动态图特征的上下文层。
AI.motivation: 现有欺诈检测方法难以捕捉跨越时间和图结构的协同欺诈模式，单独的逐笔交易分析无法识别多周期关系模式，需要新的建模方法。
AI.method: 使用合成交易模拟器生成包含稀疏环注入和破环诱饵的数据；将每日有向交易图聚合为滚动窗口；提取原始图特征、持续同调拓扑摘要及混合特征向量；比较GRU和量子启发式CML作为序列级分类器。
AI.result: 拓扑摘要单独不足以解决监督环补全任务（因丢失账户对身份和边方向），混合表示（身份保留图特征+拓扑摘要）效果最强，CML是应对时空分布证据的欺诈模式的有前景模型。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑信息最适合作为动态图特征的上下文层，CML在时序与关系上下文分布的欺诈证据建模方面展现出潜力。

title: A Theory of Least Autonomy in AI
summary:
Least privilege, the principle that an identity should hold only the permissions strictly required for its task, has been a foundational primitive of access control for decades. We argue that this principle is insufficient for agentic AI systems, which do not merely hold permissions but can combine, approve, and amplify them across workflows and system boundaries.
  We propose least autonomy as an appropriate generalization and develop a formal theory. First, we define a compositional blast radius d(a,b) that measures structural separation between actions in an enterprise hierarchy, combining an ultrametric tree with lattice-valued confidentiality, integrity, and control-context labels. Second, we define a directed agent influence graph G(theta). An arc from U to V requires a directed shared-resource write-to-read meeting or a conservative undirected agent-to-agent (A2A) communication meeting, and a meeting-conditioned influence potential at or above an externally selected policy threshold theta. A catalogue-radius profile supports calibration and audit of theta. Finally, we define a collusion predicate over graph reachability that detects authorization composition, decision manipulation, and cross-domain capability composition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"最小自治"（least autonomy）原则作为对传统最小权限原则在智能体AI系统中的推广，并建立形式化理论，包括组合爆炸半径、有向智能体影响图和共谋谓词三个核心定义。
AI.motivation: 传统最小权限原则（least privilege）在智能体AI系统中不再充分，因为智能体不仅能持有权限，还能跨工作流和系统边界组合、批准和放大这些权限，需要更合适的泛化原则。
AI.method: 1) 定义组合爆炸半径 d(a,b)，结合超度量树和格子值机密性、完整性、控制上下文标签，度量企业层级中动作间的结构分离程度；2) 定义有向智能体影响图 G(θ)，包含写读到共享资源会议、无向智能体间通信会议，以及阈值 θ 下的会议条件影响潜力；3) 定义基于图可达性的共谋谓词，检测授权组合、决策操纵和跨域能力组合。
AI.result: 提出目录-半径谱线用于校准和审计阈值 θ；共谋谓词可检测三类安全风险：授权组合、决策操纵和跨域能力组合。
AI.conclusion: 最小自治原则及其形式化理论为智能体AI系统提供了比最小权限更适用的访问控制基础，能够刻画智能体间的影响传播和共谋风险。

title: Polarization Detection: A Hybrid Approach with AfroXLMR-Social and DeBERTa for Low- and High-Resource Settings
summary: The rapid proliferation of online polarization threatens social cohesion, necessitating robust automated detection systems that operate effectively across diverse linguistic contexts. This paper presents our system description for the POLAR Shared Task 2026, focusing on the detection and characterization of polarized discourse in English and Hausa. We propose a hybrid modeling strategy: for English binary detection, we leverage the monolingual strength of \textbf{DeBERTa}, while for Hausa and all fine-grained subtasks (Types and Manifestations), we utilize \textbf{AfroXLMR-Social}. This domain-adapted multilingual model proved critical for capturing the nuances of polarization in social media text. To further address computational constraints and data scarcity, we implement Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and textual data augmentation via \texttt{nlpaug}. We report competitive results across all three subtasks, demonstrating that model selection tailored to specific subtask requirements yields the best balance of performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对POLAR Shared Task 2026任务，提出了一种混合建模策略：英语二元检测使用DeBERTa，豪萨语及所有细粒度子任务（类型和表现形式）使用AfroXLMR-Social，并采用LoRA和数据增强技术，在三个子任务上均取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 在线两极分化现象快速蔓延威胁社会凝聚力，需要开发能够在不同语言环境下有效运行的自动化检测系统，但目前缺乏针对低资源语言（如豪萨语）和细粒度分类的有效方案。
AI.method: 采用混合建模策略：英语二元检测使用DeBERTa；豪萨语及所有细粒度子任务（类型和表现形式）使用领域适配的多语言模型AfroXLMR-Social；同时引入Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)缓解计算约束，并通过nlpaug进行文本数据增强应对数据稀缺问题。
AI.result: 在英语和豪萨语的两极分化检测、类型分类和表现形式分类三个子任务上均取得了有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 针对不同子任务需求进行定制化的模型选择，能够在计算资源受限和数据稀缺的条件下取得最优的性能平衡。

title: DiffLens: A Visualization System to Explore Local Differences in Graph Sampling
summary: Graph sampling techniques have been widely used to simplify network computation and visualization, which also results in inevitable differences between the sampled networks and the original networks in terms of nodes, edges and structures. Investigating such differences can inform graph sampling technique users of the pros and cons of different techniques and select the appropriate one, and can also help graph sampling developers evaluate their own technique. However, there are still no systematic ways to achieve such a goal. This paper fills this research gap by first proposing systematic and generic quantitative measures to quantify three categories of graph differences (i.e., neighbor-based, path-based, and structure-based). Built upon this, we further propose DiffLens, a novel visualization system to help graph sampling developers and users intuitively explore local differences at different regions of their interest within a sampled graph, where three new lens-based visual designs are presented to display the neighbor-based, path-based, and structure-based differences respectively. We conducted two case studies and a user study using real-world network datasets to evaluate DiffLens. The results confirmed its effectiveness and usability in helping users explore local differences and compare different graph sampling strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套系统化的图差异量化指标（基于邻居、路径和结构三类）以及可视化系统DiffLens，帮助图采样技术的开发者和用户直观探索采样图与原始图之间的局部差异，并通过案例研究和用户研究验证了其有效性和可用性。
AI.motivation: 图采样技术广泛用于简化网络计算与可视化，但采样结果与原图在节点、边和结构上存在差异。目前缺乏系统化的方法来量化和探索这些差异，这阻碍了用户选择合适采样技术以及开发者评估自身技术。
AI.method: 首先提出了三类系统且通用的图差异量化指标：基于邻居的差异、基于路径的差异和基于结构的差异。在此基础上，设计了DiffLens可视化系统，包含三种新的透镜式视觉设计来分别显示这三类差异，支持用户按兴趣区域探索局部差异。
AI.result: 通过两个案例研究和一项用户研究，使用真实网络数据集进行实验，结果证实了DiffLens在帮助用户探索局部差异和比较不同图采样策略方面的有效性和可用性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了图采样差异系统化量化与可视化分析的空白，为图采样技术的选择与评估提供了有效的工具支持。

title: Diffusion for Long-Horizon Multi-Robot Path Planning in Human-Shared Environments
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, to be published in IROS 2026
summary: Multi-robot path planning in human-shared environments requires a delicate balance between robust inter-robot coordination and socially aware behavior. While diffusion models excel at generating predictable, human-like paths, existing generative planners are often restricted to paths of fixed duration and high computational latency, limiting their adaptability to varying goal distances and hindering real-time deployment. We present Multi-Robot Rolling Diffusion (MRRD), a novel framework that enables real-time, long-horizon navigation for large robot teams through dense crowds. MRRD combines a rolling-horizon scheme to accommodate the limited prediction horizon of human motion, parallelized diffusion inference for scalable generation of human-like paths, and a conflict-based-search mechanism for resolving inter-robot collisions. It further incorporates urgency-based temporal conditioning to generate paths with varying speeds and employs differentiated guidance terms to maximize both social awareness around humans and efficient coordination between robots. Experimental results in crowded environments demonstrate that MRRD successfully scales to 15 robots in real-time, significantly outperforming existing baselines in both safety and mission success rates.

AI.tldr: MRRD是一种结合滚动时域、并行扩散推理和冲突搜索的多机器人路径规划框架，能在密集人群中实现15台机器人的实时、长时域、社交感知导航，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的生成式规划器受限于固定路径时长和高计算延迟，无法适应不同目标距离和实时部署需求，亟需一种能平衡鲁棒机器人间协调与社交感知行为的实时、可扩展方法。
AI.method: 1) 滚动时域方案适应人类运动有限预测时域；2) 并行化扩散推理实现类人路径的可扩展生成；3) 基于冲突的搜索机制解决机器人间碰撞；4) 基于紧急度的时间条件生成可变速度路径；5) 差异化引导项最大化社交感知与机器人间协调效率。
AI.result: 在密集人群环境中成功扩展至15台机器人实时运行，在安全性和任务成功率上显著超越现有基线。
AI.conclusion: MRRD通过滚动扩散与并行推理技术，有效解决了生成式规划器在实时性、可变路径时长和大规模部署上的瓶颈，为人类共享环境中多机器人导航提供了可扩展的高效解决方案。

title: Towards Objective Dysgraphia Detection: A Multi-Branch Deep Learning Approach for Online Handwriting Analysis
summary: Dysgraphia is a specific learning disability that is prevalent among school-age children. It affects handwriting coherence, quality, fluency, and legibility, often hindering academic achievement and early learning development. This motor coordination disorder is typically diagnosed through subjective assessments based on clinician observation, which can be timeconsuming and prone to variability. In this paper, we introduce a deep learning-based framework for objective dysgraphia detection using online handwriting data captured via digitizing tablets. The proposed framework relies on two complementary branches: the first pipeline extracts both handcrafted and embedding-based kinematic features directly from raw temporal signals, while the second leverages image-based representations of the temporal signals generated using continuous wavelet transforms (CWT) and Gramian Angular Fields (GAF). The resulting features are then fused to leverage the complementary strengths of both representations. The four representations were evaluated separately and jointly using the publicly available DiaGraMo dataset, showing that the fusion of GAF, MOMENT, and hand-crafted kinematic features outperforms each individual representation, as well as other fusion schemes. These findings highlight the potential of the complementarity of image and signal based representations for more objective dysgraphia detection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于深度学习的框架，利用数字化平板采集的在线手写数据，通过融合手工特征、嵌入特征（MOMENT）、连续小波变换（CWT）和格拉姆角场（GAF）四种表示，实现客观的书写障碍检测。在DiaGraMo数据集上，GAF、MOMENT与手工运动学特征的融合方案优于单一表示及其他融合方案。
AI.motivation: 传统的书写障碍诊断依赖临床医生的主观观察，耗时且存在变异性，缺乏客观、高效的自动化检测方法。
AI.method: 提出双分支深度学习框架：第一分支从原始时间序列信号中提取手工设计的运动学特征和基于MOMENT的嵌入特征；第二分支利用连续小波变换（CWT）和格拉姆角场（GAF）将时间信号转换为图像表示。最终将四类特征进行融合。
AI.result: 在公开的DiaGraMo数据集上，GAF、MOMENT与手工运动学特征的融合方案优于各单一表示及其他融合方案。
AI.conclusion: 信号与图像表示的互补性有助于更客观的书写障碍检测。

title: Manifold Constrained Tabular Deep Neural Networks
summary: Tabular classification is often governed by local, condition-triggered rules rather than smooth global patterns. However, tabular deep neural networks (DNNs) are typically built upon Euclidean representations that favor smooth variations and semantic locality. This potential geometric mismatch can make it challenging for tabular DNNs to efficiently represent the discrete, rule-partitioned structures often underlying tabular classification. To address this issue, we propose HDE-Net, a manifold-constrained DNN that enables hierarchical decision modeling in hyperbolic space. We first abstract heterogeneous features into unified Latent Decision Nodes (LDNs) and embed them in the Poincaré ball, forming a continuous representation that resembles tree-structured reasoning. For numerical features, we introduce a Soft Decision Routing mechanism that approximates range-based local rules in a differentiable manner, bringing their LDN semantics closer to those of categorical features. An entropy-aware capacity allocation algorithm further adapts the number of LDNs per numerical feature to balance expressiveness and complexity. On the TALENT-tiny-core classification benchmark (30 datasets), HDE-Net achieves the \textit{best average rank}, outperforming both industrial GBDTs and recent tabular DNNs while maintaining high efficiency.

AI.tldr: HDE-Net是一种在双曲空间中构建分层决策建模的流形约束深度神经网络，通过潜在决策节点（LDNs）、软决策路由和熵感知容量分配机制，在30个数据集上取得了最佳平均排名，超越了GBDT和现有表格DNN方法。
AI.motivation: 表格分类任务通常由局部、条件触发的规则主导，而非平滑的全局模式。但现有的表格深度神经网络基于欧几里得表示，倾向于平滑变化和语义局部性，这种几何不匹配使得DNN难以高效表达表格分类中离散的、规则划分的结构。
AI.method: 1) 将异质特征抽象为统一的潜在决策节点（LDNs）并嵌入Poincaré球（双曲空间），形成类似树结构推理的连续表示；2) 针对数值特征提出软决策路由机制，以可微方式近似基于区间的局部规则，使LDN语义更接近类别特征；3) 熵感知容量分配算法自适应调整每个数值特征的LDN数量，平衡表达力与复杂度。
AI.result: 在TALENT-tiny-core分类基准（30个数据集）上取得最佳平均排名，同时超越工业级GBDT和当前最先进的表格DNN，并保持高效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将表格数据中的离散规则结构映射到双曲空间的连续表示，HDE-Net有效解决了欧几里得DNN与表格分类几何特性不匹配的问题，为表格深度学习提供了新的研究思路。

title: SupplyNetPy: An Open-Source Python Library for High-Fidelity Modeling and Simulation of Arbitrary Supply Chain and Inventory Networks
summary: This paper introduces SupplyNetPy, an open-source, well-documented Python library for modeling and discrete-event simulation of supply chain networks with arbitrary multi-echelon structures. It supports multiple replenishment policies, perishable inventory, node disruptions, and stochastic demand and lead times. All components are extensible via inheritance. Users describe a supply chain as a graph with node and link attributes, while the library handles simulation, providing logs and extensive node and network level performance reports. This paper presents the motivation, design, key features, and architecture of SupplyNetPy, along with detailed validation results (against analytical benchmarks, a commercial tool, and a published case study). A key motivation behind SupplyNetPy's development is programmatic generation and simulation of complex models, enabling design-space exploration, what-if analysis, training data generation, and supply chain digital twins.

AI.tldr: SupplyNetPy是一个开源的Python库，用于对任意多级结构的供应链网络进行建模和离散事件仿真，支持多种补货策略、易腐库存、节点中断以及随机需求和前置时间，并通过验证展示了其可靠性。
AI.motivation: 实现复杂供应链模型的程序化生成与仿真，支持设计空间探索、假设分析、训练数据生成以及供应链数字孪生的构建。
AI.method: 将供应链建模为带有节点和边属性的图，采用离散事件仿真引擎，所有组件通过继承实现可扩展，支持多种补货策略、易腐品、中断事件及随机需求/前置时间，仿真后提供日志及节点/网络级性能报告。
AI.result: 通过了针对分析基准、商业工具和已发表案例研究的详细验证，证明了模型的正确性和可靠性。
AI.conclusion: SupplyNetPy作为一个开源、文档完善且经过验证的供应链仿真库，能够有效支持复杂供应链系统的建模、分析与数字孪生应用。

title: Neutralizing Structural Inequality in the Nigerian FinTech Sector
summary: Algorithmic decision systems in financial services often rely on data proxies that inadvertently encode structural inequalities. This paper introduces a hierarchical human-AI triage model for Point of Sale fraud detection in the Nigerian FinTech sector. Adopting a We Are All Equal worldview, we address the challenge of discrimination laundering, wherein the system misinterprets infrastructure related aleatoric noise such as rural network timeouts as fraudulent intent. We implement a three-tier routing policy utilizing a calibrated ensemble model as a primary filter. The policy routes transactions characterized by epistemic uncertainty such as cold start new accounts to specialist analysts while reserving high stakes cases for a senior supervisor. To manage finite human capacity, we utilize a dynamic shadow price to ration human attention and implement a random audit mechanism to prevent human skill atrophy. Our experimental results demonstrate a statistically significant 1.88\% complementarity gap and a 24.79\% percentage point gain in fraud recall over an autonomous baseline. Crucially, the model reduces the regional performance gap from 19.43 to 2.88 percentage points, neutralizing structural bias. Hierarchical collaboration provides a robust mechanism for substantive equality of opportunity, ensuring that rural accounts are not excluded from the digital economy due to environmental brute luck.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分层人机协同分诊模型用于尼日利亚FinTech领域的POS欺诈检测，通过三阶段路由策略、动态影子价格和随机审计机制，在提升欺诈召回率24.79%的同时，将区域性能差距从19.43个百分点降至2.88个百分点，有效消除结构性偏见。
AI.motivation: 金融服务的算法决策系统常依赖数据代理，这些代理无意中编码了结构性不平等。特别是在尼日利亚FinTech领域，系统可能将基础设施相关的偶然噪声（如农村网络超时）误判为欺诈意图，导致"歧视洗白"问题，需要设计更公平的检测机制。
AI.method: 采用"我们都平等"的世界观，构建三层路由策略：(1)使用校准的集成模型作为初级过滤器；(2)将认知不确定性高的交易（如冷启动新账户）路由给专业分析师；(3)高风险案件交由高级主管处理。利用动态影子价格管理有限的人力注意力，并实施随机审计机制防止人类技能萎缩。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：统计显著的1.88%互补性差距；欺诈召回率比自主基线提升24.79个百分点；区域性能差距从19.43个百分点降至2.88个百分点，有效中和了结构性偏见。
AI.conclusion: 分层人机协作机制为实质性机会平等提供了稳健的解决方案，确保农村账户不会因环境性"原生运气"而被排除在数字经济之外。

title: ManiScope: LLM-Assisted Visual Analytics of Cryptocurrency Manipulation Risk
summary: Cryptocurrency markets are vulnerable to trade-based manipulation, such as wash trading, which can distort price signals and mislead investors. Prior research has mainly focused on detecting manipulation using fixed rules or labeled examples, offering limited flexibility and interpretability for assessing potential risks. Existing visual analytics tools can reveal basic manipulation-related signals, such as token distribution, but still require substantial manual effort to integrate holder relationships, suspicious behaviors, and market dynamics for risk assessment. To address these limitations, we propose ManiScope, an LLM-assisted visual analytics system for analyzing trade-based manipulation risks in cryptocurrency markets. ManiScope provides coordinated views of token distributions, holder relationships, detailed holder behaviors, price dynamics, and suspicious trading patterns. To further enhance user analysis, ManiScope introduces a human-LLM collaborative visual analytics framework. Rather than acting as a basic reactive LLM assistant, the framework positions the LLM as a co-analyst that infers users' analytical intent and emerging hypotheses from interaction context and surfaces relevant visual, statistical, and synthesized evidence for hypothesis evaluation. This design reduces repetitive inspection and strengthens evidence-based reasoning. We evaluate ManiScope through two case studies and a user study with 12 experienced cryptocurrency practitioners. The results suggest that ManiScope supports effective risk assessment of manipulation, reduces manual effort in evidence-seeking, and organizes findings around user hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 提出ManiScope，一个LLM辅助的视觉分析系统，用于分析加密货币市场中基于交易的操纵风险（如洗盘交易），通过人-LLM协作分析框架，将LLM作为共同分析师来推断用户意图和假设，并关联相关证据，降低手动工作并增强基于证据的推理。
AI.motivation: 现有检测方法依赖固定规则或标注样本，灵活性和可解释性有限；现有可视化工具需大量手动工作来整合持有者关系、可疑行为和市场动态进行风险评估。
AI.method: 提出ManiScope系统，包含代币分布、持有者关系、持有者行为、价格动态和可疑交易模式的协调视图；引入人-LLM协作视觉分析框架，LLM作为共同分析师从交互上下文中推断用户分析意图和假设，并呈现相关可视化、统计和综合证据。
AI.result: 通过两个案例研究和12名经验丰富的加密货币从业者的用户研究，表明ManiScope支持有效的操纵风险评估，减少证据寻找的手动工作，并围绕用户假设组织发现。
AI.conclusion: ManiScope通过人-LLM协作框架有效降低了加密货币市场操纵风险分析的手工劳动，增强了基于证据的推理能力。

title: A Numerically-Robust ROS 2 Port of iG-LIO: Diagnosing and Fixing Toolchain-Induced Failures in Incremental GICP LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
summary: iG-LIO is a tightly-coupled LiDAR-inertial odometry system fusing generalized-ICP and point-to-plane constraints in an iterated error-state Kalman filter over an incremental voxel map. We report an open-source ROS 2 Jazzy port of the original ROS 1 implementation and, more importantly, the diagnosis of environment-induced numerical failures that appear only after the port: a mechanically faithful migration -- estimation mathematics left unchanged -- compiled and ran, yet diverged with NaN internal values. Both causes trace to the modern ROS 2 toolchain, not the algorithm: a Quality-of-Service (QoS) mismatch that silently drops and reorders IMU samples, and an uninitialized parallel-reduce accumulator arising from the oneTBB + Eigen combination shipped with current distributions. We further correct Ouster point-field parsing to ensure correct point cloud undistortion with newer Ouster revisions, add Velodyne Velarray M1600 support, provide both a compile-time-gated Livox CustomMsg path and a driver-free path for Livox sensors publishing standard PointCloud2 (e.g. Mid-360), and expose the runtime via YAML. The result has been validated in an Ouster OS0 Rev7, an Ouster OS1 Rev 7, and a Livox MID-360. This report is a citable reference for the port itself, not a claim on the underlying algorithm [1]. The ROS 2 port of iG-LIO described in this document can be found at https://github.com/Forestry-Robotics-UC/ig_lio/tree/ros2-jazzy.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了iG-LIO从ROS 1到ROS 2 Jazzy的移植工作，重点诊断了移植后出现的由现代ROS 2工具链引起的数值发散问题（QoS不匹配导致IMU数据丢序、oneTBB+Eigen的未初始化累加器），并修复了Ouster点云解析、添加了Velodyne Velarray M1600和Livox传感器支持，最终在多种激光雷达上完成验证。
AI.motivation: 将iG-LIO从ROS 1移植到ROS 2 Jazzy，并诊断和修复移植过程中出现的环境诱导的数值故障（NaN发散），同时扩展传感器兼容性。
AI.method: 对原始ROS 1 iG-LIO的估计算法数学不变，进行机械忠实的ROS 2移植；诊断出两个由工具链引发的问题：QoS不匹配导致IMU数据丢序，以及oneTBB+Eigen组合中的未初始化并行归约累加器；修复Ouster点域解析、添加Velodyne M1600和Livox多路径支持。
AI.result: 成功在Ouster OS0 Rev7、Ouster OS1 Rev7和Livox MID-360上完成验证，解决了移植后出现的NaN发散问题，扩展了传感器支持范围。
AI.conclusion: 本工作是对iG-LIO ROS 2移植的技术报告和可引用参考，而非对底层算法的创新声明；移植的数值故障源于工具链而非算法本身。

title: TDSal: Task-Based Top-Down Saliency Prediction Model
summary: Visual saliency aims to predict the regions of an image most likely to attract human visual attention. While most saliency models assume free-viewing conditions, human attention is often shaped by explicit task goals. In this work, we address task-driven saliency prediction by proposing a model that conditions visual attention on natural-language task descriptions. The model produces task-dependent saliency maps that reflect how attention shifts under different viewing intents. Through quantitative and qualitative analysis, we show that incorporating explicit task semantics enables more faithful modeling of goal-directed visual attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于自然语言任务描述的条件视觉显著性模型，通过将任务语义融入注意力预测，实现对目标导向视觉注意力的更准确建模。
AI.motivation: 现有显著性模型大多假设自由观看条件，但人类注意力常常受明确任务目标影响，因此需要一种能根据任务描述动态调整的显著性预测方法。
AI.method: 提出一种以自然语言任务描述为条件的显著性预测模型，生成任务依赖的显著性图，反映不同观看意图下的注意力变化。
AI.result: 定量与定性分析表明，融入显式任务语义能够更真实地建模目标导向的视觉注意力。
AI.conclusion: 将任务语义纳入显著性模型可显著提升对目标驱动注意力的预测准确性，为任务导向视觉注意建模提供了有效方案。

title: EvoClawBench: Can Agents Learn Reusable Skills from Their Own Runs?
summary: Existing agent benchmarks primarily test task completion, tool use, or skill utility, but do not isolate whether a runtime can convert evidence from its own runs into reusable skills that improve fresh executions after authoring overhead. We introduce EvoClawBench, a benchmark for this closed-loop skill-learning question on repeated, fixture-backed tasks. EvoClawBench compares direct execution without skills, PreSkill authoring before execution, and PostSkill summarization from first-run evidence followed by a fresh second execution. The suite contains 100 tasks and 502 sub-problems across coding, data, office, security, operations, and domain-document workflows, with support for multiple agent runtimes. Experiments with OpenClaw and nanobot under local execution show that direct baseline performance is strongly runtime-dependent: OpenClaw remains below 20% across models, while nanobot ranges from 56.45% to 96.13%. Self-authored skills have mixed effects. nanobot GPT-5.4 stays above 96% in all modes and MiniMax-M2.7 improves from 90.97% to 94.50% under PostSkill, but nanobot DeepSeek-V4-Pro drops from 77.77% to 4.80% with PreSkill and 0.99% with PostSkill. OpenClaw shows similarly non-monotonic behavior, with some skill runs near baseline and others collapsing. These results indicate that learning reusable skills from an agent's own runs is selective and cost-sensitive, rather than an automatic benefit of adding skill authoring to an agent loop.

AI.tldr: EvoClawBench是一个评估智能体能否将执行经验转化为可复用技能的闭环学习基准。实验表明，技能学习的效果具有选择性：某些场景下性能提升（如nanobot GPT-5.4保持96%以上），但更多情况下技能引入会导致性能下降甚至崩溃（如DeepSeek-V4-Pro从77.77%跌至0.99%），说明技能复用并非自动获益。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准主要测试任务完成、工具使用或技能效用，但未能隔离评估运行时能否将自身执行中的证据转化为可复用技能，以改善后续执行效果。
AI.method: 提出EvoClawBench基准，包含100个任务和502个子问题，覆盖编码、数据、办公、安全、运维和领域文档工作流。设计三种对比模式：无技能直接执行、执行前预制技能（PreSkill）、首轮执行后总结技能再二次执行（PostSkill），支持多种智能体运行时。
AI.result: 直接基线性能强烈依赖运行时：OpenClaw在各模型下低于20%，nanobot在56.45%-96.13%之间。自创作技能效果非单调：nanobot GPT-5.4在所有模式下保持96%以上，MiniMax-M2.7在PostSkill下从90.97%提升至94.50%，但DeepSeek-V4-Pro从77.77%暴跌至4.80%（PreSkill）和0.99%（PostSkill）。OpenClaw同样出现技能运行接近基线或完全崩溃的情况。
AI.conclusion: 从智能体自身运行中学习可复用技能具有选择性和成本敏感性，并非在智能体循环中添加技能创作就能自动获益。

title: Replicating Belief, Not Bits: Epistemic State Replication for Agentic Systems
summary:
In distributed systems, the classical State Machine Replication (SMR) model assumes that correct replicas execute deterministic transitions to yield identical bitwise states. However, the rise of agentic distributed systems -- where autonomous, stochastic, and model-driven agents orchestrate infrastructure -- presents scenarios where deterministic, bitwise replication is insufficient. Replicas operating with generative models may exhibit divergent reasoning paths, summaries, and token boundaries, yet reach semantically equivalent and correct operational decisions. Forcing bitwise agreement across these stochastic participants degrades execution flexibility, induces context amnesia, and limits performance.
  We argue that in such settings replicas should agree on belief, not bits. We propose Epistemic State Replication (ESR), a belief-replication layer for agentic distributed systems that shifts the replication boundary from data visibility to knowledge visibility. We formalize the epistemic node state as a pair K = (L, B) separating the deterministic, immutable evidence log (L) from the stochastic, evolving belief lineage (B). To govern execution safety, we define Semantic Linearizability, which requires operations to reflect the latest committed operational meaning within a verifier-bounded semantic compatibility metric, and Bounded Eventual Coherence, which bounds expected semantic divergence under fair delivery, monotonic evidence, bounded verifier disturbance, and a contractive graft operator. We outline protocols for propagating derived insights using structured epistemic deltas, and formalize Verifiable Semantic Rollbacks to prune faulty premises from belief lineages without inducing context amnesia. We prototype ESR and report preliminary simulation results that show feasibility under the stated assumptions and illustrate reductions in secondary cognitive faults.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Epistemic State Replication (ESR)，一种面向智能体分布式系统的信念复制层，将复制边界从数据可见性转向知识可见性，使随机性节点在语义等价前提下无需达成比特级一致。
AI.motivation: 经典SMR假设确定性状态复制，但智能体系统（如大模型驱动的自主Agent）存在随机推理路径和语义等价但比特不同的输出，比特级一致会限制灵活性和性能，因此需要一种基于语义等价而非比特级一致的新复制模型。
AI.method: 将节点状态形式化为K=(L, B)，L为确定性不可变证据日志，B为随机演化的信念谱系；定义语义线性化和有界最终一致性作为安全语义约束；设计结构化认知增量传播协议和可验证语义回滚机制。
AI.result: 原型实现与模拟实验表明，在给定假设下ESR是可行的，并能减少次级认知故障。
AI.conclusion: 在智能体分布式系统中，节点应基于信念（语义等价）而非比特达成一致；ESR通过分离证据日志与信念谱系、定义语义一致性约束，为随机性复制的安全性和灵活性提供了形式化基础。

title: CAFE: A Compound-AI Factorial Evaluation Framework
summary: We introduce CAFE (Compound-AI Factorial Evaluation), an open-source platform that brings design of experiments to the evaluation of compound AI systems (CAIS). Such systems expose many interchangeable choices - e.g. which retriever, model, or prompt - and practitioners rarely know which of them most affects answer quality. With CAFE, a practitioner registers each swappable component of a pipeline as a factor to build a factorial design over the chosen factors, run the resulting configurations, and score the answers on a shared rubric using a configurable LLM judge together with human raters. From these ratings it attributes answer-quality variance to the components and their interactions with mixed-effects models and reports effect sizes, significance, the best configuration, cost and latency trade-offs, and judge-human reliability. Whereas existing tools mostly either search for a good configuration or score outputs in isolation, CAFE also explains which component drives quality and whether an observed difference is significant. We validate CAFE on a retrieval-augmented question-answering (QA) pipeline over the HotpotQA benchmark dataset, where it recovers planted factor effects and stays calibrated under a permutation null. CAFE is released as a Python package and as a Web application.

AI.tldr: CAFE是一个开源平台，将实验设计方法引入复合AI系统评估，通过析因设计、混合效应模型和LLM裁判，系统性地归因和量化各组件（如检索器、模型、提示词）对答案质量的影响，并已在检索增强QA流水线上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 复合AI系统包含多个可互换组件（如检索器、模型、提示词），但从业者往往不清楚哪个组件最影响答案质量，现有工具要么搜索最优配置，要么孤立评估输出，缺乏系统性地归因和显著性检验能力。
AI.method: CAFE将流水线的每个可替换组件注册为因子，构建析因设计，运行所有配置，使用可配置的LLM裁判结合人工评分者评估回答质量；通过混合效应模型将答案质量方差归因到各组件及其交互，报告效应量、显著性、最佳配置、成本延迟权衡以及裁判-人工一致性。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA基准的检索增强问答流水线上验证，CAFE能够恢复植入的因子效应，并在置换零假设下保持校准。
AI.conclusion: CAFE不仅搜索好配置或孤立评分，还能解释哪个组件驱动质量以及观察到的差异是否显著，作为Python包和Web应用开源发布。

title: Toward Inclusive Avatar Design with Limb Differences Through Artificial Intelligence
summary: As extended reality becomes more popular for social interaction and entertainment, 3D avatars must represent the full diversity of body types. Most 3D avatar systems only support normative bodies and do not accurately depict people with limb differences, amputations, or other morphological variations. This paper reviews emerging technical approaches for inclusive 3D avatar customization for this group and current guidelines that promote respectful and accurate representation. We highlight persistent challenges, including the scarcity of diverse datasets and the limitations in animation for non-normative anatomies. This paper positions artificial intelligence as a promising path to overcoming these limitations and advancing inclusive 3D avatar generation.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了面向肢体差异、截肢及其他形态变异群体的包容性3D化身定制技术，指出当前系统仅支持规范体型，并探讨了AI在解决数据集稀缺和非规范体动画限制方面的潜力。
AI.motivation: 随着扩展现实在社交和娱乐中的普及，3D化身需要代表全部身体类型多样性，但现有系统仅支持规范体型，无法准确描绘肢体差异、截肢等形态变异人群。
AI.method: 综述了新兴的包容性3D化身定制技术方法，以及当前促进尊重和准确表征的指导方针。
AI.result: 指出了持续存在的挑战，包括多样化数据集的稀缺以及非规范解剖结构的动画限制。
AI.conclusion: 将人工智能定位为克服这些限制、推进包容性3D化身生成的有前景路径。

title: SEAMLiS: Visibility-Aware Safety for Perception-Limited Multi-Robot Exploration
summary: Autonomous exploration in unknown environments is typically driven by informative frontiers, viewpoints, or trajectories, while local safety controllers avoid obstacles represented in the current map. Under finite sensing range and limited field of view, this separation can be unsafe: an exploration stack may plan optimistically through unobserved space and steer the sensor toward information gain rather than along the direction of motion, causing hidden obstacles to be detected too late for bounded-actuation avoidance. This paper presents SEAMLiS (Safe Exploration for Autonomous Multi-Robot Systems Under Limited Sensing), a modular execution-layer safety framework for decentralized multi-robot exploration. SEAMLiS preserves the upstream exploration stack, including the goal allocator and local planner, and enforces safety at the execution layer through perception-aware attitude and positional filters. A gatekeeper-based attitude filter switches between a visibility-promoting yaw policy and a velocity-tracking backup policy to preserve visibility of the critical known-free/unknown boundary with sufficient braking margin. A Control Barrier Function (CBF)-based positional filter then avoids known obstacles, newly detected obstacles, and other robots. We provide sufficient collision-avoidance conditions and validate the framework in randomized simulation, Isaac Sim, and Crazyflie hardware experiments. Results show collision-free exploration across tested single- and multi-robot settings while retaining much of the efficiency of visibility-promoting yaw control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEAMLiS，一个用于去中心化多机器人系统安全探索的执行层安全框架。该框架在保留上游探索栈（包括目标分配器和局部规划器）的同时，通过感知感知的姿态滤波器和位置滤波器在执行层强制执行安全性。基于门控的姿态滤波器在能见度促进偏航策略和速度跟踪备份策略之间切换，以保持对已知自由/未知边界的可见性并留有足够的制动裕度。基于控制障碍函数的位置滤波器则避开已知障碍物、新检测到的障碍物和其他机器人。实验表明该框架能在保证无碰撞探索的同时保留能见度促进偏航控制的高效性。
AI.motivation: 在有限感知范围和视野下，现有自主探索方法在未知环境中存在安全隐患：探索栈可能乐观地规划通过未观测空间，并将传感器转向信息增益方向而非运动方向，导致隐藏障碍物被探测到过晚，无法在有限制动能力下及时避让。
AI.method: 提出SEAMLiS安全框架，采用模块化执行层安全设计：(1) 保留上游探索栈（目标分配器和局部规划器）；(2) 在姿态层，通过门控机制在能见度促进的偏航策略和速度跟踪备份策略间切换，确保边界可见性与制动裕度；(3) 在位置层，利用控制障碍函数（CBF）避碰已知障碍、新检测障碍及其他机器人。同时给出充分碰撞避免条件。
AI.result: 通过随机仿真、Isaac Sim和Crazyflie硬件实验验证，在单机器人和多机器人场景中均实现了无碰撞探索，同时保留了能见度促进偏航控制的大部分效率。
AI.conclusion: SEAMLiS可在不修改上游探索栈的前提下，通过执行层安全过滤有效解决有限感知下多机器人探索的安全性隐患，实现了安全性与探索效率的良好平衡。

title: Does YOLO26 Truly Offer Advantages Over Its Predecessors for Edge Deployment? A Benchmark Study in Aquaculture
summary: The recently introduced YOLO26 architecture incorporates NMS-free end-to-end inference and is optimized for deployment on resource-constrained CPU-based devices, making it well-suited for edge-based aquaculture applications. However, its performance, operational efficiency, and deployment suitability have not been systematically validated in aquaculture-specific scenarios. This study presents a comprehensive benchmark of YOLO26 against three Ultralytics predecessors (YOLOv5u, YOLOv8, and YOLO11) across nano, small, and medium model scales for fish mortality detection, a critical indicator of fish population health and welfare. Twelve model variants were evaluated for detection accuracy, training efficiency across seven dataset sizes, and inference performance on high-performance NVIDIA A100 GPUs and a CPU-only Raspberry Pi 5 edge platform. All models achieved comparable performance on the full dataset, with mAP50 differing by only 1.04 percentage points, indicating that architectural generation has little influence on final detection accuracy when sufficient training data are available. However, clear trade-offs emerged in data efficiency and deployment performance. YOLOv8 achieved 90% mAP50 with only 400 training images, whereas the YOLO26 nano and small variants required 1,000 images to reach comparable accuracy. Conversely, YOLO26n achieved the highest inference speed on the Raspberry Pi 5 (7.51 FPS), while YOLOv5mu outperformed all contemporary medium-scale architectures on CPU-based hardware. These results show that architectural novelty alone is insufficient for model selection and that training data availability, target hardware, and inference requirements should be considered jointly when selecting object detection models for practical edge AI deployment in aquaculture.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统基准测试了YOLO26与三种前代YOLO模型（YOLOv5u、YOLOv8、YOLO11）在鱼类死亡检测任务上的性能。实验包含12个模型变体，评估了检测精度、训练数据效率和推理性能（NVIDIA A100 GPU和树莓派5边缘平台）。结果表明，在充足数据下各架构精度差异极小（mAP50仅差1.04个百分点），但在数据效率和部署性能上存在明显权衡：YOLOv8数据效率最高（400张图片达90% mAP50），YOLO26n在树莓派5上推理最快（7.51 FPS），YOLOv5mu在CPU硬件上表现最优。研究强调模型选择需综合考虑数据可用性、目标硬件和推理需求。
AI.motivation: YOLO26架构引入了无NMS端到端推理并针对CPU资源受限设备优化，适合边缘 aquaculture 应用，但其在 aquaculture 特定场景下的性能、运行效率和部署适用性尚未经过系统验证。
AI.method: 对YOLO26与YOLOv5u、YOLOv8、YOLO11在nano、small、medium三种模型尺度上共12个变体，从检测精度、训练数据效率（7种数据集规模）和推理性能（NVIDIA A100 GPU和树莓派5 CPU边缘平台）三个维度进行系统基准测试。
AI.result: 全数据集下所有模型mAP50仅相差1.04个百分点；YOLOv8数据效率最高（400张图片达90% mAP50），YOLO26n/s需1000张；YOLO26n在树莓派5上推理最快（7.51 FPS），YOLOv5mu在CPU硬件上表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 架构新颖性本身不足以作为模型选择依据，在选择 aquaculture 边缘AI部署的目标检测模型时，应综合考虑训练数据可用性、目标硬件和推理需求。

title: ERP Data Provisioning Financial Control Testing
summary: Financial control testing increasingly depends on representative enterprise resource planning (ERP) data in quality environments, yet direct production copies expose personal, supplier, banking, and commercially sensitive records. This work presents Secure ERP Quality Provisioning for Financial Control Testing (SEQ-FCT), a governed data-provisioning framework that combines deterministic masking, synthetic scenario expansion, referential tokenization, policy-based release approval, and automated validation for reconciliation, fraud-rule testing, and audit analytics. A single synthetic dataset is used for evaluation. It contains 186,000 finance-process records from six subsidiaries over 2022-2025, including accounts payable invoices, payments, general-ledger journals, accounts receivable receipts, and bank-statement lines. The dataset includes entity relationships, monetary values, approval paths, tax attributes, banking markers, exception labels, fraud-rule triggers, and control-failure outcomes. Because the dataset is synthetic, reported results demonstrate controlled internal consistency rather than production validation. Against a production-clone upper bound, static masking, rules-only synthesis, conditional tabular generative synthesis, and a hybrid baseline, SEQ-FCT achieved 0.932 reconciliation F1, 0.887 fraud-trigger recall, 0.914 control-failure F1, and an estimated leakage-risk score of 0.018. The analysis indicates that financial process behavior can be preserved more reliably when masking, synthetic data, and governance checks are evaluated as a single release pipeline instead of independent utilities.

AI.tldr: 提出SEQ-FCT框架，结合确定性脱敏、合成数据扩展、引用令牌化、策略审批和自动验证，在金融控制测试中平衡数据隐私保护与行为保真度。使用18.6万条合成ERP记录评估，在调和对账、欺诈触发、控制失败等任务上表现优于传统方法，泄露风险仅0.018。
AI.motivation: 金融控制测试依赖高质量的ERP数据，但直接使用生产副本会暴露个人、供应商、银行及商业敏感信息。现有独立的数据脱敏或合成方案难以同时满足隐私保护与金融流程行为保真的双重需求。
AI.method: SEQ-FCT框架包含五个核心组件：确定性脱敏（静态遮蔽）、合成场景扩展（结合规则与条件表格生成模型）、引用令牌化、基于策略的发布审批、以及面向对账/欺诈规则测试/审计分析的自动验证。评估采用单一合成数据集（18.6万条记录，来自6个子公司，2022-2025年），以生产克隆结果为上界，对比静态脱敏、纯规则合成、条件表格生成合成及混合基线。
AI.result: SEQ-FCT在合成数据集上达到：对调和对账F1=0.932，欺诈触发召回率=0.887，控制失败F1=0.914，泄露风险评分=0.018。优于所有基线方法，且表明将脱敏、合成数据与治理检查作为统一发布管道进行评估，比作为独立工具更能可靠保留金融流程行为。
AI.conclusion: SEQ-FCT框架能够有效平衡数据隐私保护与金融控制测试所需的行为保真度。将脱敏、合成数据生成与治理机制整合为统一管道，比独立使用各组件更能保留金融流程的行为特征。未来需在真实生产环境中进一步验证。

title: Task-Conditioned Synthetic Data Generation for Improving Machine Learning Performance in Agricultural Prediction Tasks
summary: Machine Learning (ML) algorithms have been widely used to estimate agricultural variables across diverse contexts. However, because the quantity and quality of training data strongly influence performance of ML algorithms, their use can be constrained by limited or incomplete reference data. Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) offers a practical approach to address this issue by producing artificial but realistic samples that preserve key characteristics of the original data. Building on teacher-student knowledge transfer and in-context learning for tabular data, this study proposes a Task-Conditioned SDG (TCSDG) algorithm that pairs a Bayesian Network generator with a transformer-based tabular foundation model (TabICL). The proposed algorithm was evaluated on two agricultural prediction tasks: crop yield prediction and crop type classification. Six benchmark SDG algorithms were also utilized to compare their performance with that of TCSDG. Across twelve study sites, two training-data fractions, four multiplication ratios, and three predictive ML algorithms, augmenting the original data with TCSDG-generated synthetic data improved ML performance in 89% of the crop type classification experiments and 74% of the crop yield prediction experiments. TCSDG also substantially outperformed benchmark SDG algorithms and was the only method to consistently improve ML performance across both tasks at the aggregate level. The study demonstrates that carefully designed and processed synthetic data can improve ML performance in precision-agriculture applications. TCSDG offers a practical and extensible framework for generating synthetic data that supports downstream ML agricultural prediction. The full implementation of TCSDG is publicly available as open source at https://github.com/HamidEbrahimy/TCSDG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种任务条件合成数据生成（TCSDG）算法，通过贝叶斯网络生成器与表格基础模型（TabICL）结合，在作物产量预测和作物类型分类任务中，数据增强后分别有74%和89%的实验提升了机器学习性能，且显著优于六种基准算法。
AI.motivation: 机器学习算法在农业变量估计中广泛应用，但训练数据的数量和质量限制了其性能，尤其当参考数据有限或不完整时。合成数据生成（SDG）提供了一种解决方案，但现有方法在农业任务中的有效性有待提升。
AI.method: 提出TCSDG算法，结合贝叶斯网络生成器与基于Transformer的表格基础模型（TabICL），利用教师-学生知识迁移和上下文学习技术，生成任务条件化的合成表格数据。
AI.result: 在12个研究站点、两种训练数据比例、四种倍增比率和三种预测ML算法下，TCSDG在作物类型分类中89%的实验和作物产量预测中74%的实验提升了ML性能；在聚合层面，TCSDG是唯一在这两类任务中均持续提升ML性能的方法。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的合成数据能够有效提升精准农业中下游ML任务的性能，TCSDG提供了一个实用且可扩展的合成数据生成框架，代码已开源。

title: Structured Thoughts For Improved Reasoning And Context Pruning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at generating long chains of thought, but long reasoning traces are often verbose and memory-inefficient. In this work, we introduce Structured Thoughts, a framework that organizes reasoning into alternating <try> and <outcome> blocks: <try> captures exploratory scratch work, while <outcome> contains the distilled conclusion of that step. We construct a dataset of structured thoughts by segmenting reasoning traces into <try> blocks and prompting an LLM to summarize each step into its corresponding <outcome>. Fine-tuning pretrained foundation models on this reformatted data produces models that adopt the structured reasoning style, leading to performance gains of up to 8.08\% on reasoning benchmarks compared to standard SFT. The explicit structure also enables context pruning: after each <try>/<outcome> pair, the <try> can be pruned, allowing the model to retain conclusions without keeping the full scratch work in the context. A proof-of-concept pruning implementation achieves an average of 85\% memory / context savings with an 8.67\% performance drop across mathematical tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Structured Thoughts框架，将推理过程组织为<try>和<outcome>交替的块结构，<try>记录探索性草稿，<outcome>包含提炼后的结论。通过微调使模型采用这种结构化推理风格，在推理基准上性能提升最高8.08%，并支持上下文剪枝，平均节省85%内存/上下文，性能下降仅8.67%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型擅长生成长链推理，但冗长的推理轨迹内存效率低下，需要一种更结构化的推理表示方法来提升效率和性能。
AI.method: 将推理轨迹分割为<try>块，并提示LLM将每个步骤总结为对应的<outcome>，构建结构化思维数据集；在该数据集上微调预训练基础模型；实现基于<try>/<outcome>对的上下文剪枝策略。
AI.result: 在推理基准上相比标准SFT性能提升最高8.08%；上下文剪枝实现平均85%的内存/上下文节省，性能下降8.67%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理组织方式既能提升推理性能，又能通过剪枝实现显著的上下文节省，为高效推理提供了一种有效范式。

title: "We are all in big trouble! *Shock Emoji": Personal Narratives in Expressing Emotions, Opinions, and Data Regarding Climate Change in TikTok Short Videos
comment: 44 pages, 33 figures, presenting this paper at CSCW 2026
summary: Climate change is a source of anxiety about the future. Understanding how people express themselves about climate change enables us to address such concerns. To study climate change expression on social media, we analyzed 200 TikTok videos tagged with #climatechange, identifying four categories of content: expression-feelings, views-appeals, news-information, and trend-hijacking. We found that creators use humor to package sharp critiques, avoiding direct confrontation. They replace complex discussions with life stories, such as adopting a vegetarian lifestyle or deleting emails. They borrow from news media to present fragmented information as scientific interpretations, creating a perception of scientific credibility, balancing scientific accuracy with emotionality. Analysis of viewer responses showed they engaged empathetically, reshaping interpretations of videos. These interactions risk reinforcing existing views but help build community on TikTok, which lacks community structure. This study reveals how creators may retell news on science using personal narratives, highlighting how short-form videos enable climate communication.

AI.tldr: 通过分析TikTok上200个带有#climatechange标签的视频，发现了四种内容类别（情感表达、观点呼吁、新闻信息、趋势劫持），揭示了创作者使用幽默、个人叙事和新闻借用等方式进行气候交流，观众则以共情方式参与互动，这些交互在缺乏社区结构的TikTok上帮助构建社区但可能强化既有观点。
AI.motivation: 气候焦虑日益普遍，理解人们在社交媒体上表达气候变化的方式有助于应对这一焦虑，但目前对短视频平台（如TikTok）上的气候表达模式缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 对200个标记为#climatechange的TikTok视频进行内容分析，识别出四种内容类别，并进一步分析创作者的表达策略和观众的回应模式。
AI.result: 发现四种视频类别；创作者使用幽默包装尖锐批评、以生活故事替代复杂讨论、借新闻媒体呈现碎片化信息以营造科学可信度；观众以共情方式参与，重塑视频解读，这些互动有助于构建社区但可能强化既有认知。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了短视频平台上的气候交流机制：创作者通过个人叙事重新讲述科学新闻，在平衡科学准确性与情感性之间形成独特的气候传播模式。

title: Task Planning for Mobile Manipulation in Retail Stores using Foundation Models with Iterative Re-planning
summary: Automation in industries such as retail, warehousing and logistics presents opportunities for greater throughput, cost reduction and mitigation of disruptions from labour shortages. Previously, such efforts have focused on back-room operations involving packing and sorting in relatively structured environments. With advances in robotic mobile manipulation hardware and foundation models, automation can now be applied to more variable and human-centric environments such as retail store shelves. In this work, we present a task-planning approach using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to address the restocking problem in retail scenarios such as supermarkets. We demonstrate this system on a custom omnidirectional mobile manipulation platform, with user-driven prompts and a feedback-based iterative re-planning approach for error correction. The end-to-end system is validated in a PyBullet simulation environment for pick-and-place tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）的零售货架补货任务规划方法，在自定义全向移动操作平台上实现，并通过基于反馈的迭代重规划进行纠错，在PyBullet仿真环境中验证了端到端的拾取和放置任务。
AI.motivation: 零售、仓储和物流行业的自动化可以提升吞吐量、降低成本并缓解劳动力短缺带来的干扰。以往自动化主要集中在结构化环境中的后台操作（如包装和分拣），而随着机器人移动操作硬件和基础模型的进步，自动化可以扩展到更具可变性和人类密集的环境（如零售货架），因此本文旨在解决零售场景中的补货问题。
AI.method: 本文采用大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）进行任务规划，在自定义全向移动操作平台上实现，采用用户驱动的提示和基于反馈的迭代重规划方法进行错误纠正，并在PyBullet仿真环境中对端到端系统进行拾取和放置任务的验证。
AI.result: 在PyBullet仿真环境中成功验证了端到端的拾取和放置任务，证明了基于LLM/VLM的任务规划方法在零售货架补货场景中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 结合LLM和VLM的任务规划方法能够使机器人自动化扩展到更具可变性和人类密集的零售环境（如超市货架补货），并通过基于反馈的迭代重规划有效处理错误，为零售、仓储和物流行业的进一步自动化提供了新的途径。

title: Reliability-Aware Ensemble Classification Under Class Imbalance: A Calibration Study on Liquid-Based Cervical Cytology
summary: Cervical cytology classification models are typically evaluated on curated, class-balanced benchmarks, but real-world liquid-based cytology (LBC) collections are often small and class-imbalanced. This paper presents a class-imbalance-aware and calibration-aware ensemble classification study on the Mendeley LBC dataset, using its native four-class Bethesda taxonomy (NILM, LSIL, HSIL, SCC) rather than a collapsed binary formulation. Three lightweight architectures (Swin-Tiny, TinyViT-5M, DenseNet121) are trained directly on Mendeley LBC using weighted random sampling to counteract class imbalance, and compared against two soft-voting ensembles (Hybrid-2, Hybrid-3). Post-hoc temperature scaling is fit on a held-out calibration subset carved out of the training portion of each cross-validation fold, distinct from both the training data used to fit model weights and the evaluation fold used for final metrics, avoiding the optimistic calibration estimates that result when the same data is used for both purposes. Calibration substantially reduces expected calibration error, Brier score, and negative log-likelihood for every model and ensemble configuration tested, while discrimination metrics (accuracy, macro-F1, macro-AUROC) remain essentially unchanged. Ensemble size shows no consistent additional reliability benefit over the best individual model once all configurations are properly calibrated. Confusion matrices show that all classification errors, across every configuration, are confined to the boundary between high-grade lesions (HSIL) and carcinoma (SCC); no errors involve the negative (NILM) or low-grade (LSIL) categories. These results suggest that, for this dataset, calibration is the dominant lever for reliability, not ensemble size, though this conclusion should be read in light of the dataset's modest size.

AI.tldr: 本文在真实的、类别不平衡的Mendeley LBC数据集上，使用加权随机采样和温度缩放校准，对比了轻量级模型及其集成配置，发现校准是提升可靠性的主要手段，而集成规模的影响微乎其微；所有分类错误均局限于HSIL与SCC之间。
AI.motivation: 宫颈细胞学分类模型通常在经过精心挑选、类别平衡的基准上进行评估，但现实中的液基细胞学（LBC）数据往往规模小且类别高度不平衡。本文旨在探索在真实不平衡小样本场景下，如何有效提升模型的可靠性。
AI.method: 使用Mendeley LBC数据集（四类Bethesda分类）；采用三种轻量级架构（Swin-Tiny, TinyViT-5M, DenseNet121）并配合加权随机采样；构建两种软投票集成（Hybrid-2, Hybrid-3）；在交叉验证中从训练集内划出独立的校准子集，对模型进行事后温度缩放校准。
AI.result: 校准显著降低了所有模型和集成的ECE、Brier分数和NLL，而判别指标（准确率、macro-F1、macro-AUROC）基本不变。集成规模在校准后未带来额外可靠性增益。混淆矩阵显示所有分类错误均局限于HSIL与SCC之间，未涉及NILM或LSIL。
AI.conclusion: 在该数据集上，校准是提升模型可靠性的主导因素，而非集成规模；但该结论需考虑数据集规模有限的局限性。
