title: Gauge dependence and structured-output corruption in sign-branched repetition penalties: measurements across models, inference stacks, and alternative repetition controls
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code, data, per-stack survey and git genealogy: https://github.com/captainpete/repetition-penalty-gauge
summary: The multiplicative repetition penalty shipped across the LLM inference ecosystem (HuggingFace, vLLM, llama.cpp, and a dozen further engines) branches on the sign of each raw logit (divide positives by theta, multiply negatives). But the softmax is unchanged by adding a constant to every logit, so a model's logit zero-point is arbitrary, and the sign-branch reads that arbitrary point. The sign-branch is itself the accepted fix for an earlier bug, so the accepted fix branches on a quantity the training objective leaves unconstrained. Two measurable consequences follow. (1) The penalty is not well-defined: re-centring a model's logits by a constant is a provable no-op at theta=1, yet at a routine theta=1.3 it changes 58-96% of greedy tokens, where subtractive and normalized penalties change none; real checkpoints sit at widely different zero-points, so a fixed repetition_penalty is a different operation on every model. (2) It corrupts structured output: on 200 real-world JSON schemas, theta=1.3 drops the rate of valid, schema-conformant output from 97% to 23%. In our measurements, applying the penalty to normalized log-probabilities instead of raw logits removes both effects. HuggingFace already ships that operator (LogitNormalization); today it is off by default and applied after the penalty. This note gives the mechanism, the measurements (five models up to 7B, base and RLHF, on WikiText-103 prefixes; two code models on HumanEval and JSONSchemaBench; both effects replicated inside vLLM and llama.cpp through their own samplers on the same inputs), and the normalized variant.

AI.tldr: LLM推理生态中广泛使用的乘法重复惩罚（repetition penalty）因对原始logit的符号进行分支而产生严重的功能性缺陷：惩罚效果依赖于未受训练约束的logit零点，导致不同模型间惩罚行为不一致，并在结构化输出场景中造成严重退化。使用归一化log概率替代原始logit可消除这两个问题。
AI.motivation: 指出当前LLM推理生态中广泛使用的乘法重复惩罚存在根本性缺陷——其符号分支逻辑依赖于训练目标未约束的logit零点，导致惩罚行为在模型间不一致，且对结构化输出造成破坏。
AI.method: 通过理论分析和实证测量，在五个模型（最高7B参数，包括base和RLHF版本）上使用WikiText-103、HumanEval和JSONSchemaBench基准，在HuggingFace、vLLM和llama.cpp引擎中复现两种效应，提出使用归一化log概率替代原始logit的修复方案。
AI.result: (1) 在theta=1.3时，重新居中logit会改变58-96%的贪婪解码token，而归一化惩罚无变化；(2) theta=1.3使JSON Schema符合率从97%降至23%。
AI.conclusion: 当前乘法重复惩罚因分支在未约束的logit零点上而导致功能不可靠和结构化输出退化，改用归一化log概率可消除这些问题；HuggingFace已提供LogitNormalization算子但默认关闭且应用顺序错误。

title: LegalFarePlan: A Label-Setting Framework for Fare-Transparent Urban Rail Route Planning under Non-Additive Fare Rules
comment: 6 pages, 4 tables; author preprint version, not the conference camera-ready version
summary: Urban rail fare systems may be non-additive: the fare of a single paid journey from an origin to a destination can differ from the sum of fares over multiple legally separated journey legs. This paper presents LegalFarePlan, a fare-transparent route-planning framework that models legal exit-and-reentry operations as explicit, auditable constraints. Given a transit network, fare function, transfer rules, station-level exit/re-entry costs, an extra-time budget, and a split limit, the planner computes explainable route plans over paid journey segments. The artifact implements Dijkstra shortest-time and direct route-planner baselines, a greedy split heuristic, bounded exact label-setting, and Pareto-frontier search. Evaluation uses controlled synthetic data and a 57-station semi-synthetic benchmark with 360 OD pairs. On the semi-synthetic benchmark, bounded exact search identifies positive modeled fare reductions for 71.11% of OD pairs, with mean reduction 3.78 and maximum reduction 9.0 synthetic fare units under a 45-minute extra-time budget. These results demonstrate method behavior and reproducibility; they are not empirical conclusions about MTR or any transit operator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LegalFarePlan框架，通过建模合法的出站再入站操作，在给定的额外时间预算和分割限制下，计算非加性票价体系中的透明路径规划方案，实验表明在71.11%的OD对上实现了平均3.78单位的票价降低。
AI.motivation: 城市轨道交通票价可能具有非加性特征，即一次性付费的全程票价与分段购票的票价之和可能不同，现有路径规划方法未充分考虑这种合法拆票操作带来的票价优化空间。
AI.method: 提出LegalFarePlan框架，将合法的出站再入站操作建模为显式、可审计的约束；实现了Dijkstra最短时间基线、直接路径规划基线、贪婪分割启发式、有界精确标签设置以及帕累托前沿搜索等方法。
AI.result: 在57个车站的半合成基准测试中，有界精确搜索在71.11%的OD对上发现了模拟的票价降低，平均降低3.78单位，最大降低9.0单位（在45分钟额外时间预算下）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了可复现的票价优化行为，但结果是针对合成数据的方法验证，并非对任何实际运营商的实证结论。

title: A Stepwise Questioning Expert-Editor Multi-Agent Framework for Long-Document Summarization
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) have shown promising potential in news summarization tasks, their performance on long-document summarization remains challenging as their length often exceeds the input limits. As the agent investment, which provide possibility to improve the inherent capabilities of LLMs. To enhance the effectiveness of long-document summarization based on LLMs, this paper proposes an expert-editor stepwise questioning multi-agent method, in which the expert and the editor guide another agent to refine the summary by posing questions on different aspects of the content and providing targeted clues for revision. We conducted experiments on two representative long-document scientific datasets and evaluated the results through widely recognized automatic metrics. The results demonstrated the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种专家-编辑逐步提问多智能体方法，通过让专家和编辑代理引导另一个代理从不同内容角度提出问题并提供针对性修改线索，来增强基于大语言模型的长文档摘要生成效果。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在长文档摘要任务中因输入长度超出模型限制而表现不佳，而智能体投资（多智能体协作）为提升LLM固有能力提供了可能性，因此需要一种有效的方法来增强长文档摘要效果。
AI.method: 提出专家-编辑逐步提问多智能体方法（expert-editor stepwise questioning multi-agent method），由专家和编辑两个智能体引导另一个智能体，通过从不同内容角度提出问题并提供针对性修改线索，逐步优化摘要。
AI.result: 在两个具有代表性的长文档科学数据集上进行了实验，并通过广泛认可的自动评估指标进行评估，结果表明该方法有效。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的多智能体协作方法能够有效提升大语言模型在长文档摘要任务上的表现。

title: HandPad: A Bimanual Hand Interface for Fluid Window Interactions in VR
summary: Virtual Reality (VR) offers potential for productivity work by creating expansive displays anywhere, yet current systems often rely on external input devices that limit the on-the-go use of mobile VR. We introduce HandPad, a suite of bare-hand interaction techniques that leverage the benefits of asymmetric bimanual coordination and self-haptic support. HandPad assigns the non-dominant hand (NDH) to establish spatial frames and interaction contexts, while the dominant hand (DH) performs fine-grained manipulation. Users can use NDH gestures as an input modifier to change the mode and target of DH interactions, including multi-window navigation, in-window content interaction, and window management. The palm surface of the NDH also serves as a physical touch surface, providing passive haptic feedback for effective DH touch interaction. Both hands and their interactions are spatially remapped to the window surface, enabling comfortable and direct interaction with virtual content. An exploratory study showed that HandPad enables efficient and ergonomic interaction, demonstrating its potential as a device-free approach for knowledge work in VR.

AI.tldr: HandPad 提出了一套基于裸手操作的非对称双手交互技术，利用非惯用手建立空间框架和交互上下文，惯用手进行精细操作，并利用手掌表面提供触觉反馈，实现无外设的 VR 生产力交互。
AI.motivation: 现有移动 VR 系统依赖外部输入设备，限制了其随时随地使用的便携性，需要一种无设备的裸手交互方案来支持 VR 中的知识工作。
AI.method: 设计了一套非对称双手协调的裸手交互技术，非惯用手用于建立空间框架、提供交互上下文和物理触摸表面（手掌），惯用手进行精细操作，并通过空间重映射将双手交互映射到虚拟窗口表面。
AI.result: 探索性研究显示 HandPad 能够实现高效且符合人体工学的交互，证明了其作为无设备 VR 知识工作方法的潜力。
AI.conclusion: HandPad 提供了一种无需外部输入设备的裸手交互方案，能够有效支持 VR 中的多窗口导航、窗口内内容交互和窗口管理等知识工作任务。

title: Chalito: An Extensible Library for Filtering-Based State Estimation in Quadruped Robots
summary: State estimation is essential for quadruped robots, enabling robust locomotion, navigation, and control. While many estimators have been proposed in the literature, existing implementations are often tied to specific robots or software stacks, making fair comparisons difficult. This lack of a general-purpose benchmarking framework hinders reproducibility and slows down algorithmic innovation. In this paper, we introduce Chalito, an extensible MATLAB/Python library for benchmarking filter-based state estimation algorithms in quadruped robots. Chalito imports robot models directly from URDF, supports multiple filtering approaches, and is designed to be easily extended with new methods. The framework runs on both simulated and real datasets, enabling systematic evaluation across robots and filters. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first open-source library exclusively dedicated to benchmarking filtering algorithms for quadruped robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Chalito，一个用于四足机器人状态估计算法基准测试的MATLAB/Python开源库，支持多种滤波方法、URDF模型导入和模拟/真实数据集评估，旨在解决现有实现缺乏通用基准测试框架的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有四足机器人状态估计实现常绑定特定机器或软件栈，难以公平比较，缺乏通用基准测试框架阻碍了可重复性和算法创新。
AI.method: 开发了Chalito库，支持从URDF导入机器人模型，集成多种滤波方法，设计为可扩展架构，兼容模拟和真实数据集，实现跨机器人和滤波器的系统化评估。
AI.result: 首个专用于四足机器人滤波算法基准测试的开源库，支持多种滤波方法、URDF模型导入及模拟/真实数据评估。
AI.conclusion: Chalito为四足机器人状态估计算法提供了统一的基准测试平台，促进了可重复性和算法创新。

title: Prompting-MammAlps: Fine-Grained Text-to-Video Retrieval for Camera-Trap Data
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026; Project page: https://cnai.epfl.ch/prompting-mammalps
summary: Automatically retrieving videos from large camera-trap datasets remains challenging. Text-to-Video retrieval (TVR) methods based on large video-language models (VLMs) have potential to retrieve events of interest by describing them with simple text queries. However, current methods often lack spatiotemporal understanding and do not generalize well to ecological data. In this work, we introduce Prompting-MammAlps, the first camera-trap TVR benchmark, and propose a fine-grained and interpretable TVR method. Specifically, we trained a vision transformer to perform spatiotemporal action localization, and convert its output to structured text, describing each video. Independently, ethology-inspired queries are processed by a Large-Language Model (LLM) based coding agent to parse the structured text per video and retrieve videos accordingly. We harnessed the LLM to use functions from a custom parsing library to minimize the risk of LLM hallucinations and to improve method interpretability. This retrieval approach applied on the Prompting-MammAlps benchmark achieved a set-based F1-score of 34\% on a test set of 135 ecologically-relevant queries and 775 candidate videos. In comparison the best zero-shot VLM achieved a F1-score of 18\%, while also lacking interpretability. Project page: https://cnai.epfl.ch/prompting-mammalps

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Prompting-MammAlps——首个相机陷阱视频-文本检索基准，并设计了一种细粒度、可解释的检索方法：利用视觉Transformer进行时空动作定位后转为结构化文本，再通过基于LLM的编码代理解析查询并检索视频。该方法在135个生态相关查询和775个候选视频上取得34%的F1分数，远超最佳零样本VLM（18%），且具有更好的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 从大规模相机陷阱数据集中自动检索视频仍然具有挑战性。现有的基于大型视频-语言模型的文本-视频检索方法缺乏时空理解能力，且对生态数据的泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 训练视觉Transformer进行时空动作定位，将其输出转换为结构化文本描述每个视频；同时，受动物行为学启发的查询由基于LLM的编码代理处理，通过调用自定义解析库函数来解析每个视频的结构化文本并检索匹配视频，以此降低LLM幻觉风险并提高可解释性。
AI.result: 在Prompting-MammAlps基准测试中，该方法在135个生态相关查询和775个候选视频上取得了34%的基于集合的F1分数，而最佳零样本VLM仅取得18%的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法在相机陷阱视频检索任务上显著优于现有零样本VLM方法，并同时提供了更好的可解释性，验证了结构化文本+LLM编码代理这一范式的有效性。

title: Metadata-Free Meta-Reweighted Direct Preference Optimization under Noisy Preference Labels
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become an important method for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences because it removes the need for explicit reward modeling and reinforcement learning optimization. However, its performance depends heavily on the quality of preference data, and noisy preference data in real-world settings can weaken alignment performance. To address this issue, we propose a bilevel optimization framework and prove, under certain assumptions, that this framework can recover the DPO optimum under clean data. We further derive a prior form for the learnable weighting function under asymmetric label-flipping noise. Considering that high-quality metadata may be difficult to obtain, we propose a task-agnostic meta-knowledge-driven method that enables meta-learning even when metadata is completely unavailable. To reduce the high cost of higher-order gradients in LLM meta-learning, we combine central-difference approximation with LoRA fine-tuning and develop a scalable training scheme. Experiments on TL;DR summarization and Anthropic HH single-turn dialogue show that the proposed method improves training performance over multiple DPO baselines under different noise rates.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于双层优化的偏好数据去噪框架（Meta-DPO），通过元学习可学习的加权函数，结合中心差分近似和LoRA微调，在无需元数据的情况下提升DPO在噪声偏好数据下的对齐性能。
AI.motivation: DPO性能严重依赖偏好数据质量，而现实中的偏好数据常含有噪声（如不对称标签翻转噪声），导致对齐性能下降；现有的去噪方法通常需要高质量元数据，而元数据往往难以获取。
AI.method: 1) 构建双层优化框架，理论上证明该框架能在干净数据下恢复DPO最优解；2) 推导出非对称标签翻转噪声下可学习加权函数的先验形式；3) 提出任务无关的元知识驱动方法，在元数据完全不可用的情况下实现元学习；4) 结合中心差分近似与LoRA微调，降低LLM元学习中高阶梯度的计算成本。
AI.result: 在TL;DR摘要和Anthropic HH单轮对话数据集上，所提方法在不同噪声率下均优于多个DPO基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效缓解了噪声偏好数据对DPO对齐性能的负面影响，且无需依赖高质量元数据，同时具备可扩展的训练方案。

title: BatteryLake: Agentic, Physics-Grounded Curation of Heterogeneous Battery Aging Data and Benchmarking
comment: The platform, benchmark, and curation protocol are publicly available at https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/
summary: Public battery aging datasets are a critical asset for advanced health management, but their practical use is often limited by inconsistent formats, unclear schemas, and metadata scattered across repositories and publications. Current curation remains largely manual and hard to reproduce, while general-purpose data integration tools miss the domain-specific semantics of electrochemical time-series data. We present BatteryLake, a governed data lakehouse that turns raw public battery data into benchmark-ready assets through an agentic, physics-grounded curation framework, with three contributions. First, LLM agents extract metadata and synthesize dataset-specific converters, grounding every output in verbatim evidence and abstaining when none supports a value. Second, a human-in-the-loop mechanism frames verification as selective prediction and gates admitted data through 26 schema, statistical, and physical-plausibility rules. Third, we release an open benchmark of 41 datasets from over 25 institutions, with standardized SOH and RUL tasks, three split protocols, and eight baseline model families. The platform, benchmark, and curation protocol are publicly available at https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/.

AI.tldr: BatteryLake是一个基于代理和物理约束的数据湖仓，通过LLM代理自动提取元数据并生成数据集转换器，结合人在回路中的选择性预测验证机制，将41个来自25+机构的公共电池老化数据集标准化为基准可用资产，并发布了标准化的SOH/RUL基准测试任务。
AI.motivation: 公共电池老化数据集存在格式不一致、模式不清晰、元数据分散等问题，当前数据整理工作大多依赖人工且难以复现，而通用数据集成工具又缺乏电化学时间序列数据的领域特定语义。
AI.method: 提出BatteryLake数据湖仓，包含三个核心贡献：1）LLM代理提取元数据并生成数据集特定转换器，输出基于逐字证据并允许弃权；2）人在回路机制将验证构建为选择性预测，通过26条模式、统计和物理合理性规则过滤数据；3）发布包含41个数据集、标准化SOH/RUL任务、三种拆分协议和八个基线模型族的开放基准。
AI.result: 成功构建了包含41个来自25+机构的数据集标准化平台，提供了完整的SOH和RUL基准测试任务、三种数据拆分协议以及八个基线模型族。
AI.conclusion: 通过代理驱动、物理约束的数据湖仓方法，有效解决了公共电池数据集的标准化和基准化难题，相关平台、基准和协议已公开提供。

title: Enjoy Your Talk: A Human-Centered Benchmark for Multi-Turn Dialogue with Decoupled User Simulation, Target Modeling, and Judging
summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) as multi-turn conversational partners requires probing capabilities that single-turn benchmarks miss: persona consistency, evolving intent tracking, emotional dynamics, and goal completion. We introduce EYT-Bench, a human-centered benchmark built around a three-party decoupled design: a persona-grounded user simulator, a target model that separates intent perception from response generation, and an independent third-party LLM judge with optional multi-judge ensembling. Personas are sampled from public human-curated corpora, Nemotron-Personas-USA and PersonaMem-v2, rather than synthesized, reducing LLM-induced persona bias. EYT-Bench also introduces two trajectory-level metrics: embedding-based intent drift and final-intent completion rate (FICR), inspired by tau-bench. In a 17-target x 200-dialogue evaluation, EYT-Bench reveals four findings: (i) state-of-the-art closed- and open-source models are statistically close on subjective dimensions (empathy / persona / anthropomorphism vary within <= 0.3), but differ by up to 9x on objective intent tracking; (ii) reasoning ("thinking on") sharply improves objective tracking on long-context personas (+0.47-0.50 latent-intent accuracy on Gemma-4) while leaving subjective scores nearly unchanged; (iii) persona format dominates trajectory spread, with FICR saturating above 0.95 on Nemotron-USA but spreading from 0.53 to 0.88 on PersonaMem-v2; and (iv) the warm-up effect is robust on 16/17 models (one outlier, GPT-5.5, reverses the effect), with stable rankings across alpha in [0.05, 0.15]. A cross-judge ablation using deepseek-v4-pro confirms that target rankings and final-intent satisfaction are preserved across judges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EYT-Bench基准，采用三阶段解耦设计评估LLM多轮对话能力，包含用户模拟器、目标模型和独立评委。在17个模型×200轮对话评估中，发现意图追踪存在9倍差异，推理能力提升意图追踪0.47-0.50但主观评分不变，人物设定格式主导轨迹分布，预热效应在16/17个模型上稳健。
AI.motivation: 现有的单轮基准无法全面评估LLM作为多轮对话伙伴所需的能力，如人物一致性、意图跟踪、情感动态和目标完成。需要设计一个更全面的基准来揭示这些维度上的差异。
AI.method: EYT-Bench采用三阶段解耦设计：(1)基于人物设定的用户模拟器，(2)将意图感知与回复生成分离的目标模型，(3)独立的第三方LLM评委（可选多评委集成）。使用来自Nemotron-Personas-USA和PersonaMem-v2的公开人物设定。引入两个轨迹级指标：嵌入意图漂移和最终意图完成率（FICR）。
AI.result: (i) 最先进的闭源和开源模型在主观维度上差异不大（≤0.3），但意图追踪客观指标差异达9倍；(ii) 推理能力显著提升长上下文意图追踪（+0.47-0.50），但对主观评分影响不大；(iii) 人物设定格式主导轨迹分布，FICR在Nemotron-USA上饱和（>0.95），PersonaMem-v2上分布为0.53-0.88；(iv) 预热效应在16/17个模型上稳健（GPT-5.5为异常值）。跨评委消融实验验证了目标排名和最终意图满足的一致性。
AI.conclusion: EYT-Bench是一个有效评估LLM多轮对话能力的基准，能够揭示单轮基准无法发现的差异。推理能力虽提升客观追踪但对主观体验提升有限，人物设定质量对评估结果影响显著。

title: Supporting Reflection in LLM-based Exploratory Search
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can make exploratory search more efficient but may undermine the reflection and iterative sensemaking needed in unfamiliar domains. Existing LLM tools often prioritize rapid answers over supporting users in tracking how their understanding evolves and how well their strategies align with their goals. We present TrailLM, a system that helps users reconstruct and revisit their exploration paths to support reflection and metacognitive engagement during information seeking. By aligning LLM assistance with users' sensemaking workflows, TrailLM aims to preserve the benefits of LLM-based search while enhancing opportunities for critical reflection on one's own search process.

AI.tldr: TrailLM是一个帮助用户在信息探索中记录和回溯搜索路径的系统，以支持反思和元认知参与，平衡LLM的高效搜索与用户的深度理解需求。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM工具优先提供快速答案，但削弱了用户在陌生领域进行反思和迭代意义建构的能力，用户难以追踪自己的理解如何演化以及策略是否与目标一致。
AI.method: TrailLM通过帮助用户重建和回溯探索路径，将LLM辅助与用户的意义建构工作流对齐，在保留LLM搜索优势的同时增强对自身搜索过程的批判性反思机会。
AI.result: 未在摘要中明确给出具体实验结果，但系统设计目标是让用户能够追踪理解演化过程并评估策略与目标的一致性。
AI.conclusion: TrailLM能够在利用LLM搜索效率的同时，增强用户在信息探寻过程中的元认知参与和批判性反思能力。

title: PinFT: Miniature 5-Axis Force/Torque Sensor Embeddable to Tweezer-like Tool
summary: We present PinFT, a miniature five-axis capacitive force/torque sensor designed for direct tip-level integration into tweezer-like tools. The sensor employs a compact three-PCB stack with segmented plated through-hole electrodes and a silicone elastomer dielectric, enabling five-degree-of-freedom force and torque sensing ($F_x$, $F_y$, $F_z$, $T_x$, $T_y$) through displacement of a central 2\,mm-diameter stainless steel pin. The fabricated prototype was calibrated using a higher-order polynomial mapping, yielding mean absolute errors of approximately 0.23\,N for forces and 2.5\,mN$\cdot$m for torques, with coefficients of determination ($R^2$) exceeding 0.97 across all axes. To demonstrate practical utility, a 3D-printed tweezer integrating PinFT sensors at both tips was mounted on a parallel-jaw gripper and evaluated across three representative manipulation tasks: grasping a sub-millimeter SMD capacitor, pulling a simulated hair from a silicone substrate, and tearing a compliant silicone specimen. In all cases, per-tip force sensing reliably captured characteristic force signatures that distinguish successful manipulation from failure events -- including slip and object ejection -- using gradient-based features derived from internal grasp force and net interaction force. These results demonstrate that direct, per-tip force sensing enables standard parallel-jaw grippers to monitor and interpret fine manipulation tasks performed through a handheld tweezer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种微型五轴力/扭矩传感器PinFT，可直接集成于镊子工具尖端。该传感器采用紧凑的三PCB堆叠结构，通过中心2mm不锈钢针的位移实现五自由度力/扭矩感知。实验表明，力与扭矩的平均绝对误差分别约为0.23N和2.5mN·m，R²>0.97。将传感器集成到3D打印镊子并安装在平行夹爪上，成功在三个精细操作任务中捕捉到区分成功与失败的特征力信号。
AI.motivation: 当前精细操作任务（如抓取微小元件）中缺乏可直接集成于镊子尖端的微型力/扭矩传感器，导致无法在操作点直接感知力信息，限制了夹爪对精细操作的监控与理解能力。
AI.method: 设计了一种三PCB堆叠结构的电容式传感器，采用分段镀通孔电极和硅弹性体介电层，通过中心2mm不锈钢针位移实现五轴力/扭矩测量。使用高阶多项式映射进行标定，并将传感器集成至3D打印镊子尖端，安装在平行夹爪上执行三项操作任务。
AI.result: 标定后力与扭矩的平均绝对误差分别约为0.23N和2.5mN·m，各轴R²均超过0.97。在抓取SMD电容、模拟拔毛、撕裂硅胶样本三项任务中，每尖端力传感可靠捕捉到区分成功与失败（滑移、物体弹出）的特征力信号。
AI.conclusion: 直接每尖端力传感使标准平行夹爪能够监控和解读通过手持镊子执行的精细操作任务，可有效区分操作成功与失败事件。

title: A Dual-Stream Challenge-Response Protocol for Ocular Liveness Verification
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Simulation-based theoretical framework; human-subject validation identified as future work
summary: Ocular biometric systems face sophisticated presentation attacks, including high-resolution video replays and real-time generative deepfakes, which easily bypass static liveness checks. Current Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) frameworks typically rely on isolated physiological metrics, such as gaze tracking or the Pupillary Light Reflex (PLR), which can be spoofed independently. This paper proposes a Spatio-Luminance Sensor Fusion protocol, which introduces a dual-stream challenge-response framework for ocular liveness verification by uniting these metrics into a simultaneous authentication challenge. By generating a randomized, time-varying visual stimulus that fluctuates in both spatial trajectory and luminance intensity, we construct a mathematically coupled state-space likelihood model, termed the Synchronization Matrix, to evaluate the continuous cross-correlation between the expected biological latencies of smooth pursuit tracking and pupillary constriction. Using Monte Carlo simulation grounded in literature-derived latency distributions, we demonstrate theoretical separability between genuine and simulated attack conditions, and show that a multi-round challenge design improves the detection of generative deepfakes when a non-zero rendering-latency gap exists. This work provides a simulation-supported theoretical framework for next-generation dynamic spoofing defense in ocular and iris biometrics; human-subject validation is identified as necessary future work before deployment claims can be made.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种时空-亮度传感器融合协议，通过随机化视觉刺激同时激发平滑追踪和瞳孔光反射，构建同步矩阵评估两种生物延迟的连续互相关，理论模拟证明其能有效检测高分辨率视频回放和生成式深度伪造攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有眼部生物特征活体检测依赖孤立生理指标（如注视追踪或瞳孔光反射），这些指标可被分别欺骗；高分辨率视频回放和实时生成式深度伪造能轻松绕过静态活体检测，亟需一种将多模态生理指标耦合为统一认证挑战的动态防御方法。
AI.method: 提出时空-亮度传感器融合协议，采用双流挑战-响应框架：生成随机时变视觉刺激（空间轨迹和亮度强度同时波动）；构建数学耦合状态空间似然模型（同步矩阵），评估平滑追踪和瞳孔收缩的预期生物延迟之间的连续互相关；基于文献推导的延迟分布进行蒙特卡洛模拟验证。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛模拟证明理论条件下真实与模拟攻击之间存在可分离性；多轮挑战设计能提升对生成式深度伪造的检测能力（当存在非零渲染-延迟差距时）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为下一代动态欺骗防御提供了模拟支持的理论框架，但人类受试者验证是未来必要的步骤，目前尚不能做出部署声明。

title: JEPA for AI-Native 6G: Predictive Representations and Open Challenges
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Tutorial and review on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) for AI-native 6G. Submitted to IEEE Communications Magazine
summary: Sixth-generation (6G) networks are moving toward AI-native operation, where learning modules are embedded across the radio access network (RAN), edge, and core. This transition requires learning from limited labels, heterogeneous wireless and network data, partial observations, non-stationary propagation, and latency-constrained control loops. Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) is a promising self-supervised paradigm for this setting because it predicts missing or future representations in latent space instead of reconstructing raw measurements or using contrastive negative samples. This article presents a wireless-oriented tutorial on JEPA for 6G intelligence. We define the JEPA training mechanism, describe how CSI, beam measurements, KPIs, topology graphs, and sensing observations can be tokenized and masked, and position the learned encoder as a predictive representation layer for RAN, O-RAN, edge, and core functions, with task-specific heads or controllers producing final decisions. Then we present an illustrative, beam-management case study suggesting that a wireless-aware target, specifically an auxiliary future beam-energy target during self-supervised pretraining, can improve label efficiency and robustness across shifted deployment conditions relative to a supervised source domain. Finally, we outline open challenges in multi-timescale prediction, action-conditioned modeling, distributed training, trustworthiness, efficient deployment, benchmarking, and standardization.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了面向6G网络的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），作为一种自监督学习范式，通过预测潜在空间中的缺失或未来表示，而非直接重建原始测量或使用对比负样本，来解决6G网络中标签稀缺、数据异构、非平稳传播和延迟受限控制环路等挑战。文章提供了面向无线的JEPA教程，包括训练机制、各类无线数据的令牌化与掩码方法，并以波束管理案例展示了无线感知目标在自监督预训练中提升标签效率和鲁棒性的优势，最后讨论了开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 6G网络正朝着AI原生方向演进，需要在无线接入网、边缘和核心网中嵌入学习模块，但面临标签有限、数据异构、部分观测、非平稳传播和延迟受限等挑战，亟需一种适合该场景的自监督学习范式。
AI.method: 提出面向6G的JEPA自监督学习框架：定义训练机制，将CSI、波束测量、KPI、拓扑图和感知观测进行令牌化和掩码处理，将学习到的编码器作为预测表示层，配合任务特定头或控制器输出最终决策。在波束管理案例中，引入辅助的未来波束能量目标作为无线感知预训练目标。
AI.result: 波束管理案例研究表明，采用无线感知目标（辅助未来波束能量目标）进行自监督预训练，相比监督源域方法，在标签效率和跨部署条件的鲁棒性方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: JEPA是6G AI原生网络中有前景的自监督范式，但仍面临多时间尺度预测、动作条件建模、分布式训练、可信性、高效部署、基准测试和标准化等开放挑战。

title: How Much Does Correctness Cost? Budgeted Placement of Strong Correctors in a Weak Multi-Agent Swarm
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures, 1 table.. Code and data: https://github.com/YehudaItkin/budgeted-oracle-placement
summary: A cheap swarm of unreliable agents can be steered to a correct consensus by a few strong, expensive "oracle" correctors. We ask how much one must spend, and where to place the oracles. We model the swarm as a consensus on a graph in which each oracle pins one node toward the truth at a cost-coupled, concave strength, and measure quality by the coherence H(R)=tr M(R)^{-1}. Our first result is that H stays submodular (each added oracle helps less than the last) even when the oracles differ in strength, so a cost-benefit greedy comes within 1-1/e of the best placement at any budget. Inverting the budget gives the budget-correctness frontier B*(eps), the least spend that guarantees an eps-correct consensus: closed-form on the complete graph, and a minimal oracle count k* when oracles cost the same. Whether a budget then buys a few strong oracles or many medium onese curvature of the cost-quality law: diminishing returns favour spreadsharply increasion. Measured onthe Qwen3 ladder (0.6-32B), the law is concave for math verificatio convex foremergent code tracing, so the verdict is genuinely task-dependent.https://github.com/YehudaItkin/budgeted-oracle-placemen

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何用少量强"预言机"引导廉价不可靠智能体群达成正确共识，分析在预算约束下预言机的优化放置问题，发现成本-质量函数的凹凸性决定应分散投资还是集中投资，且该性质在数学验证与代码追踪任务上截然相反。
AI.motivation: 研究在预算有限的情况下，如何最优地部署少量强力的"预言机"来纠正大量廉价不可靠智能体，使其达成正确共识，并探究预算与正确性之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 将群体建模为图上的共识过程，每个预言机以成本耦合的凹强度将节点钉向真实值，以相干性 H(R)=tr M(R)^{-1} 度量质量。证明了即使预言机强度不同，H仍保持子模性（每增加一个预言机带来的收益递减），因此成本-收益贪心算法在任意预算下能达到最优放置的1-1/e。推导了完全图上的预算-正确性边界闭式解以及同等成本下的最小预言机数量。
AI.result: 在Qwen3模型（0.6-32B）上实验发现：数学验证任务的成本-质量函数是凹的（收益递减，倾向于分散投资）；代码追踪任务则是凸的（收益递增，倾向于集中投资）。这表明最优策略具有任务依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 预算约束下预言机的放置策略取决于任务性质——凹性成本-质量关系支持分散部署多个中等强度预言机，凸性关系则支持集中投资少数强预言机。

title: Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models Using Diversion Decoding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful tool for retrieving knowledge through seamless, human-like interactions. Despite their advanced text generation capabilities, LLMs exhibit hallucination tendencies, where they generate factually incorrect statements and fabricate knowledge, undermining their reliability and trustworthiness. Multiple studies have explored methods to evaluate LLM uncertainty and detect hallucinations. However, existing approaches are often probabilistic and computationally expensive, limiting their practical applicability. In this paper, we introduce diversion decoding, a novel method for developing an LLM uncertainty heuristic by actively challenging model-generated responses during the decoding phase. Through diversion decoding, we extract features that capture the LLM's resistance to produce alternative answers and utilize these features to train a machine-learning model to develop a heuristic measure of the LLM's uncertainty. Our experimental results demonstrate that diversion decoding outperforms existing methods with significantly lower computational complexity, making it an efficient and robust solution for evaluating hallucination detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"分流解码"(Diversion Decoding)的新方法，通过在解码阶段主动挑战模型生成的响应，提取特征来训练机器学习模型，从而构建LLM不确定性启发式指标，用于高效检测幻觉。实验表明，该方法在显著降低计算复杂度的同时，优于现有幻觉检测方法。
AI.motivation: LLM虽然具备强大的文本生成能力，但存在幻觉问题（生成事实性错误陈述和虚构知识），影响其可靠性和可信度。现有不确定性评估和幻觉检测方法多为概率性的且计算成本高，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出分流解码(Diversion Decoding)方法，在解码阶段主动挑战模型生成的响应，提取反映LLM抵抗产生替代答案能力的特征，并利用这些特征训练机器学习模型，构建LLM不确定性的启发式度量指标。
AI.result: 分流解码在计算复杂度显著降低的情况下，超越了现有方法，是一种高效且鲁棒的幻觉检测评估方案。
AI.conclusion: 分流解码为LLM不确定性评估和幻觉检测提供了一种高效、低计算成本的实用解决方案。

title: FIERO: Empowering Creative Writing Through Collaborative Game Play
comment: 51pages, 14 figures, 5 tables, will be presenting this paper at CHIPLAY 2026
summary: Creativity often flourishes in collaboration, such as when designers brainstorm a new app together, or storytellers collectively build a world with elements of each person's narrative. However, collaborative storytelling can have challenges for its participants, such as when they disagree about the plot proposed, or when different ideas become fragmented when voiced individually. While current tools for creative collaboration focus on synchronous online text sharing, they often neglect the social dynamics of in-person collaboration critical to creative synergy. To address this, we created FIERO, a multiplayer web-based card game. Physical cards provide tangible scaffolding and social interaction, while the digital interface generates contextual visuals, facilitate group decisions, ensure narrative coherence, and synthesize different idea contributions using generative AI. Compared against online collaborative writing alone, the game significantly enhanced intuitive stimulation, idea fluency, and novelty generation, and also improved the content of the stories produced, leading to greater plot coherence (N=60). The cards provided creative structure and social engagement, while the interface provided contextualized augmentation without affecting player agency. This work shows how collaborative play can be utilized to foster creative support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FIERO——一款融合实体卡牌与数字界面的多人网页卡牌游戏，通过生成式AI增强协作叙事，相比传统在线协作写作显著提升了灵感激发、思维流畅性、新颖性和情节连贯性（N=60）。
AI.motivation: 协作故事创作中常出现意见分歧和想法碎片化的问题，现有工具侧重于同步在线文本共享，忽视了面对面协作中的社交动态，而这些对创意协同至关重要。
AI.method: 开发了FIERO多人网页卡牌游戏：实体卡牌提供有形支撑和社交互动，数字界面利用生成式AI生成上下文视觉、促进小组决策、确保叙事连贯性并整合不同创意贡献。通过对比实验（N=60）评估其效果。
AI.result: FIERO相比在线协作写作显著增强了直觉刺激、想法流畅性和新颖性生成，并改善了故事内容质量，提升了情节连贯性。卡牌提供了创意结构和社交参与，界面提供了情境化增强且不影响玩家能动性。
AI.conclusion: 协作游戏可被有效利用来促进创意支持，平衡了结构化引导与自由创造之间的关系。

title: Runtime Safety Filtering for Learned Small UAS Separation Policies under GNSS Degradation
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE/AIAA Digital Avionics Systems Conference (DASC). 9 pages, 8 figures
summary: Learning-based separation assurance for small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) achieves near-zero collision rates in simulation, but assumes accurate position and velocity information from Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS). This assumption fails in urban environments, where multipath propagation, signal blockage, and intentional interference degrade navigation integrity. This raises a fundamental architectural question for deploying learned separation policies under GNSS degradation: should runtime safety mechanisms filter the policy's actions or its observations? This work evaluates both approaches for multi-agent sUAS separation under adversarial GNSS degradation. Both architectures first estimate a worst-case traffic state consistent with bounded observation uncertainty, then diverge: action filtering constrains policy outputs via discrete-time control barrier functions evaluated at the worst-case state, while observation filtering presents the worst-case state directly to the policy as corrected input. Experimental results show that action filtering provides negligible safety improvement, while observation filtering reduces near mid-air collisions by 90% and remains robust to the barrier function's tradeoff between separation distance and closing rate. These results suggest that, for policies with learned safety behaviors, preserving the policy's decision authority outperforms overriding its actions with hand-designed constraints.

AI.tldr: 针对小型无人机系统在GNSS退化环境下的安全间隔保持问题，本文比较了两种运行时安全机制：动作过滤（用控制屏障函数约束策略输出）和观测过滤（向策略输入修正后的最坏情况状态）。实验表明，观测过滤可将近空中碰撞减少90%，而动作过滤几乎无安全改善，说明对已学习安全行为的策略，保留其决策权优于用手工设计的约束覆盖其动作。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的无人机间隔保持策略在仿真中表现优异，但依赖精确GNSS信息，而城市环境中多径传播、信号遮挡和有意干扰会降低导航完整性。因此，在GNSS退化情况下部署学习型间隔策略时，需要回答一个基本的架构问题：运行时安全机制应该过滤策略的动作还是观测？
AI.method: 两种架构均先估计与有界观测不确定性一致的最坏情况交通状态，然后分岔：动作过滤通过在最坏情况状态评估的离散时间控制屏障函数约束策略输出；观测过滤则将最坏情况状态直接作为修正输入呈现给策略。在多智能体sUAS间隔保持场景下，对两种方法在对抗性GNSS退化条件下进行了实验评估。
AI.result: 动作过滤几乎未带来安全改善，而观测过滤将近空中碰撞减少了90%，并且对屏障函数在间隔距离与接近速率之间的权衡具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 对于具有学习安全行为的策略，保留策略的决策权优于用手工设计的约束覆盖其动作。这表明在不确定性条件下，向策略提供高质量的观测估计比外部约束其输出更有效。

title: ShapKO: Shapley-Adaptive Modality Knockout for Robust Multimodal Learning
summary: Multimodal medical models often degrade when inputs are missing, a common scenario in real-world clinical workflows. Separately, even when all modalities are present, modality dominance is observed during training, where optimization over-relies on a highly predictive modality and undertrains complementary sources, resulting in poor robustness under partial availability. While training-time modality knockout improves missing-modality robustness, existing approaches use static masking rates that cannot adapt to evolving modality utility during training. We introduce ShapKO (Shapley-Adaptive Modality Knockout), a dynamic training strategy that learns modality-specific knockout probabilities based on validation utility. ShapKO periodically evaluates performance across modality subsets, estimates modality importance via Shapley values, and updates masking probabilities to suppress dominant modalities more frequently. This adaptive process promotes complementary representations, while requiring no architectural modifications. We evaluate ShapKO on three datasets covering multitask clinical classification, survival prediction, and cancer detection. ShapKO consistently improves performance under modality absence and yields interpretable trajectories of learned masking behavior. Code is available at: https://github.com/sumona00/ShapKO

AI.tldr: ShapKO是一种动态训练策略，通过基于Shapley值学习的模态特定敲除概率，自适应地抑制主导模态，增强多模态医学模型在输入缺失情况下的鲁棒性，无需修改架构即可提升多模态缺失场景的性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态医学模型在实际临床中常因输入模态缺失而性能下降；同时，即使模态齐全，训练时也存在模态主导现象（过度依赖高预测性模态，忽视互补模态），导致部分模态可用时鲁棒性差。现有训练时模态敲除方法使用静态掩码率，无法适应训练过程中模态效用的动态变化。
AI.method: ShapKO（Shapley自适应模态敲除）：一种动态训练策略，定期评估模态子集上的验证性能，通过Shapley值估计各模态重要性，据此更新敲除概率，更频繁地抑制主导模态，促进互补表征学习。无需修改架构。
AI.result: 在三个数据集（多任务临床分类、生存预测、癌症检测）上，ShapKO在模态缺失情况下持续提升性能，并产生可解释的掩码学习行为轨迹。
AI.conclusion: ShapKO通过自适应动态敲除策略有效缓解模态主导问题，提升多模态医学模型在部分模态缺失时的鲁棒性，且具有可解释性。

title: The Silent Freeze: Predicting When Low-Precision Training Stops Learning
summary: Training in reduced floating-point precision can silently halt learning: when a gradient-descent weight update falls below half the unit in the last place (ULP) of the weight, it rounds away and that coordinate freezes while its gradient is still nonzero. The freeze is deterministic, governed by a per-coordinate half-ULP condition, and predictable from a high-precision trajectory and the target mantissa length alone, without low-precision data. In a small GPT trained under the standard AdamW-plus-cosine recipe with bf16-equivalent stored weights, training proceeds normally and then permanently freezes just past mid-run, within four steps of the a-priori prediction. In a $124$-million-parameter GPT-2 transformer whose weights are constrained to the $8$-bit floating-point grid after every optimizer step, with no master weights, the dense weights freeze at initialization in both fp8 formats -- predicted \emph{a priori} from an fp32 reference -- and validation loss plateaus while full precision keeps improving. Stochastic rounding removes the persistent freeze, and the same reference predicts that too. The condition transfers across frozen-feature regression, a mantissa-truncation emulator spanning $128\times$ in precision, small networks, and a CNN on MNIST: a computable axis of low-precision training, not diffuse noise.

AI.tldr: 低精度浮点训练中，当权重更新幅度小于权重的半个最小精度单位（ULP）时，梯度下降更新会被舍入掉导致权重冻结；该冻结是可预测的，并在GPT和GPT-2实验中验证，随机舍入可消除冻结。
AI.motivation: 揭示低精度浮点训练中一种被忽视的确定性失效模式——权重更新被舍入冻结，并证明该现象是可预测而非随机噪声。
AI.method: 提出half-ULP冻结条件，通过高精度轨迹和目标尾数位数预测冻结位置；在GPT（bf16等效）和124M GPT-2（fp8格式）上进行实验验证，并使用随机舍入作为对照。
AI.result: 标准AdamW+cosine训练的GPT在中期后几步内按预测冻结；fp8约束的GPT-2权重在初始化即冻结，验证损失平台化；随机舍入消除冻结。
AI.conclusion: 低精度训练中的权重冻结是确定性的、可预测的，该条件在多种网络和精度下通用，随机舍入是有效缓解手段。

title: Norm Enforcement for AI Agents: Robustly Shaping Behavior in Multi-Agent Systems
comment: ICML2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed in shared environments where they pursue diverse goals and compete for rewards. This multi-agent competition can lead to behaviors that serve individual gains at collective cost -- for instance, marketing agents may post misleading content as a result of competing for engagement on social media. Human societies address such problems through norms that constrain acceptable behavior, supported by enforcement mechanisms that detect and penalize violations. Motivated by this, we study norm enforcement mechanisms for language model agents. We find that simple enforcement mechanisms are exploited by misaligned agents for competitive advantage, even when they are not explicitly trained or prompted to do so. We thus turn our attention to designing more robust mechanisms, and identify two key ingredients: estimating each agent's reliability over time, and updating this estimate with escalating penalties for repeated misbehavior. Across three simulated environments and a variety of agent populations, mechanisms built on these principles resist exploitation, while still penalizing norm violations at comparable or lower cost than baselines. Our results position norm enforcement mechanisms as scalable levers for shaping agents' behavior, but only when designed to anticipate becoming part of the system they govern. Our code and data are available at https://yaowenye.com/norm-enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型智能体在多智能体竞争环境中的规范执行机制。简单的执行机制容易被恶意智能体利用，而通过结合可靠性评估和递增惩罚的机制能有效抵抗利用，同时维持合理惩罚成本。
AI.motivation: 多智能体竞争环境中的AI智能体可能采取损人利己的行为（如发布误导内容），人类通过规范和执法机制来解决此类问题，受此启发研究面向语言模型智能体的规范执行机制。
AI.method: 提出两种关键设计：（1）随时间估计每个智能体的可靠性；（2）对重复违规行为采用递增惩罚。在三种模拟环境和多种智能体群体中进行验证。
AI.result: 基于上述原理设计的机制能够抵抗恶意智能体的利用，同时惩罚规范违规的成本与基线方法相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: 规范执行机制可以成为塑造智能体行为的可扩展杠杆，但必须预见到自身将成为其所治理系统的一部分。

title: When Reasoning Hurts Legal Drafting: The Verbalization Bottleneck in Patent Claim Generation
comment: Accepted to AI for Law Workshop @ ICML 2026
summary: Patent claim drafting is a challenging legal drafting task that requires technical expertise, precise linguistic control, strict adherence to formal conventions, and the preservation of complex logical relationships among claim elements. While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has been widely used to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), recent evidence suggests that its benefits may be limited, or even negative, in highly structured or pattern-sensitive tasks. Therefore, this paper investigates whether CoT prompting benefits patent claim generation. We propose a task-specific CoT method for patent claim generation and evaluate its effectiveness through both automatic metrics and human expert assessment. Our results show that reasoning-enhanced prompting can improve claim quality. Moreover, we demonstrate a counter-intuitive but important empirical finding: implicit CoT, where reasoning is kept internal rather than explicitly verbalized, consistently outperforms explicit CoT. Through systematic analysis, we show that explicit CoT can introduce an unnecessary information bottleneck for claim generation. Verbalized reasoning may compromise the quality of final outputs through three specific mechanisms: abstraction of critical details, disruption of internalized generation patterns, and cascading error propagation. Our findings provide new insights into legal tasks and CoT applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 提示是否有利于专利权利要求生成，提出了一种面向该任务的 CoT 方法，并通过自动评估和专家评估验证其有效性。关键发现是：隐式 CoT（推理过程内化而不显式表达）始终优于显式 CoT，因为显式 CoT 会引入信息瓶颈，导致关键细节抽象化、内部生成模式被破坏以及级联错误传播。
AI.motivation: 专利权利要求撰写是一项具有挑战性的法律起草任务，需要技术专长、精确的语言控制、严格的格式约定以及元素间复杂逻辑关系的保持。虽然 CoT 提示被广泛用于提升 LLM 的推理能力，但近期证据表明，在高结构化或模式敏感的任务中，CoT 的效果可能有限甚至为负。因此，本文旨在探究 CoT 是否有利于专利权利要求生成。
AI.method: 提出一种面向专利权利要求生成的任务特定 CoT 方法，通过自动评估指标和人类专家评估进行效果验证。采用隐式 CoT（推理内化）与显式 CoT（推理显式表达）两种方式进行系统性对比分析。
AI.result: 推理增强提示能够提升权利要求质量。隐式 CoT 始终优于显式 CoT。显式 CoT 通过三种机制损害输出质量：关键细节抽象化、内部化生成模式被破坏、级联错误传播。显式 CoT 引入了不必要的"信息瓶颈"。
AI.conclusion: 在高度结构化、模式敏感的专利权利要求生成任务中，隐式推理优于显式推理。显式 CoT 的言语化推理过程反而可能成为信息瓶颈，降低生成质量。该发现为法律领域的 CoT 应用提供了新见解。

title: Plug-and-Play Reweighting for Resilient Collaborative Decision-Making in Connected Autonomous Driving
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Collaborative decision-making is a fundamental capability in multi-robot systems, such as connected autonomous vehicles. However, perceptual noise and adversarial attacks in collaborators can severely affect decision reliability. Overall, existing methods typically rely on retraining with attack-specific defenses or on restrictive perturbation assumptions to improve resilience, which limits their practicality. In this paper, we propose a novel Resilient Collaborative Decision-Making (RCDM) framework that consists of an attention-based encoder for extracting individual robot perceptual embeddings and an attention-based decoder for fusing collaborator perceptions and making decisions. To improve resilience to corrupted observations, we design a novel plug-and-play reweighting module that down-weights the influence of corrupted inputs by analyzing the consistency of neighborhood points relative to the local structure and assigning smaller weights to points that deviate strongly from the local median. This module can be seamlessly integrated into attention-based collaborative decision-making without requiring additional training. We evaluate our method in high-fidelity simulations, considering perceptual noise and five types of attacks across diverse accident-prone scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing methods by up to 26% and achieves state-of-the-art resilient performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于注意力机制和可插拔重加权模块的弹性协同决策框架（RCDM），通过分析邻域点相对局部结构的一致性来降低被破坏观测的权重，无需额外训练即可抵御感知噪声和多种攻击，在仿真中性能提升高达26%。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同决策中，感知噪声和协作方对抗攻击严重影响决策可靠性，现有方法依赖攻击特定防御的重新训练或限制性扰动假设，实用性有限。
AI.method: 提出RCDM框架：1）基于注意力的编码器提取个体机器人感知嵌入；2）基于注意力的解码器融合协作方感知并做出决策；3）设计可插拔重加权模块，通过分析邻域点相对于局部结构的一致性，为偏离局部中位数的点分配较小权重，无需额外训练即可集成到注意力协同决策中。
AI.result: 在高保真仿真中，考虑感知噪声和五种攻击类型，在多种事故易发场景下，该方法一致优于现有方法，性能提升高达26%，达到了最先进的弹性性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的RCDM框架通过可插拔重加权模块有效提升了多机器人协同决策对感知噪声和对抗攻击的鲁棒性，无需额外训练，具有实用性和通用性。

title: Bridging the Catalog-to-Real Gap: Scalable Product Recognition via Multi-Stage Contrastive Learning
summary: Automated product recognition is a cornerstone of modern retail intelligence; however, accurately matching real-world, in-store images against extensive corporate catalogs remains a major scalability bottleneck for large-scale applications. In this work, we address this challenge by reformulating the task as an embedding-based cross-domain retrieval problem rather than a standard closed-set classification task. Specifically, we define the objective as retrieving the most corresponding catalog reference image for a given real-world product query crop from an expansive inventory. To bridge the severe domain gap between pristine studio packshots and noisy in-store queries, we introduce a novel catalog-to-real multi-stage contrastive learning paradigm (Cat2Real). This framework fine-tunes a vision backbone by systematically exploiting both item-level and image-level similarities to drive targeted hard negative mining. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that our paradigm scales seamlessly to unseen products and categories, yielding outstanding zero-shot generalization performance even in the complete absence of real-world training images for novel inventory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cat2Real框架，通过多阶段对比学习将产品识别重构为跨域检索问题，在无真实场景训练数据的情况下实现零样本泛化，有效弥合了影棚样片与门店实拍之间的域差异。
AI.motivation: 传统商品识别作为封闭集分类任务难以扩展到大规模应用，真实门店图像与标准产品目录图像之间存在严重的域差异，导致匹配精度成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 将商品识别转化为基于嵌入的跨域检索问题，提出Cat2Real多阶段对比学习范式，利用物品级别和图像级别的相似性进行针对性的困难负样本挖掘，微调视觉骨干网络。
AI.result: 该范式可无缝扩展到未见过的产品和类别，在完全没有真实场景训练图像的情况下展现出卓越的零样本泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: Cat2Real框架有效解决了大规模商品识别中的域适应和可扩展性难题，为零售智能中的自动化产品匹配提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Discovering Latent Response Laws in Forced Physical Systems
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures and 2 tables. Supplementary Information provided as an ancillary file
summary: Governing equations provide compact descriptions of physical systems, yet the variables in which they are simple are often hidden in high-dimensional measurements. This challenge is sharper for forced systems, whose responses depend on both intrinsic dynamics and time-dependent inputs. Here we introduce FLARE, a forced latent autoencoder for response equations that learns compact response coordinates, identifies sparse input-dependent latent dynamics and decodes equation rollouts to full responses. By estimating latent dimension from data and separating state estimation from external forcing, FLARE enables forecasts to be initialized from past responses and driven by prescribed future inputs. Across known dynamical systems, application-scale forced responses and visual observations, FLARE recovers compact forced dynamics and predicts long-horizon high-dimensional responses under inputs not used for training. By turning learned coordinates into a dynamical interface, FLARE extends equation discovery to systems whose effective states are hidden within complex observations, providing a route for interpretable modelling and prediction of high-dimensional responses in forced dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: FLARE是一种强制潜变量自编码器，能够从高维观测数据中学习紧凑的响应坐标、识别稀疏的输入相关潜变量动力学，并通过方程 rollout 解码完整响应，实现对受迫动力系统的高维响应预测与可解释建模。
AI.motivation: 受迫系统的控制方程通常在高维测量中隐藏了简单的变量形式，传统方法难以同时处理内在动力学与时间依赖输入，亟需一种能从复杂观测中自动发现紧凑受迫动力学的方法。
AI.method: 提出FLARE（Forced Latent Autoencoder for Response Equations），包含三个核心步骤：1）学习紧凑的响应坐标；2）识别稀疏的输入相关的潜变量动力学方程；3）将方程 rollout 解码为完整高维响应。该方法自动从数据估计潜变量维度，并将状态估计与外部强迫分离。
AI.result: 在多个已知动力学系统、应用尺度受迫响应以及视觉观测任务中，FLARE成功恢复了紧凑的受迫动力学，并在未见过的输入条件下实现了长时程高维响应的准确预测。
AI.conclusion: FLARE将学习到的坐标转化为动力学接口，将方程发现扩展至有效状态隐藏在复杂观测中的系统，为受迫动力系统的高维响应提供可解释建模与预测的新途径。

title: Verification of Adaptive Agentic Controllers through Finite Rule Revision
summary: Industrial agentic AI systems increasingly exhibit a gap between prototype capability and production deployment. In particular, adaptive agents may generate plausible outputs while remaining difficult to verify under non-determinism, confidentiality constraints, limited context, and weak observability. This paper formulates a bounded verification protocol for adaptive agentic controllers represented by finite symbolic rules, explicit diagnostic predicates, explanation logs, and held-out re-evaluation. The central research question is: when an adaptive agentic controller is represented through finite rules, explicit diagnostic predicates, explanation logs, and held-out re-evaluation, which classes of controller failure can be detected, locally repaired, or rejected without relying on unrestricted human-in-the-loop judgment? The proposed framework treats the controller as a finite revisable object. Diagnostic failures are mapped to predefined rule-level edits, including rule addition, rule deletion, and priority revision. Repaired controllers are then evaluated on held-out simulation seeds or cloned initial states. Experiments in a stylized financially constrained inventory-control benchmark show three outcomes: resource-induced failures that remain non-repairable by one rule edit, partial repairs that are rejected because they violate thresholds or guardrails, and a local one-step repair of an order-volatility failure induced by removing a smoothing rule. The contribution is methodological and provides a simulation-compatible procedure for testing whether specific controller-level failures can be made observable, explainable, locally revisable, and empirically re-tested under controlled conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工业自适应智能体系统从原型到部署的差距，提出了一种有界验证协议，将自适应智能体控制器表示为有限符号规则，通过诊断谓词、解释日志和留出重评估来检测、局部修复或拒绝控制器故障，并在库存控制基准上实验验证了三种故障修复结果。
AI.motivation: 工业自适应AI系统在原型到生产部署间存在显著差距，自适应智能体可能生成看似合理但难以验证的输出，面临非确定性、保密约束、有限上下文和弱可观测性等挑战，亟需一种无需全时人类介入的验证方法。
AI.method: 将自适应智能体控制器建模为有限可修正对象，通过有限符号规则、显式诊断谓词、解释日志和留出重评估构建有界验证协议；诊断失败映射到预定义的规则级编辑（规则添加、删除、优先级修正），修复后在留出模拟种子或克隆初始状态上重新评估。
AI.result: 在受财务约束的库存控制基准实验中，识别出三类结果：资源引发的故障无法通过单规则编辑修复；部分修复因违反阈值或护栏而被拒绝；通过移除平滑规则实现了对订单波动故障的局部一步修复。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献是方法论层面的，提供了一种仿真兼容的程序，用于测试特定控制器级故障是否可在受控条件下实现可观测、可解释、局部可修正和可经验性重新测试。

title: Articulate Intuition or Genuine Analysis? Benchmarking Epistemic Reliability in LLM-as-a-Judge Peer Reviews
summary: When an LLM judge calls a peer review analytical and a human committee calls another review high quality, are they tracking the same thing? We argue they are not, and that the difference matters philosophically. We operationalise Kahneman's dual-process theory into a structured rubric for peer review and release Kahneman4Review, a benchmark of 3,563 rated reviews scored along nine theoretically motivated textual dimensions, eight bias diagnostics, and a continuous reasoning-quality score. Three findings bear on trustworthiness: decision tier is not detectably aligned with the rubric's text-grounded epistemic-quality proxy; public-showcase agentic reviews receive higher raw scores than pooled human reviews, but length and venue explain most of the gap and the samples are not paper-paired; and ICLR review-text diagnostics shift at the 2022--2023 transition, temporally coincident with widespread LLM availability but without identifying its cause. A matched function-probe pilot further shows that the rubric distinguishes textual probes designed to contrast genuine fault-finding with surface fluency. We argue that a trustworthy reliability benchmark for LLM judges must separate analytical form from epistemic function, and propose concrete design choices toward that goal. An interactive demo is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/nuojohnchen/Kahneman4Review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Kahneman4Review基准——基于Kahneman双过程理论构建的同行评审结构化评估框架，包含3,563条评审记录的九维度文本评分、八项偏差诊断及连续推理质量分数。研究发现：决策层级与文本基的认知质量代理指标未显著对齐；公开展示型agent评审原始分数高于人工评审，但长度和会议归属可解释大部分差异；ICLR评审文本诊断在2022-2023年间发生偏移，与LLM广泛可用时间重合。作者认为LLM裁判的可信度基准必须区分分析形式与认知功能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM裁判评估缺乏对"分析性形式"与"认知功能"的哲学区分，同行评审中看似一致的评判（如"分析性强""质量高"）实际可能指向不同概念。作者希望引入认知科学的双过程理论来系统解构评审质量，揭示LLM裁判与人类评审在认知层面上的本质差异。
AI.method: 1) 将Kahneman双过程理论（系统1直觉/系统2分析）操作化为结构化评审评分表；2) 构建Kahneman4Review基准（3,563条评审），包含九项理论驱动的文本维度评分、八项偏差诊断及连续推理质量分数；3) 进行三项关键发现验证：决策层级对齐分析、agent/人工评审对比、ICLR时间序列诊断偏移检测；4) 开展匹配功能探针实验区分真实纠错与表面流畅性。
AI.result: 1) 决策层级与文本基认知质量代理未检测到显著对齐；2) 公开展示型agent评审原始分数高于人工，但长度和会议归属解释大部分差异，且样本未配对；3) ICLR评审文本诊断在2022-2023年转变，与LLM广泛可用时间一致但未确定因果关系；4) 功能探针实验表明评分表能区分真正找错与表面流畅性。
AI.conclusion: LLM裁判的可信度基准必须严格区分分析形式与认知功能，不能将表面上的分析性文本等同于真正的推理质量。作者为此提出了具体的设计选择建议，并发布了交互式演示。

title: Exploring Agentic Workflows for Generating High Quality Math Visual Aids
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures. Exploratory course project on agentic workflows for generating and evaluating K 12 mathematical diagrams
summary: Mathematical diagrams play a crucial role in K 12 education, both as problem components and as scaffolding for student comprehension. However, current AI tools, including Large Language Models (LLMs), struggle to reliably generate accurate and pedagogically sound visual diagrams, even when provided with detailed descriptions. A significant gap therefore remains in the reliable generation of diagrams for middle school mathematics. To address this, we introduce an agentic workflow that enables LLM agents to evaluate the quality of generated visuals and use this feedback to iteratively improve their outputs. This self improvement loop aims to enhance the accuracy and educational appropriateness of AI generated diagrams. Our research investigates two questions. First, can LLMs accurately generate quality assurance questions for a visual aid given specific criteria for visual quality? Second, given valid quality assurance questions, can Vision Language Models effectively evaluate generated K 12 visual aids and use the resulting feedback to improve them iteratively? We conduct an exploratory evaluation of our agentic workflow and identify key areas for improvement, including stronger spatial reasoning and more comprehensive coverage of diagram features in the generated quality assurance questions. Our results provide preliminary evidence that this approach can improve the reliability and educational value of AI generated mathematical diagrams.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种智能体工作流，利用LLM代理生成质量保证问题，并通过视觉语言模型迭代评估与改进K-12数学 diagrams的生成质量，初步验证了该方法能提升AI生成数学图示的准确性和教育适用性。
AI.motivation: 当前的AI工具（包括LLM）即使提供详细描述，也难以可靠地生成准确且教学上合理的数学图示，尤其是在K-12教育场景中，存在显著的空缺。
AI.method: 提出一种智能体工作流：LLM代理根据视觉质量标准生成质量保证问题，然后由视觉语言模型评估生成的K-12图示，并将评估反馈用于迭代改进输出，形成自我改进循环。
AI.result: 初步实验识别出关键改进方向，包括更强的空间推理能力和更全面的图示特征覆盖；方法初步显示出提升AI生成数学图示可靠性和教育价值的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该智能体工作流能够通过自我改进循环提高AI生成数学图示的准确性和教育适用性，但仍需在空间推理和质量保证问题的特征覆盖方面进一步优化。

title: Direct Rotor Thrust Sensing and Feedback Control for Disturbance Rejection of Multirotors Using Load-cells
summary:
Gust disturbances, dynamic vertical inflow and ground effect are key adverse aerodynamic phenomena that induce variations in the forces acting on a multirotor and complicate its flight control. Miniature rotorcraft typically rely on simplified modelling of such effects to compute adjustments in thrust to counteract these forces. In the most basic case, disturbance force estimations are derived from the aircraft's motion and the generated thrust is assumed to exactly match that requested by the controller. However, such systems rely on the aircraft's trajectory to be affected before disturbances can be sensed and compensated. Numerous approaches presented over the last 15-20 years aim to reject external disturbances more quickly, but challenges remain.
  This paper presents a new approach in this category by measuring the instantaneous force of the rotors directly at the point of generation using load-cells and implementing high-speed control to accurately track the desired thrust. Measurements from load-cells were previously considered too noisy to provide meaningful input, but the experiments presented in the paper using purpose-built hardware from low-cost commodity components in single- and dual rotor see-saw models and a flying aircraft demonstrate both the feasibility and the effectiveness of the approach in the presence of complex aerodynamic phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过载荷传感器直接测量旋翼瞬时力并实现高速控制的新方法，以应对多旋翼飞行器在阵风、动态垂直 inflow 和地面效应等复杂气动现象下的扰动问题。实验证明了低成本硬件方案的可行性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有扰动抑制方法依赖飞行器轨迹变化来感知扰动，存在响应延迟，难以快速补偿复杂气动现象引起的力变化。
AI.method: 在旋翼力生成点安装载荷传感器直接测量瞬时力，结合高速控制算法精确追踪期望推力；使用低成本商用组件搭建单/双旋翼跷跷板模型及飞行器进行验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在存在复杂气动现象的多种平台上均可行且有效，解决了以往认为载荷传感器噪声过大无法提供有效输入的问题。
AI.conclusion: 直接力测量结合高速控制能更快、更准确地抵消外部扰动，为多旋翼飞行器在复杂气动环境下的鲁棒控制提供了新途径。

title: Do Transformer Temporal Heads and Post-Pooling Motion Gates Help CorrNet-based CSLR? An Empirical Study
summary: CorrNet is a strong baseline for continuous sign language recognition (CSLR) because it models inter-frame correlations inside the visual encoding stage. In this paper, we study two natural extensions of a reproduced CorrNet system: replacing the BiLSTM temporal head with a Transformer encoder, and injecting motion cues after temporal pooling. We find that the Transformer head does not outperform the BiLSTM baseline, even with a training strategy adjusted for the Transformer, and the two heads have almost the same computational and runtime cost. For the second extension, we design a lightweight module called MotionGate. In our experiments, MotionGate consistently collapses to an identity-like mapping: the gate loses motion selectivity, and the injected residual becomes a weak, non-selective perturbation of the pooled features. These results suggest that explicit motion injection after CorrNet's correlation-based encoding is largely redundant, and that natural-looking architectural extensions in CSLR should be tested carefully instead of being assumed to help.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了CorrNet在连续手语识别中的两个自然扩展：用Transformer替换BiLSTM时间头，以及在时间池化后注入运动线索。实验发现Transformer并不优于BiLSTM，而运动注入模块MotionGate退化为恒等映射，表明这些扩展存在冗余或无效，需谨慎验证。
AI.motivation: 探索CorrNet基线系统的两个自然扩展方向的有效性：替换时间头为Transformer以及在编码后注入运动线索。
AI.method: 基于复现的CorrNet系统，分别尝试（1）将BiLSTM时间头替换为Transformer编码器并调整训练策略；（2）设计轻量级MotionGate模块在时间池化后注入运动线索。
AI.result: Transformer头未超越BiLSTM基线，两者计算成本相近；MotionGate退化为近似恒等映射，失去运动选择性，注入的残差变为微弱非选择性扰动。
AI.conclusion: 在CorrNet的相关编码后显式注入运动信息基本是冗余的，自然架构扩展应经过严格测试而非默认有效。

title: Quota Marketplace: Dynamic Pricing for Efficient Allocation of ML Training Resources
summary:
The escalating demand for Machine Learning (ML) training resources in recent years has resulted in a substantial gap between the high demand and the available supply. Efficient allocation of these scarce and expensive resources is crucial for organizations to maximize their return on investment. Existing resource allocation mechanisms, like Karma [OSDI'23], are designed to guarantee Pareto efficiency and max-min fairness in settings with dynamic (time-varying) user demands, but fail to preserve these key properties in the presence of demands with heterogeneous values. Given the ubiquity and inevitability of heterogeneity in organizational values of different workloads, effective resource allocation policies must accommodate these variations.
  In this paper, we describe the design, implementation, deployment, and theoretical analysis of Quota Marketplace, a market-based mechanism to efficiently allocate ML training chips (like GPUs), explicitly addressing scenarios with demands of heterogeneous value. We detail the implementation of this mechanism within Google and present metrics that demonstrate its impact. We also discuss many business-critical requirements that the Quota Marketplace handles quite effectively, and document the gains and opportunities it has unlocked. We establish theoretically how this market-based approach achieves the essential properties of Pareto efficiency and max-min fairness by allowing the users to express the value of their workloads and enabling dynamic resource pricing based on supply and demand fluctuations. Ultimately, the market facilitates resource allocation that aligns with organizational priorities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Quota Marketplace，一个基于市场的机制，用于在异构价值需求场景下高效分配ML训练芯片（如GPU），在Google内部部署并实现了帕累托效率和最大-最小公平性。
AI.motivation: ML训练资源需求激增导致供需缺口巨大，现有分配机制（如Karma）在处理具有异构价值的需求时无法保持帕累托效率和最大-最小公平性，亟需能适应组织内不同工作负载价值差异的资源分配策略。
AI.method: 设计并实现了一种基于市场的配额交易机制（Quota Marketplace），允许用户表达工作负载的价值，并通过供需波动驱动的动态资源定价来实现资源分配，同时给出了该机制的理论分析。
AI.result: 在Google内部成功部署该机制，提供了展示其影响的指标，有效处理了多项业务关键需求，并证明了其在理论上的帕累托效率和最大-最小公平性。
AI.conclusion: 市场化的资源分配方法能够在对异构价值需求下保持关键公平性与效率属性，与组织优先级对齐，并为未来的资源分配优化解锁了新的机遇。

title: EvoCUA-1.5: Online Reinforcement Learning for Multi-turn Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents must solve long-horizon tasks through repeated interaction with partially observable, multimodal desktop environments. Although imitation learning and offline trajectory refinement provide strong priors, static traces cannot cover the causal feedback loop of real computer use: each action changes the screen state, future action space, and recovery options. EvoCUA-1.5 extends self-evolving computer-use agents from offline experience learning to online reinforcement learning, where policies interact with executable sandbox environments and improve from verifiable task outcomes. Online RL in this setting requires more than directly reusing single-turn language-RL recipes. Multi-turn interaction introduces context-managed observations, sparse terminal rewards, variable-length trajectories, and slow environment feedback. EvoCUA-1.5 addresses these challenges with Step-Level Policy Optimization (STEPO), which preserves trajectory-level advantage balance after decomposition into step-level samples; policy-aware filtering and pass-rate calibration over verifiable synthesized tasks; Dynamic Tri-Adaptive Curriculum (DTAC), which combines learnable tasks, difficult positive replay, and controlled infeasible-task exposure; and a fully asynchronous RL infrastructure with staleness control and mini-group batching. Experiments show that these components improve training stability and downstream performance. EvoCUA-1.5 achieves 63.2\% success on OSWorld-Verified, outperforming comparable 32B/35B-scale open-weight baselines and even approaching models with significantly larger parameter counts. Overall, EvoCUA-1.5 provides a practical framework for scaling online RL in multi-turn computer-use agents.

AI.tldr: EvoCUA-1.5将在线强化学习引入计算机使用智能体，通过步骤级策略优化、动态自适应课程学习等机制解决多轮交互中的稀疏奖励、可变长度轨迹等挑战，在OSWorld-Verified上达到63.2%成功率，超越同等规模开源模型并接近更大参数模型。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体依赖离线模仿学习和轨迹微调，但静态轨迹无法覆盖真实使用中的因果反馈循环（每次动作改变屏幕状态、未来动作空间和恢复选项），需要引入在线强化学习来让策略从交互和可验证任务结果中持续改进。
AI.method: 提出EvoCUA-1.5框架，包含四个核心组件：(1) 步骤级策略优化(STEPO)，将轨迹分解为步骤级样本并保持优势平衡；(2) 策略感知过滤和通过率校准用于可验证合成任务；(3) 动态三自适应课程(DTAC)，结合可学习任务、困难正样本回放和可控不可行任务暴露；(4) 完全异步RL基础设施，包含陈化控制和迷你批次分组。
AI.result: 在OSWorld-Verified基准上达到63.2%的成功率，优于同等规模(32B/35B)的开放权重基线模型，甚至接近参数规模更大的模型。
AI.conclusion: EvoCUA-1.5提供了一个实用的框架，用于在多轮交互的计算机使用智能体中扩展在线强化学习，解决了上下文管理观测、稀疏终端奖励、变长轨迹和慢环境反馈等关键挑战。

title: UNIBROWSE: A Data-to-Agent Framework for Multimodal BrowseComp
summary: Multimodal BrowseComp tasks require agents to combine perception, tool use, and long-horizon reasoning over dynamic web content, challenging their ability to handle compositional structure, open-world uncertainty, and multimodal integration across extended interactions. Crucially, real-world multimodal browsing involves three distinct information-flow patterns: text-only, image-to-text, and text-to-image, yet existing data construction methods cover only the text-only and image-to-text patterns, leaving text-to-image largely unaddressed and limiting agent generality and robustness. We introduce UNIBROWSE, a unified data pipeline that for the first time simultaneously generates training data covering all three patterns, augments curated knowledge graphs with live web retrieval for improved fidelity, and introduces a novel metric of exploration degree to filter low-signal instances for efficient reinforcement learning. Through this pipeline, we produce high-quality cold-start tool-use trajectories and exploration-rich QA pairs, and train a 35B-scale agent via supervised fine-tuning and exploration-aware RL.The resulting UNIBROWSE agent achieves state-of-the-art performance on multimodal BrowseComp benchmarks, attaining an average accuracy of 54.4 across five diverse benchmarks -- an improvement of 10.5 points over its base model Qwen3.5-35B-A3B -- and surpassing serveral closed-source agent workflows such as GPT-5 (42.9), Gemini-2.5 Pro (44.8), and Gemini-2.5 Flash (41.3).

AI.tldr: UNIBROWSE 是首个统一数据管道，可同时生成文本、图像→文本、文本→图像三种多模态浏览训练数据，结合知识图谱与实时网页检索增强保真度，并引入探索度指标过滤低质量样本。基于此训练的35B参数智能体在5个多模态BrowseComp基准上平均准确率54.4，超越GPT-5（42.9）等闭源系统。
AI.motivation: 现有数据构建方法仅覆盖文本和图像→文本两种信息流模式，未涵盖文本→图像模式，限制了智能体在多模态浏览任务中的通用性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出UNIBROWSE统一数据管道：(1) 同时生成三种信息流模式的训练数据；(2) 结合知识图谱与实时网页检索增强数据保真度；(3) 引入探索度指标过滤低信号样本用于强化学习；最终通过监督微调和探索感知强化学习训练35B规模智能体。
AI.result: 在5个多模态BrowseComp基准上平均准确率54.4，比基础模型Qwen3.5-35B-A3B提升10.5点，超越GPT-5（42.9）、Gemini-2.5 Pro（44.8）、Gemini-2.5 Flash（41.3）等闭源系统。
AI.conclusion: UNIBROWSE通过统一三种信息流模式的数据管道和探索感知训练策略，显著提升了多模态浏览智能体的性能，达到了新的最优水平。

title: TAC-LOCO: Unified Whole-Body Control for Quadrupedal TACtile-Informed LOCO-Manipulation
summary: Dynamic loco-manipulation requires legged robots to coordinate whole-body motion while maintaining stable physical interaction with grasped objects under uncertain external forces. While tactile sensing has been widely studied for robotic manipulation, its role in dynamic whole-body control remains largely unexplored. Existing works without tactile feedback commonly grasp firmly rather than regulate the grasp according to the interaction. We propose TAC-LOCO, a tactile-augmented unified reinforcement learning framework that encodes tactile array observations from compliant grippers into a compact latent representation and joins it with proprioception for unified control of the legs, arm, and gripper. With effective grasp stability reward design, the policy learns to simultaneously track body velocity and end-effector trajectories, moderate grasp force, and prevent object slip under both gradual load changes and sudden release events. We deploy the policy zero-shot on a Unitree Go2 with an Interbotix WidowX 250 arm and tactile gripper, demonstrating dynamic tactile-informed loco-manipulation under varying external interactions, achieving a 47% reduction in grasping force and an object drop rate of less than 1%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAC-LOCO框架，利用触觉传感增强四足机器人全身动态操控，实现抓取力减少47%且掉落率低于1%。
AI.motivation: 现有动态全身控制工作缺乏触觉反馈，通常采用刚性抓取而非根据交互调节抓取力，导致在不确定外力下物体容易滑落或抓取力过大。
AI.method: 提出TAC-LOCO统一强化学习框架，将柔性夹爪的触觉阵列观测编码为紧凑潜变量，与本体感知融合后统一控制腿部、手臂和夹爪；设计抓取稳定性奖励以同时跟踪身体速度、末端轨迹并调节抓取力。
AI.result: 在Unitree Go2机器人上零样本部署，抓取力降低47%，物体掉落率低于1%，能够应对渐变负载和突然释放事件。
AI.conclusion: 触觉感知能够有效提升动态全身操控的抓取稳定性与力调节能力，为动态操控任务提供了新的范式。

title: Banshee: Target Switch Attacks on Gimbal-Stabilized Visual Tracking Systems via Acoustic Injection
comment: Accepted by the 47th IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (IEEE S&P 2026). 20 pages. Artifact: https://github.com/U1ltra/Banshee
summary: Gimbal-stabilized visual tracking is critical for modern autonomous systems such as Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). While prior work shows acoustic signals can disturb gimbal internals, the impact of such attacks on real-world applications like UAV tracking and following remains underexplored. Existing demonstrations largely overlook practical challenges for real-world attacks, such as object-motion uncertainty and runtime latency. To bridge this gap, we present Banshee, the first physically realizable attack that induces target switching in UAV visual tracking systems by exploiting acoustic vulnerabilities in gimbal-camera systems. Banshee generates carefully crafted acoustic waveforms that induce optimized adversarial gimbal oscillations, causing directionally biased camera-view drifts that break inter-frame target associations. Consequently, the onboard tracker is driven to switch from the original target to an attacker-selected object with high probability, with occasional target loss. Banshee achieves a 93.6% success rate in simulation across two commercial gimbal systems and five trackers. Real-world benchtop and in-flight black-box attacks against a commercial drone across varied scenarios show an overall 95.5% attack success rate. Our results reveal a practical cross-domain vulnerability between acoustics and vision, highlighting the need for robust designs of gimbal systems and applications. Our code is available at: https://github.com/U1ltra/Banshee.

AI.tldr: Banshee 是首个通过声波攻击引发无人机视觉跟踪系统目标切换的物理可实现攻击方法，利用声学漏洞诱导云台产生对抗性振荡，使跟踪器从原始目标切换到攻击者选定的对象，在仿真和真实实验中分别达到93.6%和95.5%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有工作已证明声学信号能干扰云台内部传感器，但这类攻击对无人机视觉跟踪与跟随等实际应用的影响尚未被充分探索，且已有演示忽视了物体运动不确定性和运行时延迟等实际挑战。
AI.method: Banshee 生成精心设计的声学波形，诱导云台产生优化的对抗性振荡，导致相机视角发生方向性漂移，破坏帧间目标关联，从而迫使机载跟踪器从原始目标切换到攻击者选定的对象。
AI.result: 在两种商用云台系统和五种跟踪器的仿真中达到93.6%的成功率；在真实场景中对商用无人机进行的黑盒攻击（包括台架测试和飞行测试）总体成功率为95.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了声学与视觉之间的跨域安全漏洞，强调了云台系统及应用需要更鲁棒的设计。

title: Spectral Origins of the Self-Correction Blind Spot in Autoregressive Generation
summary: Large autoregressive language models exhibit a self-correction blind spot: they reliably fix identical errors when attributed to an external source yet fail to fix the same errors in their own outputs. Prior work has documented this phenomenon empirically, through controlled error injection, error-depth decompositions, RL-based verifier-corrector training, and intrinsic self-verification, but offers no formal model of why generating a token suppresses the ability to detect its error, no quantitative activation condition for correction markers, and no convergence guarantee for reinforcement-learning-based self-correction. We close these gaps with SPARC, a spectral-algebraic theory of self-correction in autoregressive generation. We define the error-propagation operator as the product of per-step attention Jacobians on the residual stream and prove that the blind spot arises if and only if the spectral radius of this operator is at least one. We derive a sharp activation threshold, given as a function of the spectral radius, that a correction marker must exceed, recovering the 89.3\% blind-spot reduction observed with a simple ``Wait'' marker. We further prove that RL-based verifier-corrector training converges at a rate proportional to the squared coupling strength over the square root of the number of samples if and only if the verifier-corrector coupling matrix has spectral norm below one, and that this criterion is invariant across residual-stream autoregressive modalities, unifying text LLMs and autoregressive image and video generation. Experiments across four backbones and a visual autoregressive probe validate every theorem, with spectral predictions matching measured blind-spot rates within 3.2\% RMSE.

AI.tldr: SPARC提出了一种基于谱代数的自回归生成自校正理论，证明自校正盲点出现的充要条件是误差传播算子的谱半径≥1，推导出校正标记的激活阈值，并给出了基于强化学习的验证器-校正器训练的收敛条件。
AI.motivation: 现有工作虽经验性记录了大语言模型的自校正盲点现象，但缺乏对为何生成token会抑制错误检测能力的正式解释，没有校正标记激活的定量条件，也没有强化学习自校正的收敛性保证。
AI.method: 定义误差传播算子为残差流上每步注意力Jacobian的乘积，通过谱半径分析盲点产生条件；推导基于谱半径的校正标记激活阈值；证明RL验证器-校正器训练的收敛条件与耦合矩阵谱范数的关系。
AI.result: 盲点出现的充要条件是误差传播算子谱半径≥1；推导出"Wait"标记的激活阈值，恢复了89.3%的盲点减少；RL训练收敛速率与耦合强度平方/样本数平方根成正比；谱预测与实测盲点率的RMSE在3.2%以内。
AI.conclusion: SPARC理论统一了文本LLM和自回归图像/视频生成的自校正机制，提供了可验证的定量预测，填补了自校正现象的理论空白。

title: From Patterns to Maze Structures: SMT-Based Path Synthesis and 2D/3D Construction
summary: We present a pipeline for constructing maze structures from input patterns such as text or shapes. The central path-synthesis problem is encoded in Satisfiability Modulo Theories as global constraints on adjacency, continuity, and pattern-constrained coverage, allowing each fixed-bound instance to be solved in one call. The resulting path is either a planar, self-avoiding route or a layered traversal with prescribed over--under crossings, and it serves as a scaffold for constructing planar mazes and three-dimensional realizations of woven mazes. This report extends the published Bridges 2026 conference paper with more representative SMT-LIB examples and a fuller account of how synthesized paths become concrete maze constructions in planar and three-dimensional form.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于SMT（可满足性模理论）的迷宫结构生成流水线，能够从文本或形状等输入模式合成路径，并支持平面迷宫和三维编织迷宫的构建。
AI.motivation: 现有迷宫生成方法难以灵活地将任意输入模式（如文字、形状）直接转化为结构化的迷宫路径，缺乏一种统一、可求解的全局约束框架来同时满足邻接性、连续性和模式覆盖等要求。
AI.method: 将路径合成问题编码为SMT（可满足性模理论）中的全局约束，包括邻接约束、连续性约束和模式约束覆盖，每个固定边界实例通过一次求解器调用完成求解。生成的路径可以是平面自避行走路线，也可以是具有指定上下交叉关系的分层遍历路径。
AI.result: 成功生成了符合输入模式的平面迷宫结构和三维编织迷宫结构，并提供了更多SMT-LIB示例以展示方法的通用性。
AI.conclusion: SMT方法能够有效将输入模式转化为迷宫路径，并进一步扩展为平面和三维迷宫实体构建，为模式驱动的迷宫自动生成提供了新途径。

title: Demographic Prompting at Scale: When More Attributes Hurt LLM--Human Agreement
summary: We investigate how annotator demographic attributes, supplied as prompt cues, shape the alignment between large language model (LLM) predictions and human annotations across five tasks. Using five open-source LLMs, we systematically vary the number and composition of demographic components in the prompt, spanning every combination from single-attribute through full-attribute configurations. Our experiments reveal three principal findings. First, alignment consistently peaks with one to three high-signal attributes and degrades under the full attribute set, establishing a clear over-specification threshold. Second, the overall magnitude of demographic influence on human annotations does not predict which attributes improve LLM alignment; instead, both the learnability and the directional coherence of each attribute's annotation signal need to be considered jointly. Third, neuron probing reveals that specialized activation correlates with alignment gains only under coherent annotation signals, and that activation volume alone does not imply steerability. Together, these results demonstrate that demographic prompting is not a monolithic intervention: its utility is highly context-dependent, shaped by attribute signal quality, task characteristics, and model architecture.

AI.tldr: 研究发现在大语言模型提示中加入注释者人口统计属性时，包含1-3个高信号属性可提升模型与人类标注的对齐度，但加入全部属性反而会降低性能；人口统计属性对标注的影响程度不能直接预测其对模型对齐的改善效果；神经元探针显示仅在信号一致时激活才与对齐增益相关。
AI.motivation: 探究注释者的人口统计属性作为提示线索时，如何影响大语言模型（LLM）预测与人类标注之间的对齐程度。
AI.method: 使用五种开源LLM，在五个任务上系统性地改变提示中人口统计属性的数量和组合（从单一属性到全属性），通过神经元探针分析激活模式。
AI.result: 1) 对齐度在1-3个高信号属性时达到峰值，全属性时下降（过指定阈值）；2) 人口统计属性对标注的整体影响大小不能预测其对LLM对齐的改善效果，需联合考虑属性的可学习性和方向一致性；3) 神经元探针显示仅在信号一致时，专门化激活才与对齐增益相关，激活量本身不意味着可引导性。
AI.conclusion: 人口统计提示不是单一干预手段，其效用高度依赖于属性信号质量、任务特性和模型架构等上下文因素。

title: Navigating the Crowd: Non-linear MPC with Social Forces Dynamics for Human-Aware Robot Navigation
summary: Safe and socially compliant navigation remains a fundamental challenge for autonomous robots operating in human-populated environments. Beyond collision avoidance, robots must anticipate human motion and respect personal space to ensure human comfort. Model Predictive Control (MPC) offers a robust alternative to classical and data-driven methods, although its effectiveness strongly depends on accurate human motion prediction and efficient computation. This paper introduces SFM-NMPC, a Social Force Model-based Non-linear Model Predictive Control framework that embeds human motion prediction directly within the optimization loop. By incorporating the Social Force Model into the dynamic model of surrounding agents, the controller jointly predicts the trajectories of humans and robots over the prediction horizon, thereby enabling socially-aware planning. A tailored set of social cost functions guides the optimization toward human-compliant behaviors. Despite the increased model complexity, the proposed formulation runs in real time at 20 Hz. Extensive simulated testing in crowded environments demonstrates that SFM-NMPC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in social compliance metrics while maintaining efficient and smooth navigation. Visual trajectory analysis and an ablation study further highlight the contribution of the embedded SFM dynamics and social cost terms, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed approach for real-world social navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFM-NMPC框架，将社会力模型嵌入非线性模型预测控制的优化循环中，实现机器人在人群环境中的社交合规导航，在20Hz实时运行下优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人在人类环境中导航时不仅需要避免碰撞，还需预测人类运动并尊重个人空间以确保人类舒适度，现有MPC方法对预测精度和计算效率依赖较强。
AI.method: 提出SFM-NMPC框架，将Social Force Model融入非线性MPC的动态模型中，在优化循环内联合预测人类和机器人轨迹，并设计社交成本函数引导优化朝向符合人类期望的行为。
AI.result: 在拥挤环境仿真测试中，SFM-NMPC在社交合规指标上超越多个基线方法，保持高效平滑导航，实时运行频率达20Hz，消融实验验证了SFM动力学和社交成本项的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将社会力模型直接嵌入MPC优化循环是提升机器人社交导航合规性的有效途径，具备现实部署潜力。

title: Millimeter Wave Radar: From Synthetic Aperture to Probabilistic Mapping
summary: Robust probabilistic mapping is essential for autonomous robotic systems operating in challenging environments. While traditional sensors fail in adverse conditions such as smoke and fog, millimeter wave (mmWave) radar sensors offer reliable sensing in such conditions. However, creating accurate probabilistic maps from radar data presents significant challenges due to the inherently sparse and noisy characteristics of radio wave measurements and signal processing steps. In an attempt to address these issues, we establish a complete pipeline from raw radar signals to probabilistic occupancy maps, incorporating Synthetic Aperture Radar processing followed by a probabilistic modeling step. We conduct extensive validation across indoor environments, comparing our approach against different signal processing and probabilistic modeling approaches. We also evaluate mapping quality through downstream path planning performance analysis. Furthermore, we investigate the impact of key parameters and antenna array configuration on mapping performance. The experimental results demonstrate both the effectiveness and limitations of SAR-based probabilistic mapping for real-world robotic deployment. To facilitate future research and broader adoption, we contribute an open-source cascaded mmWave radar dataset with an accompanying GPU-accelerated signal processing pipeline available at https://github.com/rpl-cmu/rpm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从毫米波雷达原始信号到概率占用地图的完整处理流程，结合合成孔径雷达（SAR）处理与概率建模，在室内环境中验证了该方法在烟雾、雾气等恶劣条件下的建图效果，并分析了关键参数和天线配置的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统传感器在烟雾、雾气等恶劣环境中的感知能力受限，而毫米波雷达虽能在这些条件下可靠感知，但其数据固有的稀疏性和噪声特性使得构建准确的概率地图面临显著挑战。
AI.method: 构建从原始雷达信号到概率占用地图的完整流程：先进行合成孔径雷达（SAR）信号处理，再进行概率建模；通过下游路径规划性能分析评估建图质量；研究关键参数和天线阵列配置对建图性能的影响。
AI.result: 实验结果表明了基于SAR的概率建图在真实机器人部署中的有效性与局限性，并提供了开源级联毫米波雷达数据集及GPU加速的信号处理流程。
AI.conclusion: SAR结合概率建模的方式可有效提升毫米波雷达在恶劣条件下的建图能力，但仍存在局限性；开源的数据集和GPU加速流程有助于推动该领域的研究与应用。

title: UniPose9D: Universal Category-Agnostic Object Pose Estimation
summary: Object pose estimation is a fundamental problem in 3D vision. Although recent state-of-the-art approaches achieve strong performance, they often overfit to existing benchmarks and exhibit limited generalization to novel categories and unseen scenes. We propose UniPose9D, a category-agnostic foundation model for 9D object pose estimation: given an instance mask/ROI and either an RGB-D observation or an RGB image with predicted depth, the model estimates rotation, translation, and metric size without category labels, CAD models, mean-shape priors, or reference views. Specifically, UniPose9D samples point pairs from the observed object geometry and uses DINOv2 and PointNet features to predict NOCS coordinates for each pair. To improve accuracy, we introduce a point-pair-based RANSAC N-hop Kabsch--Umeyama algorithm with an adaptive threshold. We further employ flow matching to address symmetric ambiguities and construct a large-scale training set by curating and aligning pose annotations from existing public datasets. Experiments across six datasets show that a single unified model can match or surpass specialist methods while generalizing to unseen objects and in-the-wild scenarios. Our code and model are available on https://github.com/qq456cvb/UniPose9D.

AI.tldr: UniPose9D是一个类别无关的9D物体姿态估计基础模型，无需类别标签、CAD模型或参考视图，仅通过实例掩码和RGB-D（或RGB+预测深度）输入即可估计旋转、平移和度量尺寸。该方法在六个数据集上匹配或超越专用方法，并能泛化到未见过的物体和野外场景。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的物体姿态估计方法在现有基准上表现良好，但往往过拟合，对新型类别和未见场景的泛化能力有限。作者希望构建一个统一的、类别无关的基础模型来解决这些问题。
AI.method: UniPose9D从观测到的物体几何中采样点对，使用DINOv2和PointNet特征为每对点预测NOCS坐标；提出基于点对的RANSAC N跳Kabsch-Umeyama算法（带自适应阈值）提升精度；采用流匹配（flow matching）处理对称歧义；通过整理和配准现有公共数据集的姿态标注构建大规模训练集。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上的实验表明，单个统一模型可以匹配或超越专用方法，同时泛化到未见过的物体和野外场景。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种类别无关的9D姿态估计基础模型，通过点对NOCS预测、改进的Kabsch-Umeyama算法和流匹配等技术，实现了对未见物体和场景的良好泛化能力。
