title: RUBRIC: Realism--Utility Balanced Ranking for Imbalanced Classification
summary:
Class imbalance poses a fundamental challenge in risk-sensitive applications such as fraud detection and medical diagnosis, where minority-class samples are scarce yet critical for accurate classification. Existing oversampling methods generate synthetic samples to rebalance class distributions; however, they often produce large numbers of low-quality candidates that distort decision boundaries or introduce artifacts, leading to overfitting and degraded generalization.
  In this work, we introduce RUBRIC, a generator-agnostic filtering framework that formulates synthetic sample selection as a quality-over-quantity optimization problem. RUBRIC ranks candidates using a realism-utility trade-off: realism is quantified by a learned discriminator that distinguishes real samples from synthetic samples, while utility captures proximity to the decision boundary through a concave margin-based scoring function. We show that, under mild regularity conditions, the proposed filtering strategy monotonically tightens the generalization bound for margin-based classifiers by jointly reducing distribution shift and suppressing near-negative tail contributions.
  Through extensive experiments on credit-card fraud detection and other imbalanced benchmarks, we demonstrate that RUBRIC improves F1-macro and recall while maintaining comparable ROC-AUC across several generators. We also provide explicit lambda-sensitivity analysis to show how users can recover AUPRC when ranking quality is prioritized.

AI.tldr: RUBRIC是一个生成器无关的过滤框架，通过质量优先的合成样本选择策略（现实性-效用权衡）来改善类别不平衡问题，在信用卡欺诈检测等任务上提升了F1-macro和召回率，并给出了泛化界的理论分析。
AI.motivation: 现有过采样方法生成大量低质量合成样本，扭曲决策边界或引入伪影，导致过拟合和泛化能力下降，在欺诈检测、医疗诊断等风险敏感应用中问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 提出RUBRIC框架，将合成样本筛选建模为质量优先优化问题。使用学习到的判别器量化样本的"现实性"（区分真实与合成样本）；通过凹的基于间隔的评分函数量化"效用"（靠近决策边界的程度）。在温和正则条件下，证明了该策略通过联合降低分布偏移和抑制近负类尾部贡献来单调收紧间隔分类器的泛化界。
AI.result: 在信用卡欺诈检测和其他不平衡基准数据集上，RUBRIC在多个生成器下提升了F1-macro和召回率，同时保持可比的ROC-AUC。提供了显式的λ敏感性分析，展示用户如何在排序质量优先时恢复AUPRC。
AI.conclusion: RUBRIC作为一种生成器无关的过滤框架，通过质量优于数量的合成样本选择策略有效缓解了类别不平衡问题，兼具理论保障和实证效果。

title: Length Penalties Make Chain-of-Thought Less Monitorable
summary: Length-penalized reinforcement learning can shorten chain-of-thought reasoning while hiding an influence that drives the model's answer. In our experiments, training with length penalties does not stop misleading hints from steering models, even though the models' chains of thought mention the hint much less often. A token-accuracy evaluation would count these runs as successful because they use fewer reasoning tokens with little accuracy loss; it would miss whether the remaining trace still shows what drove the answer. We train Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B variants with different target chain lengths, then evaluate them with biasing-hint interventions on held-out MMLU-Pro-R and four transfer benchmarks. Compression sharply cuts reasoning tokens, preserves most multiple-choice accuracy, and leaves hint influence near baseline. At the strongest target, lower-bound faithfulness falls to 63.1% of baseline for Qwen3-14B and 69.4% for Qwen3-4B; the raw rate at which a monitor catches hint use falls from 69% to 49% and from 60% to 48%. To separate length from content, we randomly delete sentences from uncompressed baseline chains until the remaining text matches the compressed length. Even after this length matching, compressed chains disclose the hint 7-35 percentage points less often than baseline chains that we shorten at random, for both Qwen3 sizes and all five evaluation distributions. Compression therefore does more than shorten reasoning, preferentially removing the cues a monitor needs to see what influenced the answer. Together, these results reveal a compression-monitorability frontier in which cheaper reasoning can preserve answers while making the influences behind them harder to detect.

AI.tldr: 长度惩罚的强化学习可以缩短思维链推理，但不会消除误导性提示对模型答案的影响。压缩大幅减少推理token，保持准确率，但显著降低了可监控性——模型不再在思维链中暴露驱动答案的提示。通过随机删除基线链中句子进行长度匹配对比，发现压缩链披露提示的频率比随机缩短的基线链低7-35个百分点，表明压缩不仅缩短推理，还偏好性地移除了监控所需的线索。这揭示了一个压缩-可监控性前沿：更便宜的推理可以保持答案，但使影响答案的因素更难被检测。
AI.motivation: 探索长度惩罚的强化学习在缩短思维链推理时，是否会影响模型答案的可解释性和可监控性，即缩短后的推理是否仍然保留驱动模型答案的线索。
AI.method: 训练Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-14B变体使用不同目标链长度，采用带偏置提示干预的评估方法，在MMLU-Pro-R和四个迁移基准上测试。通过随机删除基线链中句子进行长度匹配对比实验，分离长度缩短与内容移除的影响。
AI.result: 压缩大幅减少推理token并保持多选准确率，但提示影响力接近基线水平。最強压缩下，下限忠实度降至基线的63.1%（Qwen3-14B）和69.4%（Qwen3-4B）；监控捕获提示使用的原始率从69%降至49%，从60%降至48%。长度匹配对比显示，压缩链披露提示的频率比随机缩短的基线链低7-35个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 压缩不仅缩短推理长度，还偏好性地移除了监控所需的线索，揭示了压缩-可监控性前沿：更便宜的推理可以保持答案准确，但使影响答案的因素更难被检测。

title: Non-binary bottom-up constituency parsing without arity actions
summary: Non-binary bottom-up constituency parsing is usually taken to require arity actions: reductions such as \(\textsc{Reduce-}X\#k\) specify both the mother label and the number of children to be composed. We show that this arity parameter is not a necessary transition primitive. Our parser introduces constituent labels separately and recovers reduction spans from delimiter-bounded stack configurations. In a well-formed reduction configuration, arity is uniquely determined by the active delimiter and the label marker, making it a derived property of parser state rather than an action label. This factorization removes label--arity-specific reduce actions while preserving direct construction of original non-binary trees. Experiments on PTB and CTB show that the delimiter-guided parser remains competitive with an arity-specific bottom-up baseline under the same implementation framework, with substantially smaller action inventories. Analyses further show that its predicted arity profile remains close to the gold treebanks and that high-arity constituents do not collapse when arity actions are removed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需arity参数的非二值自底向上成分句法分析方法，通过分隔符引导的栈配置来推导归约跨度，在保持性能的同时大幅减少了动作库存。
AI.motivation: 传统非二值自底向上成分句法分析需要arity动作（如Reduce-X#k）同时指定母亲标签和子节点数量，作者质疑该arity参数是否为必要的转换原语，试图简化动作空间。
AI.method: 将成分标签引入与归约动作分离，从分隔符界定的栈配置中恢复归约跨度。在良构的归约配置中，arity由活动分隔符和标签标记唯一确定，成为分析器状态的派生属性而非动作标签。
AI.result: 在PTB和CTB上的实验表明，分隔符引导的分析器在与arity特定的自底向上基线相同的实现框架下保持竞争力，且动作库存大幅缩减。预测的arity分布接近黄金树库，高arity成分在去除arity动作后不会坍塌。
AI.conclusion: arity参数并非非二值自底向上成分句法分析的必要原语，可通过分隔符机制将其从动作标签中移除，实现更紧凑的动作系统同时保持分析质量。

title: Anamnesis: An Open-Source Platform for Large-Scale Backstory-Conditioned Survey Simulation
summary: We present Anamnesis, an interactive system for demographically controllable survey simulation using large language models. Open-source, and designed for non-technical users/researchers, Anamnesis enables the prototyping and stress-testing of survey instruments on virtual populations rather than real human subjects. The platform operationalizes the recently introduced Anthology and Alterity frameworks, which use structured narrative backstories to condition model responses, within a unified web interface. It supports open-ended generation, probabilistic demographic resampling, and multimodal (image and audio) surveys. We evaluate the system through two case studies: (1) replicating segments of Pew Research Center's American Trends Panel (ATP) on political typology and biomedical issues and (2) emulating human preference in the New Yorker Caption Contest. In both cases, Anamnesis produces opinion distributions that more closely match real-world survey data than standard persona-prompting baselines, offering a transparent, reproducible, and open-source alternative to proprietary simulation services.

AI.tldr: Anamnesis是一个面向非技术用户的开源交互式调查模拟系统，通过结构化叙事背景故事驱动大语言模型，生成可控的人口统计调查结果，在政治倾向和幽默偏好两个案例中比标准角色提示方法更接近真实调查数据。
AI.motivation: 为研究人员提供一种透明、可复现、开源的方式，在虚拟人群上对调查问卷进行原型设计和压力测试，替代需要真实人类被试的昂贵调查过程以及不透明的商业模拟服务。
AI.method: 基于Anthology和Alterity框架，使用结构化叙事背景故事（而非简单的人口统计标签）条件化模型响应；系统提供统一Web界面，支持开放式生成、概率性人口重采样以及多模态（图像和音频）调查。
AI.result: 在两个案例（皮尤研究中心美国趋势小组的政治类型学/生物医学议题、纽约客漫画大赛的人类偏好模拟）中，Anamnesis生成的舆论分布比标准角色提示基线方法更接近真实世界调查数据。
AI.conclusion: Anamnesis提供了一种比标准角色提示更准确、比专有模拟服务更透明可复现的替代方案，可用于调查问卷的预测试和压力测试。

title: From Non-Rigid to Rigid: Safe Acquisition of Rigid Communication Graphs under Limited Sensing
summary: Communication graph rigidity is a fundamental requirement in many multi robot formation control approaches. However, ensuring and maintaining a rigid communication topology becomes challenging in practice due to limited sensing ranges and dynamic operating conditions. This paper provides a method for achieving an inter robot collision free, rigid time varying communication graph, where communication links are established or broken according to limited sensing ranges, without assuming an initial rigid graph. In addition, the proposed approach guarantees the realization of a rigid graph for heterogeneous nonlinear multi robot systems. A computationally lean, distributed quadratic optimization-based controller is developed for a leader follower architecture, acquiring rigidity based on hierarchical second-order consensus among robots. Follower agents do not require global absolute positions of any agent, including their own. The proposed method is validated through both simulations and hardware experiments in a motion-capture environment, demonstrating reliable performance under the limited sensing capabilities of individual robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在有限感知距离和动态条件下，无需初始刚性图即可实现多机器人系统无碰撞、时变刚性通信拓扑的方法，并基于分层二阶一致性设计了分布式二次优化控制器，通过仿真和实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 多机器人编队控制中通信图的刚性是基本要求，但实际中由于感知范围有限和动态运行条件，确保和维护刚性通信拓扑具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出了一种实现无碰撞、时变刚性通信图的方法，通信链路根据有限感知距离建立或断开；针对异构非线性多机器人系统，开发了基于分层二阶一致性的分布式二次优化控制器，采用领导者-跟随者架构，跟随者无需全局绝对位置信息。
AI.result: 通过仿真和运动捕捉环境下的硬件实验验证了该方法在机器人有限感知能力下的可靠性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够在有限感知范围和动态条件下实现刚性通信拓扑，无需初始刚性图，且适用于异构非线性多机器人系统。

title: Model Guides You How to Draw: Adaptive Visual Gating for Unified Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) with interleaved reasoning, which generate both textual and visual steps as part of intermediate reasoning traces, have demonstrated great potential for visual mathematical reasoning tasks. However, we identify a key insight in this paradigm: generating intermediate visual reasoning steps is not always beneficial and can even be harmful, as self-generated visual steps may introduce erroneous visual evidence that misleads subsequent reasoning. Moreover, frequently triggering visual steps during reasoning incurs substantial computational and memory overhead, degrading inference efficiency. To address these accuracy and efficiency challenges, we observe that the model's internal signals can indicate whether a visual step will benefit reasoning before the entire visual generation is completed. Specifically, this work identifies two internal signals: 1) Generation Intent, which reflects whether the model has a concrete textual plan for what to draw, and 2) Visual Fidelity, which measures whether the visual generation remains grounded in the original input image. Leveraging these internal signals, we propose AdaViG, a training-free adaptive visual gating method for unified multimodal reasoning. AdaViG dynamically evaluates each triggered visual step at an early visual generation stage and aborts it when both signals are weak, thereby preventing misleading visual evidence from entering the reasoning trace while avoiding unnecessary computation. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that AdaViG improves accuracy by up to 5.7% while reducing visual generation FLOPs by 25.0%-91.0% and wall-clock latency by 15.4%-45.6%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaViG，一种无需训练的自适应视觉门控方法，通过模型内部信号（生成意图和视觉保真度）在早期评估中间视觉推理步骤是否有效，动态决定是否中止视觉生成，从而在统一多模态推理中平衡准确率和效率。实验显示准确率提升最高5.7%，视觉生成FLOPs降低25.0%-91.0%，延迟降低15.4%-45.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMMs）在视觉数学推理中生成中间视觉推理步骤，但发现视觉步骤并非总是有益，自生成的视觉证据可能引入误导信息，且频繁触发视觉生成导致大量计算和内存开销，影响推理效率。
AI.method: 提出AdaViG（Adaptive Visual Gating），一种无需训练的自适应方法。利用模型内部的两个信号——生成意图（模型是否有具体的文本绘制计划）和视觉保真度（视觉生成是否基于原始输入图像），在视觉步骤早期生成阶段动态评估其有效性，当两个信号都弱时中止该视觉步骤，避免误导性视觉证据进入推理轨迹并节省计算资源。
AI.result: 准确率提升最高5.7%，视觉生成FLOPs降低25.0%-91.0%，端到端延迟降低15.4%-45.6%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应地控制中间视觉推理步骤的生成，在提升推理准确率的同时显著降低计算开销，验证了模型内部信号可用于指导视觉门控决策的有效性。

title: Estimation, Prediction, and Assortment Optimization for Markov Chain Choice Models with Panel Data
summary: We propose a framework for the Markov chain (MC) choice model with panel data, including parameter estimation, personalized choice prediction, and personalized assortment optimization. In contrast to the traditional setting, which assumes that each transaction is independently drawn from a random utility model, our framework accounts for dependencies among transactions for the same customer in historical data, captured by partial-ordering preference information. To the best of our knowledge, our framework initiates the study of choice modeling with panel data under MC. As our primary result, we propose novel expectation-maximization (EM) algorithms for MC parameter estimation by incorporating partial-ordering-based customer preference information. On synthetic datasets and the sushi dataset, our EM algorithms outperform the traditional EM algorithm of Simsek and Topaloglu (Operations Research, 66, 2018) and multinomial-logit-based partial-order benchmarks adapted from Jagabathula and Vulcano (Management Science, 64, 2018). As our secondary contribution, we present hardness and computational results for conditional choice prediction and assortment optimization problems. These results complement our estimation framework and clarify the computational landscape of conditional choice and assortment optimization, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向面板数据的马尔可夫链选择模型框架，涵盖参数估计、个性化选择预测和个性化品类优化。通过引入偏序偏好信息，设计了新的EM算法，在合成数据和寿司数据集上优于传统方法，并给出了条件选择预测和品类优化的计算复杂度分析。
AI.motivation: 传统马尔可夫链选择模型假设每个交易独立同分布，忽略了同一位顾客在历史数据中多次交易之间的依赖关系。本文旨在利用面板数据中的偏序偏好信息来建模这种依赖关系，从而提升参数估计精度和个性化推荐质量。
AI.method: 提出基于偏序偏好信息的EM算法用于MC模型参数估计；对条件选择预测和品类优化问题进行了复杂度分析（包括计算困难性结果）。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和寿司数据集上，所提出的EM算法在估计精度上优于Simsek & Topaloglu (2018)的传统EM算法以及基于多项Logit的偏序基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将面板数据引入马尔可夫链选择模型，提出的框架在参数估计性能上具有显著优势，同时厘清了相关优化问题的计算边界。

title: PHITSBench: an execution-scored benchmark for AI-assisted PHITS radiation-transport input generation using natural language
summary: We introduce PHITSBench, an execution-scored benchmark for the Monte Carlo Particle and Heavy Ion Transport code System (PHITS). PHITSBench comprises 282 transport-scorable tasks spanning three common workflow categories: parameter editing (Edit), syntax repair (Repair ), and complete simulation generation from natural-language descriptions (Reproduce). Each task is evaluated using a Composite Metric Score that combines execution success with agreement between generated and reference transport observables. Using PHITSBench, we evaluate five GPT-5.4-based configurations ranging from zero-shot prompting to knowledge-augmented and agentic workflows. Without domain-specific knowledge, the model performs well on editing and repair tasks (95% and 70% success, respectively) but fails to generate correct simulations from scratch (0% success on the Reproduce track). A structured, machine-readable PHITS knowledge catalog, supplied alongside the user manual, raises single-shot Reproduce-task success to 57%. Agentic execution provides a further improvement to 66-73%, but at increased computational cost. Failure analysis shows that the remaining errors are dominated by incorrect selection and configuration of physical observables rather than syntax generation. These results suggest that future progress in AI-assisted radiation-transport modeling will depend as much on machine-readable knowledge bases, curated domain-training datasets, and execution-grounded evaluation environments as on advances in foundation models themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PHITSBench，一个用于蒙特卡罗粒子与重离子输运代码系统(PHITS)的基于执行评分的基准测试。该基准包含282个可评分任务，涵盖参数编辑、语法修复和从自然语言描述生成完整模拟三种工作流。评估采用结合执行成功率和输运观测值一致性的复合指标。实验表明，无领域知识时模型在编辑和修复任务上表现良好(95%和70%)，但无法从头生成正确模拟(0%)。引入结构化知识目录后，单次生成成功率提升至57%，代理执行进一步提升至66-73%，但计算成本增加。错误分析显示主要问题在于物理观测量的选择与配置而非语法生成。研究表明AI辅助辐射输运建模的未来进展同样依赖于机器可读知识库、领域训练数据集和执行评估环境。
AI.motivation: 现有AI辅助科学计算基准缺乏对蒙特卡罗辐射输运领域专业代码(PHITS)的全面评估，尤其是缺乏基于实际执行结果的评分机制。研究者希望构建一个能真实反映模型在该专业领域代码生成与修改能力的标准化评估平台。
AI.method: 构建包含282个任务的PHITSBench基准，设置编辑、修复、复现三类工作流。设计复合指标评分(结合执行成功与物理量一致性)。评估5种GPT-5.4配置(从零样本到知识增强再到代理工作流)，并通过结构化知识目录注入领域知识。
AI.result: 无领域知识时编辑95%成功、修复70%成功、复现0%成功。引入知识目录后复现单次成功达57%，代理执行提升至66-73%。主要错误源于物理观测量的选择配置而非语法错误。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助辐射输运建模的未来进展不仅依赖于基础模型进步，同样需要机器可读知识库、领域训练数据集和执行评估环境的共同发展。

title: Eval-Pair Matrix: Answer-Paired Meta-Evaluation of LLM Judges for Grounded RAG
summary: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation is widely used for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), but reusing the same model family as both generator and judge makes self-leniency difficult to identify. We introduce Eval-Pair Matrix, a controlled meta evaluation protocol for source-grounded RAG. Starting from GaRAGe questions and grounding passages, we induce one hidden answer-causal contradiction per record, generate answers from perturbed passages with GPT, Grok, and Gemini models, and then use the same models as blind judges to evaluate each answer against the original passages. The experiment contains 300 core records, 897 labeled generator outputs, and 2,683 judge verdicts in a crossed 3 x 3 matrix; the primary analysis uses 275 fully validated records. Instead of comparing diagonal and off-diagonal cells across different answers, we estimate same-model effects by pairing judges on the exact same candidate answer. This changes the interpretation: diagonal and off diagonal F1 are similar, and the paired same-model recall effect is near zero (-0.5 pp; 95% cluster bootstrap CI [-2.7, +1.7]). The only robust paired gap is lower matching-judge flagging for answers that avoided the induced claim (-4.3 pp). A targeted human evaluation finds that reviewed apparent false positives are alternate source-error detections, mistakes in labeling whether the induced claim was adopted, or unclear cases; none were adjudicated as genuine false alarms. The lesson is methodological: RAG judge studies should report full matrices, answer-paired effects, behavior strata, and label-task alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Eval-Pair Matrix评估协议，通过控制实验设计（3×3模型矩阵、答案配对分析）发现LLM即评判者范式中，相同模型作为生成器和评判者不存在显著的自我宽松偏差，主要偏差仅出现在避免诱导性声明时的标记率降低，且经人工验证后未发现真正的假阳性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-judge评估广泛用于RAG系统，但重复使用同一模型族作为生成器和评判者会产生自我宽松偏差（self-leniency），且难以识别。需要一种受控的元评估协议来量化这种偏差。
AI.method: 构建Eval-Pair Matrix评估框架：基于GaRAGe问题和基础段落，在每条记录中隐藏一个答案-因果矛盾，通过GPT、Grok、Gemini三种模型从扰动段落生成答案，再由相同模型作为盲评者进行评估。实验包含300条核心记录、897个标注生成输出和2683个评判结果，形成3×3交叉矩阵。核心分析采用答案配对方法（配对相同候选答案），而非比较不同答案的对角线与非对角线单元。
AI.result: 对角线与非对角线的F1分数相似；配对相同模型召回效应近乎为零（-0.5个百分点；95%聚类自助法置信区间[-2.7, +1.7]）；唯一显著的配对差距是当答案避免诱导性声明时，匹配评判者的标记率降低（-4.3个百分点）。人工评估发现，表面上的假阳性实际上是替代源错误检测、标签任务错误或模糊案例，没有一例被判定为真正的假警报。
AI.conclusion: RAG评判者研究报告应包含完整矩阵、答案配对效应、行为分层和标签任务对齐。

title: Toward Contemplative LLM: A Modular Framework for Evaluating and Enhancing LLM Alignment in Mental Health
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at HARMONY 2026 (Human-centered AI Research for Mental Health, an Open Networking Symposium), co-located with IEEE/ACM Conference on Connected Health: Applications, Systems, and Engineering Technologies (CHASE 2026) held in Pittsburgh, August 6, 2026
summary: Contemplative traditions have long guided ethical behavior and prosocial interaction, and recent work suggests that contemplative principles (e.g., mindfulness, compassion, non-dual reasoning) may offer a promising paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs), improving cooperation and reducing ethical violations in LLM outputs. However, as new models, evaluation metrics, and benchmarks emerge rapidly, it remains challenging to systematically assess whether and how contemplative principles enhance LLM alignment across diverse and evolving scenarios, and existing approaches are often ad hoc and fail to generalize. We present a modular, extensible evaluation framework, initially targeted at the mental health domain, that enables seamless integration of new models, metrics, and benchmarks through a reusable pipeline. The framework currently reproduces existing state-of-the-art results and supports systematic cross-evaluation by flexibly mixing and matching models, metrics, and benchmarks, enabling fair comparison and deeper insight. Its plug-and-play prompting module offers a principled pathway for incorporating ethical perspectives such as contemplative principles, allowing domain experts to define alignment criteria without requiring technical expertise. Although initially focused on mental health, the framework is domain-agnostic and extends naturally to areas such as decision-making, moral reasoning, and human-AI collaboration. By bridging computational evaluation with human-centered ethical reasoning, this work lays the groundwork for interdisciplinary research spanning cognitive science, behavioral economics, philosophy, and system design, toward robust, trustworthy, and socially beneficial human-AI ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个模块化、可扩展的评估框架，用于系统评估沉思原则（如正念、慈悲、非二元推理）对大语言模型对齐的影响。该框架最初针对心理健康领域，支持灵活集成新模型、指标和基准，并通过即插即用的提示模块让领域专家无需技术背景即可定义对齐标准，为构建可信、有益的人机生态系统奠定跨学科基础。
AI.motivation: 现有评估大语言模型对齐中沉思原则影响的方法通常是临时的、缺乏泛化性，难以系统评估不同模型、指标和基准下沉思原则是否及如何增强对齐效果。
AI.method: 提出了一个模块化、可扩展的评估框架，包含可重用管道，支持灵活混合匹配模型、指标和基准；集成了即插即用的提示模块，允许领域专家定义对齐标准而不需要技术专业知识；支持跨评估的系统比较。
AI.result: 框架能够复现现有最先进的结果，支持通过灵活的组合进行公平比较和深入洞察，尽管目前专注于心理健康领域，但具有领域无关性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架弥合了计算评估与以人为中心的伦理推理之间的差距，为认知科学、行为经济学、哲学和系统设计等跨学科研究奠定了基础，推动构建稳健、可信、有益的人机生态系统。

title: On the Efficiency of LoRA Fine-Tuning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Industrial Robotic Manipulation
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN 2026); to appear in Springer LNCS
summary: Deploying billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on industrial hardware requires fine-tuning to bridge the embodiment gap. Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) provides maximal plasticity but requires data centre-grade GPUs. We present a systematic study of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for $π_0$, a flow-matching VLA, evaluated on four precision assembly tasks with a UR5e robotic manipulator. Across a sweep of LoRA ranks (r=8 to 256), allocation strategies, and component-freezing ablations, we find no statistically significant advantage of FFT over certain LoRA configurations. Performance saturates at r=32, and uniform allocation across the Vision-Language-Model (VLM) backbone and action expert proves sufficient. Freezing the VLM or restricting the vision encoder to LoRA significantly degrades performance, indicating that embodiment adaptation requires both semantic and visual plasticity. These results suggest that LoRA at r=32 with full vision encoder fine-tuning is a practical approach, reducing static peak VRAM from 36.2 to 10.8 GiB (parameters and optimizer states, activation memory excluded) without detectable performance loss.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了LoRA在π₀流匹配VLA模型上的微调效果，发现在精密装配任务中，秩r=32的LoRA配置与全参数微调性能相当，但显存从36.2 GiB降至10.8 GiB。
AI.motivation: 部署十亿参数级VLA模型到工业硬件需要微调以弥合具身差距，但全参数微调需要数据中心级GPU资源，因此需要探索更高效的微调方法。
AI.method: 在π₀流匹配VLA模型上系统比较不同LoRA秩(r=8到256)、分配策略和组件冻结消融实验，在UR5e机械臂的四个精密装配任务上进行评估。
AI.result: LoRA在r=32时性能饱和且与全参数微调无统计显著差异；均匀分配至VLM主干和动作专家效果最佳；冻结VLM或限制视觉编码器为LoRA会显著降低性能。
AI.conclusion: LoRA r=32配合完整视觉编码器微调是一种实用方案，在无性能损失下将静态峰值显存从36.2 GiB降至10.8 GiB。

title: FlashBEV: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact BEV Transformation with IO-Awareness
summary: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception is a core component of camera-based 3D understanding in autonomous driving, where view transformation (VT) maps multi-camera image features into a unified BEV representation. Sampling-based view transformation (Sampling-VT) is attractive because it supports dense and continuous BEV aggregation for high-resolution and long-range perception. Its deployment bottleneck, however, is systems-level: standard tensorized implementations of Sampling-VT -- which we refer to as Tensorized Sampling-VT -- explicitly materialize large height-dependent intermediate tensors, causing memory and latency costs that scale poorly with vertical resolution and the number of cameras. We revisit Tensorized Sampling-VT from an operator-execution perspective and show that it follows a gather-reduction pattern: each BEV query independently accumulates contributions across cameras and height bins, enabling thread-local accumulation with on-the-fly recomputation that eliminates the need to materialize height- and camera-dependent intermediates. Based on this insight, we propose FlashBEV, a fully fused and IO-aware execution strategy mathematically equivalent to Tensorized Sampling-VT (same operator output) while substantially reducing global memory traffic and kernel-launch overhead. Experiments show that FlashBEV achieves more than an order of magnitude lower peak GPU memory and significant inference-latency speedups, with memory effectively independent of the number of height bins, reducing the operator's peak memory to O(BCXY) (output only). This unlocks higher BEV range/resolution and vertical discretization within fixed deployment budgets on memory-constrained devices. Our contribution is an execution redesign -- same math, different execution -- that removes a key scalability barrier for deployment-ready Sampling-VT. Code available at https://github.com/yokosyun/FlashBEV

AI.tldr: FlashBEV是一种针对鸟瞰图感知中采样型视图变换（Sampling-VT）的IO感知全融合执行策略，通过将原有的张量化实现重新理解为gather-reduction模式，以即时重计算替代中间张量的显式物化，在保持数学等价的前提下显著降低峰值GPU内存（降至O(BCXY)）和推理延迟，尤其使内存消耗与高度方向离散化数量解耦，突破部署场景下的可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有张量化实现的Sampling-VT需要显式物化依赖于高度方向和相机数量的大规模中间张量，导致内存和延迟开销随垂直分辨率与相机数量急剧增长，成为部署场景下的关键可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 从算子执行视角将Tensorized Sampling-VT重解释为gather-reduction模式：每个BEV查询独立跨相机和高度bin累加贡献，利用线程本地累加与即时重计算消除中间张量的物化，并采用完全融合、IO感知的执行策略减少全局内存访问与内核启动开销。
AI.result: 峰值GPU内存降低超一个数量级，推理延迟显著加速，内存有效独立于高度bin数量，算子峰值内存降至O(BCXY)（仅输出）。
AI.conclusion: 通过执行层面的重新设计（相同数学运算，不同执行方式），消除了部署就绪型Sampling-VT的关键可扩展性障碍，在固定部署预算内支持更高的BEV范围/分辨率和垂直离散化。

title: Learning Predictive Ambiguity Sets for Decision-Focused Distributionally Robust Optimization
summary: Predict-then-optimize systems usually compress uncertainty into a point forecast and then solve a downstream optimization problem as if the forecast were reliable. Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) offers protection against misspecification, but the ambiguity set is often centered at historical samples and uses a fixed radius. We propose \emph{learned predictive ambiguity sets} (LPAS): a deep contextual model outputs a finite nominal scenario distribution, a state-dependent Wasserstein radius, and optionally an anisotropic ground metric. These outputs define a contextual ambiguity set that feeds a DRO decision layer. The radius is trained by a combination of conditional quantile calibration, size regularization, and downstream decision loss, so that robustness is adaptive rather than globally fixed. We derive the finite dual form used by the decision layer, present a staged training algorithm, and evaluate the method on distributionally robust portfolio optimization with 20 S&P 500 constituents from 2018--2026. The proposed method substantially improves over equal-weight, predict-then-optimize, and historical Wasserstein DRO baselines, achieving 26.28% annualized return, Sharpe ratio 1.30, final wealth 1.61, and lower tail loss than a deep fixed-radius DRO baseline while using a smaller average radius. The results show that learned ambiguity radii can recover most of the performance of strong fixed-radius DRO while reducing unnecessary conservatism and improving regime adaptivity.

AI.tldr: 提出学习型预测模糊集(LPAS)，通过深度上下文模型输出有限名义场景分布、状态依赖的Wasserstein半径及各向异性地面度量，构建自适应的分布鲁棒优化框架，在S&P 500投资组合优化中实现26.28%年化收益、1.30夏普比率，优于传统预测-优化和固定半径DRO基线。
AI.motivation: 传统预测-优化系统将不确定性压缩为点预测，忽略预测误差；分布鲁棒优化虽能抵御误设定，但其模糊集常以固定半径围绕历史样本，缺乏状态自适应性，导致不必要的保守性。
AI.method: 提出LPAS框架：深度上下文模型输出有限名义场景分布、状态依赖的Wasserstein半径及各向异性地面度量，构成上下文模糊集；通过条件分位数校准、规模正则化与下游决策损失联合训练半径；推导有限对偶形式并设计分阶段训练算法。
AI.result: 在2018-2026年20只S&P 500成分股投资组合优化中，LPAS实现26.28%年化收益、1.30夏普比率、1.61期末财富；尾损失低于固定半径DRO基线，且平均半径更小。
AI.conclusion: 学习型模糊半径可恢复强固定半径DRO的大部分性能，同时降低不必要的保守性并提升对市场状态的自适应能力。

title: Semantic Drift and the Stability of Operator Control in Reasoning-Class Decision Support Systems
summary: The article investigates the fundamental problem of ensuring the stability of operator control and preserving goal-targeting in hybrid human-machine decision support systems (DSS) of a new generation. Based on a two-month continuous longitudinal experiment on the joint design of a monograph-format textual array, the latent phenomenon of semantic context drift in large language models of deep logical reasoning (Reasoning LLMs) is verified and described. A mathematical model of interaction in the human-machine interface is proposed, and an original metric is introduced - the operator control stability coefficient, which takes into account the non-linear contextual pressure of hidden reasoning chains. Within the paradigm of the cognitome theory, a critical point of control functions inversion is captured. Engineering recommendations are formulated for implementing dynamic relational arbitration loops based on a modified hierarchical similarity model.

AI.tldr: 基于两个月连续纵向实验，验证并描述了推理型大语言模型中语义上下文漂移的潜在现象；提出了人机交互数学模型，引入算子控制稳定性系数作为新指标；在认知组学理论范式下捕捉了控制功能反转临界点；并提出了基于改进层次相似性模型的动态关系仲裁循环工程建议。
AI.motivation: 解决新一代混合人机决策支持系统中算子控制稳定性与目标保持这一基本问题。
AI.method: 两个月连续纵向实验（联合设计专著格式文本阵列）、数学建模、认知组学理论分析。
AI.result: 验证了推理型大语言模型中的语义上下文漂移现象；提出了算子控制稳定性系数；捕捉了控制功能反转临界点。
AI.conclusion: 应实施基于改进层次相似性模型的动态关系仲裁循环以保障人机决策系统的稳定性。

title: EquiFusion: Kinematics-Agnostic Human Motion Prediction via Equivariant Latent Diffusion
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Visit our webpage at https://ceveloper.github.io/publications/equifusion/
summary: Existing Stochastic 3D Human Motion Prediction models are fundamentally constrained by hard-coding the skeleton kinematics, severely limiting generalization, preventing cross-dataset training, and requiring complex data retargeting. We introduce EquiFusion, the first kinematics-agnostic model to solve this bottleneck, implementing a latent diffusion model with a permutation equivariant architecture. EquiFusion treats the kinematics' connectivity as an explicit input parameter, ensuring its internal computations are inherently agnostic to joint ordering and graph structure. This novel design enables truly cross-dataset generalization to unseen kinematics and unlocks novel zero-shot directions, such as motion prediction from partial or occluded observations and targeted limb generation. EquiFusion achieves state-of-the-art results on major benchmarks, being up to 75% more compact than previous kinematics-specific methods, while achieving faster training and inference. EquiFusion thus establishes a new, flexible standard for robust human motion prediction. Model and training code are available at https://ceveloper.github.io/publications/equifusion/.

AI.tldr: EquiFusion 是首个运动学无关的随机3D人体运动预测模型，采用置换等变潜扩散架构，将运动学连接作为显式输入参数，实现了跨数据集泛化、零样本预测（如部分观测、目标肢体生成），在多个基准上达到SOTA，且模型体积缩小75%，训练和推理更快。
AI.motivation: 现有随机3D人体运动预测模型硬编码骨架运动学结构，严重限制泛化能力、无法跨数据集训练，且需要复杂的数据重定向。作者旨在打破这一瓶颈，设计一个运动学无关的通用模型。
AI.method: 提出 EquiFusion，一个运动学无关的潜扩散模型，采用置换等变架构，将运动学连接作为显式输入参数，使内部计算天然不受关节顺序和图结构影响。
AI.result: 在多个主要基准上达到SOTA，模型体积比此前运动学特定方法缩小75%，训练和推理速度更快，且实现了跨数据集泛化到未见运动学结构的能力。
AI.conclusion: EquiFusion 为鲁棒的人体运动预测建立了新的灵活标准，开启了零样本运动预测新方向（如部分遮挡观测、目标肢体生成）。

title: ActiveFly-Bench: Aligning Embodied Question Answering with Vision-Language-Action for Aerial Embodied Perception
summary: We introduce ActiveFly-Bench, the first benchmark to bridge cyberspace reasoning and physical-world interaction for UAV embodied perception. The benchmark decomposes active perception into three hierarchical tasks: Aerial Embodied Question Answering (Air-EQA), Observation Behavior Planning (OBP), and Fine-grained Language-guided UAV Control (FLUC), explicitly connecting high-level task understanding, behavior planning, and low-level control. The datasets are collected from both real-world and simulated outdoor environments for training and evaluation. We further develop ActiveFly, a closed-loop UAV agent that integrates visual-language reasoning with fine-grained control, and deploy it on a physical UAV platform. Experiments with representative VLMs and VLA models show that current UAV agents still struggle with behavior planning, viewpoint adjustment, and robust task completion in active perception. These results establish ActiveFly-Bench as a new testbed for embodied aerial intelligence.

AI.tldr: ActiveFly-Bench是首个连接网络推理与物理世界交互的无人机具身感知基准，包含三个层次化任务（Air-EQA、OBP、FLUC），并提出了ActiveFly闭环无人机智能体，实验表明现有模型在行为规划和视角调整等方面仍存在挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏将网络空间推理与物理世界交互相连接的能力，无人机主动感知中高层任务理解、行为规划与底层控制三者之间存在割裂。
AI.method: 构建ActiveFly-Bench基准，将主动感知分解为三个层次化任务（Air-EQA、OBP、FLUC）；开发ActiveFly闭环无人机智能体，集成视觉-语言推理与细粒度控制；在真实和仿真户外环境中采集数据集。
AI.result: 当前无人机智能体在行为规划、视角调整和鲁棒任务完成方面仍存在困难，现有VLM和VLA模型表现不足。
AI.conclusion: ActiveFly-Bench为具身空中智能提供了新的测试平台，揭示了当前模型在主动感知任务中的局限性。

title: Label-Free Target-Domain Adaptation for Unconstrained Event-Image Feature Matching via Dual-Stage Distillation
comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. The source code and benchmark will be made publicly available at https://github.com/ZhonghuaYi/nexus2-official
summary: Building pixel-level correspondence between event and image data is a fundamental task for multi-sensor systems. However, existing cross-modal matching methods are largely restricted by their reliance on either matching labels or strictly aligned hardware, which limits them to unlabeled and unconstrained real-world scenarios where neither matching ground truth nor prior sensor relationships are available. To address this, we propose a novel two-stage training paradigm. First, we leverage large-scale data to perform label-agnostic distillation pretraining, upgrading optimization objectives with distribution-based and contrastive losses to learn highly generalizable representations. Second, to tackle unlabeled and unconstrained downstream data, we introduce an epipolar-guided self-distillation framework. By utilizing consistency verification to isolate robust matches and incorporating geometric confidence derived from an external epipolar prior, our model can effectively self-evolve directly on target domains without any supervision. Furthermore, we introduce a rigorous cross-modal evaluation benchmark based on TUM-VIE, featuring physically separated cameras with distinct intrinsic parameters and resolutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both MVSEC and TUM-VIE pose estimation tasks. The source code and benchmark will be made publicly available at https://github.com/ZhonghuaYi/nexus2-official.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无标签、无约束条件下的跨模态（事件相机与图像）像素级匹配方法，采用两阶段训练范式：先通过大规模数据无标签蒸馏预训练学习通用表征，再引入极线引导的自蒸馏框架在目标域无监督自演化。在TUM-VIE基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态匹配方法高度依赖匹配标签或严格对齐的硬件，无法应用于无标签、无约束的真实世界场景，亟需一种不依赖标注和先验传感器关系的通用匹配方法。
AI.method: 提出两阶段训练范式：(1) 无标签蒸馏预训练——利用大规模数据，通过分布损失和对比损失进行优化目标升级，学习高泛化性表征；(2) 极线引导的自蒸馏框架——在无标签下游数据上，通过一致性验证筛选可靠匹配，并利用外部极线先验的几何置信度引导模型在目标域自演化。
AI.result: 在MVSEC和TUM-VIE的位姿估计任务上均达到SOTA性能；构建了基于TUM-VIE的严格跨模态评估基准，包含物理分离、不同内参和分辨率的相机。
AI.conclusion: 无监督两阶段训练范式有效消除了对匹配标签和硬件对齐的依赖，为真实世界无约束跨模态匹配提供了可行方案。

title: A Strong Balanced-Softmax Classifier-Retraining Baseline for Long-Tailed Recognition
summary: Long-tailed recognition methods often modify losses, margins, or representations to reduce the dominance of frequent classes. We ask whether, after Balanced Softmax training, the remaining tail error can be reduced by retraining only the classifier. We evaluate BS-cRT, a two-stage procedure that trains a backbone and cosine classifier with Balanced Softmax, freezes the backbone, and updates only the classifier on balanced episodic batches. The second stage keeps the empirical-prior Balanced Softmax objective and uses raw cosine logits at inference. Across CIFAR-100-LT, CIFAR-10-LT, ImageNet-LT, and Places-LT, this classifier-only step consistently improves Few-shot accuracy over the matched Balanced Softmax checkpoint. At imbalance factor 100, Few-shot gains are +5.15 points on CIFAR-100-LT and +5.83 on CIFAR-10-LT; on ImageNet-LT and Places-LT, gains are +6.92 and +9.78 points, respectively, with a Top-1/Few-shot trade-off on ImageNet-LT. We also analyze Counterfactual Boundary Risk Minimization (CBRM), a boundary-probe extension using prototype-based features near decision boundaries. CBRM identifies two failure modes: scaled-logit cosine margins destabilize training, and corrected hardest-negative probes remain head-class anchored. The results support BS-cRT as a practical classifier-side baseline and indicate that boundary supervision must account for class frequency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BS-cRT两阶段方法：先用Balanced Softmax训练骨干网络和余弦分类器，再冻结骨干网络、仅用平衡小批量更新分类器。在多个长尾基准上，该分类器微调步骤一致提升Few-shot准确率，且分析了边界监督中的两类失败模式。
AI.motivation: 长尾识别中，现有方法通常修改损失函数或表示来抑制头部类主导地位，但作者探究在Balanced Softmax训练后，仅重训分类器能否进一步降低尾部错误。
AI.method: BS-cRT：两阶段流程。阶段一用Balanced Softmax训练骨干和余弦分类器；阶段二冻结骨干，仅在平衡小批量上更新分类器，保持经验先验的Balanced Softmax目标，推理时使用原始余弦logits。同时提出CBRM边界探测扩展，分析缩放logits余弦间隔和校正的最难负样本两类失败模式。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100-LT、CIFAR-10-LT、ImageNet-LT和Places-LT上，分类器微调一致提升Few-shot准确率。不平衡因子100时，CIFAR-100-LT提升+5.15点，CIFAR-10-LT提升+5.83点，ImageNet-LT提升+6.92点，Places-LT提升+9.78点，但ImageNet-LT上存在Top-1/Few-shot权衡。
AI.conclusion: BS-cRT是一种实用的分类器侧基线方法，边界监督必须考虑类别频率，CBRM分析表明余弦间隔缩放会 destabilize 训练，校正后的最硬负样本仍锚定于头部类。

title: Agentic Context Learning with Self-Discovered Specification
summary: Context learning is an emerging inference-time task where LLMs must learn and apply novel, task-specific knowledge from intricate contexts absent from pre-training; even frontier models score under 24% task success. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study to understand why this setting remains difficult. A natural hypothesis is that failures stem from content access; yet across twelve retrieval, reflection, and verification baselines on CL-Bench, an extensive context learning benchmark, we find limited gains over direct full-context prompting. Further failure analysis reveals a key finding: unlike typical long-context tasks such as long document understanding, context learning requires not only recovering local content but also acquiring local specifications that are often unspecified in the query but distributed across the context: domain-specific formats, local rules, and completeness conditions. Across all 31,592 rubric items, we find that 55.4% clearly evaluate specification acquisition, while only 22.6% evaluate content acquisition. Moreover, despite 76.7% of specifications being unspecified in the user query, 95.5% are traceable to the context, indicating these are learnable obligations rather than hidden requirements. To validate this diagnosis, we design a deliberately simple intervention PSCI (private specification-contract induction) which extracts local specifications and enforces them through adversarial checking and repair; PSCI achieves state-of-the-art 28.14% with GPT-5.1 (+5.59 pp absolute and +24.8% relative) on CL-Bench, replicated on Qwen3.5-27B (+5.28 pp) and Gemini 3 Pro (+6.17 pp). Seventeen ablations further isolate the role of task-specific specifications. Overall, our results suggest context learning hinges on not only content acquisition but also specification acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了上下文学习（Context Learning）这一新兴推理时任务，发现即使是前沿模型在此任务上的成功率也低于24%。通过全面实验，作者发现失败原因并非内容获取问题，而是规范获取（Specification Acquisition）问题：模型需要从上下文中提取领域特定的格式、局部规则和完整性条件等规范。为此，作者提出PSCI方法，通过提取局部规范并进行对抗性检查与修复，在CL-Bench上实现了28.14%的SOTA性能，相比基线提升显著。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在上下文学习任务中表现极差（<24%），现有检索、反思、验证等基线方法提升有限，需深入探究其失败根源。
AI.method: 1. 在CL-Bench上对12种检索、反思、验证基线进行全面实验；2. 分析31,592个评分项，区分内容获取与规范获取；3. 提出PSCI方法，提取局部规范并通过对抗性检查与修复强制执行。
AI.result: 55.4%的评分项评估规范获取，仅22.6%评估内容获取；76.7%的规范未在用户查询中指定，但95.5%可追溯到上下文。PSCI在GPT-5.1上达28.14%（+5.59 pp），在Qwen3.5-27B和Gemini 3 Pro上分别提升+5.28 pp和+6.17 pp。
AI.conclusion: 上下文学习的困难不仅在于内容获取，更在于规范获取；显式提取和强制执行局部规范是提升性能的有效途径。

title: MafiaScope: Non-Invasive, Time-Resolved Belief Probing for LLM Agents in Social Deduction Games
summary: An LLM agent's public behaviour reveals little about its social reasoning: an agent that votes correctly may be guessing, and an agent that lies well leaves no trace of what it actually believes. We present MafiaScope, an open testbed that turns the social deduction game Mafia into a measurement instrument for machine Theory of Mind. After every public utterance, every agent privately answers a configurable set of structured probe questions; the answers never re-enter the game and are scored automatically against the ground truth the engine knows. An interactive visualizer renders the belief trajectories: impersonate mode shows the game as one agent sees it, panels chart timeline-aligned accuracy and calibration, and counterfactual replay forks any recorded step. In a 32-game DeepSeek case study with 13{,}815 parsed probe answers, stated confidence is poorly calibrated, with expected calibration error 0.17, agents over-predict being suspected 1.5 times, and a 30-fork replay experiment walks the counterfactual replay workflow end to end. Engine, viewer and a corpus of 200+ cross-model games are released under an open licence; live demo: https://karpovilia.github.io/mafiascope/; screencast: https://vimeo.com/1208920221.

AI.tldr: MafiaScope 是一个将社交推理游戏“黑手党”转化为心智理论测量工具的开源测试平台。它通过结构化探针问题记录智能体在每轮对话后的真实信念（不注入游戏），配合可视化工具展示信念轨迹、校准度和反事实重放，并在 DeepSeek 的 32 局实验中揭示了智能体社会推理的严重缺陷：置信度校准误差高达 0.17，过度猜测自己被怀疑达 1.5 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 智能体社会推理评估存在根本性问题：仅观察智能体的公开行为（如投票或语言表达）无法区分其是真正理解他人心智还是仅仅碰巧猜对或策略性撒谎，因此需要一种能直接测量智能体内在信念状态的方法。
AI.method: 设计 MafiaScope 测试平台：1）将黑手党游戏作为社会推理场景；2）在每轮公开对话后，智能体私下回答一组结构化探针问题（如“你认为谁是黑手党？”“你觉得谁怀疑你？”），答案不返回游戏；3）引擎基于真实身份自动评分；4）提供交互式可视化器，支持单智能体视角沉浸模式、时间线对齐的准确性和校准曲线、以及反事实分支重放。
AI.result: 基于 DeepSeek 的 32 局实验（含 13,815 条探针回答）显示：智能体置信度校准极差（ECE=0.17），过度预测自己被怀疑达 1.5 倍，并通过 30 次分支重放实验完整演示了反事实工作流。
AI.conclusion: LLM 智能体的公开行为无法反映其真实社会推理能力；MafiaScope 提供了一种可复现的、基于探针的内部信念测量框架，揭示了现有模型在社会认知层面的显著缺陷。项目已开源并附带 200+ 跨模型游戏语料库。

title: LightMem-Ego: Your AI Memory for Everyday Life
summary: Personal AI assistants on mobile and wearable devices continuously perceive users' daily lives through visual and audio streams. However, answering queries about past experiences requires lightweight multimodal memory that can continuously accumulate, organize, and retrieve long-term experiences, which remains challenging. To address this challenge, we present LightMem-Ego, a lightweight streaming multimodal memory system for everyday-life assistance. The system continuously captures egocentric visual and audio streams, aligns them on a shared timeline, and organizes them into a hierarchical memory consisting of current, short-term, and long-term memory. Given a user query, LightMem-Ego dynamically routes retrieval to the appropriate memory level and generates answers grounded in multimodal evidence. The demonstration can be deployed on smartphones and AI glasses, supporting object finding, conversation recall, life summarization, routine discovery, and personalized assistance. Code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem-Ego.

AI.tldr: LightMem-Ego 是一个轻量级流式多模态记忆系统，用于移动和可穿戴设备上的日常辅助，能够持续感知、组织和检索用户的长期体验，支持多种记忆查询任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的个人AI助手在回答关于用户过去经历的问题时，缺乏能够持续积累、组织和检索长期经验的轻量级多模态记忆系统。
AI.method: 系统持续捕捉第一人称视觉和音频流，将其在共享时间线上对齐，并组织成包含当前记忆、短期记忆和长期记忆的分层记忆结构；根据用户查询动态路由到适当的记忆层级，基于多模态证据生成答案。
AI.result: 该系统可部署在智能手机和AI眼镜上，支持物体查找、对话回忆、生活总结、日常发现和个性化辅助等任务。
AI.conclusion: LightMem-Ego 为日常生活中的多模态记忆辅助提供了一种轻量级、流式处理的解决方案，相关代码已开源。

title: Source-Lifted Flow Matching for Intervenable Multimodal Imitation
summary: Flow-matching policies are promising for imitation learning because they model complex multimodal action distributions. However, their stochasticity is largely passive: repeated sampling may yield diverse behaviors, but users cannot directly choose among valid continuations from the same state. We propose Source-Lifted Flow Matching (SL-FM), a source-intervenable flow-matching policy that exposes such a handle while keeping the velocity field shared and latent-free. The handle selects only the source endpoint of the conditional flow, not a mode-specific field, preserving the standard formulation while avoiding decomposition into separate mode-conditioned dynamics. The core mechanism is \textbf{Orthogonal Source Lifting}, designed to prevent path-crossing ambiguity. Instead of partitioning target actions by mode, SL-FM lifts handle-specific sources into auxiliary orthogonal coordinates and keeps targets in the original action subspace. This preserves the demonstrated action distribution while allowing one shared field to carry different branches without merging at crossings. To keep handles usable across states, we learn a state-dependent source mixture end to end and use a responsibility floor, giving each handle weak supervision and mitigating dead modes. Experiments on crossing-flow diagnostics and robot-control benchmarks show that SL-FM converts passive source randomness into an actionable intervention variable. It removes crossing-induced composite trajectories, changes future routes in 91.1\% of matched-prefix interventions, and achieves strong free-deployment performance, with improvements in several benchmark settings. Overall, source geometry provides actionable multimodal control without conditioning the velocity field on the selected mode.

AI.tldr: SL-FM提出了一种源可干预的流匹配策略，通过正交源提升机制将被动随机性转化为可操作的干预变量，在不分割模式条件动力学的情况下实现多模态行为控制。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配策略虽然能建模复杂的多模态动作分布，但其随机性是被动的：重复采样可能产生多样行为，但用户无法直接从同一状态选择有效的连续轨迹。
AI.method: 提出正交源提升（Orthogonal Source Lifting）机制，将特定源的源点提升到辅助正交坐标中，目标保持在原始动作子空间，避免路径交叉歧义；学习状态依赖的源混合分布，并使用责任下限（responsibility floor）为每个源提供弱监督，防止死模式。
AI.result: 在交叉流诊断和机器人控制基准测试中，SL-FM将被动源随机性转化为可操作的干预变量，消除了交叉引起的复合轨迹，在91.1%的匹配前缀干预中改变了未来路径，并在多个基准设置中取得强性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 源几何结构提供了可操作的多模态控制，无需根据所选模式对速度场进行条件化。

title: CVKD-UDA: Cross-View Knowledge Distillation for 3D Unsupervised Domain Adaptive Segmentation
summary: 3D unsupervised domain adaptive (UDA) segmentation mitigates the high cost of manual annotations of the new domain data. Self-training has emerged as the dominant approach in this area, where its success heavily depends on a well-initialized warm-up model to generate reliable pseudo labels. However, existing methods often depend on source supervision or output-level adversarial alignment to obtain the warm-up model, which suffer from limited generalization and training instability due to the large domain gap between domains. Constructing domain-similar representations is an effective way to bridge this gap. In this work, we propose CVKD-UDA, which revisits voxel size as a core design factor to construct domain-similar representations and leverages cross-view complementary cues to balance transferability and discriminability of the warm-up model. First, we generate two complementary views by varying voxel sizes and introduce a cross-view knowledge distillation (CVKD) to enhance generalization and target perception of the model. Second, to balance transferability and discriminability, we design a lightweight Decouple-Adapter and an auxiliary imitation classifier to decouple cross-view knowledge transfer. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate that CVKD-UDA effectively improves the performance of self-training methods and provides a new perspective for 3D UDA segmentation. Our code will be available at GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CVKD-UDA方法，通过重新审视体素大小作为核心设计因素来构建域相似表示，并利用跨视图互补线索平衡迁移性和判别性，以改进3D无监督域自适应分割中的自训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D UDA自训练方法依赖源域监督或输出级对抗对齐来获取热身模型，但由于域间差异大，存在泛化能力有限和训练不稳定的问题。构建域相似表示是弥合这一鸿沟的有效途径。
AI.method: 1) 通过改变体素大小生成两个互补视图；2) 提出跨视图知识蒸馏(CVKD)以增强模型泛化能力和目标域感知；3) 设计轻量级解耦适配器(Decouple-Adapter)和辅助模仿分类器来解耦跨视图知识迁移，平衡迁移性和判别性。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，CVKD-UDA有效提升了自训练方法的性能，为3D UDA分割提供了新视角。
AI.conclusion: CVKD-UDA通过体素大小变化构建域相似表示结合跨视图知识蒸馏，有效解决了3D UDA中热身模型泛化差和训练不稳定的问题，为3D分割领域的域自适应提供了新的研究思路。

title: From Direction to Magnitude: How Multimodal Instruction-Tuning Reorganizes the Geometric Encoding of Identity-Specifying Prompts in Transformer Hidden States
comment: 16 pages, 8 tables. Working draft v0.3. Uses Ollivier-Ricci curvature and edge-wise Wasserstein-1 as primary geometric statistic; four models (Gemma-4-E4B, Gemma-4-E4B-it, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct)
summary: We investigate whether identity-specifying system prompts produce statistically distinguishable geometric fingerprints in the hidden-state trajectories of four open-weight transformer language models spanning four post-training regimes: no training (Gemma-4-E4B base), multimodal RLHF (Gemma-4-E4B-it), RL distillation (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B), and SFT (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct). Three prompt conditions (an identity-specifying axis prompt, a length-matched generic-assistant prompt, and a 26-token vanilla baseline) are compared via five geometric metrics, principally the 1-Wasserstein distance between edge-wise distributions of Ollivier-Ricci curvature on k-NN trajectory graphs. Claims rest on trajectory-level permutation tests with multiple geometric controls (teacher-forced content controls, temporal-chain vs k-NN topology, ABT-projected k-NN, angular vs Euclidean graph construction, B=5000 permutations on borderline statistics). The central finding is a qualitative reorganization of identity encoding across the instruction-tuning boundary: in the base model the fingerprint is direction-coded (separation 0.034, p=0.002 under angular k-NN); in the multimodal instruction-tuned model it migrates into the magnitude (angular separation collapses to p=0.439 while Euclidean survives at p=0.042, and the mean norm of the first generated state inverts its length-ordering, being lowest for the identity prompt). This direction-to-magnitude reorganization is specific to the multimodal instruction-tuning regime, absent under RL distillation and SFT. A teacher-forced control attributes ~30% of the free-running cosine signal to prompt-driven effects. We position W_1 on edge-wise Ollivier-Ricci distributions on k-NN trajectory graphs as a methodological contribution of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了四种后训练范式的开源Transformer模型（基础、多模态RLHF、RL蒸馏、SFT）中，身份指定系统提示是否会在隐状态轨迹中产生统计学上可区分的几何指纹。主要发现是：在基础模型中，身份编码以方向编码形式存在；在多模态指令微调模型中，身份编码迁移至幅度（模长）维度。这种方向到幅度的重组仅出现在多模态指令微调中，而在RL蒸馏和SFT中不存在。本文还将k-NN轨迹图上边级Ollivier-Ricci曲率的1-Wasserstein距离作为一种具有独立价值的方法学贡献提出。
AI.motivation: 探究不同后训练范式（尤其是多模态指令微调）下，语言模型是否会在隐状态轨迹的几何结构中编码身份信息，以及这种编码方式是否随训练范式发生质变。
AI.method: 使用四种开源模型（Gemma-4-E4B base/it、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct），对比三种提示条件（身份指定轴提示、长度匹配的通用助手提示、26 token的vanilla基线），通过5种几何指标（核心为k-NN轨迹图边级Ollivier-Ricci曲率的1-Wasserstein距离）进行分析，采用轨迹级置换检验及多种几何控制实验（teacher-forced内容控制、时序链vs k-NN拓扑、ABT投影k-NN、角度vs欧氏图构建、边界统计量B=5000次置换）。
AI.result: 基础模型中身份指纹为方向编码（角度k-NN下分离度0.034, p=0.002）；多模态指令微调模型中身份指纹迁移至幅度维度（角度k-NN下p=0.439，欧氏k-NN下p=0.042，且首个生成状态的均值模长发生反转，身份提示最低）。这种方向到幅度的重组仅存在于多模态指令微调，RL蒸馏和SFT中未观察到。teacher-forced控制显示约30%的自由运行余弦信号归因于提示驱动效应。
AI.conclusion: 不同后训练范式会质变性地改变模型对身份信息的几何编码方式，多模态指令微调导致了从方向编码到幅度编码的特定重组，且该现象具有范式特异性。

title: Knowledge Distillation for Automated AI Tutor Evaluation
summary: The rapid integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into K-12 and higher education has outpaced the development of reliable methods for evaluating their pedagogical quality. As the research community starts to explore the space of automating evaluation of AI tutors, we introduce FATE (FLC AI Tutor Evaluator), a specialized 8B-parameter language model designed to evaluate AI tutors. Aligned with the four core evaluation tracks from the BEA 2025 Shared Task, our model assesses pedagogical ability across Mistake Identification, Mistake Location, Guidance, and Actionability. Because pedagogical evaluation is a specialized task with limited labeled data, we leverage knowledge distillation from a frontier LLM to generate additional supervision, yielding absolute performance gains up to 22.63 percentage points. Finally, we demonstrate FATE's utility as an automated evaluator by benchmarking instructional responses generated by popular commercial models, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek. On average, we have found that Gemini 2.5 Flash perfomed best (82.88%), then ChatGPT 5.5 Instant (80.75%), followed by DeepSeek V4 Flash (80.13%) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 (74.00%).

AI.tldr: FATE是一个专为评估AI导师教学质量设计的8B参数语言模型，通过知识蒸馏提升性能，并在对主流商业模型的基准测试中发现Gemini 2.5 Flash表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在教育领域快速融入，但缺乏可靠的教学质量评估方法，亟需自动化评估AI导师的工具。
AI.method: 提出FATE（8B参数专用语言模型），利用前沿LLM的知识蒸馏生成额外监督信号，针对BEA 2025共享任务的四个评估轨道（错误识别、错误定位、引导、可操作性）进行评估。
AI.result: 知识蒸馏带来高达22.63个百分点的绝对性能提升；对商业模型基准测试显示：Gemini 2.5 Flash最佳（82.88%），其次为ChatGPT 5.5 Instant（80.75%）、DeepSeek V4 Flash（80.13%）和Claude Sonnet 4.6（74.00%）。
AI.conclusion: FATE可作为有效的自动化AI导师评估器，知识蒸馏策略在小样本专业评估任务中具有显著优势。

title: PaperRouter-Agent: A Content-Grounded LLM Agent for Personalized Hierarchical Paper Routing
summary: Researchers organize the papers they collect into personal folder hierarchies in reference managers, and route each new paper into the folder where it belongs. This task differs from standard hierarchical text classification. A user's folder hierarchy is not a fixed, shared taxonomy but a private and evolving folksonomy whose folder meanings may be topical, shorthand, venue-based, or process-oriented, and are often defined by the papers already stored inside them. We formalize this setting as personalized hierarchical paper routing (PHPR): assigning an incoming paper to folders in a user-specific hierarchy without per-user training. We propose PaperRouter-Agent, a training-free LLM agent that grounds routing decisions in folder members rather than folder names alone. The agent first narrows the candidate hierarchy, retrieves folder-specific evidence, verifies fit by inspecting member papers, and incorporates similarity-gated feedback from past user rejections. A formative study on real personal libraries shows that PaperRouter-Agent raises overall Recall@1 from 0.39 to 0.61 and Recall@3 from 0.57 to 0.83, with the largest gains on organizational folders defined by metadata such as venue or year, where single-shot methods collapses (Recall@1 0.09 to 0.50). On the public LaMP-2 benchmark, the same approach improves accuracy from 44.5% to 51.5% (+9.0 macro-F1) over a single-shot baseline, while remaining low-cost for practical use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PaperRouter-Agent，一个无需训练的LLM代理，通过基于文件夹成员内容而非仅名称进行分层论文路由，在个人论文管理中将Recall@1从0.39提升至0.61，并在公开基准上提升9%宏F1。
AI.motivation: 研究人员在参考管理器中用个人文件夹层次结构组织论文，需要将新论文路由到正确文件夹。这与标准分层文本分类不同，因为用户的文件夹层次是私有的、演化的民间分类法，其含义可能是主题性、速记性、基于会议或面向过程的，通常由已存储在其中的论文定义。现有方法无法处理这种个性化设置。
AI.method: 提出PaperRouter-Agent，一种无训练的LLM代理。核心步骤包括：(1) 缩小候选层次结构；(2) 检索文件夹特定证据；(3) 通过检查成员论文验证匹配度；(4) 引入基于相似性的历史拒绝反馈。该代理基于文件夹成员内容而非仅文件夹名称进行路由决策。
AI.result: 在真实个人库上，Recall@1从0.39提升至0.61，Recall@3从0.57提升至0.83。在按会议或年份等元数据定义的组织文件夹上提升最大（Recall@1从0.09到0.50）。在LaMP-2公开基准上，准确率从44.5%提升至51.5%，宏F1提升9.0%，且保持低成本。
AI.conclusion: PaperRouter-Agent通过利用文件夹成员内容而非仅名称，显著优于单次基线方法，特别是对元数据定义的组织文件夹效果突出，且无需针对每个用户进行训练，具有实际应用价值。

title: Diffusion-Residual Model Predictive Steering Control for Vehicle Stabilization at the Limit of Handling under Model Uncertainty
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology
summary: At the limit of handling, a stabilizing MPC depends on the yaw-rate reference it tracks and the stable-handling envelope it enforces, both operating-point-dependent and unknown a priori, so fixed or worst-case settings are either too conservative or unsafe. We learn this uncertainty with a conditional diffusion residual model and apply it to the controller's reference and constraints rather than its control law. Conditioned on the steering command, the model returns the residual's mean and a predictive spread: the mean re-sizes the tracked yaw reference, while the spread, propagated over the prediction horizon, tightens the stable-handling envelope through a one-sided chance back-off. Together these form the proposed diffusion-residual MPC (D-res), so caution is anticipated ahead of the tracking error rather than corrected after it by a high-gain loop. Because only two moments per command are needed, the generator is tabulated offline and the online controller adds a single table lookup to the baseline MPC, with no in-loop diffusion; it runs within the 100 Hz budget on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier (worst-case 4.08 ms per step). Across a 7-DOF model and high-fidelity CarMaker co-simulation spanning vehicle, tire, road, and maneuver diversity, D-res reduces peak side-slip where the fixed bicycle model is least accurate and restores directional stability on low-friction maneuvers, where the fixed reference over-commands the available grip.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种扩散残差MPC（D-res）方法，通过条件扩散残差模型学习不确定性，在线调整横摆角速度参考和稳定操纵包络，在100 Hz预算内运行，有效降低峰值侧滑并恢复低附路面的方向稳定性。
AI.motivation: 极限操纵状态下，MPC的稳定性依赖于跟踪的横摆角速度参考和强制的稳定操纵包络，这两者都与工作点相关且先验未知，固定或最坏情况设置要么过于保守要么不安全。
AI.method: 使用条件扩散残差模型学习不确定性；以转向指令为条件，输出残差的均值和预测散布；均值重新调整跟踪的横摆参考，散布在预测时域内传播，通过单侧机会约束收紧稳定操纵包络；发生器离线下表化，在线控制器只需一次查表，无在线扩散过程。
AI.result: 在7自由度模型和高保真CarMaker联合仿真中，跨车辆、轮胎、道路和工况多样性验证，D-res在固定自行车模型最不准确的区域降低了峰值侧滑，并在低附着力操纵中恢复了方向稳定性；在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上最坏情况每步4.08 ms，满足100 Hz预算。
AI.conclusion: D-res通过预测性调整参考和约束而非事后高增益修正，提前预判并应对跟踪误差，实现了安全性与保守性的更好平衡。

title: EMBRACE: A Multi-task Framework for Comprehensive Quality Assessment in Cleavage-stage Embryo
summary: Cleavage-stage embryo assessment in in vitro fertilization requires the integrated interpretation of cytoplasmic fragmentation, developmental stage, and blastomere symmetry. However, conventional visual assessment is affected by observer variability, particularly when fragmented regions are small, irregular, or low contrast. This study presents EMBRACE, a multi-task deep learning framework for jointly performing cytoplasmic-fragmentation segmentation, t2/t4 developmental-stage classification, and blastomere-symmetry grading from static cleavage-stage embryo microscopy images. EMBRACE combines a shared ResNet-50 backbone, a concatenation-based multi-scale feature-fusion (C-MSFF) module, a U-Net-style segmentation decoder, and two task-specific classification heads. After predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, 9,137 annotated embryo images were divided into 7,309 training, 914 validation, and 914 held-out test images. On the held-out test set, EMBRACE achieved a Dice coefficient of 0.781 and an intersection over union of 0.677 for fragmentation segmentation. Developmental-stage classification achieved an accuracy of 0.995, macro-F1 of 0.994, and AUC of 1.000. Blastomere-symmetry grading achieved a balanced accuracy of 0.901, macro-F1 of 0.907, and quadratic weighted kappa of 0.859. These findings support the feasibility of combining spatially inspectable fragmentation localization with embryo-level morphology assessment in a single framework. External and prospective validation is required before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMBRACE，一个多任务深度学习框架，用于联合执行胚胎细胞质碎片分割、发育阶段分类和卵裂球对称性分级，在9,137张胚胎图像上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统胚胎视觉评估存在观察者变异性，特别是当碎片区域小、不规则或对比度低时，亟需一个整合多种形态学评估任务的自动化框架。
AI.method: EMBRACE采用共享ResNet-50骨干网络、基于拼接的多尺度特征融合模块(C-MSFF)、U-Net风格分割解码器以及两个任务特定分类头，同时完成碎片分割、阶段分类和对称性分级三个任务。
AI.result: 在测试集上，碎片分割Dice系数0.781、IoU 0.677；阶段分类准确率0.995、宏F1 0.994、AUC 1.000；对称性分级平衡准确率0.901、宏F1 0.907、二次加权kappa 0.859。
AI.conclusion: EMBRACE在单一框架中结合了空间可检查的碎片定位与胚胎级形态学评估，具有可行性；临床部署前仍需外部和前瞻性验证。

title: Nonlinear Axiomatic Attribution for Cooperative Games
summary: The Shapley value is a widely used concept in attribution problems, as it uniquely satisfies the axioms of linearity, consistency, equal treatment, and efficiency. Often, the inclusion AUC metric is used to evaluate the quality of player rankings, in order to identify positively participating players. However, it can be established that the Shapley value is not always reliable for this purpose. The core issue lies in its linearity: the Shapley value acts as a linear operator with an excessively large null space, which is likely to contain non-negligible perturbations that remain indistinguishable to the operator. To address this limitation, we explore the design of nonlinear axiomatic attribution methods. Inspired by the least core, which is a popular nonlinear substitute for the Shapley value, we introduce a class of nonlinear attribution methods that retain the remaining necessary axioms. Each method yields a contribution vector that is the unique optimal solution to a minimization problem, which aims to approximate utility functions as faithfully as possible. In terms of the inclusion AUC metric, our experiments demonstrate the potential effectiveness of these methods compared to Shapley value variants that relax only the efficiency axiom. Our code is available at https://github.com/watml/nonlinear-axiom.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有Shapley值因线性性质导致零空间过大，在排序任务中不可靠，并提出一类保留必要公理的非线性归因方法，通过最小化问题逼近效用函数，实验表明其在包含AUC指标上优于仅放松效率公理的Shapley值变体。
AI.motivation: Shapley值虽然在归因问题中被广泛使用，但其线性性质导致零空间过大，非平凡扰动可能无法被区分，从而在基于包含AUC指标评估玩家排序时不可靠。因此需要探索非线性归因方法来解决这一局限性。
AI.method: 受最小核（least core）启发，提出一类非线性公理归因方法，保留除线性外的其余必要公理。每个方法通过求解一个最小化问题来逼近效用函数，得到唯一的贡献向量作为最优解。
AI.result: 在包含AUC指标上，所提非线性方法相比仅放松效率公理的Shapley值变体展现出潜在的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 非线性归因方法能够克服Shapley值线性导致的零空间问题，在排序任务中更具可靠性，为公理归因方法的设计提供了新思路。

title: TopoExplore: Topological Discrimination for Archive-Based Exploration
summary: Archive-based exploration methods such as Go-Explore select which visited state to return to using visitation rarity, and frontier methods return to the boundary of the unknown; neither asks whether the unexplored region behind a boundary is enterable at all. Exploration is not just about finding reward - it is about collecting a structurally complete experience for downstream learning and planning. We introduce TopoExplore, which augments Go-Explore cell selection with a periodic topological pass: enclosed unexplored regions (voids) of the visited-set occupancy grid are detected by flood fill (the H1 classes of its cubical complex), and a decaying selection bonus is placed only on their strict entrances (gap or door cells), so sealed regions are never targeted and entered regions retire. On a controlled 18-environment MiniGrid suite (15 seeds, frozen hyperparameters) TopoExplore attains a 1.52x geometric-mean speedup in median steps-to-first-entry over its exact Go-Explore ablation, versus 1.37x for a frontier baseline; frontier exploration degrades when sealed decoy structure appears (0.83-1.48x on decoy environments vs. 1.65-2.11x for TopoExplore), while TopoExplore holds its largest win on hard multi-interaction doors (10.9x). We report an honest negative on Montezuma's Revenge - without wall knowledge, unreachable occupancy artifacts capture the bonus and performance degrades as it grows, isolating the wall-aware entrance test as the load-bearing component - and a preliminary positive on HM3D scanned buildings, where the speedup over Go-Explore tracks scene difficulty (r=0.69) even as frontier selection dominates blanket coverage. The evidence supports a deliberately scoped claim: topology-aware selection pays off where enclosed structure must be discriminated, and remains competitive at open coverage, where frontier methods are strongest, despite not being tuned for that regime.

AI.tldr: TopoExplore通过拓扑感知的入口检测机制改进Go-Explore方法，只在封闭未探索区域（空洞）的严格入口（间隙/门单元）施加衰减探索奖励，避免针对密封区域或已进入区域，在MiniGrid套件中实现1.52x加速，在困难多交互门场景达10.9x加速，但在Montezuma's Revenge中因墙壁感知缺失出现性能退化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于存档的探索方法（如Go-Explore）根据访问稀有度选择返回状态，前沿方法则返回未知边界；但这些方法没有询问边界后的未探索区域是否可进入。探索不仅是寻找奖励，更是为下游学习和规划收集结构完整的经验。因此需要一种能区分可进入与不可进入未探索区域的拓扑感知探索方法。
AI.method: TopoExplore对Go-Explore的细胞选择进行周期性拓扑增强：通过泛洪填充检测已访问集占据网格中的封闭未探索区域（空洞，即立方复形的H1类），仅在它们的严格入口（间隙或门单元）施加衰减选择奖励，使得密封区域永远不会被目标化，已进入区域自动退役。
AI.result: 在18个环境的MiniGrid套件（15个种子，固定超参数）上，TopoExplore相比Go-Explore消融实现了1.52x几何中位数加速（首次进入步数），而前沿基线为1.37x；在存在密封诱饵结构的环境中，前沿探索退化（0.83-1.48x），而TopoExplore保持1.65-2.11x；在困难多交互门场景达到10.9x加速。Montezuma's Revenge中因缺乏墙壁知识出现负面结果，HM3D扫描建筑中加速比与场景难度相关（r=0.69）。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑感知选择在需要区分封闭结构的环境中有显著优势，并且在开放覆盖场景（前沿方法最强）中仍保持竞争力，尽管未针对该场景调优。负载核心组件是墙壁感知的入口测试。

title: Unlocking Parallelism in Autoregressive Language Models via Speculative Decoding with Progressive Tree Drafting
summary: Speculative decoding has significantly accelerated Large Language Model (LLM) inference by alleviating memory-bound bottlenecks. However, traditional speculative decoding typically relies on auxiliary draft modules, incurring significant training and communication overhead. Although recent methods attempt to generate drafts within the target model itself, they often fail to fully exploit its latent parallel capacity due to a lack of structural coordination. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Progressive Tree Drafting (PTD)}, which employs a structured, guided parallel drafting strategy to harness the model's parallel potential. By coupling a progressive tree structure with a stepwise pruning mechanism, PTD actively guides the LLM to explore multiple semantic paths in a single forward pass, ensuring both draft diversity and coherence. Experiments demonstrate that PTD achieves up to $2\times$ decoding speedup across various benchmarks while remaining training-free and model-agnostic. Our code is available at: https://github.com/MINE-USTC/PTD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出渐进式树草稿（PTD）方法，通过结构化引导的并行草稿策略和逐步剪枝机制，在单个前向传播中探索多条语义路径，实现无训练、模型无关的LLM推理加速，最高可达2倍解码加速。
AI.motivation: 传统推测解码依赖辅助草稿模块导致训练和通信开销大，现有方法缺乏结构协调，未能充分利用目标模型自身的并行潜力。
AI.method: 采用渐进式树结构与逐步剪枝机制耦合，在单次前向传播中引导LLM探索多条语义路径，保证草稿多样性与连贯性。
AI.result: 在多种基准测试中实现最高2倍解码加速，且无需训练、模型无关。
AI.conclusion: PTD通过结构化并行草稿策略有效提升了LLM推理速度，是一种高效且通用的加速方法。

title: ERR@HRI 3.0 Challenge: Multimodal Detection of Errors and Anticipation in Human-Robot Interactions
summary: As robots become increasingly integrated into human environments, their ability to detect and respond to errors remains critical for maintaining user trust and interaction quality. While recent advances in machine learning have improved error detection capabilities, most approaches are limited to specific contexts, controlled settings, or pre-extracted features, limiting their generalizability and applicability to real-world conditions. To address this challenge, the third edition of the ERR@HRI Challenge (ERR@HRI 3.0) provided researchers with two complementary datasets that enable end-to-end innovation in methods for both detecting and preventing errors in human-robot interaction. The challenge offered raw, non-anonymized video data from naturalistic settings: (1) the Bystander Affect Detection (BAD) dataset, containing webcam recordings of 45 participants' spontaneous reactions to robot and human failure scenarios; and (2) the Bad Idea dataset, featuring 29 participants' anticipatory facial responses while predicting action outcomes before failures occur. Both datasets were collected via crowdsourcing, capturing the inherent variability of real-world conditions. This naturalistic variability, while challenging, provides an authentic testbed for developing robust error detection systems. Participants developed multimodal machine learning models for bystander reaction detection (Track 1) and anticipatory outcome prediction (Track 2), with an optional cross-dataset generalization track (Track 3). Three teams submitted valid models, all of which surpassed our convolutional neural network baselines. This paper describes the datasets, tasks, baselines, and results of ERR@HRI 3.0, and discusses implications for building generalizable, context-aware, and anticipatory error detection systems for human-robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ERR@HRI 3.0挑战赛，该赛事提供两个自然情境下的视频数据集（BAD和Bad Idea），旨在推动人机交互中端到端的错误检测与预防方法创新。参赛团队开发了多模态机器学习模型，在旁观者反应检测和预期结果预测两个任务上均超越了CNN基线，展示了向泛化性、情境感知和预期性错误检测系统迈进的潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有错误检测方法多局限于特定语境、受控环境或依赖预提取特征，泛化性和实际适用性不足。为突破这一局限，ERR@HRI 3.0挑战赛提供来自自然情境的原始视频数据，促使研究者开发更通用、鲁棒的错误检测与预防方法。
AI.method: 挑战赛提供两个互补数据集：(1) BAD数据集，包含45名参与者在面对机器人和人类失败场景时的自发反应网络摄像头录像；(2) Bad Idea数据集，包含29名参与者在行动结果发生前预测结果时的预期性面部反应。两者均通过众包收集。设置三个赛道：旁观者反应检测（Track 1）、预期结果预测（Track 2）和跨数据集泛化（Track 3）。参赛者开发多模态机器学习模型。
AI.result: 三个团队提交了有效的模型，所有模型均超越了卷积神经网络（CNN）基线。
AI.conclusion: 自然情境数据的变异性虽带来挑战，但为开发鲁棒的错误检测系统提供了真实测试环境。结果展示了构建通用、情境感知且具备预期能力的HRI错误检测系统的可行性和未来方向。

title: PIER-Flow: Physics-Informed Efficient Rectified Flow for Real-Time Mobile Robot Navigation
summary: Autonomous navigation in dense and highly dynamic environments requires both physically feasible control and low-latency replanning. Optimization-based methods such as Model Predictive Control (MPC) explicitly handle robot kinematics and safety constraints, but repeated nonlinear optimization can limit real-time responsiveness. Deterministic behavior-cloning policies enable efficient inference but may fail to represent multimodal avoidance behaviors, whereas diffusion policies capture multimodality at the cost of time-consuming iterative denoising. We propose PIER-Flow (Physics-Informed Efficient Rectified Flow), a lightweight navigation policy for mobile robots. By distilling an MPC expert into a continuous-time Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), PIER-Flow achieves single-step action generation through parallel latent sampling and lightweight feasibility selection. We introduce a physics-informed training objective to enforce kinematic consistency, paired with an asynchronous action chunking architecture for robust sim-to-real deployment. Extensive simulations demonstrate that PIER-Flow achieves a 98.85\% success rate and zero collisions, with an average inference of $\sim$1.29 ms, which accelerates planning by 37.2$\times$ compared to MPC and over 800$\times$ against standard diffusion models. Crucially, real-world deployment on a resource-constrained edge computer further achieves an approximately stable inference latency of $\sim$5.3 ms, avoiding the latency spikes and freezing events observed with planning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIER-Flow，一种基于物理信息修正流（Rectified Flow）的轻量级移动机器人导航策略。通过将MPC专家蒸馏为连续时间ODE，结合并行潜变量采样、物理信息训练目标和异步动作块架构，在动态密集环境中实现了单步动作生成，仿真成功率达98.85%、零碰撞，推理速度比MPC快37.2倍、比扩散模型快800倍以上，在边缘设备上实现了约5.3ms的稳定推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有优化方法（如MPC）虽能显式处理运动学和安全性约束，但重复的非线性优化限制了实时性；确定性行为克隆策略推理高效但无法表示多模态避障行为；扩散策略虽能捕捉多模态但迭代去噪耗时。亟需一种兼具物理可行性、实时性和多模态表达能力的轻量级导航策略。
AI.method: 1) 将MPC专家蒸馏为连续时间ODE（Rectified Flow），实现单步动作生成；2) 采用并行潜变量采样与轻量级可行性选择机制；3) 引入物理信息训练目标（physics-informed loss）确保运动学一致性；4) 设计异步动作块架构（asynchronous action chunking）增强仿真到现实部署的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 仿真环境中成功率达98.85%、零碰撞；平均推理延迟约1.29ms，比MPC快37.2倍，比标准扩散模型快800倍以上。真实环境边缘设备部署中实现约5.3ms稳定推理延迟，避免了基线方法的延迟尖峰和冻结事件。
AI.conclusion: PIER-Flow通过将MPC先验蒸馏为连续ODE流，在保持物理约束的同时显著提升了推理速度和多模态表示能力，为资源受限平台上实时密集动态导航提供了可行的解决方案。

title: LFD: Enabling Real-World Lensless Face Recognition with a Large-Scale Dataset
summary: Face recognition is a ubiquitously used computer vision task that has a wide range of applications ranging from everyday smartphone biometrics to high-stakes security systems. Most face recognition systems rely on traditional cameras, which often suffer from limitations such as bulky form factors, high costs, and limited privacy protection. To address these limitations, lensless cameras have emerged as an alternative. Lensless cameras use thin optical encoders, enabling smaller size, lower cost, and greater design flexibility. These cameras are typically paired with reconstruction algorithms that convert raw captures into recognizable images. However, reconstructed images often contain artifacts, and the reconstruction methods struggle to generalize well to real-world conditions. Furthermore, existing face datasets do not account for the artifacts present in lensless images. To address this issue, we introduce the Lensless Face Dataset (LFD). LFD comprises 21,080 lensless raw measurements, reconstructions, and standard images of faces captured under diverse lighting, angle, and distance. Our key contributions are: (1) Real-world lensless face data: LFD focuses on capturing a diverse face dataset with varying levels of artifacts introduced under different environments; (2) In-the-wild captures: 4,976 images are captured in outdoor settings with varying intensities of natural light and different background patterns; (3) Multiple lensless devices: LFD includes face images collected from three different types of lensless cameras, each with a unique optical encoder. We use this hardware diversity to demonstrate generalization across different lensless cameras. Through comprehensive evaluations and analysis, we show that LFD effectively captures shared features and artifacts across different lensless imaging devices, making it a valuable dataset for advancing lensless face recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了透镜less人脸数据集（LFD），包含21,080张真实世界透镜less相机的原始测量、重建图像和标准人脸图像，涵盖多种光照、角度和距离条件，并包含来自三种不同透镜less相机的数据以及户外环境下的4,976张图像，旨在推动透镜less人脸识别研究。
AI.motivation: 传统人脸识别系统依赖传统相机，存在体积大、成本高、隐私保护有限等问题。透镜less相机虽可克服这些局限，但其重建图像存在伪影且难以泛化到真实场景，同时现有数据集未考虑透镜less图像的伪影特征，因此需要专门的数据集来推动相关研究。
AI.method: 通过三种不同光学编码器的透镜less相机在多种环境（不同光照、角度、距离及户外场景）下采集21,080张人脸数据，包含原始测量值、重建图像和标准图像，构建LFD数据集。
AI.result: LFD有效捕捉了不同透镜less成像设备间的共享特征和伪影，展示了跨透镜less相机的泛化能力，为透镜less人脸识别研究提供了有价值的基准。
AI.conclusion: LFD数据集通过真实世界数据、多设备多样性和户外场景覆盖，弥补了现有数据集在透镜less人脸识别领域的空白，有助于推动该领域的发展。

title: Serving the Long Tail: Training-Free LLM Candidate Generation for Vacation Rental Marketplaces
comment: Accepted at TSMO 2026 workshop, co-located with KDD 2026; 9 pages
summary: Vacation rental marketplaces face a structural imbalance on the supply side: a small fraction of properties receive most user interactions, while the long tail of new, niche, and seasonal listings generates too little behavioral signal for collaborative filtering to serve effectively. At Vrbo, item-based k-nearest neighbors (IBKNN) is a core candidate generation channel, but leaves tens of thousands of properties with no candidates and produces weak neighborhoods for sparsely interacted ones. We present a training-free, LLM-based candidate generation pipeline that complements IBKNN using static property metadata alone. An off-the-shelf LLM synthesizes diverse semantic queries per property, a pre-trained text encoder embeds them, and an approximate nearest-neighbor index retrieves candidates from an 11.7M-property catalog. A Union fusion strategy merges these with IBKNN while preserving the behavioral channel's ordering, guaranteeing no degradation on well-served properties, and a downstream learning-to-rank model re-scores the fused pool. Evaluated on 1.6M focal properties, the system extends candidate coverage to tens of thousands of properties IBKNN cannot reach, delivers its largest gains on the long-tail segment where behavioral methods are weakest, and matches or beats IBKNN at every K on shared properties. A downstream learning-to-rank stage further lifts the fused pool, yielding a complete candidate generation and re-ranking stack that serves the long tail without regressing well-served properties. We additionally show that Union fusion collapses the recall gap between a 3B open-weights LLM and frontier API-based models from 27-46% to under 1%, supporting self-hosted small-model deployment at marketplace catalog scale.

AI.tldr: Vrbo提出了一种基于LLM的无训练候选生成管道，利用静态属性元数据为长尾房源生成语义查询和候选，与IBKNN融合后覆盖了数万原本无法被协同过滤触及的房源，并在长尾段取得最大收益。
AI.motivation: 度假租赁市场存在供给侧结构性失衡：少数房源占据大部分用户交互，而大量新上架、小众和季节性房源缺乏行为信号，导致基于协同过滤的IBKNN无法为其生成有效候选或邻居。
AI.method: 1) 使用现成LLM为每个房源合成多样化的语义查询；2) 用预训练文本编码器将查询嵌入；3) 通过近似最近邻索引从1170万房源目录中检索候选；4) 采用Union融合策略将LLM候选与IBKNN合并，保留IBKNN的顺序保证不退化；5) 下游LTR模型对融合池重新排序。
AI.result: 在160万焦点房源上评估，系统覆盖了IBKNN无法触及的数万房源；在长尾段收益最大；在共享房源上每个K值匹配或超越IBKNN；Union融合将3B开源模型与前沿API模型的召回差距从27-46%缩小到1%以下。
AI.conclusion: 该方法构建了完整的候选生成与重排序栈，在不退化已服务好的房源的前提下有效服务长尾，并支持自托管小模型在目录规模上的部署。

title: Who&When Pro: Can LLMs Really Attribute Failures in AI Agents?
summary: Automated failure attribution uses LLMs to identify where and why agentic systems fail. As agents become more capable, their failures become subtler, making automated attribution increasingly important. We introduce Who&When Pro, a large-scale benchmark for automated failure attribution in agentic systems. Using a strictly controlled pipeline that injects a failure only after exactly replaying a successful prefix, we construct 12,326 failed trajectories with golden labels across 3 modalities and 26 benchmarks covering various scenarios. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct extensive experiments and analyses, revealing systematic patterns in how models attribute failures across modalities, protocols, and model families, and providing empirical guidance for future automated failure attribution systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Who&When Pro，一个大规模自动化故障归因基准测试，包含12,326条带标注的失败轨迹，覆盖3种模态和26个基准，并揭示了不同模型在故障归因中的系统性模式。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体系统能力增强，其失败模式变得更加隐蔽，人工调试成本高且难以扩展，因此需要自动化的故障归因方法。然而缺乏大规模、高质量的标准基准来评估和推动该领域发展。
AI.method: 通过严格控制的数据生成管线：先精确回放成功前缀，再注入特定故障，构建了12,326条带黄金标签的失败轨迹；涵盖3种模态（文本、代码、多模态）和26个基准；使用多种LLM进行系统化的归因实验分析。
AI.result: 构建了大规模自动化故障归因基准Who&When Pro；通过广泛实验揭示了不同模态、协议和模型家族在故障归因中的系统性表现差异模式。
AI.conclusion: 该基准和实验分析为未来自动化故障归因系统提供了实证指导，有助于推动智能体系统可靠性的提升。

title: A Corpus of Persuasion Techniques in Slavic Languages
comment: Corpus used for SlavicNLP 2025 Workshop co-located with ACL 2025, Published at LREC 2026
summary: Persuasion techniques are powerful rhetorical devices used to sway public opinion in a wide range of media. We present a new corpus of persuasion techniques, focusing on Slavic languages. The corpus contains documents in Bulgarian, Polish, and Russian, annotated with persuasion techniques at the coarse-grained text-span level and fine-grained sentence level. The techniques are drawn from a taxonomy of 25 fine-grained persuasion techniques, grouped under six broad categories of rhetorical persuasion strategies. The corpus contains approximately 7500 text spans from 222 documents that cover topics hotly debated at the national and international levels. We describe the corpus creation process, provide detailed statistics, and examine correlations between topics and persuasion techniques. We use classic ML-based and generative AI-based models to provide baselines and benchmark results for the detection and classification of persuasion techniques at the text-span level and sentence level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对斯拉夫语言（保加利亚语、波兰语、俄语）的说服技巧语料库，包含约7500个文本跨度，覆盖222篇文档，标注了25种细粒度说服技巧（分为6大类），并提供了基于传统机器学习和生成式AI的基准检测结果。
AI.motivation: 现有说服技巧研究多聚焦于英语，缺乏针对斯拉夫语言的高质量标注语料库，难以支持多语言环境下的说服检测研究。
AI.method: 构建了包含保加利亚语、波兰语、俄语三种斯拉夫语言的说服技巧语料库，在粗粒度文本跨度级别和细粒度句子级别进行标注，采用25种说服技巧（6大类）的分类体系，并使用经典机器学习模型和生成式AI模型建立基线基准。
AI.result: 构建了约7500个文本跨度、222篇文档的语料库，覆盖国内外热议话题；提供了语料库统计数据和话题-说服技巧相关性分析；给出了ML和生成式AI模型在文本跨度级别和句子级别上的基准检测结果。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库填补了斯拉夫语言说服技巧研究的空白，为多语言说服检测任务提供了基准资源和评估标准。

title: Requirement-Driven Design of Whole-Body Social Tactile Sensing via Virtual Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Tactile sensing for social-physical human-robot interaction (spHRI) is designed in a hardware-driven manner, where predefined sensor configurations constrain coverage, spatial resolution, and the range of recognizable gestures. We propose a requirement-driven framework that derives sensing requirements, specifically spatial resolution and placement, directly from interaction data. Using a VR-based platform with haptic feedback, we collected high-resolution whole-body contact distributions across multiple social scenarios, from which we identified nine recurring social touch gestures. Eight gestures were selected for controlled data collection with 18 participants, yielding an open-source dataset of 5,520 trials. Analysis of contact distributions and simulated tactile encodings provides quantitative baselines for skin coverage and sensor density on a humanoid robot platform. While demonstrated on a single robot platform, the methodology is designed to be transferable to other robot morphologies, potentially enabling morphology-specific sensing requirements to be derived prior to hardware fabrication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种需求驱动的触觉感知框架，通过VR平台收集多人社交互动中的全身接触分布数据，识别出9种社交触摸手势，并基于18名参与者的5,520次试验构建了开源数据集，为仿人机器人平台的皮肤覆盖率和传感器密度提供定量基线，且方法可迁移至其他机器人形态。
AI.motivation: 现有社交物理人机交互（spHRI）的触觉感知采用硬件驱动方式，预定义的传感器配置限制了覆盖范围、空间分辨率和可识别手势的种类，缺乏从交互数据出发的自底向上设计方法。
