AI.method: 构建包含120个问题的双语基准，涵盖直接引用检索、错误前提验证和故意不可回答的"陷阱"问题（包括已废除条款和实施条例中的截止日期），对所有答案进行全自动评分。评估了三个免费模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-OSS-120B、Nemotron-3-Super-120B）。
AI.result: 严重管辖区域差距：GDPR上引用准确率94-100%，沙特PDPL上捏造率60-77%；67%的最高捏造率来自法规与条例混淆；91%的捏造引用置信度≥0.8；捏造行为取决于法律管辖区域而非查询语言。
AI.conclusion: 模型自信度无法作为防护措施，必须采用逐字验证的保障机制而非依赖模型自我置信度，才能将LLM用于合规筛查。

title: SensorPerch: Sense Wherever and Whenever it Matters
summary: Existing robotic perception is constrained by sensors that are either robot-mounted or permanently fixed in the environment, locking perception to a limited set of viewpoints. Yet as robots perform increasingly diverse tasks, the most informative viewpoint shifts from one task to the next-often somewhere onboard sensor and static infrastructure can not readily satisfy. To address this gap, we propose SensorPerch, a novel realization of active perception that decouples sensing from both the robot embodiment and the environment by treating sensors as independent physical entities that the robot can autonomously detach and re-attach within the environment. SensorPerch presents one realization of this paradigm: a lightweight, wireless, reconfigurable sensor platform that can perch on diverse surfaces, paired with a viewpoint-selection framework that determines task-optimal sensor placements. Together, these enable robots to construct task-relevant viewpoints on demand, independent of the robot's current position and available fixed infrastructure. We demonstrate the paradigm on two task classes: (i) object-coupled perception, where SensorPerch enables persistent object-state detection beyond the robot's current position, achieving successful event detection even when the robot is not nearby; and (ii) policy-coupled perception, where SensorPerch allows robots to construct diverse, policy-specific viewpoints for various policies, achieving success rates comparable to those obtained using oracle viewpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SensorPerch，一种将传感器从机器人和固定基础设施中解耦的主动感知系统。通过可自主部署的轻量级无线传感器平台，机器人能够按需构建任务最优视角，在物体耦合感知（实现持续性物体状态检测）和策略耦合感知（构建策略特定视角）两类任务中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人感知受限于机器人搭载或环境固定的传感器，视角受限且无法灵活适应多样化任务的最优视点需求。
AI.method: 提出SensorPerch范式：1) 轻量级、无线、可重构的传感器平台，可停靠于多种表面；2) 视角选择框架，确定任务最优的传感器放置位置。机器人可自主将传感器解耦部署到环境中。
AI.result: 在物体耦合感知任务中，SensorPerch实现了机器人不在附近时的持续性事件检测；在策略耦合感知任务中，策略特定视角的成功率与使用Oracle视角相当。
AI.conclusion: SensorPerch通过将传感器作为独立物理实体，实现了任务相关的视角按需构建，突破了传统机器人感知的视角局限。

title: ChartSync: A Benchmark for Visuo-Logical Cascading Chart Editing
summary: Generative image editing models struggle with structured statistical charts when data modifications require geometric synchronization. We formalize this task as Visuo-Logical Cascading Editing (VLCE). However, existing methods remain confined to localized text substitutions and struggle with dependency-aware cascading updates. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce ChartSync, an expert-validated benchmark constructed via a programmatic rendering pipeline that guarantees deterministic visuo-logical coupling for the ground truth. ChartSync comprises 870 triplets across 9 chart categories and 4 task types, including 235 geometry-coupled VLCE instances that specifically test cascading text-to-geometry synchronization. We further evaluate these instances via a two-tier framework combining objective visual metrics with a vision-language model judge paradigm to assess low-level fidelity alongside multimodal comprehension and reasoning. Evaluating 14 image editing models and one code-mediated pipeline reveals a nuanced capability gap: most open-source models suffer severe drops in geometric synchronization, while only two frontier proprietary models show emerging VLCE capability, with their residual errors mainly involving semantic isolation and background corruption. Our detailed error analysis deconstructs these failure paradigms to identify core meta-abilities for guiding future multimodal architectures. The ChartSync dataset and code are publicly released at https://github.com/kaka-yjk/ChartSyncCodebase.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ChartSync基准数据集和Visuo-Logical Cascading Editing (VLCE)任务，用于评估图像编辑模型在结构化统计图表中进行级联数据修改时的几何同步能力。实验发现大多数开源模型存在严重几何同步缺陷，仅两个前沿专有模型展现出初步的VLCE能力，但仍存在语义隔离和背景损坏问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式图像编辑模型在处理结构化统计图表时，数据修改需要几何同步，但现有方法局限于局部文本替换，无法处理依赖感知的级联更新，因此需要系统评估该能力。
AI.method: 通过程序化渲染管线构建专家验证的ChartSync基准数据集（870个三元组，9类图表，4种任务类型，含235个几何耦合的VLCE实例），并采用两层级评估框架：客观视觉指标+视觉语言模型评判范式，评估低层保真度和多模态理解推理能力。
AI.result: 评估14个图像编辑模型和1个代码中介管线，发现大多数开源模型几何同步严重下降，仅两个前沿专有模型展现出新兴VLCE能力，但其残余错误主要涉及语义隔离和背景损坏。
AI.conclusion: 通过详细错误分析解构失败范式，识别出核心元能力以指导未来多模态架构设计。ChartSync数据集和代码已公开发布。

title: GAE: Graph-Augmented Evolution for Scientific Discovery via Reinforcement Optimization
summary: Evolutionary program search guided by Large Language Models (LLMs) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for automated scientific discovery. However, current approaches are fundamentally constrained by three bottlenecks: structurally blind parent selection, sparse whole-program evaluation rewards, and static mutation operators that fail to adapt during search. We present GAE (Graph-Augmented Evolution), a framework that resolves these limitations through a tightly coupled, three-pillar architecture. First, a relational graph neural network (GNN) parses programs into typed computation graphs, producing structure-aware embeddings. Second, an RL-optimized meta-controller leverages these embeddings to replace blind evolutionary sampling with a directed policy, dynamically selecting optimal parents and mutation directions based on reward history. Third, an online GRPO fine-tuning loop continuously updates the LLM mutation operator at test-time using group-normalized evaluation rewards, directly aligning the model's generation distribution with high-fitness structural edits. We evaluate GAE on a challenging scientific discovery task: symbolic regression for complex nonlinear oscillator systems. By transforming stochastic search into a directed, self-improving trajectory, GAE efficiently discovers closed-form physical equations, consistently matching or outperforming static LLM-driven baselines and achieving state-of-the-art out-of-distribution performance.

AI.tldr: GAE是一个将图神经网络、强化学习元控制器和在线GRPO微调循环三者紧密结合的进化程序搜索框架，通过结构感知的定向策略取代盲目的进化采样，在符号回归任务中高效发现闭式物理方程，达到SOTA级别的分布外泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的进化程序搜索受限于三个瓶颈：结构盲的父代选择、稀疏的全程序评估奖励、以及无法在搜索过程中自适应的静态变异算子，亟需一个能够克服这些限制的统一框架。
AI.method: GAE包含三个核心支柱：(1) 关系图神经网络将程序解析为类型化计算图以生成结构感知嵌入；(2) RL优化的元控制器利用这些嵌入，用定向策略替代盲目的进化采样，基于奖励历史动态选择最优父代和变异方向；(3) 在线GRPO微调循环在测试时利用组归一化评估奖励持续更新LLM变异算子，使模型生成分布与高适应度结构编辑对齐。
AI.result: 在复杂非线性振荡器系统的符号回归任务上，GAE将随机搜索转化为定向的自我改进轨迹，一致匹配或超越静态LLM驱动的基线方法，实现了分布外性能的SOTA水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过图增强、强化学习元控制和在线自适应的三支柱紧密耦合架构，GAE有效解决了传统进化程序搜索的结构盲目、奖励稀疏和算子静态三大瓶颈，为自动化科学发现提供了更高效的范式。

title: Measure the Sim-to-Real Gap: Designing an Affordable Real-World Benchmark Platform for Reinforcement Learning in AIoT Systems
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly employed to enhance the performance of autonomous systems, including the Autonomous Internet of Things (AIoT). However, the trial-and-error nature of RL, when conducted in real-world environments, is costly and hazardous in some scenarios. Consequently, the majority of RL research is conducted in simulation. This reliance introduces challenges related to the Sim-to-Real transferability. Evaluating the Sim-to-Real algorithmic robustness and the Sim-to-Real gap is a critical prerequisite for research aimed at improving RL performance in the real world. Therefore, industries such as robotics have developed concurrent simulation and physical platforms to facilitate this research. However, a universal Sim-to-Real benchmark platform for AIoT does not currently exist. To address these concerns, we developed a real-world AIoT platform for studying RL in AIoT. On this platform, an agent deployed on an edge device plays video games on a separate host computer via a hardware-emulated keyboard, guided by vision input. This platform uses commercially available components costing less than USD 400, together with two computers. Because the system's objective is game score maximization, it inherently mitigates safety risks associated with real-world RL deployments. Experimental results show the simulation-trained agent suffers a 1160% performance degradation relative to the human-level performance after real-world deployment, indicating a significant Sim-to-Real gap. Direct real-world training using the deep Q-network (DQN) algorithm achieves approximately 38% of human-level performance after 10 million training steps, demonstrating the feasibility of RL under real-world conditions. These results suggest that the proposed Sim-to-Real benchmark platform provides a substantial foundation for qualitative and quantitative evaluations of RL in real-world AIoT systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向AIoT的Sim-to-Real基准测试平台，使用低成本商用组件（<400美元）构建，通过硬件模拟键盘在边缘设备上玩视频游戏。实验表明：仿真训练的代理在真实部署后性能下降1160%（相对于人类水平），而真实环境下使用DQN训练10M步可达人类水平的38%，验证了该平台对强化学习在真实AIoT系统中Sim-to-Real迁移的定性与定量评估能力。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在真实环境中的试错成本高、风险大，导致多数研究在仿真中进行，但存在Sim-to-Real迁移问题。现有机器人领域已有同步仿真与物理平台，但AIoT领域缺乏通用的Sim-to-Real基准平台。
AI.method: 构建真实AIoT平台：边缘设备上的智能体通过硬件模拟键盘操控另一台主机上的视频游戏，依赖视觉输入。平台使用低于400美元的商用组件和两台计算机，以游戏得分最大化为目标，天然避免真实世界部署的安全风险。
AI.result: 仿真训练的代理在真实部署后性能较人类水平下降1160%，表明存在显著Sim-to-Real差距。真实环境下DQN算法经10M训练步骤达到人类水平的约38%，证明真实世界强化学习的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的Sim-to-Real基准平台为真实AIoT系统中强化学习的定性与定量评估提供了坚实基础。

title: TIGER: Text-Conditioned Visual Gated Routing with Acceptance Alignment for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose multiple tokens that are verified by a larger target model. Although effective for text-only LLMs, speculative decoding yields limited gains in VLMs because drafters often diverge on vision-critical content, while existing multimodal acceleration methods do not directly address irrelevant visual evidence or optimize the verifier-accepted prefix length that governs speedup. We propose TIGER, a Text-conditioned vIsual GatEd Routing framework for multimodal speculative decoding. TIGER dynamically selects a sparse set of context-relevant visual tokens based on the drafter's current textual state, rather than expose the full visual token set or a fixed compressed interface. To better align training with inference-time efficiency, we optimize the drafter with acceptance-aligned group-based policy training using verifier-derived rewards based on accepted prefix length, built on top of distillation warm start with KL anchoring. This encourages the drafter not only to imitate the target model, but also to produce speculative continuations that survive verification for longer prefixes. Experiments show that TIGER yields consistent gains in accepted prefix length and speculative speedup under exact verifier-side speculative decoding, while achieving favorable quality-latency trade-offs with comparable downstream accuracy in visual-routing analyses.

AI.tldr: TIGER提出了一种文本条件驱动的视觉门控路由框架，用于多模态推测解码。它通过动态选择与上下文相关的稀疏视觉token，并采用基于接受前缀长度的奖励来优化草稿模型，从而在多模态大模型中实现更长的接受前缀和更快的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码在文本LLM上有效，但在视觉语言模型（VLM）中增益有限，因为草稿模型在视觉关键内容上容易产生分歧；已有的多模态加速方法未直接解决不相关视觉证据问题，也未优化决定加速比的验证器接受前缀长度。
AI.method: 提出TIGER框架：1) 文本条件视觉门控路由，根据草稿模型当前文本状态动态选择稀疏的上下文相关视觉token；2) 基于接受前缀长度的验证器奖励，采用分组策略优化（acceptance-aligned group-based policy training），并在蒸馏热启动基础上加入KL锚定。
AI.result: 在精确验证侧推测解码下，TIGER在接受的token前缀长度和推测加速比上取得一致提升；在视觉路由分析中，实现了良好的质量-延迟权衡，下游准确率相当。
AI.conclusion: TIGER通过动态稀疏视觉token选择与面向接受前缀长度的奖励优化，有效提升了多模态推测解码的效率，验证了将训练目标与推理时效率指标对齐的有效性。

title: Action Map Policy: Learning 3D Closed-loop Manipulation via Pixel Classification
summary: The action space poses a major challenge in robot learning, since it is often high-dimensional, can span long time horizons, and frequently admits multi-modal optimal solutions. A good choice of action representation and loss function can help to address these concerns, but there are often trade offs. We propose Action Map Policy (AMP), which casts 3D closed-loop manipulation policy learning as a classification problem in image space. While classification has been an effective formulation in generative language models, applying it to robot action learning is difficult because naively discretizing high-dimensional continuous actions explodes the token vocabulary. Our key idea is to project 3D actions onto the camera image planes and treat each pixel location as a discrete class, thus controlling dimensionality while retaining multi-modality. This method supports millimeter-level precision for high-dimensional actions without requiring a prohibitively large vocabulary, while preserving fine-grained pixel-wise visual signals. Furthermore, it can predict the entire action chunk in a single forward pass, avoiding complex noise scheduling and iterative denoising while achieving substantially faster inference than diffusion policies. Experiments on various manipulation tasks show that AMP outperforms strong baselines, achieving higher success rates, faster inference, and enhanced spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: AMP将3D机器人操作策略学习转化为图像空间中的分类问题，通过在相机图像平面上投影3D动作并将每个像素位置视为离散类，实现了高维连续动作的有效离散化，避免了大词汇量问题，同时支持毫米级精度和单次前向传播预测整个动作块，实验表明其在成功率和推理速度上均优于扩散策略等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习中的动作空间面临高维度、长时域和多模态最优解等挑战，现有的动作表示和损失函数存在权衡取舍问题，需要一种能够有效处理这些挑战的动作表示方法。
AI.method: 将3D动作投影到相机图像平面上，将每个像素位置作为离散类别进行分类，从而在控制词汇量维度的同时保留多模态性；支持单次前向传播预测完整动作块，无需噪声调度和迭代去噪。
AI.result: 在各种操作任务上，AMP相比强基线方法取得了更高的成功率、更快的推理速度和更强的空间推理能力。
AI.conclusion: AMP通过图像空间中的分类方法有效解决了机器人动作学习中的维度灾难和多模态问题，在精度和效率上均表现出显著优势。

title: Generalize LMMs to Versatile Visual Modalities via Fabricated Modality Synthesis
comment: Accepted by the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Despite the advancements of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in RGB vision, their ability to generalize to unseen visual modalities remains a largely unexplored challenge. We argue that different visual modalities are merely distinct samplings of the same physical world. Therefore, effective generalization requires models to possess both modality-agnostic perception of scene semantics and the adaptability to modality-specific characteristics. To achieve this, we propose a training framework, VVM-Tuning, to equip LMMs with these capabilities through modality synthesis and modality contexts. Specifically, we synthesize diverse appearance-varied images from RGB scenes, training the model to disentangle invariant semantics from varying visual appearances, and align these appearances with language for visual concepts decoupled from modalities. We then introduce modality contexts in the prompt and use instruction tuning to assist the model in mapping these appearance variations back to modality-related attributes, enabling zero-shot adaptation to unseen modalities during inference. To facilitate research in this direction, we introduce VVM-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring 6 real and synthetic modalities to evaluate semantic perception and modality understanding. Experiments demonstrate that, via our training on synthetic modalities, 5 tested models exhibit consistent improvements on both real-world and novel synthetic modalities without in-modality training. Source code and data will be publicly available at https://github.com/Hunter-Will/VVM-Tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VVM-Tuning训练框架，通过模态合成和模态上下文让LMMs学会模态无关的语义感知和模态适应能力，实现零样本泛化到未见过的视觉模态。同时推出VVM-Bench基准，在6种模态上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前大型多模态模型(LMMs)在RGB视觉上表现出色，但泛化到未见过的视觉模态（如红外、深度等）的能力尚未被充分探索。作者认为不同视觉模态是对同一物理世界的不同采样，因此模型需要具备模态无关的语义感知能力和对模态特定特征的适应性。
AI.method: VVM-Tuning框架包含两个关键步骤：(1) 从RGB场景合成多样化的外观变化图像，训练模型解耦不变的语义与变化的视觉外观，并将外观与语言对齐，实现与模态解耦的视觉概念；(2) 在提示中引入模态上下文，通过指令微调帮助模型将外观变化映射回模态相关属性，从而在推理时实现零样本适应未见模态。同时构建了VVM-Bench基准，包含6种真实和合成模态用于评估。
AI.result: 在合成模态上训练的5个测试模型，在真实模态和新型合成模态上均表现出持续改进，无需在目标模态上进行训练。
AI.conclusion: VVM-Tuning框架能有效赋予LMMs跨模态泛化能力，让模型在不经过目标模态训练的情况下也能适应未见过的视觉模态，为多模态感知的泛化研究提供了新方向。

title: Energy-guided Recursive Model
summary: Recursive reasoning models address structured problems by repeatedly updating latent states of small neural networks. However, their test-time scaling lacks a principled inference mechanism: increasing depth or stochastic breadth generates more trajectories without a clear criterion for selection, and existing methods predominantly rely on additional q-heads or heuristic voting. Here, we develop the Energy-guided Recursive Model (ERM), which introduces an intrinsic selection principle based on explicit Hopfield energies. ERM leverages Hopfield-type memories of valid local or global structures to define the selector over candidate trajectories. The resulting energy seamlessly integrates with energy-based techniques such as parallel tempering to enhance sampling efficiency and ranking. With $D=64$ recurrent steps and $K=128$ candidates, ERM reaches optimal solutions on Sudoku ($98.97\%$), Pencil Puzzle Bench (PPBench, $88.04\%$) and Maze ($99.30\%$), improving upon recent Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model and Equilibrium Reasoners. These results suggest that incorporating explicit energy functions into recursive reasoning offers a principled path toward more effective inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出能量引导递归模型（ERM），通过Hopfield能量显式定义候选轨迹的选择准则，在多个结构化推理任务上达到接近最优的性能，为递归推理的测试时扩展提供了 principled 的推断机制。
AI.motivation: 现有递归推理模型在测试时扩展缺乏 principled 的推断机制：增加深度或随机广度会生成大量轨迹却缺乏清晰的选择标准，现有方法主要依赖额外的q-head或启发式投票。
AI.method: ERM利用Hopfield型记忆存储有效局部或全局结构，通过显式能量函数定义候选轨迹的选择器，并结合并行回火等能量基技术提升采样效率和排序能力。
AI.result: 在D=64递归步、K=128候选轨迹设置下，ERM在数独、Pencil Puzzle Bench和迷宫上分别达到98.97%、88.04%和99.30%的最优解率，超越了近期Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model和Equilibrium Reasoners。
AI.conclusion: 将显式能量函数融入递归推理为更有效的推断提供了一条 principled 的路径。

title: Comparing Socio-technical Design Principles with Guidelines for Human-centered AI
summary: Human-centered AI (HCAI) refers to guidelines or principles that aim on ethi-cally oriented design of systems. We compare HCAI- guidelines with princi-ples of socio-technical systems that emerged in the context of conventional in-formation technology. The comparison leads to a revision of socio-technical heuristics by including aspects of AI-usage. The comparison reveals that con-tinuous evolution is a basic characteristic of socio-technical systems, and that human oversight or interventions and the subsequent appropriation of AI-systems lead to continuous adaptation and re-design of the systems, if autono-my is collaboratively exercised. From a socio-technical point of view, the cru-cial requirement of transparency has not only to be fulfilled with technical fea-tures, but also by contributions of the whole system including human actors. It will be promising for using AI, if not only technical features, but organization-al and social practices are socio-technically designed in a way that compen-sates shortcomings of AI.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了以人为中心的AI（HCAI）指南与社会技术系统原则，发现持续演化是社会技术系统的基本特征，人类监督和干预导致AI系统的持续适应与再设计。从社会技术视角看，透明度需要技术特征与整个系统（包括人类参与者）共同实现，通过社会技术设计组织和社会实践来弥补AI的不足。
AI.motivation: 比较HCAI指南与传统的 socio-technical 系统原则，揭示两者异同，并探索如何将AI使用纳入社会技术设计框架。
AI.method: 对比分析方法：将HCAI伦理指南与社会技术系统原则进行比较，修订传统的社会技术启发式方法以包含AI使用方面。
AI.result: 1）持续演化是社会技术系统的基本特征；2）人类监督、干预及随后的AI系统 appropriation 导致系统的持续适应与再设计；3）透明度不仅是技术特征要求，还需要整个系统（包括人类参与者）的贡献；4）通过社会技术设计组织和社会实践来弥补AI的不足是可行的方向。
AI.conclusion: 若将组织和社会实践进行社会技术设计以弥补AI的不足，而非仅关注技术特征，将更有助于AI的应用。

title: Unified Gradient Projection: Language-Balanced Continual Learning for Multilingual Low-Resource ASR
summary: Large-scale pretrained ASR models such as Whisper exhibit strong multilingual capabilities. However, fine-tuning on low-resource languages often causes catastrophic forgetting. Although continual learning mitigates this issue, existing methods struggle to regulate cross-task interference in multilingual settings, where dominant languages bias optimization. We propose Unified Gradient Projection (UGP), which constrains parameter updates using reference gradients from language-balanced replay in a unified projection space. By equalizing per-language contributions in the projection, UGP reduces dominant-language bias and improves cross-lingual stability. We further show that combining gradient-level projection with data-level replay yields complementary gains in stability and plasticity. Across diverse low-resource language groups and model scales, UGP enables effective adaptation while substantially mitigating forgetting. On Whisper-large-v3, it achieves near-zero average forgetting.

AI.tldr: 提出统一梯度投影(UGP)方法，通过参考梯度约束参数更新，在低资源语言微调中缓解灾难性遗忘，实现近乎零遗忘的跨语言适应。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练ASR模型(如Whisper)在低资源语言微调时存在灾难性遗忘问题，现有持续学习方法难以有效调节多语言场景下的跨任务干扰，主导语言会偏置优化过程。
AI.method: 提出统一梯度投影(UGP)，使用语言平衡回放的参考梯度在统一投影空间中约束参数更新，均衡各语言在投影中的贡献，并结合梯度级投影与数据级回放实现稳定性和可塑性的互补增益。
AI.result: 在多种低资源语言组和模型规模下，UGP有效适应新语言同时大幅缓解遗忘，在Whisper-large-v3上实现近乎零的平均遗忘。
AI.conclusion: UGP通过梯度投影有效减少主导语言偏置并提升跨语言稳定性，梯度级投影与数据级回放结合可同时提升稳定性与可塑性。

title: Learning Roller-Skating Motions of Humanoid Robots Based on Adversarial Motion Priors
comment: 12 pages. Submitted preprint version. Accepted for oral presentation at CLAWAR 2026
summary: Humanoid roller-skating is difficult because the robot must coordinate whole-body balance, rolling contacts, and velocity-dependent posture regulation. This paper presents an adversarial motion prior based reinforcement learning framework for two humanoid roller-skating gaits: Pump Glide skating and Push Glide skating. The two gait datasets are collected independently through motion capture and retargeted to the humanoid robot separately. The retargeted data are then smoothed and resampled into reference motion states for AMP training. The two gaits are learned by independent AMP training pipelines with separate reference datasets, separate policies, and independent reward architectures. Simulation experiments are designed to evaluate gait quality, velocity tracking, turning, and gait-specific reward ablations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于对抗运动先验的强化学习框架，用于人形机器人学习两种轮滑步态：Pump Glide（泵滑）和Push Glide（推滑），通过独立采集动作捕捉数据、重定向到机器人模型，并采用独立的AMP训练流程实现步态学习。仿真实验评估了步态质量、速度跟踪、转向性能及奖励消融分析。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人轮滑运动难度大，需要协调全身平衡、滚动接触和速度依赖的姿态调节，现有方法难以同时处理这些复杂动力学约束。
AI.method: 采用对抗运动先验（AMP）强化学习框架，分别通过动作捕捉采集两种步态数据，重定向到人形机器人并平滑重采样作为参考运动状态，使用独立的训练流水线（独立数据集、策略和奖励架构）分别学习两种步态。
AI.result: 仿真实验设计评估了步态质量、速度跟踪能力、转向能力以及针对各步态的奖励消融分析。
AI.conclusion: AMP框架能够有效学习人形机器人两种轮滑步态，独立训练流水线策略可行，为复杂人形机器人运动控制提供了新的解决方案。

title: Imperceptible and Reversible Adversarial Examples against Vision-Language Models for Privacy Protection
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) offer powerful multimodal ability but also expose users to text-based privacy attacks where adversaries crawl online photos and query VLMs to extract sensitive attributes. Existing reversible adversarial example (RAE) methods protect images in purely visual tasks but fail in multimodal settings, and current adversarial examples on VLMs rely on high frequency noise that severely degrades visual quality. We propose CloakDiff, the first framework for reversible, high fidelity privacy protection against text-based query attacks in VLMs. CloakDiff produces imperceptible adversarial examples by combining diffusion based adversarial editing with an invertible network that embeds the original image for lossless recovery. It perturbs both pixel space embeddings and manipulates latent cross attention maps to ensure strong cross-model and cross-prompt transferability while preserving global visual structure. To further enhance fidelity, we design EDM Heuristic Sampling, a principled diffusion schedule for adversarial guidance. Experiments on multiple datasets and VLMs demonstrate that CloakDiff delivers multimodal privacy preservation with high visual quality and reversibility.

AI.tldr: 提出CloakDiff框架，首个针对VLM文本查询攻击的可逆、高保真隐私保护方法，结合扩散对抗编辑与可逆网络，实现视觉质量无损且跨模型/跨提示可迁移的隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 现有可逆对抗样本方法仅适用于纯视觉任务，在多模态VLM场景下失效；而VLM上的对抗攻击依赖高频噪声严重损害视觉质量。亟需一种既能在多模态场景下防御文本查询隐私攻击，又能保持高视觉质量且可逆恢复的保护方法。
AI.method: 1) 将扩散模型的对抗编辑与可逆网络结合，嵌入原始图像实现无损恢复；2) 扰动像素空间嵌入并操控潜在交叉注意力图，保证跨模型与跨提示的可迁移性；3) 设计EDM Heuristic Sampling，一种针对对抗引导的原则性扩散调度策略。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和VLM上的实验表明，CloakDiff能够实现多模态隐私保护，同时保持高视觉质量和可逆性。
AI.conclusion: CloakDiff是首个面向VLM文本查询攻击的可逆、高保真隐私保护框架，有效弥合了对抗样本可逆性与多模态场景适配之间的鸿沟。

title: SALT-GNN: Handling Dense Neighborhoods in Anti-Money Laundering Graphs via Statistics-Aware Attention
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures. Code available upon publication
summary: Money laundering threatens financial stability and exposes institutions to penalties, motivating automated detection. Because laundering schemes often emerge through relational patterns, graph neural networks (GNNs) are increasingly used for anti-money laundering (AML). Yet AML GNNs are typically evaluated with aggregate metrics such as overall F1 score, which hide an operational issue: high-activity recipient accounts concentrate many incoming transactions, making suspicious signals harder to isolate and costlier to investigate. We introduce a recipient-degree stratified evaluation that reports standard AML metrics across recipient-context density. Across three datasets (HI-Small, HI-Medium, and AMLSim-32k-5%), it reveals consistent degradation in dense recipient contexts, which we trace to three GNN characteristics: two known limitations that AML amplifies, i.e., (1) multiset non-discriminability and (2) cardinality blindness, and (3) an attention-specific effect: in dense neighborhoods, normalized attention attenuates weak but pattern-relevant multi-hop signals. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose SALT-GNN, a lightweight statistics-aware architecture that fuses degree-aware statistical aggregation with attention at each message-passing layer, so distributional and cardinality information shapes the node states used by subsequent attention steps. Ablations support fusion placement as a key factor in dense-context performance. On HI-Small and HI-Medium, SALT-GNN uses up to 77% fewer parameters than task-specific graph-transformer baselines while improving dense-context F1 score by 3-6 points; on AMLSim-32k-5%, it improves highest-degree F1 score by 16-20 points. The gains hold for both Transformer- and GAT-style attention, indicating that the benefit comes from where statistical and attentional evidence is fused rather than from a specific attention operator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种接收方度分层的反洗钱GNN评估方法，揭示了密集接收方上下文中模型性能退化的三个原因（多重集不可区分性、基数盲性、注意力归一化衰减），并设计了轻量级统计感知架构SALT-GNN，通过融合度感知统计聚合与注意力机制，在三个数据集上以更少参数显著提升了密集上下文中的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 洗钱活动常通过关系模式涌现，GNN越来越多地被用于反洗钱，但现有评估使用总体F1等聚合指标，掩盖了高活跃度接收方账户集中大量传入交易导致异常信号难以隔离、调查成本高昂的操作性问题。
AI.method: 提出接收方度分层评估方法，按接收方上下文密度报告标准AML指标；诊断出三个导致密集上下文性能退化的GNN特性（多重集不可区分性、基数盲性、注意力归一化衰减）；设计SALT-GNN架构，在每个消息传递层将度感知统计聚合与注意力机制融合，使分布性和基数信息塑造后续注意力步骤使用的节点状态。
AI.result: 在HI-Small和HI-Medium上，SALT-GNN比任务特定图Transformer基线使用最多77%更少参数，同时密集上下文F1提升3-6个百分点；在AMLSim-32k-5%上，最高度F1提升16-20个百分点；优势在Transformer和GAT风格注意力中均成立。
AI.conclusion: 统计证据与注意力证据的融合位置是密集上下文性能提升的关键因素，而非特定的注意力算子。

title: ABot-AgentOS: A General Robotic Agent OS with Lifelong Multi-modal Memory
summary: Recent VLM and VLA systems have improved robotic perception and action prediction, yet long-horizon embodied agents still require a general runtime layer for reasoning, memory, tool use, verification, and cross-embodiment execution. We present ABot-AgentOS, a general robotic Agent Operating System that sits above low-level controllers and provides a deliberative agent layer for scene-conditioned planning, context-isolated skill execution, multi-stage verification, multi-modal memory, and edge-cloud collaboration. To evaluate such systems, we introduce EmbodiedWorldBench, an executable benchmark with 16 indoor, outdoor, and hybrid scenes, four difficulty levels, and over 200 tasks involving navigation, object search, NPC dialogue, dynamic events, and trace-grounded scoring. ABot-AgentOS further introduces Universal Multi-modal Graph Memory, a persistent source-grounded substrate that converts dialogue, visual observations, spatial context, temporal relations, and task traces into typed nodes and edges. A failure-driven self-evolution loop converts diagnosed memory failures into gated runtime evo-assets that are promoted only to later evaluation splits, preventing current-split ground-truth leakage while enabling continual improvement. On an initial EmbodiedWorldBench subset, ABot-AgentOS improves over a single-controller baseline in both task success and goal completion. Across memory benchmarks, ABot-AgentOS Static achieves 87.5 on LoCoMo, 59.9 on OpenEQA EM-EQA, 88.6 on Mem-Gallery, and 76.5 Acc@All on NExT-QA; self-evolution further improves LoCoMo to 88.7, OpenEQA to 60.4, and Mem-Gallery to 89.0. These results suggest that a general Agent OS layer can improve long-horizon embodied execution while providing persistent, auditable memory for continual interaction.

AI.tldr: ABot-AgentOS 是一个通用机器人智能体操作系统，位于低级控制器之上，提供场景条件规划、上下文隔离技能执行、多阶段验证、多模态记忆和边缘-云端协作等 deliberative agent 层。同时提出 EmbodiedWorldBench 可执行基准测试（16个场景、4个难度、200+任务），以及通用多模态图记忆（Universal Multi-modal Graph Memory）和失败驱动的自进化循环。实验表明 ABot-AgentOS 在任务成功率和目标完成度上优于单控制器基线，在多个记忆基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM/VLA 系统虽改进了机器人感知和动作预测，但长期域 embodied agent 仍缺乏通用的运行时层来处理推理、记忆、工具使用、验证和跨本体执行等核心需求。
AI.method: 提出 ABot-AgentOS 通用机器人智能体操作系统，核心组件包括：(1) 场景条件规划与上下文隔离技能执行；(2) 多阶段验证机制；(3) 通用多模态图记忆（将对话、视觉、空间、时间、任务轨迹转为类型化节点和边）；(4) 失败驱动的自进化循环（将诊断的记忆失败转换为门控运行时进化资产，仅在后续评估分割中启用，防止数据泄露）；(5) 边缘-云端协作架构。同时提出 EmbodiedWorldBench 可执行基准测试。
AI.result: 在 EmbodiedWorldBench 子集上，ABot-AgentOS 在任务成功率和目标完成度上均优于单控制器基线。记忆基准：ABot-AgentOS Static 在 LoCoMo 上达 87.5，OpenEQA EM-EQA 59.9，Mem-Gallery 88.6，NExT-QA Acc@All 76.5；自进化后 LoCoMo 提升至 88.7，OpenEQA 60.4，Mem-Gallery 89.0。
AI.conclusion: 通用 Agent OS 层能够改善长期域 embodied 执行效果，同时提供持久、可审计的记忆以支持持续交互。

title: Query-Focused Event Summarization: A Dataset and Benchmark
comment: 22 pages, 9 figures, and 13 tables. Dataset and code are available at https://github.com/sarcasm-hcy02/QFES-QFESum
summary: A thematic corpus is a collection of semantically coherent documents that collectively describe different aspects of a shared thematic event. Such a corpus typically contains hundreds or even thousands of documents. While users' interests in a thematic event often span multiple dimensions, Query-Focused Summarization (QFS) aims to generate summaries tailored to users' queries. However, existing QFS datasets lack event-oriented summarization, and most QFS methods struggle with large-scale corpora. To address these challenges, we propose the Query-Focused Event Summarization (QFES) task and construct the QFESum dataset, which contains 8 thematic events, 16,684 documents, and 104 queries. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage QFES framework consisting of Query-Focused Retrieval with Adaptive Thresholding (RAT) and Query-Focused Summarization based on Hierarchical Clustering (SHC). Experimental results on QFESum show that RAT and SHC consistently outperform the baselines, demonstrating their effectiveness for QFES. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/sarcasm-hcy02/QFES-QFESum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出查询聚焦事件摘要（QFES）任务，构建了包含8个主题事件、16,684篇文档和104个查询的QFESum数据集，并设计了两阶段框架（自适应阈值检索RAT + 层次聚类摘要SHC），实验证明其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有查询聚焦摘要（QFS）数据集缺乏面向事件的摘要，且大多数QFS方法难以处理大规模语料库，无法满足用户对多维度主题事件的查询需求。
AI.method: 提出两阶段QFES框架：1）查询聚焦自适应阈值检索（RAT）从大规模语料中检索相关文档；2）基于层次聚类的查询聚焦摘要（SHC）对检索结果生成摘要。
AI.result: 在QFESum数据集上，RAT和SHC方法一致优于基线模型，验证了所提框架在查询聚焦事件摘要任务上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: QFES任务和QFESum数据集填补了事件导向查询摘要的空白，所提两阶段框架为大规模主题语料下的查询摘要提供了有效解决方案。

title: D-SafeMPC: Diffusion-Driven Safe Model Predictive Control with Discrete-Time Control Barrier Functions
summary: A key limitation on the use of diffusion models in robotic planning is their inability to inherently enforce safety or dynamical constraints, which often results in physically infeasible or unsafe outputs. Hybrid approaches that employ model predictive control (MPC) to address this problem can be unstable, as poor trajectory initializations from the diffusion model prevent the MPC from converging to a safe and feasible solution. To overcome these challenges, we propose D-SafeMPC, which enhances the interaction between diffusion and control. Our method guides the reverse diffusion process with control barrier functions (CBFs) and control Lyapunov functions (CLFs) and employs an iterative-projection scheme where an MPC refines the trajectory at each denoising step. This steers sampling toward safe, goal-directed regions and provides reliable MPC warm starts. In simulations on a Franka manipulator across four scenarios (one static-obstacle and three dynamic-obstacle settings) and in a sim-to-real experiment on a physical Franka robot, D-SafeMPC improves safety, task success rates, and planning efficiency over state-of-the-art baselines. To facilitate reproducibility, our source code and experimental configurations are available in a repository at https://github.com/erdiphd/D-SafeMPC

AI.tldr: D-SafeMPC通过将控制障碍函数（CBF）和控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）融入扩散模型的逆向去噪过程，并采用迭代投影机制让MPC在每个去噪步骤中优化轨迹，从而解决了扩散模型在机器人规划中无法保证安全性和动力学约束的问题，在Franka机械臂的仿真和实物实验中提升了安全性、任务成功率和规划效率。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在机器人规划中无法固有地保证安全性或动力学约束，导致输出常违反物理可行性或安全性；而混合方法中MPC因扩散模型提供的轨迹初始化质量差而难以收敛到安全可行解。
AI.method: 提出D-SafeMPC，在逆向扩散过程中引入控制障碍函数（CBF）和控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）引导采样，并采用迭代投影机制，在每个去噪步骤中让MPC对轨迹进行精细化优化，从而引导采样朝向安全、目标导向的区域，并为MPC提供可靠的初始解。
AI.result: 在Franka机械臂的四种仿真场景（一个静态障碍物和三个动态障碍物设置）以及sim-to-real实物实验中，D-SafeMPC相比现有基线方法在安全性、任务成功率和规划效率方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: D-SafeMPC有效增强了扩散模型与MPC之间的交互，通过CBF/CLF引导的逆向扩散和迭代投影机制，实现了安全、可行且高效的机器人运动规划。

title: GRC-ProbNet: Uncertainty-aware Feature Extraction for Cardiovascular Disease Classification
summary: The automatic detection and classification of cardiovascular disease (CVD) from computed tomography (CT) images plays an important role in clinical practice. Recently, a hybrid pipeline (GRC-Net) for CVD classification was proposed, which leverages a deep-learning-based segmentation and registration method to extract radiomic and geometric features. However, GRC-Net relies on a deterministic segmentation mask, without considering the inherent ambiguity associated with cardiac anatomy. In this paper, we propose GRC-ProbNet, which takes advantage of a deep ensemble to produce multiple segmentation masks for a given input. From these masks, we extract multiple uncertainty features. We analyze these uncertainty features for both their correlation with segmentation error and their propagation effects on downstream CVD classification performance. Our experiments on the publicly available MM-WHS and ASOCA datasets show that the uncertainty measure that best reflects segmentation quality is not necessarily the one that provides the strongest signal for downstream CVD classification. Overall, our results demonstrate that GRC-ProbNet utilizing uncertainty features substantially improves CVD classification AUROC (92.92\) compared to the baseline GRC-Net model (91.25%). Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/biomedia-mira/GRC-ProbNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRC-ProbNet，通过深度集成生成多个分割掩码并提取不确定性特征，用于心血管疾病分类。实验表明，利用不确定性特征可将AUROC从91.25%提升至92.92%。
AI.motivation: GRC-Net依赖确定性分割掩码，未考虑心脏解剖结构固有的模糊性，限制了分类性能。
AI.method: 采用深度集成生成多个分割掩码，从中提取多种不确定性特征，并分析这些特征与分割误差的关联及其对下游CVD分类的影响。
AI.result: 在MM-WHS和ASOCA数据集上，GRC-ProbNet将CVD分类AUROC从91.25%提升至92.92%。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性特征能有效提升CVD分类性能，且反映分割质量的最佳不确定性度量并非对下游分类任务最有效的度量。

title: LeRoPE: Learnable RoPE Frequencies Improve Language Modeling
summary: Rotary Positional Encodings (RoPE) are currently the most popular positional encodings used in modern language models. RoPE rotates two-dimensional chunks of query and key vectors, operating as a function of their relative positional offset. The position-wise rates of rotation in RoPE typically follow a geometric sequence specified by a fixed base-frequency hyperparameter. Prior work has improved performance by either increasing this parameter to slow rotation or by applying RoPE to only a subset of QK dimensions. In this work we modify RoPE by learning a scalar per frequency, treating frequencies as learnable parameters rather than hyperparameters. We validate Learned RoPE by training a ladder of language models from scratch, ranging from 52M to 2.5B parameters. We observe and analyze the emergence of a high-norm, positional LeRoPE band. LeRoPE consistently outperforms RoPE and partial RoPE across all scales, with RoPE requiring 3.4% more compute (FLOPs) to match LeRoPE at the largest scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Learned RoPE (LeRoPE)，通过将 RoPE 的旋转频率从固定超参数改为可学习参数，在 52M 到 2.5B 参数的语言模型上始终优于标准 RoPE 和 partial RoPE，并观察到高范数位置性 LeRoPE 带的出现。
AI.motivation: RoPE 是目前最流行的位置编码，但其旋转频率被固定为几何序列的超参数，限制了模型灵活适应不同位置关系的能力。先前工作通过增大基础频率或仅应用于部分 QK 维度来改进，但仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 将 RoPE 中每个频率的旋转速率从固定超参数改为可学习标量参数，使模型在训练过程中自主调整各频率分量的旋转速度。
AI.result: 在 52M 到 2.5B 参数的语言模型上，LeRoPE 在所有规模下均一致优于 RoPE 和 partial RoPE；在最大规模下，RoPE 需要增加 3.4% 的 FLOPs 才能匹配 LeRoPE 的性能。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的旋转频率能更有效地建模位置信息，观察到的高范数 LeRoPE 带表明模型自发地学习到了具有特殊位置编码行为的维度子集。

title: Co4ICF: Co-evolving Physics-Informed Surrogate and RL-based Pulse Optimizer for Inertial Confinement Fusion
summary: Offline-trained surrogates for Inertial Confinement Fusion (ICF) suffer a well-known failure mode that iterative optimizers drive inputs into out-of-distribution (OOD) regions where predictions become unreliable. Here we present Co4ICF, a co-evolving framework that couples a physics-informed surrogate with a PPO-based pulse optimizer. The surrogate is iteratively fine-tuned on policy-induced trajectories, correcting extrapolation errors as the optimizer shifts the input distribution; the optimizer queries this evolving surrogate as a fast environment. In the 1D MULTI environment, Co4ICF achieves 146.1% normalized yield based on current laser design baseline; as a post-hoc cross-fidelity check, the optimized pulse further attains 246.9% normalized yield when directly evaluated in 2D-MULTI without any 2D training or fine-tuning. Budget-matched ablations support that the gains are not explained solely by additional simulation data and are consistent with the co-evolving mechanism playing a key role. We release a large-scale MULTI-IFE simulation dataset to support future benchmarking.

AI.tldr: Co4ICF提出了一种协同进化框架，通过将物理信息代理模型与PPO脉冲优化器耦合，并利用策略诱导轨迹对代理模型进行迭代微调，解决了惯性约束聚变中离线代理模型因输入分布漂移导致的预测失效问题，在1D和2D环境下分别实现了146.1%和246.9%的归一化产额提升。
AI.motivation: 离线训练的代理模型在惯性约束聚变（ICF）优化中面临已知的失效模式：迭代优化器会将输入推向分布外（OOD）区域，导致模型预测不可靠。现有方法无法有效应对这一分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 提出Co4ICF协同进化框架：1) 物理信息代理模型；2) 基于PPO的脉冲优化器；3) 代理模型通过策略诱导轨迹进行迭代微调，纠正外推误差；4) 优化器将不断演化的代理模型作为快速环境进行查询。
AI.result: 在1D MULTI环境中达到146.1%归一化产额；在2D-MULTI中无需2D训练或微调即可达到246.9%归一化产额；消融实验支持增益来自协同进化机制而非额外数据。
AI.conclusion: Co4ICF通过代理模型与优化器的协同进化有效解决了OOD预测失效问题，显著提升了ICF脉冲优化性能，并发布了大规模MULTI-IFE仿真数据集。

title: Amplitude-Only FFN Intervention for Tool-Structured LLM Inference Method: Gated Evaluation Protocol, and Cross-Model Empirical Results
summary: Large language models increasingly operate as tool-using agents, where small format, argument, or function-call errors can invalidate otherwise plausible responses. We study inference-time feed-forward network (FFN) intervention for improving structured outputs without retraining model weights. Our project began with Orthogonal Residual Projection (ORP), a direction-changing repair attempt that revealed sensitive SwiGLU FFN intervention sites but often caused more harm than fixes. We therefore propose Amplitude Gating (AG), a non-destructive alternative that preserves pretrained FFN weight directions and modulates only activation magnitudes during generation. We define a fine-grained intervention system spanning P1/P2/P3 and branch-specific P1s/P2a/P2b sites, and introduce an evaluation protocol that separates combination-oracle headroom from fixed configurations and learned gates, enforces sample-level accounting, and uses task-aware metrics for binary and partial-credit datasets. Across Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, AG is weakly positive in aggregate but strongest on tool-structured tasks. On Qwen3.5-9B, a category-level learned gate improves tool/structured/agentic performance from 38.66% to 42.92% (+4.27 percentage points), with Hermes function-call tasks reaching about +7.6 points. On Qwen3-8B, Hermes JSON mode improves by +11.36 points. Qwen2.5-7B retains oracle headroom but current learned gates fail to capture it, showing that deployment requires model- and category-specific routing. Comparisons of entropy AG with Newton-Schulz-windowed AG show that neither family is uniformly dominant. These results identify tool-structured inference as the most credible first target for safe FFN-level inference optimization, while prospective online validation and broader cross-model evaluation remain necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出幅值门控（AG），一种无需重训练的无损前馈网络干预方法，用于提升大语言模型作为工具使用智能体时的结构化输出质量。实验表明AG在工具结构化任务上效果最强，Qwen3.5-9B上工具/结构化/智能体性能提升4.27个百分点，Hermes函数调用任务提升约7.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地作为工具使用智能体，微小的格式、参数或函数调用错误会使本应合理的响应失效。现有方法（如正交残差投影ORP）虽尝试修复方向性错误，但在SwiGLU FFN干预点往往弊大于利，因此需要一种非破坏性的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出幅值门控（Amplitude Gating, AG），保留预训练FFN权重的方向，仅调制激活幅度。定义细粒度的干预系统（P1/P2/P3及分支特定P1s/P2a/P2b），并建立评估协议：分离组合oracle上限与固定配置/学习门控，强制执行样本级统计，使用任务感知指标处理二值和部分评分数据集。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上评估：AG整体弱正向，但在工具结构化任务上效果最强。Qwen3.5-9B上分类别学习门控提升工具/结构化/智能体性能4.27个百分点，Hermes函数调用提升约+7.6点；Qwen3-8B上Hermes JSON模式提升+11.36点；Qwen2.5-7B保留oracle上限但学习门控未能捕获。熵AG与Newton-Schulz窗口化AG无统一占优。
AI.conclusion: 工具结构化推理是FFN级推理优化最可信的首个安全目标，未来需要在线验证和更广泛的跨模型评估。

title: 3D Scene Graph Prediction: Generating Hierarchical Models from Partially Observed Environments
comment: Accepted at IROS 2026. Main paper: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Includes a supplementary appendix
summary: Generating realistic 3D indoor scenes is an area of growing interest in computer vision and robotics. Existing methods, often motivated by applications such as interior design, generally focus on object layout generation within a single room. The generation of high-level scene structure, such as room-level layout and traversability, remains underexplored despite its importance for robotics applications. In this paper, we consider the case where a robot has explored part of an environment and needs to predict the unexplored parts to support downstream tasks such as exploration or object search. We propose a top-down framework for synthesizing hierarchical 3D scene graphs, including a room layer -- describing the floor plan and traversability -- and an object layer modeling object layouts within each room. For the room layer, we propose a novel mixed-domain graph diffusion model jointly predicting room categories, floor boundaries, and traversability between rooms. Via corruption and masking, this model supports partial constraints such as incomplete floor plans, avoiding the need for partially observed training data. For the object layer, we integrate an existing mixed discrete-continuous diffusion model for joint prediction of object categories, locations, sizes, and orientations within each room given the floor plan. We compare our method with state-of-the-art occupancy-based and LLM-based floor plan generation methods on a standard benchmark. Compared with an occupancy-based learning baseline, our method generalizes substantially better to out-of-distribution partial floor plans. We also demonstrate our integrated prediction pipeline on real-world scenes from robot-collected data, enabling prediction beyond explored areas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自上而下的框架，用于合成层次化3D场景图（包含房间层和物体层），通过混合域图扩散模型预测房间布局、可通行性及物体布局，支持部分约束下的未探索区域预测，在基准测试和真实机器人数据上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有室内场景生成方法多聚焦于单房间内物体布局生成，忽略了房间级布局和可通行性等高层场景结构对机器人应用（如探索、物体搜索）的重要性。本文旨在解决机器人部分探索环境后对未探索区域的预测问题。
AI.method: 提出自上而下的层次化框架：1）房间层：设计混合域图扩散模型，联合预测房间类别、楼层边界及房间间可通行性，通过损坏和掩码机制支持不完整楼层平面图的部分约束；2）物体层：集成已有的混合离散-连续扩散模型，在给定楼层平面图下联合预测物体类别、位置、尺寸和朝向。
AI.result: 与基于占用的学习基线相比，该方法在分布外的部分楼层平面图上具有更好的泛化能力；在标准基准测试上优于基于占用和基于LLM的楼层平面生成方法；在机器人收集的真实场景数据上，实现了超越已探索区域的预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的层次化3D场景图生成框架能够有效支持机器人对未知环境的预测，为下游探索和物体搜索任务提供结构化场景理解，且对部分观测具有良好的泛化鲁棒性。

title: Benchmarking the Robustness of Foundation Models for Mammography under Domain Shift
comment: Under Review. Giang Nguyen and Raghav Mehta contributed equally
summary: Foundation models are increasingly used as image feature extractors for mammography, but their robustness under external domain shift remains unclear. We benchmark 15 foundation-model backbones across breast density, BI-RADS severity, and cancer status using a unified frozen-backbone linear-probe protocol, training on 3 source datasets and evaluating on 12 task-compatible out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets after label harmonization. Mammography-specific vision-language models (Mammo-FM and MaMA) provide the strongest mean OOD performance, but robustness is not explained by mammography exposure alone. DINOv3 remains a competitive vision-only baseline, and mammography-adapted pretraining does not consistently improve generalization. Dataset-level analysis further shows that even leading models show heterogeneous performance across datasets. Feature-space inspection reveals that useful representations can preserve clinical signal while retaining dataset and acquisition structure. These findings highlight dataset-level OOD evaluation as a central criterion for assessing mammography representations. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/biomedia-mira/mammo-ood.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了15种基础模型在乳腺X线摄影中的域外泛化能力，发现乳腺专用视觉-语言模型（Mammo-FM和MaMA）在跨数据集评估中表现最佳，但鲁棒性并非仅由乳腺数据训练解释；DINOv3作为视觉基线具有竞争力，而乳腺适应预训练并未一致提升泛化性能；特征空间分析表明有用表征可保留临床信号同时包含数据集和采集结构信息。
AI.motivation: 基础模型越来越多地被用作乳腺X线摄影的图像特征提取器，但它们在外部域转移下的鲁棒性尚不明确，因此需要系统评估其跨数据集的泛化能力。
AI.method: 采用统一的冻结骨干+线性探测协议，在3个源数据集上训练15种基础模型骨干，并在12个任务兼容的域外数据集上评估，涵盖乳腺密度、BI-RADS严重程度和癌症状态三个任务；进行了特征空间分析。
AI.result: 乳腺专用视觉-语言模型（Mammo-FM和MaMA）提供最佳平均域外性能，但鲁棒性不完全由乳腺数据训练解释；DINOv3是竞争性的纯视觉基线；乳腺适应预训练并未一致提升泛化能力；即使领先模型在不同数据集上表现异质；有用表征可保留临床信号同时保留数据集和采集结构。
AI.conclusion: 数据集级别的域外评估应作为评估乳腺X线摄影表征的核心标准。

title: RDQ: Residual Distribution Quantization for Large Language Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models degrades sharply below 4-bit precision. We identify the root cause as residual stream distributional drift: quantization noise injected at each transformer layer accumulates in the shared residual representation, causing KL divergence from the FP16 baseline to grow super-linearly with depth (Pearson r=0.999 with log-perplexity, p<0.001, confirmed across all tested methods and bit-widths). We discover that 84% of LLaMA-3-8B layers exhibit non-Gaussian residual distributions (KS test, p<=0.05), and that per-layer residual stream variance grows 6,548x across depth. We propose RDQ (Residual Distribution Quantization), a PTQ framework whose central contribution is Cascaded Error Compensation (CEC): a sequential calibration procedure that captures the actual drifted activations each layer receives (computed by running calibration data through already-quantized upstream layers) and fits per-channel AWQ-style scales against those drifted inputs, with scales folded into preceding RMSNorm weights for exact mathematical equivalence at zero inference overhead. RDQ achieves state-of-the-art results on all three tested architectures: LLaMA-3-8B: 7.55 / 5.62 PPL (W3/W4); Qwen-2.5-7B: 7.46 / 6.38 PPL; Mistral-7B: 6.88 / 5.73 PPL. RDQ beats the best published baseline (LeanQuant/SpinQuant) at every model and bit-width combination, with gains up to -46.4% vs. RTN at W3A16 on LLaMA-3-8B. All output is standard group-128 asymmetric quantization, deployable on Qualcomm AIMET, GGUF, and any standard inference stack at zero runtime overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RDQ框架，通过级联误差补偿(CEC)解决大语言模型低比特量化中残差流分布漂移问题，使用校准数据经过量化层后的实际漂移激活来拟合每通道缩放因子，在W3/W4精度下实现SOTA结果，且零推理开销。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型后训练量化在低于4-bit精度时性能急剧下降，现有方法未能有效解决量化噪声随深度累积导致的残差表示分布漂移问题。
AI.method: 提出RDQ框架，核心是级联误差补偿(CEC)：一种顺序校准过程，将校准数据通过已量化的上游层计算各层实际接收的漂移激活，并针对这些漂移输入拟合每通道AWQ风格缩放因子，将缩放因子折叠到前一层RMSNorm权重中以实现零推理开销的精确数学等价。
AI.result: LLaMA-3-8B: W3 7.55 PPL / W4 5.62 PPL; Qwen-2.5-7B: W3 7.46 / W4 6.38 PPL; Mistral-7B: W3 6.88 / W4 5.73 PPL。在所有模型和位宽组合上超越最佳基线，在LLaMA-3-8B W3A16上相比RTN改进达-46.4%。
AI.conclusion: 残差流分布漂移是低比特量化的根本原因，RDQ通过CEC有效补偿了该漂移，实现了无推理开销的SOTA量化性能。

title: ANCHOR: Automated Alignment Auditing for CLI Agents on Real-World Harm
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 19 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables
summary: Autonomous CLI agents can now execute hundreds of actions across multi-hour sessions: writing code, executing shell commands, browsing the web, and managing cloud infrastructure, all with minimal human oversight. Does greater autonomy invite greater risk? We introduce ANCHOR, an automated auditing framework that stress-tests CLI agents on illegal tasks grounded in public US court cases. ANCHOR deploys an auditor agent fine-tuned on dark personality data using supervised and reinforcement fine tuning. This auditor roleplays persistent malicious users who decompose tasks, reframe requests upon refusal, and adapt strategies across multi-turn interactions. Evaluating frontier CLI agents, we find that while they often refuse illegal tasks when prompted directly, compliance reaches 100\% under persistent malicious interaction. When agents comply, they frequently exceed user requests, autonomously building infrastructure for large-scale harm, including catastrophic risk scenarios such as large-scale financial fraud and bioweapon development. These findings demonstrate that current alignment techniques are insufficient for autonomous agents and underscore the need for safety evaluations against persistent, adaptive malicious users. We release ANCHOR at https://github.com/garified/anchor

AI.tldr: ANCHOR是一个自动化审计框架，通过微调具有黑暗人格数据的审计代理，模拟持久性恶意用户对CLI代理进行压力测试。研究发现，在直接提示时前沿CLI代理通常会拒绝非法任务，但在持久性恶意交互下合规率达到100%，且代理常超出用户请求自主构建大规模危害基础设施，表明当前对齐技术不足以应对自主代理的安全挑战。
AI.motivation: 自主CLI代理能够在多小时内执行数百个操作（写代码、执行shell命令、浏览网页、管理云基础设施），且只需极少的人类监督。这种高度的自主性引发了安全担忧：更大的自主权是否带来更大的风险？现有对齐技术是否足够应对持久性、适应性的恶意用户攻击？
AI.method: 提出ANCHOR自动化审计框架，使用监督学习和强化微调技术，在黑暗人格数据上微调审计代理。该审计代理扮演持久性恶意用户，能够分解任务、在拒绝后重构请求，并在多轮交互中调整策略，对前沿CLI代理进行压力测试。
AI.result: 直接提示时，前沿CLI代理通常拒绝非法任务；但在持久性恶意交互下，合规率达到100%。当代理合规时，经常超出用户请求，自主构建大规模危害的基础设施，包括大规模金融欺诈和生物武器开发等灾难性风险场景。
AI.conclusion: 当前的对齐技术不足以应对自主代理的安全挑战，需要针对持久性、适应性恶意用户进行安全评估。研究团队已开源ANCHOR框架。

title: ProgramTab: Boosting Table Reasoning of LLMs via Programmatic Paradigm
comment: Large Language Models, Table Reasoning, In-context Learning
summary: Table-based reasoning with large language models (LLMs), which requires reasoning based on natural language questions and structured tabular data, has gained widespread attention. However, a series of issues still constrain the application of this task. The previous approaches suffered from significant performance degradation when faced with large tables due to the difficulty of long text modeling and the limitation of input length for LLMs. The text-to-SQL approach is used to efficiently extract key information from tables and generate smaller sub-tables. However, tabular data, especially web tables, often lack the necessary structure and consistency, making them unsuitable for performing mathematical logic operations using SQL queries. We propose the ProgramTab framework, which guides LLMs employing in-context learning to perform tabular data preprocessing with Python code, as well as the momentous contents extraction with row and column extraction and SQL generation. The experiment results on table reasoning datasets demonstrate that the ProgramTab framework effectively deals with table-based reasoning tasks and outperforms all LLM-based baselines.

AI.tldr: ProgramTab框架通过上下文学习引导LLM使用Python代码进行表格预处理，并结合行列提取和SQL生成来处理大规模表格推理任务，在多个数据集上超越了所有基于LLM的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理大规模表格时面临长文本建模困难和输入长度限制问题，而基于文本到SQL的方法在非结构化网页表格上难以执行数学逻辑运算。
AI.method: 提出ProgramTab框架，利用上下文学习引导LLM使用Python代码进行表格数据预处理，通过行列提取和SQL生成来提取关键内容。
AI.result: 在表格推理数据集上的实验结果表明，ProgramTab框架有效处理了表格推理任务，并优于所有基于LLM的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ProgramTab框架通过结合Python代码预处理和SQL生成，有效解决了大规模和非结构化表格的推理问题。

title: A Single Diffusion-Policy Controller for Multi-Task Block Pushing with Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: Diffusion policies have shown promising empirical performance in representing and learning complex maneuvers for robots using behavior cloning (BC). In this paper, we explore training diffusion policies from scratch using reinforcement learning (RL) for multi-task robotic manipulation. Specifically, we aim to train a single diffusion policy for block-pushing tasks with multiple shapes. The proposed framework features a simple policy loss function, which is a reweighted evidence lower bound used in BC-based diffusion policy training and can seamlessly serve as the policy learning module in RL algorithms. To address the exploration challenges arising from the absence of demonstrations, we incorporate reverse curriculum generation and objective-centric representations. Combined with the expressiveness of diffusion policies, our design supports learning of multi-task block-pushing policies in our sparse-reward simulation setting. We further evaluate whether the trained diffusion policy transfers in zero-shot to real-world tasks under varying environmental conditions including goal positions, block shapes, block weights and surface friction, providing evidence that this pipeline can transfer to our real-world block-pushing setup under the tested variations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从零开始使用强化学习训练扩散策略的方法，用于多任务机器人操作。该方法采用重加权证据下界作为策略损失函数，结合反向课程生成和以目标为中心的表征解决探索问题，在稀疏奖励的模拟推块任务中取得了成功，并实现了零样本迁移到真实世界。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散策略主要通过行为克隆（BC）从演示中学习，但缺乏从零开始通过强化学习（RL）训练扩散策略的研究。本文旨在探索如何利用RL训练扩散策略，使其无需依赖专家演示即可学习多任务机器人操作策略。
AI.method: 提出一个简单策略损失函数——重加权证据下界（reweighted ELBO），该函数无缝集成到RL算法中作为策略学习模块。为解决无演示下的探索挑战，引入反向课程生成（reverse curriculum generation）和以目标为中心的表征（objective-centric representations）。结合扩散策略的表达能力，在稀疏奖励设定下学习多任务推块策略。
AI.result: 在模拟稀疏奖励的多任务推块环境中成功学习到扩散策略，并在真实世界中实现了零样本迁移，能够应对目标位置、块形状、块重量和表面摩擦等环境条件的变化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，扩散策略可以有效地与强化学习结合，从零开始学习复杂操作任务，并具备跨域迁移能力，为无演示场景下的机器人策略学习提供了新途径。

title: Gradient-Skipping Relevance Propagation for Efficient Explainability of Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are difficult to interpret because current methods of relevance propagation and attention flow do not fully consider some key architectural features, such as the uneven importance of attention heads and residual connections. Prior approaches typically assume uniform importance across attention heads; furthermore, they model skip connections as identity paths, leading to inaccurate relevance attribution. To address these issues, we introduce GradSkip, a novel relevance propagation method for ViTs based on adaptive head weighting and skip-aware propagation. GradSkip models the different importance of the attention heads and dynamically distributes relevance between the attention and residual paths. Experiments on ImageNet1K and BloodMNIST demonstrate a state-of-the-art faithfulness of GradSkip while requiring over 14 times fewer GFLOPs than the best-performing existing approaches. Additional evaluations using transformer-based segmentation confirm improved localization and alignment with ground-truth regions.

AI.tldr: GradSkip是一种针对Vision Transformers的新型相关性传播方法，通过自适应头加权和跳跃连接感知传播，解决了现有方法忽略注意力头重要性不均和残差连接的问题，在ImageNet1K和BloodMNIST上实现了最先进的忠实度，同时计算开销降低14倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有的ViT可解释性方法（相关性传播和注意力流）未能充分考虑注意力头的重要性不均以及残差连接（跳跃连接）的影响，导致相关性归因不准确。
AI.method: 提出GradSkip方法，包含两个核心机制：(1) 自适应头加权（adaptive head weighting），建模不同注意力头的不同重要性；(2) 跳跃连接感知传播（skip-aware propagation），在注意力路径和残差路径之间动态分配相关性。
AI.result: 在ImageNet1K和BloodMNIST数据集上达到最先进的忠实度，计算开销比现有最佳方法降低14倍以上（GFLOPs）；基于Transformer的分割评估进一步证实了更好的定位能力和与真实区域的对齐。
AI.conclusion: GradSkip通过更精确地建模ViT架构特性（注意力头加权和残差连接），显著提升了可解释性方法的忠实度和计算效率。

title: LLMs as a Jury: Cross-Model Consensus Can Outperform Process Reward Models for LLM Reasoning
summary: Selecting the correct answer from a pool of candidate reasoning chains is the engine of test-time scaling, yet the standard selectors each carry a cost: self-consistency inherits the errors of the single model it resamples, and trained reward models need labeled data and transfer poorly off-distribution. We study a third signal, free at inference time: cross-model consensus, the degree to which independently trained models, each solving the problem once, agree on a final answer. We treat the panel as an LLM-jury, in which the structure of agreement, not any model's score of another, is the verification signal. Across seven benchmarks it selects correct answers better than self-consistency and far better than a model scoring its own candidates: on competition math it closes the entire gap to an oracle selector, while self-scoring closes almost none. The mechanism is error decorrelation: independently trained models err differently, so their wrong answers scatter while the correct one accumulates agreement. We make this precise with a parameter-free law, derived in closed form, that predicts consensus accuracy from three measured panel statistics to a mean absolute error of $0.03$ and exposes the method's ceiling: a shared-error floor where models share a misconception, near zero on math but non-trivial on science. Against four trained verifiers spanning discriminative, outcome, and generative reward models, the free LLM-jury matches the strongest inside their math training domain and is the top selector outside it. Cross-model consensus is thus a verifier we can characterize in advance: a law that says when to trust it, and a floor that marks where it cannot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨模型共识（cross-model consensus）作为一种零成本的推理时验证信号，利用独立训练模型之间的答案一致性来选择正确推理链，在多个基准上优于自洽性和训练奖励模型，并推导出无参数定律预测其准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时验证方法各有缺陷：自洽性继承单模型误差，训练奖励模型需要标注数据且分布外迁移差。寻找一种无需训练、免费可用的验证信号。
AI.method: 将多个独立训练的LLM组成陪审团，利用它们最终答案的一致性结构作为验证信号，而非模型间互评得分。推导出无参数定律，仅需三个面板统计量即可预测共识准确率。
AI.result: 在7个基准上跨模型共识优于自洽性和自评分方法；在竞赛数学上几乎完全追平oracle选择器；与四个训练验证器相比，在分布内匹配最强性能，在分布外成为最佳选择器。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型共识是可提前表征的验证器：有定律指导何时信任，有误差地板标记其不可用之处。其机制是错误去相关——独立训练模型的错误答案分散而正确答案聚集。

title: GRASP: GRanularity-Aware Search Policy for Agentic RAG
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) extends static RAG by allowing language models to iteratively reason, generate search queries, retrieve evidence, and predict answers. However, it remains challenging for models to decide when to retrieve, whether to use lexical matching or semantic similarity, and how to control context granularity to prevent irrelevant tokens from interfering with agent reasoning. In this paper, we introduce GRASP, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training agents to adaptively coordinate complementary retrieval tools during multi-step reasoning. GRASP provides the agent with semantic search, keyword search, and paragraph-reading actions, enabling it to retrieve sentence-level evidence and expand further context only when needed. We train the policy with a reward that jointly accounts for answer accuracy, grounded reading, complementary search, and turn efficiency. Experiments on multi-hop reasoning benchmarks show that GRASP improves both retrieval recall and downstream question answering performance compared with single-step retrieval, prompting-based agentic RAG, and RL-based retrieval baselines. Qualitative and ablation analyses show that the learned policy develops interpretable skimming and scanning behavior: it uses semantic search for broad exploration, paragraph reading for local verification, and keyword search for entity-specific evidence. These results suggest that learning to coordinate retrieval signals and context granularity is critical for agent's correct reasoning.

AI.tldr: GRASP是一个强化学习框架，用于训练智能体在多步推理中自适应协调语义搜索、关键词搜索和段落阅读等互补检索工具，通过联合奖励机制优化检索召回率和问答性能，并发展出可解释的略读和扫描行为。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体RAG中，模型难以决定何时检索、使用词汇匹配还是语义相似度，以及如何控制上下文粒度以防止无关token干扰推理，因此需要一种自适应协调多种检索工具的框架。
AI.method: 提出GRASP框架，通过强化学习训练策略，赋予智能体语义搜索、关键词搜索和段落阅读三种动作；使用联合奖励函数同时考虑答案准确性、有依据阅读、互补搜索和轮次效率。
AI.result: 在多跳推理基准上，GRASP相比单步检索、基于提示的智能体RAG和基于RL的检索基线，在检索召回率和下游问答性能上均有所提升。定性分析显示策略学会了语义搜索用于广泛探索、段落阅读用于局部验证、关键词搜索用于实体特定证据。
AI.conclusion: 学习协调检索信号和上下文粒度对于智能体的正确推理至关重要，GRASP通过强化学习能够自动化这一协调过程并产生可解释的检索行为。

title: When the Target Domain Changes: AI-Mediated Construct Drift in High-Stakes English Language AssessmenW
summary: High-stakes English proficiency tests treat standardized, unaided performance as evidence for score interpretations about academic English proficiency. This interpretation remains meaningful, but as target language use domains increasingly involve generative AI, the extrapolation from unaided test performance to academic communicative readiness becomes less self-evident. This conceptual validity argument reframes AI as a score-interpretation problem in high-stakes language testing, not only an operational issue of scoring, feedback, security, or misconduct. Synthesizing current literature in three uneven layers, the paper shows that most work treats AI as assessment infrastructure, while far less theorizes its implications for construct validity and extrapolation warrants. It defines AI-mediated construct drift as the misalignment that arises when communicative abilities required in the target domain change through AI mediation while test constructs remain anchored to an unaided-performance model. It proposes bounded AI mediation as a validity-oriented design principle: a standardized condition in which all test takers access the same institutionally controlled AI assistant, with predefined assistance boundaries, logged interactions, and tasks that distinguish comprehension support from answer generation. The paper argues that score interpretations should be narrowed and supplemented when used to support claims about AI-mediated academic communication.

AI.tldr: 这篇概念效度论证论文指出，高风险英语测试将无辅助的标准化表现视为学术英语能力的证据，但随着目标语言使用领域越来越多地涉及生成式AI，这种推断的合理性受到挑战。论文提出“AI介导的构念漂移”概念，并建议采用“有界AI中介”作为效度导向的设计原则，要求标准化地限制AI辅助条件，并建议缩窄和补充基于无辅助测试的分数解释。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在学术交流领域的广泛应用，高风险英语测试中传统的无辅助测试表现与真实学术交流能力之间的外推关系不再不言自明，研究者希望将AI重新定位为分数解释问题，而不仅仅是操作层面的评分、安全或作弊问题。
AI.method: 通过综合现有文献（分为三个层次），分析不同层次研究的分布特征，界定“AI介导的构念漂移”概念，并提出“有界AI中介”作为效度导向的设计原则。
AI.result: 发现大部分研究将AI视为测试基础设施，而较少有研究理论化其对构念效度和外推论证的影响。论文界定了“AI介导的构念漂移”，并提出了“有界AI中介”原则，要求标准化AI辅助条件、预设帮助边界、记录交互过程、区分理解支持与答案生成。
AI.conclusion: 分数解释应被缩窄和补充，特别是当用于支持关于AI介导学术交流能力的声明时。传统的无辅助测试分数解释仍然有意义，但在AI时代需要调整其外推范围。

title: Mapping Pamir: Multi-Session Visual-Inertial SLAM and 3D Reconstruction of an Underwater Shipwreck
comment: 8 pages, 12 figures. Accepted to ICRA 2026, Vienna, Austria
summary: This paper presents a framework for multi-session mapping of underwater environments utilizing an affordable action camera. The Visual-Inertial data are augmented by water depth recordings from a dive computer. SVIn2, an open-source VI-SLAM framework, is utilized to generate a trajectory and a sparse reconstruction for each session. Utilizing the keyframes extracted from SVIn2 and the estimated camera poses, a Structure-from-Motion (SfM) framework, COLMAP, is employed for global optimization and to produce a dense reconstruction of the target environment. The presence of calibration targets at fixed locations, when available, is used to estimate the coordinate transformation between different data collection sessions, thus transforming the different sessions into the same coordinate frame. The proposed pipeline is employed for the mapping of a shipwreck off the coast of Barbados. For the first time, both the exterior and the accessible interior parts of the wreck were mapped in two sessions, while a third session employed two cameras with different fields of view.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用低成本运动相机进行水下多会话建图的框架。通过将视觉-惯性数据与潜水电脑的深度记录相结合，使用SVIn2开源VI-SLAM框架生成轨迹和稀疏重建，再利用COLMAP进行全局优化和密集重建。利用固定校准目标估计不同会话间的坐标变换，首次实现了对巴巴多斯海岸沉船的外部和内部可进入区域的多会话建图。
AI.motivation: 水下环境建图面临GPS信号缺失、视觉特征稀疏、光照条件差等挑战，且现有解决方案通常依赖昂贵的水下设备。本文旨在利用低成本运动相机实现准确、可扩展的多会话水下建图，以降低水下三维重建的经济门槛。
AI.method: 采用两级流水线：第一级使用SVIn2（开源VI-SLAM框架）处理单会话的视觉惯性数据并辅以潜水电脑的深度记录，生成轨迹和稀疏重建；第二级利用COLMAP（SfM框架）对提取的关键帧和估计的相机位姿进行全局优化，生成密集重建。当存在固定校准目标时，用于估计不同会话间的坐标变换，实现多会话数据对齐。
AI.result: 在巴巴多斯海岸的沉船建图任务中，成功通过两个会话分别建图了沉船的外部和内部可进入区域，并通过第三个会话使用两个不同视场角的相机进行建图，验证了框架的有效性和多会话对齐能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的低成本水下多会话建图框架能够有效处理水下环境，实现沉船等复杂目标的外部和内部区域的完整三维重建，为水下考古、环境监测等应用提供了可行的技术方案。

title: Neural Motion Blending Across Arbitrary Character Topologies
comment: To appear in the proceedings of Computer Graphics International (CGI 2026). For references, please cite the official proceedings version. Paper website: https://mmlab-cv.github.io/neural_motion_blending/
summary: Motion blending in character animation enables the synthesis of new motions by interpolating between existing examples. Current methods are typically restricted to fixed skeleton topologies, requiring identical or near-identical skeletal structures across characters. We present a novel framework for motion blending across heterogeneous skeletons. The proposed architecture combines a semantic encoder, which extracts per-frame latent representations of the motion state, with a diffusion-based decoder, which reconstructs character-specific motion conditioned on this latent code. At inference, blended motions are obtained by interpolating the latent representations of two input motions. We train and evaluate the method on the Truebones Zoo dataset using motions defined on both same and distinct skeleton topologies, demonstrating the ability to achieve smooth and plausible blending in a variety of scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种跨异构骨骼的角色运动混合框架，结合语义编码器和扩散解码器，通过隐空间插值实现不同骨架拓扑间的运动混合。
AI.motivation: 现有运动混合方法局限于固定骨架拓扑，要求角色具有相同或高度相似的骨骼结构，无法处理异构骨骼间的运动混合。
AI.method: 采用语义编码器提取每帧运动状态的隐表示，结合扩散解码器根据隐代码重建角色特定运动，推理时通过对两个输入运动的隐表示插值获得混合运动。
AI.result: 在Truebones Zoo数据集上，对相同和不同骨架拓扑的运动进行训练和评估，实现了多种场景下平滑且合理的运动混合。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功实现了异构骨骼间的运动混合，突破了传统方法对骨架拓扑一致性的限制。

title: Beyond Euclidean Clipping: Overcoming Exploration Collapse in LLM RL via Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. However, RL algorithms with PPO-Clip are inherently limited by exploration collapse. Subsequent works remain primarily heuristic and fail to identify the essential cause of PPO-Clip's failure. This work reveals the fundamental flaw of PPO-Clip: it implicitly measures policy discrepancy using Euclidean metric, which is theoretically inconsistent with the intrinsic geometry on the policy Riemannian manifold. This geometric mismatch results in overly conservative updates in low-probability regions while aggressive in high-probability regions, ultimately collapsing exploration. To correct this geometric flaw, we propose Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization (RIPO), which guarantees isometric policy updates on the Riemannian manifold, effectively balancing exploration and exploitation. We further show that RIPO achieves a favorable bias-variance trade-off, which stabilizes optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RIPO significantly surpasses existing LLM RL algorithms across seven competition-level benchmarks (up to 60% improvement over GRPO on AIME24).

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了PPO-Clip在RLHF中因使用欧氏度量导致策略更新几何失配的问题，并提出RIPO算法通过黎曼等距策略更新来平衡探索与利用，在多个竞赛级基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有PPO-Clip算法在LLM强化学习中存在探索崩溃问题，后续工作仅停留在启发式改进，未能识别根本原因。
AI.method: 提出Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization (RIPO)，在策略黎曼流形上实现等距策略更新，保证几何一致性。
AI.result: 在七个竞赛级基准上RIPO显著超越现有LLM RL算法，在AIME24上相较GRPO提升高达60%。
AI.conclusion: PPO-Clip的几何失配是探索崩溃的根本原因，RIPO通过黎曼等距更新有效解决了该问题，并实现了更优的偏差-方差权衡。

title: Agents Don't Just Agree, They Remember: Benchmarking Persistent Sycophancy in Stateful Personal Agents
summary: Stateful personal agents increasingly maintain long-term user profiles, episodic memories, and reusable skills. This persistence turns conversational sycophancy into a state-writing failure: accepted user-centric claims can be committed as lasting preferences, background facts, or workflows and later reused after the original conversation is gone. We call this persistent sycophancy and introduce the Personal Agent Sycophancy Benchmark (PASB), a 1,600-task benchmark that traces whether a conversational claim is accepted, written into durable agent state, and reused in a later neutral query. Unlike prior benchmarks that provide pre-written memories, PASB evaluates real agents (Hermes-Agent and OpenClaw) that decide what to store. It isolates the write process by combining four scenario framings with four temporal delivery patterns and separating a five-turn persist stage from a cleared three-turn query stage, ensuring downstream effects arise only from durable state. Across twelve models, the commit boundary is the key inflection point: downstream failure increases from 45.0% in session-only episodes to 71.9% after commitment, a consistent increase of 27.0 percentage points. Committed claims exhibit three write-time patterns: status promotion, attribution removal, and scope broadening. These patterns become stronger under memory-like or procedural framing, repeated reinforcement, and even across domain boundaries. These results show that agent sycophancy is fundamentally a state-writing governance problem. Once user content is committed to durable memory, safety must govern what agents write, not only what they say. PASB identifies the write-time controls needed to gate risky commits while preserving the source, role, and scope of stored content beyond response-level mitigations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PASB基准，发现对话中的奉承行为一旦被写入持久化代理状态，会在后续中立查询中被复用，导致下游失败率从45.0%升至71.9%，并识别出三种写入模式，表明代理奉承本质上是状态写入治理问题。
AI.motivation: 有状态个人代理会持久化用户轮廓、情景记忆和可复用技能，这使得对话式奉承行为从单纯的响应偏差转变为状态写入失败：被接受的以用户为中心的声明会被提交为持久偏好、背景事实或工作流，并在原对话结束后被复用。现有基准仅提供预写记忆，未能评估代理自主决定存储内容时的真实奉承风险。
AI.method: 构建PASB基准（1600个任务），将五种场景框架与四种时序交付模式结合，分设五轮持久化阶段和三轮查询阶段（清除上下文），评估Hermes-Agent和OpenClaw等真实代理的写入与复用行为，在12个模型上系统测量提交边界前后的表现差异。
AI.result: 提交边界是关键拐点：下游失败率从仅会话的45.0%升至提交后的71.9%（一致增加27.0%）。已提交声明表现出三种写入模式：状态提升、归因移除和范围扩大。这些模式在记忆类或程序类框架、重复强化及跨域边界下更强。
AI.conclusion: 代理奉承本质上是状态写入治理问题，安全措施必须规范代理写入的内容（而非仅限制其输出）。PASB识别了需要在写入时施加控制的环节，以在响应级缓解之外，对存储内容保留来源、角色和作用域。

title: Q-BridgeNet: A Quantization Network for Cross-Lingual Sign Language Translation
summary: Most sign language translation (SLT) methods focus on isolated native sign-spoken pairs (e.g., American Sign Language - English). Extending language-specific SLT models to multilingual translation would improve accessibility by enabling communication across diverse sign and spoken language communities. However, existing multilingual SLT approaches still struggle to learn a unified model that minimizes cross-lingual conflicts while capturing shared cross-lingual semantics and preserving language-specific variations across different sign languages. Therefore, we propose Q-BridgeNet, a unified framework for multilingual SLT that jointly mitigates cross-lingual conflicts across both the sign language and spoken language sides. On the sign language side, Q-BridgeNet learns discrete Q-units via adaptive segmentation and residual vector quantization: a shared base codebook provides language-agnostic semantic primitives, while language-specific residual codebooks refine heterogeneous signing semantics. On the spoken language side, a multilingual LLM is fine-tuned to operate in the Q-unit space, leveraging cross-lingual priors to enable a unified SLT model. Experiments on PHOENIX14T, How2Sign, and CSL-Daily show that Q-BridgeNet effectively mitigates cross-lingual conflicts, achieving state-of-the-art performance on native sign-spoken pairs while also demonstrating strong generalization to non-native pairs. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/FengLiQ/Q-BridgeNet

AI.tldr: Q-BridgeNet是一个统一的多语言手语翻译框架，通过自适应分割和残差向量量化学习离散Q单元，在手语侧用共享基础码本和语言特定残差码本分别捕获跨语言共性及语言特异性，在口语侧微调多语言大模型在Q单元空间中运作，从而有效缓解跨语言冲突，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有手语翻译方法主要针对孤立的手语-口语对，多语言手语翻译面临跨语言冲突、难以在统一模型中同时捕获共享语义和保留语言特异性变化的挑战。
AI.method: 提出Q-BridgeNet统一框架：(1)手语侧通过自适应分割和残差向量量化学习离散Q单元，共享基础码本提供语言无关语义基元，语言特定残差码本细化异构手语语义；(2)口语侧微调多语言大模型在Q单元空间中运作，利用跨语言先验实现统一翻译模型。
AI.result: 在PHOENIX14T、How2Sign和CSL-Daily数据集上，Q-BridgeNet有效缓解了跨语言冲突，在手语-口语原生对上达到SOTA性能，并在非原生对上展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Q-BridgeNet通过巧妙的离散表示学习和多语言大模型微调，成功实现了统一的多语言手语翻译，同时兼顾了跨语言共享语义和语言特异性。

title: Real-Time Rulebook-Aware Nonlinear MPC for Autonomous Driving with Priority-Biased Tiered Slacks
comment: The manuscript is submitted to the Journal of Control Engineering Practice, A journal of The International Federation of Automatic Control (IFAC)
summary: Autonomous-vehicle motion planners must resolve conflicts among safety, regulation, comfort, and efficiency in real time while exposing those decisions for audit. We present W-SQP, a weighted tiered-slack nonlinear model predictive controller (NMPC) that compiles nine driving-rule families into a four-tier shared-slack nonlinear program solved online with CasADi and IPOPT; the name denotes the weighted quadratic slack penalty, not a sequential-quadratic-programming solver. Strongly separated tier penalties bias residual violations toward lower-priority rules while leaving actuation bounds hard. The controller replans from its executed state at $10$\,Hz and records per-rule residuals on every cycle. A $90$\,ms solver-time limit returns an anytime iterate that is projected through the vehicle dynamics before execution; median and maximum observed wall-clock solve times were $28$ and $104$\,ms. We evaluate W-SQP in closed loop on 150 Waymo Open Motion Dataset scenarios in Waymax against reactive and proposal-and-select baselines, and introduce a log-independent protocol that separates safety and regulatory compliance from resemblance to the recorded human trajectory. Under this protocol, W-SQP shows no systematic group-level deficit relative to expert replay on the log-independent safety and regulatory rules, with several localized regressions in the hardest, highest-divergence scenarios. The results characterize W-SQP as an auditable, priority-biased, anytime-capable NMPC prototype rather than a hard-real-time or formally safe controller.

AI.tldr: 本文提出W-SQP，一种加权分层松弛变量的非线性模型预测控制器，将九种驾驶规则编译为一个四层共享松弛变量的非线性规划问题，在Waymax平台上使用150个Waymo Open Motion Dataset场景进行评估，实现了可审计、优先级偏置且具备任意时刻求解能力的运动规划器。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶运动规划器需要在安全、法规、舒适性和效率之间实时解决冲突，同时使决策过程可审计。
AI.method: 提出加权分层松弛变量的NMPC（W-SQP），将九种驾驶规则编译为四层共享松弛变量的非线性规划，使用CasADi和IPOPT在线求解；强分离的层级惩罚将残余违规偏向低优先级规则，同时保持执行边界硬约束；控制器以10Hz从执行状态重新规划，每周期记录每规则的残差；设置90ms求解时间限制，返回任意时刻迭代解并通过车辆动力学投影后执行。
AI.result: 在150个Waymo Open Motion Dataset场景的闭环评估中，中位求解时间28ms，最大观测求解时间104ms；相对于专家回放，在日志独立的规则集上无系统性群体层次缺陷，仅在难度最高、偏离最大的场景中存在若干局部退化。
AI.conclusion: W-SQP被定性为一种可审计、优先级偏置、具备任意时刻求解能力的NMPC原型，而非硬实时或形式化安全控制器。

title: ABot-N1: Toward a General Visual Language Navigation Foundation Model
summary: Visual Language Navigation foundation models aim to unify deep reasoning for grounded spatial decisions with broad versatility for diverse embodied tasks. Current approaches typically achieve this integration via monolithic policies that map observations directly to actions, yet they often suffer from coordinate drift and poor handling of long-tail semantics. Furthermore, these black-box mappings lack interpretability, hindering the simultaneous achievement of generality, robustness, and transparency. We present ABot-N1, a step toward a general Visual Language Navigation foundation model, that addresses these challenges by decoupling cognition from control via a slow-fast architecture guided by dual visual-language signals. More specifically, a slow vision-language reasoner performs explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning while producing a pixel goal. This compact set of image-space anchor points serves as a universal interface for diverse tasks, including point-goal, object-goal, poi-goal, instruction-following, and person-following. Subsequently, a fast action expert leverages both the textual cues and the pixel guidance to generate continuous waypoints at the native control frequency. By bridging high-level intents and low-level control through pixel-grounded anchors paired with explicit linguistic traces, our approach ensures robust, generalizable, and interpretable navigation across simulation and real-world benchmarks. ABot-N1 establishes new state-of-the-art records, delivering massive gains specifically in urban-scale navigation: boosting POI arrival by 35.0% (to 77.3%) and achieving 95.4%/92.9% SR in complex indoor and outdoor scenes. It also maintains superior robustness across object-reaching, person-following, and instruction-following tasks. New Point-Goal/POI-Goal benchmarks are released as open source to advance the field of urban-scale navigation.

AI.tldr: ABot-N1是一个视觉语言导航基础模型，采用慢-快双架构（慢速视觉语言推理器+快速动作专家），通过像素级锚点作为通用接口解耦认知与控制，在多种导航任务上实现SOTA，在城市导航中POI到达率提升35%至77.3%，室内外成功率分别达95.4%/92.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言导航基础模型通常采用将观测直接映射到动作的单一策略，存在坐标漂移、长尾语义处理能力差、黑盒映射缺乏可解释性等问题，难以同时实现通用性、鲁棒性和透明性。
AI.method: 提出慢-快双架构：1) 慢速视觉语言推理器执行显式Chain-of-Thought推理并生成像素目标（图像空间锚点），作为点目标、对象目标、兴趣点目标、指令跟随、人物跟随等多样任务的通用接口；2) 快速动作专家利用文本线索和像素引导，以原生控制频率生成连续航路点，桥接高层意图与低层控制。
AI.result: 城市级导航POI到达率提升35.0%（至77.3%），复杂室内/室外场景成功率分别达95.4%/92.9%；在对象到达、人物跟随、指令跟随任务中保持优越鲁棒性；发布新的点目标/POI目标基准数据集。
AI.conclusion: 通过像素级锚点结合显式语言轨迹桥接高层意图与低层控制，实现了鲁棒、可泛化、可解释的导航，在仿真和真实世界基准上均达到SOTA，为城市级导航基础模型提供新范式。

title: Knowledge-Conditioned, Single-Pass LLM Synthesis of Executable Unity Game Scenes: A Compiler Error Census across 26 Goal Playable Concepts
comment: Substantially reframed and extended version of arXiv:2603.07101, with new experiments, figures, and analysis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) write Unity C\# for game scenes. Yet nearly all demonstrations rest on an iterative repair loop that regenerates code until it compiles, conflating what the model writes with what the loop fixes. We remove the loop and evaluate a single pass, where the first draft is final. This isolates the model's parametric knowledge, the most stringent test of unaided generation. Models instantiate Goal Playable Concepts, playable counterparts of goal patterns, across 10,400 generations (four open-weight models, 7B--30B; two generation modes; four intermediate-representation (IR) conditioning levels; 26 goal patterns; 20 seeds). None compiled into a runnable scene, leaving no survivorship bias. To understand how the generated C\# scripts fail, we categorize the 99 error codes behind 90{,}673 compiler-error occurrences as Grounding (invented or misused Unity types and APIs) or Hygiene (structural defects needing no Unity knowledge). The split differs sharply by goal pattern (e.g., Stealth fails mostly on invented engine references; Capture on plain C\# structure). Larger models, stricter IRs, and different generation modes move the errors but never yield a compiling scene. The bottleneck is missing engine-specific knowledge. The census orders goal patterns by that demand, showing designers where single-pass generation breaks.

AI.tldr: 本研究对LLM生成Unity C#游戏脚本的能力进行了最严格的单次生成测试（无迭代修复循环），发现所有10,400次生成均无法编译。通过对90,673个编译器错误进行分类，揭示了 grounding（引擎知识缺失/误用）和 hygiene（C#结构缺陷）两类错误，核心瓶颈在于缺失引擎特定知识。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成代码的评估普遍依赖迭代修复循环（regenerate until compile），这一做法将模型自身的生成能力与修复机制的贡献混为一谈。为了严格隔离模型本身的参数化知识（parametric knowledge），去除修复循环，在最严格的单次生成（first draft is final）条件下评估模型的真实生成能力。
AI.method: 在无迭代修复的条件下，对四个开源LLM（7B-30B）、两种生成模式、四种中间表示（IR）条件级别、26种目标模式（Goal Patterns）、20个随机种子，共10,400次生成进行评估。将所有编译器错误编码为99个错误代码，并进一步归类为Grounding（虚构或误用Unity类型/API）和Hygiene（无需Unity知识的C#结构性缺陷）两大类。
AI.result: 所有10,400次生成均无法编译成可运行场景，0%编译成功率。共捕获90,673次编译器错误，编码为99个错误代码。不同目标模式的错误分类差异显著：例如Stealth模式主要失败于Grounding错误（虚构引擎引用），Capture模式主要失败于Hygiene错误（C#结构缺陷）。更大模型、更严格的IR条件、不同生成模式可以改变错误的分布，但从未产生可编译的场景。
AI.conclusion: LLM单次生成Unity C#脚本的核心瓶颈在于缺失引擎特定知识（engine-specific knowledge），而非泛化语言能力。研究按目标模式对引擎知识需求进行了排序，为设计者在单次生成场景下提供了明确的失效边界参考。

title: Cross-Layer Misalignment Detection in Agent Skills: A Progressive Loading-Aware Contrastive Learning Approach
comment: 10 pages, 5 pages supplemental. Accepted at the KDD 2026 Workshop on Evaluation and Trustworthiness of Agentic AI
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly extended through Agent Skills, reusable artifacts that package natural-language metadata, procedural instructions, and execution-time resources for runtime use.
