As open-source skill marketplaces expand, users and agents increasingly rely on brief metadata to select third-party skills, making it difficult to detect inconsistencies between a skill's description and its true behavior, a problem we call cross-layer misalignment. To address this issue, we propose Progressive Loading-Aware Hierarchical Contrastive Learning (PL-HCL), an LLM-based framework that detects misalignment by modeling the layered structure of Agent Skills and learning cross-layer consistency. Using a normalized corpus of over 264,000 open-source skills and a human-verified challenge set, PL-HCL improves Macro-F1 from approximately 0.45 for unadapted baselines to 0.87-0.89 across evaluated LLM backbones. This approach offers an effective screening tool for users and operators, as well as design principles for detecting inconsistencies in layered digital artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出渐进式加载感知分层对比学习（PL-HCL）框架，用于检测LLM智能体技能中描述与行为之间的跨层不一致性，在264K开源技能数据集上将Macro-F1从0.45提升至0.87-0.89。
AI.motivation: 随着开源技能市场扩展，用户和智能体依赖简短元数据选择第三方技能，但技能描述与实际行为之间存在不一致（跨层不对齐问题），现有方法缺乏有效检测手段。
AI.method: 提出PL-HCL框架，对智能体技能的分层结构（自然语言元数据、程序指令、运行时资源）进行建模，通过学习跨层一致性来检测不对齐。
AI.result: 在264K+开源技能语料和人工验证挑战集上，PL-HCL将Macro-F1从基线约0.45提升至0.87-0.89，在不同LLM骨干网络上表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: PL-HCL可作为用户和运营者的有效筛选工具，并为检测分层数字制品中的不一致性提供设计原则。

title: TreeThink: A Modular Tree Search Library for Mathematical Reasoning with LLMs
summary: Tree search algorithms enable systematic exploration of the proof space in neural theorem proving. Existing LLM tree search libraries primarily target natural language reasoning and do not provide native integration with formal verifiers, while theorem proving systems often rely on task-specific search implementations. We introduce TreeThink, an open-source Python library for modular, fully asynchronous tree search in neural theorem proving. It integrates established tree search methods with vLLM-based inference pipelines and diverse node evaluation techniques, ranging from lightweight heuristics to neural evaluators. We support Lean~4, Rocq, and Isabelle/HOL alongside natural language. It connects directly to each language's Read-Eval-Print Loop (REPL) server for real-time verification and proof state extraction. We evaluate TreeThink on miniF2F and MATH500, demonstrating cross-language formal proof search, natural language reasoning support, and up to 6.3$\times$ wall-clock speedup from asynchronous execution. Source code is released under the MIT license at https://github.com/GGLAB-KU/treethink , and the library is accessible as a downloadable package at https://pypi.org/project/treethink/ .

AI.tldr: TreeThink 是一个开源 Python 库，提供模块化、全异步的树搜索框架用于神经定理证明，支持 Lean 4、Rocq、Isabelle/HOL 及自然语言，集成 vLLM 推理流水线和多种节点评估方法，在 miniF2F 和 MATH500 上实现跨语言形式化证明搜索，异步执行带来最高 6.3 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 树搜索库主要面向自然语言推理，缺乏与形式化验证器的原生集成；而定理证明系统通常依赖特定任务的搜索实现，缺乏通用、可复用的异步树搜索框架。
AI.method: TreeThink 采用模块化设计，将树搜索算法与 vLLM 推理引擎解耦，支持异步执行；集成多种节点评估技术（从轻量级启发式到神经评估器）；通过直接连接各语言 REPL 服务器实现实时验证和状态提取。
AI.result: 在 miniF2F 和 MATH500 基准上验证了跨语言形式化证明搜索和自然语言推理能力，异步执行实现最高 6.3 倍墙钟时间加速。
AI.conclusion: TreeThink 提供了一个通用、高效、异步的树搜索库，填补了神经定理证明中缺乏通用树搜索框架的空白，并支持多种形式化语言和自然语言。

title: Think When It Matters: Conditional VLM Reasoning for Social Navigation with RL Policies
summary: As mobile robots become more integrated into everyday human environments, social robot navigation is becoming essential for ensuring human comfort, safety, and trust. While reinforcement learning (RL) navigation policies provide the fast inference and reactive behavior necessary for real-time deployment, they still lack flexible semantic reasoning capabilities and often fail to generalize to complex social scenarios. Recent approaches have increasingly turned to vision-language models (VLMs) in place of RL policies to improve semantic and social reasoning in robot navigation. Nevertheless, their high computational cost and slow inference remain major barriers to real-time deployment. To overcome these limitations, we introduce HUMA (Hybrid Understanding for Multi-modal social Navigation), a hybrid architecture that dynamically balances the computational efficiency of RL policies with the deep semantic understanding of VLMs. Our approach uses a reactive RL policy to handle low-density, routine navigation tasks, while conditioning it on a post-trained high-level VLM when a human enters sensitive situations, such as the robot's proximity zone. We evaluate HUMA on the Social-MP3D and Social-HM3D benchmarks, where it achieves task success improvements of 20% and 3%, respectively, while significantly reducing personal space violations and human collisions against state-of-the-art baselines. Extensive ablation studies validate each architectural component, and real-world deployment on the Mirokaï mobile robot further demonstrates the practical viability of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出HUMA混合架构，结合强化学习策略的高效性与视觉语言模型的深度语义理解，在社交导航中动态切换两种模型，实现任务成功率提升且减少人际空间侵犯。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习导航策略缺乏语义推理能力，难以泛化到复杂社交场景；而视觉语言模型计算成本高、推理慢，无法实时部署，需要一种兼顾效率与语义理解的混合方案。
AI.method: HUMA采用混合架构：低密度常规导航由反应式RL策略处理，当人类进入机器人邻近敏感区域时，则切换到后训练的高层VLM进行条件化控制，实现计算效率与语义理解的动态平衡。
AI.result: 在Social-MP3D和Social-HM3D基准上，任务成功率分别提升20%和3%，显著减少个人空间侵犯和人际碰撞；消融实验验证各组件有效性，并在Mirokaï移动机器人上完成实际部署验证。
AI.conclusion: HUMA混合架构有效解决了社交导航中效率与语义理解的权衡问题，为移动机器人在人类环境中安全、舒适地导航提供了实用可行的方案。

title: Vertical Fusion: Condensing Internal Representations for Robust ViT Classification
summary: Despite exposing rich intermediate representations, Vision Transformers (ViTs) are almost exclusively utilized as black-box feature extractors, where only the last layer is considered for downstream tasks. We challenge this convention by introducing the notion of recoverability: the capacity of intermediate representations to correct last-layer failures. By evaluating independent classification probes at every model depth across 16 datasets, we observe that intermediate probes correctly classify 18% to 76% of samples that the last-layer probe misclassifies. We show that these gains are not primarily driven by predictive diversity, but by a redundancy-correctness correspondence, where the internal hierarchy acts as a series of stable, redundant probes of a shared discriminative signal. While established horizontal ensemble strategies (i.e., across multiple models) can improve performance, they incur high computational cost and ignore this vertical signal within a single model. To bridge this gap, we propose VFusion, a principled vertical aggregation strategy employing a learnable mapping into a low-dimensional latent space that synthesizes features across the internal ViT hierarchy. VFusion substantially outperforms established aggregation baselines in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, notably closing 45% of the accuracy gap between the best individual layer and a theoretical oracle performance. Our gains consistently generalize across model sizes and pre-training regimes, confirming that VFusion offers a robust and efficient alternative to horizontal ensemble methods. The code is available at https://github.com/francescodisalvo05/vit-vertical-fusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VFusion，一种利用ViT内部层级表示进行垂直聚合的策略，通过可学习的低维潜空间映射融合中间层特征，显著提升分类性能，弥合最佳单层与理论最优之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 挑战ViT仅将最后一层用作下游任务特征的惯例，发现中间层表示具有"可恢复性"——能够纠正最后一层失败的样本分类（18%-76%），而现有水平集成策略（多模型集成）计算成本高且忽略了单模型内部的垂直信号。
AI.method: 提出VFusion，一种可学习的垂直聚合策略，将ViT内部层级的特征通过映射到低维潜空间进行融合合成，在保持计算高效的同时捕获层级间的冗余-正确性对应关系。
AI.result: 在16个数据集上，VFusion显著优于现有聚合基线；在分布内和外分布场景下，弥合了最佳单层与理论最优之间45%的准确率差距；结论在不同模型规模和预训练方案下均保持一致。
AI.conclusion: VFusion是一种稳健且高效的水平集成方法替代方案，表明ViT内部层级结构可作为稳定的冗余探针序列来共享判别信号，为利用单模型内部垂直信息提供了新的范式。

title: PhysMRV: Physical Memory Retrieval and Verification for Physics Plausibility Reasoning
summary: Video-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on video understanding and visual question answering, yet they remain unreliable in reasoning about physical plausibility, where understanding object interactions, causal dynamics, and fundamental physical principles is essential. This limitation is particularly evident on challenging physical reasoning benchmarks, revealing a persistent gap in physical commonsense reasoning. To address this challenge, we propose PhysMRV, a training-free physical memory and verification framework for physical plausibility reasoning. Unlike retrieval-augmented VLMs that retrieve semantically similar videos as additional context, PhysMRV transforms training videos into a Hierarchical Memory Bank of structured physical knowledge comprising three complementary levels: scene descriptions capturing visual context, physical-event graphs modeling object interactions and causal structure, and physics-rule summaries distilling reusable physical principles and cues. During inference, PhysMRV retrieves physically relevant memories and leverages their structured physical evidence to guide a frozen VLM in verifying physical plausibility, requiring neither fine-tuning nor parameter updates. We evaluate PhysMRV on three challenging physical reasoning benchmarks, ImplausiBench, IntPhys2, and GRASP Level 2, across multiple state-of-the-art VLMs. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over direct prompting across diverse VLMs and evaluation benchmarks, showing that structured physical memories provide an effective and scalable means of enhancing physical plausibility reasoning without additional training.

AI.tldr: 提出PhysMRV，一种无需训练的物理记忆与验证框架，通过将训练视频转化为三层结构化物理记忆库（场景描述、物理事件图、物理规则摘要），在推理时检索相关物理证据引导冻结的VLMs进行物理合理性推理，在三个基准上显著提升多类VLMs的物理常识推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型在物理合理性推理（如物体交互、因果动力学、基本物理原理）方面表现不可靠，即使是最先进的VLMs在物理推理基准上仍存在明显差距，亟需一种无需额外训练即可增强物理常识推理能力的方法。
AI.method: PhysMRV包含两个阶段：1）记忆构建阶段，将训练视频转化为层次化记忆库，包含场景描述（视觉上下文）、物理事件图（物体交互与因果结构）和物理规则摘要（可复用物理原理与线索）；2）推理阶段，检索与输入视频物理相关的记忆，利用结构化物理证据引导冻结的VLM进行物理合理性验证，无需微调或参数更新。
AI.result: 在ImplausiBench、IntPhys2和GRASP Level 2三个物理推理基准上，PhysMRV在不同VLMs上均一致优于直接提示方法，证明结构化物理记忆能够有效且可扩展地增强物理合理性推理。
AI.conclusion: 结构化物理记忆提供了一种无需额外训练即可增强VLMs物理合理性推理的有效且可扩展的方案，克服了传统检索增强方法仅依赖语义相似视频的局限。

title: AI YOU Town: Make Friends and Money with Your Digital Twin
summary: Existing approaches to infer user traits and generate responses consistent with a persona rely on static prompting. They lack calibrated uncertainty, ignore sequential evidence, and drift during long interactions. We present \textbf{AI YOU}, a framework that continually updates a personality profile with 22 dimensions from conversation and embodies it in a personal digital twin. Practically, the system combines prompting, Bayesian updating, and conformal prediction for persona inference. A periodically refreshed memory anchor and cognitive memory with three layers preserve persona consistency over long interactions. Across the main results, AI YOU \emph{(i)} achieves conformal coverage ranging from 0.921 to 0.976, \emph{(ii)} improves uncertainty calibration and reasoning grounded in memory, and \emph{(iii)} enhances persona fidelity over static prompting in role playing over 100 turns while reducing trait drift, for most evaluated backbones under adversarial settings with multiple agents. The prototype \emph{AI YOU Town} initializes an imaginative twin world for future interaction. The online demo is available at \href{https://quinnnnnne-ai-you.hf.space/}{\mbox{\texttt{quinnnnnne-ai-you.hf.space}}}.

AI.tldr: AI YOU 是一个持续从对话中更新22维人格画像并将其具身化为个人数字孪生的框架，通过结合提示词、贝叶斯更新和共形预测实现人格推理，利用周期性刷新记忆锚点和三层认知记忆在长对话中保持人格一致性，在多项评估中达到0.921-0.976的共形覆盖，提升了不确定性校准和人格保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖静态提示来推断用户特质和生成与人格一致的回复，缺乏校准的不确定性度量，忽略序列证据，且在长交互中会出现人格漂移。
AI.method: 提出AI YOU框架，包含：(1) 22维人格画像的持续更新；(2) 结合提示词、贝叶斯更新和共形预测进行人格推断；(3) 周期性刷新的记忆锚点与三层认知记忆结构保持长对话中的人格一致性；(4) AI YOU Town原型系统构建想象的双子世界。
AI.result: (i) 共形覆盖率达到0.921-0.976；(ii) 不确定性校准和基于记忆的推理得到改善；(iii) 在100轮以上的角色扮演中，人格保真度优于静态提示，人格漂移减少，在多数骨干模型和对抗性多智能体设置下有效。
AI.conclusion: AI YOU通过持续更新和校准的人格画像有效解决了长对话中的人格漂移问题，提升了不确定性校准和人格保真度，AI YOU Town原型为未来交互提供了想象的双子世界。

title: Automated Textbook Auditing with Multi-Agent LLM Systems
comment: Presented @ iTextbooks 2026: 7th Workshop on Intelligent Textbooks at AIED'2026
summary: Ensuring the quality of educational materials requires more than standard proofreading: textbooks must be audited for factual accuracy, domain-specific technical correctness, and linguistic quality simultaneously -- a task that general-purpose grammar checkers cannot address. We present \textbf{AI Textbook Auditor}, a modular multi-agent pipeline for automated quality assurance of educational materials across subject domains. The system accepts a textbook PDF and produces a structured, human-reviewable report via two analysis tracks: a \textbf{Factual and Technical Track} in which an ensemble of specialized LLM agents detects factual inaccuracies, code errors, incorrect definitions, and conceptual inconsistencies, augmented with web search for humanities domains; and a \textbf{Grammar Track} operating PDF-natively to preserve diacritical encoding. A \textbf{Judge Agent} filters false positives using domain-specific rules before presenting findings to a human reviewer. The pipeline supports two ingestion modes -- vision-native page rendering and PyMuPDF text extraction -- and is domain-adaptable via custom prompts encoding subject-specific error taxonomies. We demonstrate the system on two Romanian upper-secondary textbooks: a CS textbook (56 technical findings across seven categories, with an expert-validated precision of 62.5\%) and a history and social sciences textbook (72 findings spanning factual errors, ideological bias, and grammar). The system is designed as a triage tool that reduces the manual effort of locating candidate issues, with human expert validation required before any editorial action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI Textbook Auditor，一个模块化多智能体管道，用于自动审核教材的事实准确性、技术正确性和语言质量。该系统在罗马尼亚高中CS和文史教材上验证，分别取得56项技术发现（精确率62.5%）和72项综合发现，旨在作为减少人工定位候选问题工作量的分诊工具。
AI.motivation: 教材质量保障不仅需要标准校对，还需同时进行事实准确性、领域专业技术正确性和语言质量的审计，而通用语法检查器无法胜任这一任务。
AI.method: 采用模块化多智能体管道，包含两条分析轨道：事实与技术轨道（由专用LLM智能体集成检测事实错误、代码错误、定义错误和概念不一致，文史领域辅以网络搜索）和语法轨道（PDF原生处理以保留变音符号编码）。Judge Agent使用领域特定规则过滤误报后再呈现给人工审核员。支持两种PDF输入模式（视觉原生页面渲染和PyMuPDF文本提取），并通过自定义提示编码学科特定错误分类实现领域自适应。
AI.result: 在罗马尼亚高中CS教材上获得56项技术发现（7个类别），专家验证精确率62.5%；在历史与社会科学教材上获得72项发现，涵盖事实错误、意识形态偏见和语法问题。
AI.conclusion: 该系统设计为分诊工具，可减少人工定位候选问题的工作量，但任何编辑行动前仍需人类专家验证。

title: Wearing A Coat: Dual-Arm Robot-Assisted Dressing with Differentiable Clothing Simulation
summary: The development of assistive robots for dressing tasks serves to augment human convenience and improve the quality of life for individuals with physical impairments. However, due to the intricate contact interactions between garments and the human limbs during dressing, most robot-assisted dressing algorithms treat clothing as an assembly of discrete segments, thereby struggling to manage the partial worn garments under contact constraints. To overcome this challenge, we propose a novel robotic dressing control algorithm that integrates realtime differentiable clothing simulation. The simulation algorithm employs explicit iterative scheme with intentionally introduced higher-order perturbations to enhance computational efficiency while maintaining stability under large time-step conditions. Through simulation, we resolve the garment state under contact constraints, which then enables a multi-phase control strategy for successful coat dressing assistance. To further improve real-time performance, we introduce a constrained local model along with its corresponding optimization solver, permitting high-frequency local compensation for the differentiable simulation based global controller. Finally, we experimentally validate our approach through both simulated and physical dressing scenarios, conclusively demonstrating its feasibility and efficacy

AI.tldr: 提出一种集成实时可微衣物仿真的机器人穿衣控制算法，通过高阶扰动显式迭代方案提升计算效率与稳定性，结合多阶段控制策略与约束局部模型优化，在仿真与实物实验中验证了穿衣辅助的有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器人辅助穿衣中衣物与人体肢体接触复杂，现有方法将衣物视为离散分段，难以处理接触约束下的部分穿着状态。
AI.method: 提出实时可微衣物仿真算法，采用引入高阶扰动的显式迭代方案提升大时间步长下的计算效率与稳定性；通过仿真求解接触约束下的衣物状态，设计多阶段控制策略完成穿衣；引入约束局部模型及优化求解器，实现高频局部补偿以提升实时性能。
AI.result: 在仿真与实物穿衣场景中验证了方法的可行性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提算法能够有效处理接触约束下的部分穿着衣物状态，实现成功的机器人穿衣辅助，具有实际应用价值。

title: Self-supervised Automatic Matting
summary: High-quality alpha mattes are notoriously expensive to annotate, creating a fundamental data bottleneck for deep image matting. While prior work attempts to reduce annotation cost using coarser labels like trimaps or masks, they remain reliant on costly per-pixel supervision, limiting scalability and generalization. In this work, we push the boundary further and ask: can we train an automatic matting model using only RGB images, with no manual annotation at all? We answer this by presenting SSMatte, a self-supervised framework that for the first time achieves performance on par with fully-supervised automatic matting. Our key insight is to decompose the problem into semantic anchoring and detail matting. SSMatte first generates a semantic matting prompt from frozen self-supervised ViT features by propagating class-token seeds via a novel, training-efficient semantic anchoring loss based on a generalized Rayleigh quotient. This prompt then anchors a detail matting network, which is optimized via a fixed-point-based loss that enforces alpha-RGB consistency. Extensive experiments show SSMatte outperforms prior weakly-supervised methods, matches the performance of fully-supervised models on portrait benchmarks, and demonstrates favorable scaling and generalization behaviors with additional data. Our work pushes automatic matting to an fresh, fully annotation-free paradigm. Code will be available.

AI.tldr: SSMatte是一个完全无需人工标注的自监督抠图框架，通过语义锚定和细节抠图两大模块，首次实现了与全监督方法性能相当的自动抠图，在肖像数据集上达到全监督水平。
AI.motivation: 高质量alpha matte标注成本极高，现有弱监督方法仍依赖逐像素标注，限制了可扩展性和泛化能力。作者希望探索是否能在完全无人工标注的条件下训练自动抠图模型。
AI.method: 将问题分解为语义锚定和细节抠图两个子任务。语义锚定阶段：从冻结的自监督ViT特征中，通过基于广义Rayleigh商的新型训练高效语义锚定损失传播类标记种子，生成语义抠图提示。细节抠图阶段：利用该提示锚定细节抠图网络，通过基于不动点的损失函数优化，确保alpha-RGB一致性。
AI.result: SSMatte在多个指标上超越现有弱监督方法，在肖像基准上匹配全监督模型性能，并展现出良好的数据扩展性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将自动抠图推向完全无需标注的新范式，证明了自监督方法可以在无任何人工标注条件下达到与全监督相当的性能。

title: Generative Augmentation of Raman Spectra for Glioma Classification
summary: Access to sufficiently large biomedical datasets remains a major obstacle for machine learning in Raman spectroscopy-based diagnostics. In particular, for glioma analysis, datasets are typically small and heterogeneous, affected by acquisition-specific variability. This work investigates the utility of deep generative augmentation in such a small-cohort setting. We analyze glioma biopsy spectra acquired from 58 tumor samples and consider both binary IDH-status classification and 6-class methylation subtype classification problems. To address the limited size and imbalance of the dataset, we develop a conditional variational autoencoder ($β$-CVAE) capable of generating class-conditioned synthetic Raman spectra. The generated data are evaluated in Train-on-Synthetic, Test-on-Real (TS/TR) and Train-on-Synthetic+Real, Test-on-Real (TSR/TR) settings under a strict patient-isolated cross-validation protocol. Models trained exclusively on synthetic data underperform models trained on real spectra, indicating a substantial domain gap between synthetic and real distributions. However, augmenting the real training data with synthetic spectra consistently improves classification performance across multiple models. These findings indicate that, even with a limited number of independent patient samples, generative models can capture sufficient structure to provide useful regularization for downstream classifiers. We also investigate a reconstruction-based inference strategy, termed Classification by Reconstruction (CbR), in which class prediction is based on reconstruction error under different class conditions. Overall, the results support the use of deep generative augmentation as a practical strategy for improving machine learning robustness in Raman spectroscopy applications characterized by limited biomedical datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在拉曼光谱诊断中，针对胶质瘤小样本异质性数据集，使用条件变分自编码器（β-CVAE）进行深度生成增强以提升分类性能的有效性。实验表明，虽然纯合成数据训练效果不及真实数据，但合成数据作为真实数据的增强手段能持续改善多个模型的分类表现。
AI.motivation: 拉曼光谱机器学习诊断面临生物医学数据集规模小、异质性高、采集变异大的问题，尤其是胶质瘤分析中，缺乏足够的独立患者样本，严重制约了模型性能与泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出条件变分自编码器（β-CVAE）生成类别条件合成拉曼光谱；实验设置包括纯合成训练（TS/TR）和合成+真实训练（TSR/TR）两种范式；采用严格的患者隔离交叉验证协议；同时探索了基于重构误差的分类推理策略（Classification by Reconstruction, CbR）。
AI.result: 纯合成数据训练的模型性能不及真实数据训练的模型，表明合成与真实分布间存在领域差异。但在真实训练数据中补充合成光谱后，多个分类模型的性能均得到一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 即使只有少量独立患者样本，生成模型仍能捕获足够的结构信息为下游分类器提供有效的正则化，深度生成增强是提升拉曼光谱小样本场景下机器学习鲁棒性的实用策略。

title: Large language model agents accelerate inverse design of metal-organic frameworks for gas separation
summary: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) offer a highly modular platform for adsorptive gas separation, yet their vast reticular design space makes inverse design difficult under simultaneous constraints of chemical validity, separation performance, and structural diversity. Here, we present LEMO Agent, a large-language-model agent framework for closed-loop inverse design of gas-separation MOFs in MOFid space. LEMO Agent couples language-based candidate generation with MOFid standardization, explicit validity checking, Transformer-based property prediction, structured design memory, and multi-island exploration. Through iterative generate--validate--evaluate--remember cycles, the agent uses feedback from both successful and failed candidates to guide chemically constrained search across linker, metal, and topology choices. We evaluate LEMO Agent on CH$_4$/N$_2$ and CO$_2$/N$_2$ separation tasks. Compared with representative generative, optimization, and agentic baselines, LEMO Agent enriches high-performing candidates, improves predicted separation performance, and maintains broad chemical and topological diversity. Selected candidates are further reconstructed, evaluated by GCMC simulations, and passed through an experimental down-selection workflow based on chemical feasibility and ligand purchasability, leading to initial wet-lab synthesis and SEM characterization. These results demonstrate that large language model agents can serve as interpretable and scalable design engines for accelerating MOF discovery beyond conventional fixed-library screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEMO Agent，一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，用于金属有机框架（MOF）的逆设计。该框架通过闭环的"生成-验证-评估-记忆"循环，在MOFid空间中搜索高性能的气体分离MOF候选材料，并在CH₄/N₂和CO₂/N₂分离任务上验证了其有效性，部分候选材料已进入湿法合成和SEM表征阶段。
AI.motivation: MOF具有高度模块化的气体分离平台，但其巨大的网状设计空间使得在化学有效性、分离性能和结构多样性等多重约束下进行逆设计非常困难。传统固定库筛选方法效率有限，亟需一种可解释、可扩展的新设计范式。
AI.method: 提出LEMO Agent框架，包含以下核心组件：(1) 基于语言模型的候选生成，(2) MOFid标准化，(3) 显式化学有效性检查，(4) Transformer基属性预测，(5) 结构化设计记忆，(6) 多岛探索策略。通过迭代的生成-验证-评估-记忆循环，利用成功和失败候选的反馈信息指导化学约束搜索，遍历连接子、金属和拓扑选择空间。
AI.result: 在CH₄/N₂和CO₂/N₂分离任务上，LEMO Agent相比生成式、优化式和智能体基线方法，能够富集高性能候选、提升预测分离性能，并维持广泛的化学和拓扑多样性。部分候选经GCMC模拟评估和实验下行筛选（化学可行性、配体可购买性）后，已进入湿法合成和SEM表征阶段。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型智能体可以作为可解释且可扩展的设计引擎，加速MOF发现，超越传统固定库筛选方法的局限。

title: FAD-SA-GRU: Enhancing Hate Speech Detection in Algerian Dialect Through Feature-Augmented Self-Attention GRU Networks
summary:
The widespread adoption of social media platforms has transformed online communication by enabling users to exchange information and opinions instantly. However, these platforms have also facilitated the dissemination of abusive and hateful content, posing major social, psychological, and ethical challenges. Hate speech can incite discrimination, harassment, and violence against individuals or communities based on attributes such as ethnicity, religion, gender, nationality, or political affiliation. Consequently, automatic hate speech detection has become a major research topic in natural language processing (NLP) and an essential component of content moderation systems.
  This paper investigates automatic hate speech detection in the Algerian Arabic dialect (Darija) on social media. This task remains challenging because of the dialect's linguistic diversity, characterized by the coexistence of Arabic, French, and Arabizi (Arabic written using the Latin alphabet). We compare four categories of text classification approaches: (1) traditional machine learning models using TF-IDF features, (2) deep learning models based on recurrent neural networks, (3) Transformer-based language models, including DziriBERT and multilingual BERT, and (4) a novel hybrid architecture, FAD-SA-GRU, which combines semantic representations from DZ FastText, DZ AraVec, and DziriBERT through multi-embedding fusion, followed by a self-attention-enhanced GRU encoder.
  Experiments on an annotated dataset of Algerian Darija social media comments for binary hate speech classification show that FAD-SA-GRU outperforms all baselines, achieving 93.2% accuracy, 93.4% precision, 91.0% recall, 92.1% F1-score, and 97.0% ROC-AUC. Results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining complementary embedding representations with attention-based sequence modeling for robust hate speech detection in low-resource dialectal Arabic.

AI.tldr: 本文针对阿尔及利亚阿拉伯方言（Darija）社交媒体上的仇恨言论自动检测问题，提出了一种名为FAD-SA-GRU的混合架构，通过融合DZ FastText、DZ AraVec和DziriBERT的多嵌入表示并结合自注意力增强的GRU编码器，在二分类仇恨言论检测数据集上达到93.2%的准确率，优于传统机器学习、深度学习和Transformer基线模型。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上仇恨言论的传播引发了严重的社交、心理和伦理问题，而阿尔及利亚阿拉伯方言（Darija）由于同时使用阿拉伯语、法语和Arabizi（拉丁字母书写的阿拉伯语），语言多样性显著，现有自动检测方法在该低资源方言上效果不佳，亟需针对性的检测方案。
AI.method: 比较四类文本分类方法：(1) 基于TF-IDF的传统机器学习模型；(2) 基于循环神经网络的深度学习模型；(3) Transformer语言模型（DziriBERT和多语言BERT）；(4) 提出的混合架构FAD-SA-GRU，通过多嵌入融合（DZ FastText、DZ AraVec、DziriBERT）结合自注意力增强的GRU编码器进行仇恨言论分类。
AI.result: FAD-SA-GRU在阿尔及利亚Darija社交媒体评论的仇恨言论二分类数据集上达到93.2%准确率、93.4%精确率、91.0%召回率、92.1% F1分数和97.0% ROC-AUC，优于所有基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 结合互补的嵌入表示与基于注意力的序列建模能够有效提升低资源方言阿拉伯语环境下仇恨言论检测的鲁棒性。

title: Affordance-Based Manipulation Planning with Text Goals and Sim-to-Real Generalisation via Real-to-Sim Image Conversion
summary: We present a manipulation planning system based on affordance recognition and action effect prediction. The system reasons through possible futures in visual form, and evaluates candidate plans by agreement of predicted outcomes with text-based goals set at run-time, using a multi-modal goal-matching module. Positions of objects named in the goal text are tracked through predictions even when occluded, making it possible to generate action plans even when objects become occluded, or when their initial descriptors cease to identify them in future states. We further expand the system with an image conversion module for translating real-world state images with objects of varied shapes and visual appearances into a consistent visual appearance, to facilitate manipulation planning in a physical robot setup. We evaluate performance of the system's modules in isolation and demonstrate the integrated system's manipulation planning capabilities on a set of challenging tasks in both simulation and on hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于 affordance 识别和动作效果预测的机器人操作规划系统。该系统通过视觉形式推理可能的未来状态，利用多模态目标匹配模块评估候选计划与运行时设定的文本目标的一致性。即使物体被遮挡或初始描述符失效，系统仍能通过预测跟踪目标物体位置。此外，引入了图像转换模块将真实世界状态图像统一为一致视觉外观，便于物理机器人操作规划。在仿真和硬件上验证了系统性能。
AI.motivation: 现有操作规划系统难以处理物体遮挡、视觉外观多样性以及运行时灵活设定文本目标的问题，需要一种能够通过视觉推理未来状态、跟踪遮挡物体并适配物理机器人的统一规划框架。
AI.method: 1) 基于 affordance 识别和动作效果预测的视觉推理模块；2) 多模态目标匹配模块，用于评估预测结果与文本目标的一致性；3) 物体位置跟踪机制，支持遮挡情况下的持续预测；4) 图像转换模块，将不同形状和外观的真实世界图像统一为标准视觉表示。
AI.result: 在仿真和硬件上完成了多项具有挑战性的操作任务，分别评估了各模块的性能，并展示了集成系统的操作规划能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了通过视觉未来推理、遮挡下物体跟踪以及多模态目标匹配相结合的方法，能够有效实现灵活、鲁棒的机器人操作规划，并在物理机器人上具备可行性。

title: SynthDocBench: Controlled Benchmark for Long-Context Visual Document Understanding
comment: 29 Pages, 27 Tables, 13 Figures, Accepted at COLM 2026
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on visual document understanding benchmarks such as DocVQA, ChartQA, and MMLongBench-Doc. However, real-world documents combine multiple factors such as length, layout complexity, modality, and question difficulty, which makes it difficult to attribute model failures to specific causes. We introduce SynthDocBench, a fully synthetic benchmark for long-context visual document understanding that systematically controls factors including document length, layout structure, modality composition, and question type. The benchmark is constructed using a combinatorial design, each factor is varied independently across generated documents, enabling controlled analysis of model behavior. Documents are generated end to end using an LLM pipeline across six layout archetypes, with a 40 percent random override to prevent models from exploiting spurious correlations. Additionally, SynthDocBench spans long-context documents with substantially greater length and structural diversity than existing benchmarks. Evaluating seven frontier VLMs, we uncover three failure modes that existing benchmarks cannot surface: sharp degradation with document length, a systematic positional sensitivity in which the middle third of a document is hardest for five of six models and five of six models show a negative Early-to-Late trend (steepest decline: 8.3 percentage points), and breakdown of chart comprehension in long-document settings. These results suggest that current models may be overfitting to benchmark artifacts rather than achieving robust long-context visual document understanding.

AI.tldr: SynthDocBench是一个全合成、多因素可控的长上下文视觉文档理解基准，通过系统性控制文档长度、布局结构、模态组合和问题类型等变量，揭示了现有前沿VLM在长文档理解中的三大失效模式：随长度急剧退化、中间三分之一区域的位置敏感性、以及长文档场景下图表的理解崩溃。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在视觉文档理解基准上表现强劲，但真实文档中长度、布局复杂度、模态和问题难度等多因素交织，难以将模型失败归因于特定原因。需要一个能系统控制各因素、支持细粒度归因分析的基准来揭示模型真实能力缺陷。
AI.method: 采用组合设计方法，独立变化文档长度、布局结构、模态组成和问题类型四个因素；通过LLM流水线在六种布局原型上端到端生成文档，并引入40%随机覆盖机制防止模型利用虚假相关性；生成长度与结构多样性远超现有基准的长上下文文档。
AI.result: 评估7个前沿VLM后发现三个现有基准无法揭示的失效模式：1) 随文档长度急剧退化；2) 系统性位置敏感性——5/6模型在文档中间三分之一区域表现最差，且5/6模型呈现负的Early-to-Late趋势（最陡下降8.3个百分点）；3) 长文档场景下图表理解能力崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM可能是在过拟合基准伪影而非真正实现了鲁棒的长上下文视觉文档理解能力。

title: The Differential Neural Tangent Kernel and Its Positivity
summary: The Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) is one powerful tool for analyzing the training dynamics of neural networks in the over-parameterized regime. Recently, the theoretical framework has been extended to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving linear PDEs, one highly popular class of neural PDE solvers. In the analysis, the positivity of the associated NTK plays a fundamental role. However, establishing the positivity of the NTK for PINNs is highly challenging, due to the presence of multiple differential operators. In this work, we propose a new theoretical framework, called Differential Neural Tangent Kernel (DNTK), for analyzing PINNs through the lens of the NTK, and establish the positivity of the infinite width DNTK for both shallow and deep neural networks for a wide class of activation functions, including RePU and smooth but non-polynomial activations, for all linear differential operators. These theoretical results lay the foundation for the analysis of gradient type algorithms for training PINNs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出微分神经正切核（DNTK）框架，用于分析物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的训练动力学，并建立了浅层和深层神经网络在无限宽度下DNTK的正性，适用于多种激活函数和所有线性微分算子。
AI.motivation: 神经正切核（NTK）是分析过参数化神经网络训练动力学的强大工具，但将其扩展到PINNs时，由于多个微分算子的存在，建立NTK的正性极具挑战性。本文旨在解决这一难题。
AI.method: 提出微分神经正切核（DNTK）这一新理论框架，通过该框架分析PINNs的NTK，并证明无限宽度下浅层和深层神经网络DNTK的正性，涵盖RePU和光滑非多项式激活函数及所有线性微分算子。
AI.result: 成功建立了DNTK的正性，适用于多种激活函数和所有线性微分算子，为后续分析PINNs的梯度类训练算法奠定了理论基础。
AI.conclusion: DNTK框架有效解决了NTK在PINNs中正性证明的困难，为分析PINNs训练动力学提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: CRiT-QA: Evaluating Multi-hop Reasoning with Counterfactual Chains and Distractor Traps
summary: Evaluating the multi-hop reasoning capabilities of large language models remains a significant challenge. Although current models achieve strong results on existing multi-hop question answering datasets, such performance often masks two critical vulnerabilities: (1) reliance on internal parametric knowledge rather than adherence to the provided context, and (2) exploitation of dataset shortcuts, such as single-document cues or type-matching, that diminish the need for genuine evidence aggregation across multiple documents. We introduce CRiT-QA (Counterfactual Reasoning with Traps), a dataset explicitly designed to address both limitations. To neutralize reliance on memorized knowledge and enforce strict context dependency, CRiT-QA transforms factual reasoning chains with counterfactual entities. Furthermore, it injects multi-anchor distractor chains, plausible but incorrect reasoning paths that diverge at different hops. These traps require models to follow the entire reasoning process rather than exploiting shallow heuristics. Our experiments show that LLMs exhibit substantial performance degradation on CRiT-QA compared to standard datasets, exposing their vulnerability to counterfactual conditions and distractor traps. CRiT-QA thus serves as a rigorous diagnostic tool for evaluating genuine multi-hop reasoning and provides a foundation for developing more reliable, evidence-grounded LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRiT-QA数据集，通过反事实实体转换和多重干扰链注入，解决大语言模型在多跳推理中依赖参数知识和利用数据集捷径的问题。实验表明LLMs在该数据集上性能显著下降，揭示了其在真实多跳推理中的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLMs在多跳问答数据集上表现良好，但这种高性能往往掩盖了两个关键缺陷：(1)过度依赖内部参数知识而非上下文；(2)利用数据集捷径（如单文档线索或类型匹配），降低了跨文档证据聚合的必要性。
AI.method: 构建CRiT-QA数据集：(1)通过反事实实体替换将事实推理链转化为严格依赖上下文的推理链；(2)注入多锚点干扰链（distractor chains），即看似合理但在不同跳数发生偏离的错误推理路径，迫使模型完成完整推理过程而无法利用浅层启发式策略。
AI.result: LLMs在CRiT-QA上的性能相较于标准数据集显著下降，暴露了其在反事实条件和干扰链陷阱下的脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: CRiT-QA可作为评估真实多跳推理能力的严格诊断工具，并为开发更可靠、以证据为基础的LLMs奠定基础。

title: The In-Car Sign Language Corpus (ICSL): A Multi-Modal Resource for Constrained-Space Sign Language Recognition
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the LREC2026 12th Workshop on the Representation and Processing of Sign Languages: Language in Motion Original publication: https://www.sign-lang.uni-hamburg.de/lrec/pub/26.html The paper is distributed under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license. Link to paper: https://www.sign-lang.uni-hamburg.de/lrec/pub/26033.html
summary: This paper addresses the challenges of using sign language within shared mobility services, such as taxis, carpools, or ride-sharing platforms. The use of sign language recognition (SLR) in real-world, confined environments, specifically vehicle interiors remains largely unexplored. To motivate research in this area, we present the In-Car Sign Language (ICSL) dataset for Brazilian Sign Language (Libras), with the long-term goal of improving public transport accessibility for the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing community. The dataset consists of: (1) high-precision laboratory motion capture (MoCap) data to establish an idealized linguistic baseline and (2) real-world multi-modal in-car recordings captured using a 2D camera and 3D Time-of-Flight sensors. The dataset provides a basis for comparative analyses between synthesized signing avatar animations and recorded real signing interpreter videos, which enable future research into robust "in-the-wild" SLR models and domain adaptation. We describe in detail the use cases, the setup, the data collection protocol, and the metadata structure of the corpus. In total, we recorded a multimodal dataset exceeding 1.5 million frames, comprising the synchronized multimodal streams described above featuring Libras users across various in-car scenarios. The corpus is provided with gloss annotation of lexical signs and non-lexical sign language elements specially designed to support the training and evaluation of deep neural networks for constrained space recognition. In-vehicle signing offers a technically significant example of a constrained, occluded, and non-frontal environment. While recognizing the diverse communication strategies already employed by the Deaf community, identifying automotive-specific limitations provides a useful stepping stone for research into enhancing in-car accessibility and passenger quality of life.

AI.tldr: 本文针对共享出行服务中手语识别面临的挑战，提出了面向巴西手语(Libras)的车内手语(ICSL)数据集。该数据集包含高精度实验室运动捕捉数据和真实场景下多模态车内记录，总计超过150万帧，支持受限、遮挡、非正面环境下的手语识别研究，旨在改善聋哑及听障群体的公共交通可及性。
AI.motivation: 现有手语识别研究多集中于理想环境，而共享出行场景（如出租车、网约车）中车内空间受限、视角非正面、存在遮挡等问题尚未被探索。为促进该领域研究并提升聋哑群体公共交通可及性，作者构建了车内手语数据集。
AI.method: 构建ICSL数据集：(1) 高精度实验室MoCap数据建立语言学基线；(2) 真实车内环境下2D摄像头和3D ToF传感器多模态同步采集；(3) 提供词汇手语和非词汇手语元素的注释标注，支持深度神经网络训练。
AI.result: 构建了超过150万帧的多模态数据集，包含同步的MoCap、2D及3D传感器数据，涵盖多种车内场景，并提供了完整的词汇级注释。
AI.conclusion: 车内手语识别是一个技术上有意义的受限、遮挡、非正面环境案例，该数据集为未来鲁棒的"野外"手语识别模型和域适应研究提供了基础，有助于提升车内无障碍设施及乘客生活质量。

title: Whole-Body Semantic-to-Actuation Grounding of Elephant-Inspired Soft-Trunk Motion via Lightweight Flow Matching
summary: For close-contact human-robot interaction (HRI), trunk-like continuum manipulators provide a physical channel for diverse whole-body expression, but grounding open-vocabulary responses into such robots is difficult: end-effector motion underspecifies body shape, whereas direct whole-body commands are high-dimensional and hard to keep feasible. We propose a whole-body semantic-to-actuation grounding framework for elephant-inspired soft-trunk HRI based on lightweight flow matching. The framework converts responses from a multimodal large language model into bounded, morphology-aligned intent-intensity tuples, parameterizes tendon-actuation trajectories with compact Catmull-Rom spline controls, and uses a rectified-flow generator to sample feasible whole-body trunk motions. Experiments show that the proposed framework improves held-out grounding correctness from 25.0% to 77.2% over a raw-response dense-regression baseline. Compared with a denoising-diffusion baseline, it improves correctness from 71.9% to 77.2% and reduces inference time from 7.86 ms to 4.87 ms while preserving motion diversity. A 100-participant physical HRI study further shows that adding the generated soft-trunk motion channel increases the positive overall-satisfaction rating from 46% to 82% over the audiovisual-only baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于轻量级流匹配的全身语义到驱动映射框架，用于象鼻软体连续体机械臂的人机交互，将多模态大语言模型的响应转化为可行的全身躯干运动，实验表明正确率从25.0%提升至77.2%，推理时间降至4.87ms，且物理HRI研究中用户满意度从46%提升至82%。
AI.motivation: 连续体机械臂为人机交互提供了丰富的全身表达通道，但将开放词汇的响应映射到这类机器人存在困难：末端执行器运动无法充分描述体态，而全身直接指令维度高且难以保证可行性。
AI.method: 基于轻量级流匹配的语义到驱动映射框架：将多模态大语言模型响应转化为与形态对齐的意图-强度元组，用Catmull-Rom样条参数化肌腱驱动轨迹，并通过整流流生成器采样可行的全身躯干运动。
AI.result: 在保留测试中，正确率从25.0%（密集回归基线）提升至77.2%，相比去噪扩散基线从71.9%提升至77.2%，推理时间从7.86ms降至4.87ms。物理HRI研究中，用户满意度从46%提升至82%。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能有效实现开放词汇语义到软体连续体机械臂全身运动的映射，显著提升交互正确性和用户满意度，且具有较低推理延迟。

title: TVT-PAPD: Pathology-Aware Prototype Distillation for Self-Supervised Whole Slide Image Classification
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as an effective paradigm for learning transferable representations from large-scale unlabeled whole slide images (WSIs). However, existing SSL methods primarily learn generic visual features and often fail to explicitly capture pathology-specific morphological patterns that are critical for disease characterization. To address this limitation, we propose Tiny Vision Transformer with Pathology-Aware Prototype Distillation (TVT-PAPD). This self-supervised pathology representation learning framework integrates a Tiny Vision Transformer (TVT) with a novel Pathology-Aware Prototype Distillation (PAPD) module. PAPD employs a learnable pathology prototype bank to discover and preserve representative tissue morphology patterns, encouraging semantically similar pathological regions to learn consistent and discriminative representations. The proposed framework enhances pathology-aware feature learning while maintaining computational efficiency with 90M parameters. Experiments on the Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) low-grade glioma (LGG)/glioblastoma (GBM) dataset and the Indian Pathology Brain (IPD-Brain) dataset demonstrate that TVT-PAPD achieves weighted F1-scores of 93.02% and 90.23%, respectively, for LGG-GBM classification, while exhibiting strong cross-cohort generalization across independent glioma datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出TVT-PAPD框架，通过病理感知原型蒸馏（PAPD）模块，在自监督学习中发现并保留代表性组织形态模式，实现高效（90M参数）且准确的病理表征学习，在LGG/GBM分类任务中取得93.02%和90.23%的加权F1分数。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督学习方法在学习全切片图像表征时，主要捕获通用视觉特征，未能显式学习疾病表征所必需的特异性病理形态模式。
AI.method: 提出Tiny Vision Transformer (TVT)结合病理感知原型蒸馏模块。PAPD包含可学习的病理原型库，用于发现和保留代表性组织形态模式，促使语义相似的病理区域学习一致且可区分的表征。
AI.result: 在TCGA LGG/GBM数据集上加权F1达93.02%，在IPD-Brain数据集上达90.23%，并展现出强跨队列泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TVT-PAPD在保持计算效率（90M参数）的同时，通过学习病理感知特征，有效提升了脑胶质瘤分类性能及跨数据集泛化能力。

title: Two Confounds in Cross-Model Value Comparison: Response Determinism and the Access Harness
summary: Cross-model comparisons read divergence in value dispositions as evidence that language models hold individuated values. Under single-draw measurement this conflates two quantities: a difference in central tendency (a genuine value difference) and a difference in response determinism (how sharply a model commits to a forced choice). We introduce a separation protocol -- no-rule value dilemmas with counterbalanced, repeated forced-choice measurement and a determinism index -- and a determinism-corrected decomposition that splits an apparent cross-model distance into a direction-flip component (genuine disagreement) and a same-side-more-extreme component we label determinism. Across nine models, determinism varies substantially (0.66-0.95 among engaging models); whether it is a per-model trait or tracks provider and scale is a question our method makes measurable but our sample leaves open. Correcting for determinism shrinks apparent individuation, while a few cross-family disagreements survive a strict test. We then isolate a second confound: the access harness serving each model. Re-collecting the same models through raw provider APIs, we find the deployment client shifts a model's value profile substantially and client-specifically: one subscription CLI moves a profile by 0.31, flips four of eighteen items, and inflates the flagship's apparent softness (0.34 via CLI vs 0.66 via raw API), whereas another provider's client is clean, confounding provider family with access client. The harness is a value-shaping layer: a base model that refuses one-in-ten forced choices is made compliant by an agent system prompt, established causally in a white-box control. An audit ranking models by single-draw value distance thus ranks a determinism-inflated quantity, confounded further by the client used. We contribute the decomposition and identify the deployment harness as a distinct value confound.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了跨模型价值比较中的两个混淆因素：响应确定性（模型对强制选择的承诺程度）和访问接口（部署客户端的差异）。作者提出分离协议（无规则价值困境、重复强制选择测量、确定性指数）和确定性校正分解方法，将表观跨模型距离分解为方向翻转成分（真正分歧）和同侧更极端成分（确定性）。在9个模型中发现确定性差异显著（0.66-0.95），校正后表观个体化缩小。此外，同一模型通过不同API客户端收集会大幅偏移价值轮廓，部署客户端是价值塑造层。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模型价值比较采用单次测量，混淆了中心趋势差异（真正价值差异）和响应确定性差异（模型对强制选择的承诺程度），导致无法准确衡量模型间真实价值分歧。
AI.method: 提出分离协议：(1) 无规则价值困境；(2) 反平衡重复强制选择测量；(3) 确定性指数。引入确定性校正分解：将表观跨模型距离分解为方向翻转成分（真正分歧）和同侧更极端成分（确定性）。同时通过对比原始API和订阅CLI等不同访问接口收集的数据，隔离部署客户端的影响。
AI.result: 9个模型中确定性变化范围为0.66-0.95；校正确定性后模型间表观个体化缩小；部署客户端（如订阅CLI）可使模型价值轮廓偏移高达0.31，翻转18个价值项中的4个，旗舰模型的确定性从0.66（原始API）降至0.34（CLI）；不同提供商的客户端影响差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型价值排名实际排名的是被确定性膨胀的量，且进一步被访问客户端混淆。部署接口是独立的价值混淆因素，研究贡献了分解方法和这一发现。

title: Laguerre Geometry for Interpreting Large Language Models
summary: Existing hypotheses represent a concept in an LLM as a single point, a linear direction, or a Gaussian cluster, yet it remains unclear how and why such structures emerge. Here, we show that concept geometry can be precisely characterized via Laguerre Geometry, in which a concept is defined as a region--a Laguerre-Voronoi cell or a union of cells--allowing us to strictly define, measure, and separate concepts. Building on this formulation, we show that finer-grained concept structures, such as inclusion and hierarchy, are naturally revealed by the Laguerre weights. We then push this geometry inside the transformer. Decomposing each layer into piecewise-linear operators, we show that a token's hidden trajectory is governed by two coupled mechanisms: a static tree of self-contained piecewise-linear flow, and a dynamic transport that hops the trajectory across trees when cross-token attention fires. This decomposition yields Geometric Lens, a training-free, hyperparameter-free method for reading out the exact concept a hidden vector encodes at any layer. We also develop Laguerre Autoencoder, a 2D visualizer that renders both the decision geometry and a model's full reasoning trajectory in one view. Finally, we move beyond explanatory geometry toward actionable interpretability, showing that Geometric Lens recovers the correct factual token when a model is prompted with in-context interference. The code is available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用Laguerre几何来精确刻画LLM中的概念几何结构，将概念定义为区域（Laguerre-Voronoi胞腔或胞腔并集），并由此发展出Geometric Lens——一种无需训练、无需超参数的方法，可在任意层读取出隐藏向量编码的具体概念。同时提出Laguerre Autoencoder进行2D可视化，并在上下文干扰场景中验证了其可解释性价值。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM概念表示假设（单点、线性方向、高斯聚类）无法解释概念结构如何及为何涌现，缺乏精确的几何刻画工具。
AI.method: 利用Laguerre几何将概念定义为区域（Laguerre-Voronoi胞腔或并集），并分解Transformer每层为分段线性算子，揭示token隐藏轨迹由两种耦合机制（静态分段线性流树与动态跨token注意力跳跃）共同驱动，在此基础上设计Geometric Lens和Laguerre Autoencoder。
AI.result: Geometric Lens能在任意层精确读出隐藏向量编码的概念；Laguerre Autoencoder可2D可视化决策几何与完整推理轨迹；在上下文干扰提示下能恢复正确事实token。
AI.conclusion: Laguerre几何为LLM概念表征提供了精确的数学框架，Geometric Lens实现了从解释性几何到可操作可解释性的跨越，为理解LLM内部机制提供了有力工具。

title: Characterising AI Models for Cataloguing
summary: The creation of digital collections involves not only the digitisation of content, but also the creation of catalogue records for it. This often-overlooked task requires slow and costly expert manual work. In this project, we have evaluated the application of AI models to this task, comparing different implementations and models. This work includes a qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the experiments carried out, as well as recommendations on the use of AI models that go beyond the specific use case.

AI.tldr: 本论文探讨了AI模型在数字馆藏编目记录创建中的应用，通过对比不同实现和模型，进行了定性与定量评估，并提出了超越特定用例的AI模型使用建议。
AI.motivation: 数字馆藏创建过程中，编目记录的制作是一项常被忽视但需要缓慢且昂贵的专家手工劳动的任务，因此需要探索自动化解决方案以提高效率并降低成本。
AI.method: 评估了多种AI模型在不同实现方案下应用于编目记录创建任务的效果，并进行了定性与定量对比实验。
AI.result: 通过实验获得了不同AI模型在编目任务上的性能表现数据，并形成了相应的定性和定量评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 提出了关于使用AI模型的一般性建议，这些建议不仅适用于特定的编目用例，还可推广至更广泛的场景。

title: SegDiff: Segmented Trajectory Diffusion for Consistent and Adaptive Robot Manipulation
summary: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire manipulation skills from demonstrations by mapping observations to actions. Existing approaches predict either short-horizon continuous action sequences or discrete keyposes. However, continuous prediction methods suffer from compounding errors due to short prediction horizons and struggle with multi-modal action distributions, whereas keypose-based methods necessitate an external planner, constraining real-time applicability. To address these challenges, we introduce SegDiff, a closed-loop visuomotor policy that integrates the strengths of both paradigms. SegDiff decomposes demonstrations into motion segments between keyposes and learns to predict the continuous trajectory from the current state to the next keypose, enabling long-horizon prediction with real-time refinement. Furthermore, we leverage the capability of diffusion models and DDIM inversion to propose a Dynamic Temporal Ensembling mechanism, which allows the policy to efficiently respond to dynamic environments and mitigate discontinuities caused by inconsistent multi-modal sampling. SegDiff demonstrates significant performance gains over existing approaches across various simulated and real-world scenarios, indicating its strong ability to reason over extended temporal dependencies while maintaining real-time adaptability and control stability.

AI.tldr: SegDiff是一种闭环视觉运动策略，通过将演示分解为关键帧间的运动片段，并利用扩散模型和DDIM反演的动态时间集成机制，实现长时域预测与实时自适应控制，在模拟和真实场景中均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有模仿学习方法存在两大问题：连续预测方法因短预测视界导致累积误差且难以处理多模态动作分布；基于关键帧的方法需要外部规划器，限制了实时应用能力。SegDiff旨在融合两种范式的优势，解决上述挑战。
AI.method: 1) 将演示分解为关键帧间的运动片段；2) 学习从当前状态到下一关键帧的连续轨迹预测，实现长时域预测与实时精化；3) 利用扩散模型和DDIM反演提出动态时间集成机制，使策略能高效响应动态环境并缓解多模态采样的不连续性。
AI.result: 在多种模拟和真实世界场景中，SegDiff相比现有方法取得了显著的性能提升，展现了其在扩展时间依赖推理、实时自适应能力和控制稳定性方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: SegDiff通过融合连续预测与关键帧方法的优势，有效解决了长时域预测中的累积误差和实时控制问题，为机器人模仿学习提供了一种高效且稳定的闭环策略。

title: GNOCHI: Generative Neural mOdel for Close Human-Human Interactions
summary: Creating realistic 3D human-human interactions in virtual environments is challenging due to the high degrees of freedom in the human body and the need for physically accurate poses that do not collide with each other. Traditional methods for human-human interaction are based on motion tracking or 3D body reconstruction, but lack generative capabilities. Recent generative methods enable the synthesis of individual or interacting motions via text or image input, but generally fall short in modeling close interactions. This paper introduces a novel generative model for close 3D human-human interactions using a conditional variational autoencoder (cVAE), which generates poses for one human conditioned on the pose of another, allowing for controlled and diverse interaction synthesis. To train our model, we address two underlying long-standing challenges in the field of human-human interaction: data scarcity, for which we propose an automated supervised data augmentation strategy that generates synthetic yet realistic interaction poses; and collision awareness in generative approaches, for which we propose a self-supervised loss based on a collision resolution technique using volumetric proxies to ensure physically correct interactions. We extensively evaluate the capabilities of our model, and demonstrate a wide variety of plausible and physically correct interactions, not possible to generate with current state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于条件变分自编码器（cVAE）的生成模型，用于生成物理准确的、无碰撞的3D人体交互姿态。通过自动监督数据增强策略缓解数据稀缺问题，并引入基于体积代理的自监督碰撞感知损失确保交互的物理正确性，生成结果优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的人体交互方法依赖运动跟踪或3D重建，缺乏生成能力；现有生成方法难以建模紧密交互且缺乏碰撞感知。此外，人体交互数据稀缺且生成过程中难以保证姿态间无物理碰撞。
AI.method: 采用条件变分自编码器（cVAE），以一个人的姿态为条件生成另一个人的姿态；提出自动监督数据增强策略生成合成交互数据；设计基于体积代理的碰撞解析技术的自监督损失函数，确保生成姿态无物理碰撞。
AI.result: 模型能够生成大量合理且物理正确的紧密交互姿态，在多样性和物理正确性上超越了当前最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文同时解决了人体交互生成中的数据稀缺和碰撞感知两大难题，为生成物理可信的3D人体紧密交互提供了有效框架。

title: When Does Depth Survive Composition? Compute--Quality Regimes in Latent World Models
summary: Adaptive-compute world models -- early-exit or mixture-of-depths predictors that spend variable depth per step -- assume depth buys better predictions and can be routed adaptively. In autoregressive rollouts, the first assumption requires depth's per-step precision to survive composition. We test this with a pre-registered instrument, the shallow penalty $ρ=\mathrm{err}(\text{shallowest-exit rollout})/\mathrm{err}(\text{full-depth rollout})$, across nine DeepMind Control tasks under matched single-step ($K=1$) and multi-step ($K=4$) training, three seeds each. We find three regimes: on 6/9 tasks depth helps rollouts (intrinsic, $ρ$ up to $4.7\times$), on 2/9 the shallow exits beat the full stack (inversion, $ρ$ down to $0.85\times$), and one is flat. The robust inversion (cheetah) is not a property of the dynamics but is created by training: an ablation supervising early exits only at the first rollout step erases it ($ρ: 0.87\to1.18$, $n=8$, $Δ=+0.31$), while an intrinsic-tradeoff task is unaffected -- a double dissociation we call the routability catch-22, since the supervision that makes exits routable is what trains them to out-roll the full stack. The regime is partly predictable a priori: observation/action dimensionality and one-step model error correlate with $ρ$ at $|\text{Spearman}|\approx0.75$ ($n=9$). Inside a CEM planner, $ρ$'s sign predicts whether planning benefits from depth, most sharply on the inversion task, where shallow planning beats deep. Finally, three cautions: a task's regime depends on the metric space, the rollout horizon, and the encoder. All thresholds and gates were fixed before the compute campaign, including a pre-registered negative for the hypothesis that motivated the study.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性研究了自适应计算世界模型中深度是否真正有益于自回归 rollout。通过在9个DeepMind Control任务上引入"浅层惩罚系数"ρ，发现了三种不同机制：深度有益(6/9)、深度反转(2/9)和平坦(1/9)。特别揭示了"可路由性catch-22"：使早期退出可路由的监督方式反而会训练它们超越全深度模型。ρ的符号可以预测CEM规划器是否受益于深度。
AI.motivation: 验证自适应计算世界模型的一个核心假设——深度在每步提供更好的预测精度，且在自回归展开中这一优势能够保持。具体回答：深度在自回归rollout中是否真的有用？
AI.method: 提出浅层惩罚系数ρ = err(最浅退出rollout)/err(全深度rollout)；在9个DeepMind Control任务上进行K=1和K=4训练（各3个种子）；通过消融实验（仅在第一rollout步监督早期退出）验证因果机制；分析ρ与任务特征的相关性（Spearman相关系数）。
AI.result: 识别出三种机制：深度有益(6/9, ρ高达4.7×)、深度反转(2/9, ρ低至0.85×)和平坦(1/9)。发现"可路由性catch-22"：训练中监督早期退出使其可路由的机制，反而会训练它们超越全深度模型（反转任务ρ从0.87→1.18, n=8, Δ=+0.31）。观测/动作维度和单步模型误差与ρ的Spearman相关系数达0.75。
AI.conclusion: 深度在自适应计算世界模型中并非总是有益的，存在深度反转的反直觉现象。深度是否有益部分可预测（与任务特征相关），但存在根本性权衡（catch-22）。任务机制依赖于度量空间、rollout步长和编码器选择，所有阈值在计算实验前已预先注册。

title: Constraint-Aware Hierarchical Search for Regulation-Driven Fine-Grained Classification
summary: Tasks such as customs tariff classification, export control categorization, and standards-based equipment coding require assigning an input instance to a fine-grained class under an explicit regulatory hierarchy. Unlike standard text classification, the correct label in these tasks is not determined by semantic similarity alone, but by rule-defined boundaries, threshold conditions, exclusion clauses, definitions, and local exceptions. As a result, two highly similar inputs may require different labels, while a retrieved passage that appears relevant may still be inapplicable under the governing rules. Existing flat classifiers, hierarchical text classification methods, and retrieval-augmented LLM systems are not designed to jointly enforce hierarchical validity, rule consistency, and fine-grained boundary reasoning. In this paper, we formulate this setting as regulation-driven fine-grained hierarchical classification, where an external instance must be assigned to a fine-grained class through a valid path in a regulatory hierarchy and supported by auditable evidence. We construct four benchmark datasets from representative regulation-intensive scenarios and validate the annotations through an expert-in-the-loop process. We further propose a constraint-aware hierarchical search framework that converts regulatory documents into a searchable tree, retrieves only valid local candidate nodes, and uses structured regulatory fields with evidence snippets to guide each next-hop decision. Experiments show that our method achieves the best mean accuracy on all four datasets and provides interpretable decision paths, with the largest gains on cases involving fine-grained neighboring categories and rule-based boundary conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向法规驱动的细粒度层次分类任务，并设计了约束感知层次搜索框架，在四个基准数据集上取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的扁平分类器、层次文本分类方法和检索增强LLM系统无法同时满足层次有效性、规则一致性和细粒度边界推理的要求，而诸如海关关税分类、出口管制分类等任务需要依据明确的法规层次结构进行精确分类，且语义相似度不足以确定正确标签。
AI.method: 构建了四个法规密集型场景的基准数据集，通过专家在环流程验证标注；提出约束感知层次搜索框架，将法规文档转化为可搜索的树结构，仅检索有效的局部候选节点，并利用结构化法规字段和证据片段指导每一步决策。
AI.result: 该方法在全部四个数据集上取得了最佳平均准确率，尤其在涉及细粒度邻近类别和基于规则的边界条件的案例上提升最为显著，并提供可解释的决策路径。
AI.conclusion: 约束感知层次搜索框架能有效解决法规驱动下细粒度层次分类问题，在保证层次有效性和规则一致性的同时提供可审计的证据支持。

title: RefineEvo: Planning-Guided Heuristic Evolution with Bidirectional Experience
summary: Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) has emerged as a transformative approach for solving combinatorial optimization problems. While recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods have shown promise, they predominantly rely on fixed evolutionary operators and struggle to effectively accumulate and reuse historical search experience. This paper proposes RefineEvo, a novel evolutionary framework that transforms AHD from a static trial-and-error process into a planning-guided, experience-driven system. RefineEvo introduces a Planner to dynamically schedule evolutionary operators and trigger refinement based on the current search state, and a Reflector to distill valuable lessons into a Bidirectional Experience Pool containing both positive insights and negative pitfalls. This synergistic framework enables the system to adapt its search tools to the evolving complexity of the problem and leverage trajectory-aware, situation-conditioned insights to guide generation. Experiments on several classic combinatorial optimization benchmarks demonstrate that RefineEvo consistently outperforms strong baselines. In particular, RefineEvo delivers superior solution quality while improving token efficiency, enabling more efficient and autonomous heuristic design.

AI.tldr: 提出RefineEvo框架，将自动启发式设计从静态试错转变为规划引导、经验驱动的系统，通过Planner动态调度进化算子、Reflector提取经验到双向经验池，在多个组合优化基准上超越基线方法，同时提升解质量和token效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动启发式设计方法依赖固定的进化算子，难以有效积累和复用历史搜索经验，导致搜索效率低下。
AI.method: 提出RefineEvo框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Planner - 根据当前搜索状态动态调度进化算子并触发优化；(2) Reflector - 将搜索经验提炼为包含正面见解和负面陷阱的双向经验池，实现轨迹感知、情境条件化的经验引导。
AI.result: 在多个经典组合优化基准上，RefineEvo一致优于强基线方法，在提升解质量的同时提高了token效率。
AI.conclusion: 将AHD从静态试错转变为规划引导、经验驱动的系统，实现了更高效、更自主的启发式设计。

title: Learning to Navigate Efficiently with Only 0.58M Trainable Parameters
summary: Recent progress in visual navigation has largely been driven by scale: end-to-end policies with hundreds of millions of parameters trained on billions of frames or large-scale simulated data. We ask how much of this scale a single task family actually requires, and what structure can substitute for it. We propose a decomposed navigation model in which operations with known closed-form structure, such as projective geometry, occupancy, and coordinate transforms, are computed analytically and serve as interfaces between three small learned modules: an egress predictor that grounds the episode goal as a local subgoal in the current view, a navigation predictor that estimates a goal-conditioned posterior over where trajectories travel, and an endpoint-pinned residual diffusion generator that samples trajectory shapes from this posterior. The system trains only 0.58M out of a total of 22.7M parameters, on 44k frames in under one GPU-hour, yet approaches the performance of state-of-the-art models on navigation tasks across 6060 point-goal episodes and 60 environments, while having 233x fewer trainable parameters, the lowest collision rate among all evaluated methods, and 50 Hz inference speed. The decomposition further transfers to no-goal exploration by retraining only the 123k-parameter egress head, and its failure modes under sensor corruption are transparent and analytically correctable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分解式导航模型，仅用0.58M可训练参数（共22.7M参数）在44k帧数据上训练不到1GPU小时，即可在6060个点目标导航任务上接近SOTA性能，同时碰撞率最低、推理速度达50Hz，且可迁移至无目标探索任务。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉导航中当前依赖大规模数据和参数量的范式是否真的必要，以及能否通过引入结构化的先验知识（如投影几何、占据坐标变换等）来替代大规模的端到端学习。
AI.method: 提出分解导航模型，将具有已知闭式解的操作（投影几何、占据图、坐标变换）以解析方式计算，作为三个小型学习模块（出口预测器、导航预测器、端点固定残差扩散生成器）之间的接口，仅需微小的可学习参数。
AI.result: 在6060个点目标导航任务和60个环境中，以SOTA方法233倍少的可训练参数、最低碰撞率和50Hz推理速度接近SOTA性能；通过仅重训练123k参数的出口头即可迁移到无目标探索任务；在传感器损坏时的故障模式透明且可解析修正。
AI.conclusion: 通过将已知的几何结构计算与小型学习模块相结合，可以极大减少导航任务对大规模数据和参数量的依赖，同时保持高效率和强泛化能力，验证了结构化先验知识替代纯数据驱动的可行性。

title: SPORT: Structure-Aware Prototype Disentanglement for Incomplete Multi-View Clustering
summary: Prototype-based Incomplete Multi-view Clustering has recently attracted increasing attention by exploiting prototypes as semantic anchors for missing-view imputation. However, existing approaches are still limited in three aspects. First, they typically focus on enforcing cross-view prototype consistency, while ignoring view-specific information embedded in prototypes, thus limiting multi-view expressiveness. Second, most methods rely on instance-level contrastive learning that only aligns paired samples across views, failing to preserve cluster-level relational structures. Third, missing-view imputation is usually performed using global prototypes alone, without considering local geometric neighborhood structures, leading to inaccurate recovery of missing representations. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework termed Structure-aware PrOtotype disentanglement foR incomplete multi-view clusTering (SPORT), which explicitly disentangles shared and view-specific components of prototypes while preserving cluster-level relational structures. Specifically, we decouple prototypes into orthogonal shared and view-specific components, aligning only shared components to capture consensus semantics while de-correlating view-specific components to preserve complementary information. Meanwhile, a structure-aware contrastive learning mechanism is incorporated to explicitly model cluster-level relationships during cross-view representation learning. Furthermore, a hybrid imputation strategy integrates global prototype matching with local neighborhood matching, enabling joint exploitation of semantic prototypes and manifold structures for missing-view recovery. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets show that SPORT achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods under various missing rates.

AI.tldr: 提出SPORT框架，通过解耦原型为共享和视图特定组件、引入结构感知对比学习以及混合插补策略，解决不完整多视图聚类中原有方法忽视视图特定信息、未能保持聚类级关系结构以及缺失视图恢复不准确的问题，在六个基准数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于原型的不完整多视图聚类方法存在三个局限：1) 仅关注跨视图原型一致性而忽视视图特定信息；2) 仅进行实例级对比学习，未能保留聚类级关系结构；3) 仅使用全局原型进行缺失视图插补，忽视局部几何邻域结构。
AI.method: 1) 将原型解耦为正交的共享和视图特定组件，对齐共享组件以捕获共识语义，去相关视图特定组件以保留互补信息；2) 引入结构感知对比学习机制，显式建模跨视图表示学习中的聚类级关系；3) 提出混合插补策略，结合全局原型匹配与局部邻域匹配，联合利用语义原型和流形结构进行缺失视图恢复。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上，SPORT在不同缺失率下均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: SPORT通过原型解耦、结构感知对比学习和混合插补策略，有效解决了现有方法的三个局限性，显著提升了不完整多视图聚类性能。

title: Exploratory Analysis of Deep Learning Models for Forecasting Meteorological Parameters in the Agricultural Sector
summary: Accurate meteorological forecasting is essential for agricultural planning, irrigation management, and environmental decision support. This study conducts a comparative evaluation of recurrent and hybrid deep learning architectures for multivariate forecasting of reference evapotranspiration ($ET_0$), vapour pressure deficit (VPD), wind speed, and the sine and cosine components of wind direction. The analysis utilizes 134,376 hourly observations from Ioannina, Greece, spanning January 2011 to April 2026, sourced from ERA5 via the OpenMeteo Historical Weather API. Single and multi-layer GRU and LSTM networks are compared with hybrid 1D-CNN-GRU and 1D-CNN-LSTM models for two forecasting tasks: a 24-hour next-day forecast and a 168-hour week-ahead forecast. Performance is evaluated using normalized root mean squared error, the coefficient of determination, and a composite Weighted Quotient Score (WQS). The most effective purely recurrent models are a 64-unit LSTM for the 24-hour horizon, with a WQS of 0.816755, and a 1024-unit GRU for the 168-hour horizon, with a WQS of 0.779465. The hybrid CNN-GRU models achieved the highest overall scores of 0.827535 and 0.782863 for the 24-hour and 168-hour horizons, but with additionally more number of units respectively to LSTM models, while the CNN-LSTM models yield nearly identical results with substantially fewer parameters. Compared to the corresponding recurrent baselines, the hybrid models improve WQS by 1.22--1.63\% at 24 hours and by 0.44--0.45\% at 168 hours, indicating that convolutional feature extraction is more beneficial for short-term forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比评估了循环神经网络（GRU、LSTM）与混合深度学习架构（1D-CNN-GRU、1D-CNN-LSTM）在希腊约阿尼纳地区多变量参考蒸散发、蒸汽压差、风速及风向分量预报中的表现，发现混合模型在24小时和168小时预报窗口上均优于纯循环模型，且CNN-LSTM在参数效率上更具优势，卷积特征提取对短期预报提升更显著。
AI.motivation: 准确的气象预报对农业规划、灌溉管理和环境决策至关重要，而深度学习模型在气象时间序列预报中的应用效果需要系统性比较，尤其是不同类型循环网络及其与卷积网络混合架构在多变量蒸散发相关变量预报中的相对优劣尚不明确。
AI.method: 利用2011年1月至2026年4月间134,376小时观测数据，采用单层和多层GRU、LSTM及混合1D-CNN-GRU、1D-CNN-LSTM模型，对参考蒸散发、蒸汽压差、风速和风向正弦余弦分量进行24小时（次日）和168小时（未来一周）多步预报，以归一化均方根误差、决定系数和加权商数评分评估性能。
AI.result: 最佳纯循环模型为24小时窗口的64单元LSTM（WQS=0.816755）和168小时窗口的1024单元GRU（WQS=0.779465）；混合CNN-GRU模型取得最高总体评分（24h: 0.827535, 168h: 0.782863），CNN-LSTM以更少参数达到近似结果。相比基线，混合模型在24小时提升1.22-1.63%，在168小时提升0.44-0.45%。
AI.conclusion: 混合深度学习架构（尤其CNN-LSTM）在参数效率和预测精度间取得更好平衡，卷积特征提取对短期（24小时）预报的增益大于中期（168小时）预报，为气象时间序列建模提供了网络结构选择的实证依据。

title: MRUF: Multi-granularity Routing with Uncertainty-Aware Fusion for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
comment: Main paper (6 pages). Accepted for publication by IEEE International Conference on Systems and Man and and Cybernetics 2026 (IEEE SMC 2026)
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis relies on language, visual, and acoustic cues, but utterance-level modality quality may vary due to occlusion, background noise, motion blur, or imperfect transcripts, causing conventional fusion to over-trust unreliable modalities. We propose MRUF, a reliability-aware fusion method that combines multi-granularity routing with uncertainty-aware calibration. MRUF summarizes sentiment-relevant representations, performs subspace- and modality-level routing, and supervises modality routing with leave-one-out error increases to estimate utterance-level modality importance. It further predicts modality-wise uncertainty and refines modality gates through inverse-variance reweighting, while modality-invariant contrastive alignment stabilizes the shared representation space. Experiments on CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI under aligned and unaligned settings show consistent improvements over strong baselines, and mechanism analysis verifies that modalities with higher predicted uncertainty receive lower fusion weights.

AI.tldr: MRUF是一种可靠性感知的多模态融合方法，通过多粒度路由、不确定性校准和对比对齐，在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI数据集上 consistently 提升多模态情感分析性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感分析中，语言、视觉和声学线索在话语层面可能出现质量下降（如遮挡、噪声、运动模糊、不完美转录），导致传统融合方法过度信任不可靠模态。
AI.method: MRUF包含三个核心组件：1) 多粒度路由（子空间级和模态级路由）；2) 不确定性感知校准（预测模态不确定性并通过逆方差重新加权优化模态门控）；3) 模态不变对比对齐以稳定共享表示空间。模态路由通过留一法错误增量监督。
AI.result: 在对齐和未对齐设定下，CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI数据集上 consistently 优于强基线；机制分析验证了高预测不确定性模态获得更低融合权重。
AI.conclusion: MRUF有效解决了多模态融合中模态质量不均导致的过信任问题，通过显式建模模态可靠性提升了融合鲁棒性和情感分析性能。

title: Beyond Sally-Anne: Evaluating Theory of Mind in LLMs using Epistemic Schelling Points
summary: Text-based evaluations of Theory of Mind (ToM) in Large Language Models (LLMs) often involve cognitive tests akin to the Sally-Anne task that can be gamed due to exposure to relevantly similar tasks in pre-training and do not obviously test models' functional ToM abilities in ways that generalize to naturalistic settings. To address these issues, we introduce the Epistemic Asymmetry Schelling Task (EAST), a two-player dialogue game designed to benchmark robust and generalizable ToM abilities. By requiring LLM-LLM dyads to independently converge on semantic Schelling points under varying states of epistemic transparency, we evaluate whether models can robustly apply ToM to achieve coordination. Our results reveal a significant capability gap in functional social reasoning, with only frontier models successfully navigating the varying epistemic demands of the tasks. Analysis of reasoning traces shows that coordination failures are primarily driven by epistemic tracking errors, such as conflating private knowledge with mutual knowledge. Despite high performance on traditional static benchmarks, our study shows that robust social reasoning and epistemic tracking remain a critical bottleneck, providing concrete targets for future LLM evaluation and development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Epistemic Asymmetry Schelling Task (EAST)，一种双人对话游戏，用于测试LLM在自然场景下鲁棒且可泛化的心智理论能力。通过要求LLM-LLM对话对在不同认知透明度下独立收敛于语义Schelling点，评估模型是否能够稳健运用ToM实现协调。结果显示只有前沿模型能成功应对不同认知需求的任务，协调失败主要源于认知追踪错误（如混淆私有知识与共同知识）。尽管在传统静态基准上表现良好，但鲁棒的社会推理和认知追踪仍是关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于文本的ToM评估（如Sally-Anne任务）存在两个问题：一是模型可能因预训练接触过类似任务而"应试"通过；二是这些测试无法泛化到自然场景中评估模型的功能性ToM能力。因此需要一种更鲁棒且更具生态效度的评估方法。
AI.method: 设计EAST任务，让两个LLM在独立条件下（无法通信）基于对对方心智状态的推理，从一组选项中选出相同的语义Schelling点。通过操纵认知透明度（如私有信息vs共同信息），测试模型在不同认知状态下的协调能力。分析模型的推理轨迹以诊断失败原因。
AI.result: 只有前沿模型（如GPT-4等）能够成功应对不同认知透明度的任务；大多数模型在需要认知追踪的任务上表现不佳；协调失败的主要原因是模型混淆了私有知识与共同知识，即认知追踪错误。
AI.conclusion: 尽管LLM在传统静态ToM基准上表现优异，但功能性社会推理（特别是鲁棒的认知追踪能力）仍然是关键瓶颈。EAST任务为评估和提升LLM的ToM能力提供了更具挑战性和生态效度的新方向。

title: GraspGraphNet: Graph-Structured Multi-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
summary: Dexterous grasp generation across robot hands is challenging because hands differ in kinematic topology, actuation dimensions, and native command spaces. We introduce GraspGraphNet, a topology-aware grasp generation framework that represents each hand as a URDF-derived kinematic graph and directly generates executable palm poses and joint configurations. GraspGraphNet combines hierarchical object surface encoding, differentiable forward kinematics, and dynamic world-edge message passing to model evolving robot-object interactions. It applies conditional flow matching directly in executable palm-pose and joint-state space, avoiding post-processing optimization, inverse kinematics, and retargeting. Using a shared model trained on Barrett Hand, Allegro Hand, and Shadow Hand, GraspGraphNet achieves an average success rate of 83.48% with 40ms inference time per grasp on a 40-object benchmark. Without retraining, the same model achieves 72.70% success on controlled finger-removal variants, demonstrating robustness to hand-topology variations. These results suggest that graph-structured hand representations can effectively support dexterous grasp generation across robot hands with different kinematic structures. Project: https://lysees.github.io/graspgraphnet-page

AI.tldr: GraspGraphNet是一种拓扑感知的抓取生成框架，将不同机器人手表示为URDF导出的运动学图，直接在可执行掌位和关节空间中进行条件流匹配，无需后处理优化或逆运动学，在三款多指手上实现83.48%平均成功率，每抓取仅需40ms推理时间，并对未训练的变体手表现出良好泛化性。
AI.motivation: 跨机器人手的灵巧抓取生成具有挑战性，因为不同手在运动学拓扑、驱动维度和原生命令空间上存在显著差异，现有方法往往需要针对特定手型进行后处理优化或逆运动学求解，缺乏统一且高效的跨手抓取框架。
AI.method: 将机器人手表示为基于URDF的运动学图，结合层次化物体表面编码、可微正向运动学和动态世界边消息传递来建模机器人-物体交互，直接在可执行掌位和关节状态空间中应用条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching），无需后处理优化、逆运动学或重定向。
AI.result: 在Barrett Hand、Allegro Hand和Shadow Hand上使用单一共享模型训练，在40物体基准测试中平均成功率83.48%，每抓取推理时间仅40ms；在不重新训练的情况下，在受控手指移除变体上仍达72.70%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的运动学手部表示能够有效支持不同运动学结构的机器人手之间的灵巧抓取生成，表明该框架具有良好的跨手拓扑泛化能力。

title: BOCCHI: A More Realistic and Challenging Benchmark for Local Motion Blur Detection with MSDCT-UNet
summary: Local motion blur detection requires pixel-level localization of blurred regions. Existing benchmarks let models rely on gradient shortcuts that fail to transfer. We introduce BOCCHI (Blurred Objects Captured across Cameras with Human-annotated Imagery), a real-captured benchmark whose sharp regions overlap the blur gradient distribution and defeat these shortcuts, and propose MSDCT-UNet (Multi-Scale Discrete Cosine Transform UNet), a frequency-aware encoder-decoder injecting multi-scale DCT priors through DCT Attention and FiLM. MSDCT-UNet ranks first in in-domain mIoU and boundary localization on BOCCHI, and BOCCHI-trained models outperform every other training source on cross-dataset transfer with only 633 training images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出真实拍摄的局部运动模糊检测基准BOCCHI（解决梯度捷径问题）和频域感知模型MSDCT-UNet（利用多尺度DCT先验），在域内mIoU和边界定位上排名第一，且仅用633张训练图像即实现最优跨数据集迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 现有局部运动模糊检测基准存在梯度捷径（sharp区域的梯度分布与blur区域不重叠），导致模型学到的特征无法跨数据集迁移，亟需一个真实拍摄的、能消除这一捷径的基准数据集。
AI.method: 1) 构建BOCCHI基准：真实相机拍摄模糊图像，确保sharp区域与blur区域的梯度分布重叠，从而消除梯度捷径；2) 提出MSDCT-UNet：在UNet编解码器中注入多尺度DCT先验，通过DCT Attention和FiLM机制融合频域信息，增强模型对模糊边界的感知能力。
AI.result: MSDCT-UNet在BOCCHI上域内mIoU和边界定位均达到第一；在跨数据集迁移实验中，仅用633张BOCCHI训练图像的模型性能超过所有其他训练来源。
AI.conclusion: BOCCHI有效解决了梯度捷径导致的迁移性问题，MSDCT-UNet通过频域先验显著提升了模糊检测精度和泛化能力，验证了小规模高质量真实数据+频域感知架构的有效性。

title: DSSMs: State Space Models with Explicit Memory via Delay Differential Equations
summary: State Space Models (SSMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for efficient long-sequence modeling, offering parallel training and fast linear-time recurrent inference. However, like other recurrent architectures, SSMs must compress an unbounded history into a fixed-size state, which limits context retention and makes precise retrieval over long-range context inherently difficult. To overcome this limitation, we propose Delay State Space Models (DSSMs), a delay differential equation (DDE)-inspired extension of diagonal SSMs that augments discrete SSM recurrences with explicit delayed-state feedback. Making explicit delayed feedback practical requires new stability parameterization, history management, and FFT-training tools. We address these challenges with a practical discretization and parameterization grounded in a simple delay-independent stability condition. To bypass direct time-domain kernel construction, we derive the DSSM transfer function and compute kernels in the frequency domain, using a kernel contour shift to suppress aliasing and recover accurate FFT training. Empirically, DSSMs substantially improve targeted delayed-retrieval tasks while outperforming S4D on most standard sequence metrics and remaining close on the others.

AI.tldr: 提出延迟状态空间模型（DSSM），通过引入显式延迟状态反馈来增强状态空间模型的长程上下文保持能力，并设计了稳定性参数化、历史管理和FFT训练工具，在延迟检索任务上显著提升，在标准序列指标上整体优于S4D。
AI.motivation: 传统状态空间模型（SSM）需将无界历史压缩到固定大小状态中，导致上下文保留受限，难以精确检索长程信息。为克服这一根本性局限，提出DSSM。
AI.method: 基于延迟微分方程（DDE）思想，在离散SSM循环中引入显式延迟状态反馈；提出延迟无关稳定性条件指导下的实用离散化与参数化方案；通过频域推导传递函数并计算核函数，利用核轮廓移位抑制混叠，实现精确FFT训练。
AI.result: DSSM在目标延迟检索任务上大幅提升；在大多数标准序列指标上优于S4D，其余指标接近。
AI.conclusion: 显式延迟反馈是一种有效的长程上下文建模策略，DSSM在保持高效训练和推理的同时显著改善了SSM的上下文保持能力。

title: Agentic-DPO: From Imitation to Agentic Policy Optimization on Expert Trajectories
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are commonly trained from expert trajectories using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which treats multi-turn agent behavior as ordinary text imitation. This recipe is simple and low-cost, but it only learns to imitate the sequence of expert actions, rather than training the agent to choose the right action against plausible mistakes at each state. Existing methods to mitigate this problem include preference learning or reinforcement learning, but they usually need high-cost environment rollouts and reward models. We propose Agentic-DPO, a lightweight offline agent policy optimization method that turns expert trajectories into state-conditioned preference supervision. At each expert action state, Agentic-DPO samples a one-step action from the current state, treats plausible wrong actions as negatives, and contrasts them with the expert action using a DPO-style preference objective. To avoid mixing both policy and schema in preference learning, we introduce Policy-Preserving Augmentation (PPA), which renders the same latent trajectory under multiple schemas while keeping the expert policy fixed. Agentic-DPO requires no online environment rollout, reward model, or full-trajectory student exploration. We conduct experiments across StableToolBench, tau-bench retail, and Mind2Web, where Agentic-DPO consistently improves agents at different model scales beyond imitation. In particular, it raises tau-bench accuracy from 21.7% (SFT) to 41.4% for a 9B model, matching online GRPO under the same backbone with only step-level rollouts and without environment interaction during gradient steps. The results suggest that expert trajectories can support low-cost agentic policy optimization when converted from demonstrations into state-level action preferences. Code for Agentic-DPO is released at https://github.com/Schuture/Agentic-DPO.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic-DPO方法，通过将专家轨迹转化为状态条件偏好，实现轻量级离线智能体策略优化，无需在线环境交互或奖励模型，在多个基准上显著超越模仿学习。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体常用的监督微调（SFT）方法仅学习模仿专家动作序列，而非训练智能体在每个状态下从错误选项中选出正确动作。现有偏好学习或强化学习方法需要高成本的环境交互和奖励模型。
AI.method: Agentic-DPO在每步专家动作状态，从当前策略采样一步动作，将合理错误动作视为负例，使用DPO式偏好目标与专家动作对比优化。引入策略保留增强（PPA）在保持策略不变下渲染不同模式的同一潜在轨迹，分离策略与模式学习。
AI.result: 在StableToolBench、tau-bench retail和Mind2Web上一致超越SFT；tau-bench上9B模型准确率从21.7%（SFT）提升至41.4%，匹配在线GRPO性能，且仅需步级展开，无需环境交互。
AI.conclusion: 专家轨迹可通过转化为状态级动作偏好支持低成本智能体策略优化。

title: Agentic Routing: The Harness-Native Data Flywheel
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly executed not by a single model call, but by an execution harness that manages observation, context, control, action, state, and verification. At the same time, frontier and open models are becoming structurally specialized: a model that is strong at code editing, long-context recovery, tool use, mathematical reasoning, or low-latency response may not dominate on the other axes. This makes model selection inside an agent a core systems problem rather than a per-query serving trick. Existing routing methods mostly optimize single-turn cost-quality trade-offs and therefore miss the execution state, intermediate failures, and feedback loops that make agents different from chat completion. We propose Harness-Native agentic routing, a step-level routing paradigm that selects either a single best-fit model for cost-effective execution or multiple complementary models for ensemble-style accuracy improvement, conditioned on the full harness state. The key insight is that every routing decision naturally produces a structured data record -- consisting of the query, harness state, model choice or model set, execution trace, outcome, and cost -- whose labels are supplied by the environment rather than by the router itself. These records form a harness-native data flywheel: execution traces train better routers and harness-native models, which improve cost-quality trade-offs and generate more traces under the same budget. We instantiate this idea in OpenSquilla with a four-layer routing stack, an open LightGBM cold-start ranker, and a staged router-model path that turns logged arena records into progressively stronger routing policies. The report studies singleton and multi-model routing on agentic benchmarks including DRACO and PinchBench, and argues that agentic routing is not merely cost control, but a data engine for agent-native training.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向智能体系统的、基于步骤级别的原生路由范式（Harness-Native Agentic Routing），能根据完整执行状态选择单模型或多模型，并利用执行轨迹构建数据飞轮，持续提升路由策略与模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有路由方法主要优化单轮成本-质量权衡，忽略了智能体执行中的状态、中间失败和反馈循环，无法有效处理多步骤、多状态的智能体场景。
AI.method: 提出步骤级路由范式，基于完整执行状态选择单模型（最优性价比）或多模型（集成式精度提升）；利用路由决策产生的结构化数据记录（查询、状态、模型选择、轨迹、结果、成本）构建原生数据飞轮；实例化为OpenSquilla系统，包含四层路由栈、LightGBM冷启动排序器和分阶段路由-模型路径。
AI.result: 在DRACO和PinchBench等智能体基准上分别检验了单模型和多模型路由效果，证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 智能体路由不仅是成本控制手段，更是一种面向智能体原生训练的数据引擎。

title: PAKE: Learning Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation with Partial Kinematic Embeddings
summary: Loco-manipulation has recently shown promising capabilities; however, achieving high-precision control, managing the high-dimensional action space induced by many degrees of freedom (DoFs), and fully exploiting the inherent redundancy of whole-body systems remain challenging. In this paper, we propose a novel whole-body control framework that effectively addresses these challenges by decomposing the complex loco-manipulation problem into partial reference motion generation and low-level imitation control. We introduce a new Kinematic Normalizing Flow (KNF) model, trained on a large-scale kinematic dataset, that generates diverse yet feasible partial reference motions. A high-level controller is then trained to navigate the KNF's latent space to exploit redundant solutions, while a low-level controller ensures physically feasible and accurate motion execution. We validate our approach on the quadrupedal robot equipped with a six-DoF robotic arm. In simulation, experimental results show that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of tracking accuracy and feasible workspace coverage. For hardware deployment, we evaluate the system over 24 episodes across 8 different mobile loco-manipulation tasks. The system achieves end-effector pose-tracking errors of 4.5 cm and 0.14 rad, while maintaining accurate locomotion tracking with linear and angular velocity errors of 0.1 m/s and 0.01 rad/s, respectively, outperforming competitive baselines. Our method represents a practical and powerful solution for accurate and generalized whole-body loco-manipulation in high-DoF robotic systems, with promising potential for diverse downstream robotic tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于运动学归一化流（KNF）的全身控制框架，通过将复杂的移动操作问题分解为部分参考运动生成和低级模仿控制，在四足机器人（配备六自由度机械臂）上实现了高精度跟踪和更大的可行工作空间覆盖，端到端位姿跟踪误差为4.5 cm和0.14 rad。
AI.motivation: 现有移动操作技术在高精度控制、高维动作空间管理以及全身系统固有冗余利用方面仍存在挑战。
AI.method: 提出全身控制框架，包含：1）基于大规模运动学数据集训练的Kinematic Normalizing Flow (KNF)模型，生成多样且可行的部分参考运动；2）高层控制器在KNF潜空间中导航以利用冗余解；3）低层控制器确保物理可行且精确的运动执行。
AI.result: 仿真中显著优于现有方法；硬件部署上，在24个episode、8种任务中实现末端执行器位姿误差4.5 cm/0.14 rad，线速度和角速度误差0.1 m/s和0.01 rad/s。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为高自由度机器人系统的精确、泛化全身移动操作提供了实用且强大的解决方案，具有应用于多样化下游机器人任务的潜力。

title: Annotation-Free Furniture Codes: What They Encode, and How Far They Transfer
