AI.tldr: 本文提出SVR-R1，一个多轮强化学习框架，通过让模型对自己的推理结果进行二元自验证（Yes/No），将验证信号转化为学习信号，从而提升多模态推理能力。无需外部监督或辅助评判器，在视觉-语言推理基准上显著优于标准GRPO基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在推理时缺乏有效的自我验证与自我纠正机制，且推理时自我精炼与RL训练的结合在VLM领域探索不足。作者希望将模型自身的验证能力转化为强化学习信号，实现无需外部监督的自举式多模态推理提升。
AI.method: 提出SVR-R1框架：每个查询中，模型用相同权重生成答案并进行二元自验证（Yes/No）。若验证结果为No，则触发第二次机会重思考；若为Yes或达到回合上限，则输出最终答案并计算基于结果的奖励。采用GRPO与异步多轮rollout框架实现训练。
AI.result: 在视觉-语言推理基准上，SVR-R1相比标准GRPO基线取得了大幅的准确率提升。训练动态显示，验证轮次逐渐减少，但测试准确率反而更高，表明验证与生成之间的差距随着策略内化自我纠正而缩小。
AI.conclusion: SVR-R1弥合了推理时自我精炼与RL训练在VLM中的交叉领域，提供了一种简单有效的多模态推理自举方案。将开源SVR-R1以促进未来VLM研究。

title: Losing My Composure: Predicting Compositionality Over Time
comment: 40 pages, 31 tables, 10 figures. This is a pre-print under review by Computational Linguistics
summary: We explore the phenomenon of semantic change of German and English noun compounds, with the objective of investigating and modeling gradual changes of meanings and degrees of compositionality in the past and over time. To do so, we introduce the Compositionality Trend Prediction task, which is evaluated against a novel dataset of in-context compositionality ratings sampled across several decades of diachronic corpora for 23 German and 26 English target compounds, uniquely providing per-decade ratings and corresponding trends over time. These per-decade compositionality ratings allow us to investigate empirically untested hypotheses of generalized trends in compositionality over time, such as the idea that compounds should become less compositional (less transparent) over time. Beyond our empirical observations from the diachronic compositionality annotations, we perform experiments with semantic vector representations of varying complexity, as well as several temporal granularities for training these representations on diachronic data, resulting in about 100 models of each representation type, each covering a different 1--5 decade slice of a diachronic corpus. Contrary to the decisive tendency posited in the literature, we find only a small negative trend in compositionality over time in our target compounds. In our computational experiments, we find that using models trained on narrow time slices of diachronic data (single decades, or incrementally expanding temporal windows) align better with the per-decade compositionality ratings than those trained on an entire half-century window, the latter setting being an analog for the prevalent modeling approach of training representations on an entire half of a corpus' data. Additionally, we find static representations to be competitive with contextual representations in the Compositionality Trend Prediction task.

AI.tldr: 本文探究德语和英语名词复合词的语义变化，引入"组合性趋势预测"任务，基于跨年代语料库中23个德语和26个英语目标复合词的每十年组合性评分数据集，发现组合性随时间仅呈现微小下降趋势，且基于窄时间窗口训练的静态表示模型在预测任务中表现良好。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对复合词组合性随时间变化的系统性实证检验，特别是关于"组合性应随时间降低"这一假设尚未得到充分验证。作者希望利用历时语料库数据，通过人工标注和计算建模相结合的方式，填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 构建包含23个德语和26个英语目标复合词的每十年组合性评分数据集，提出"组合性趋势预测"任务。采用多种语义向量表示（静态和上下文表示），在不同时间粒度（1-5十年窗口）下训练约100个模型，并通过历时语料库数据评估模型预测组合性趋势的能力。
AI.result: 与文献中提出的决定性趋势相反，组合性随时间仅呈现微小的负向趋势。窄时间窗口（单十年或增量扩展窗口）训练的模型比半世纪窗口训练的模型更符合每十年组合性评分。静态表示在组合性趋势预测任务中与上下文表示相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 复合词组合性随时间下降的趋势并不显著，窄时间窗口训练方案和静态表示方法在建模历时语义变化方面具有优势，为后续历时语义变化研究提供了方法论参考。

title: WarpMPC: Large-Batch MPC on GPU via ADMM with Unrolled $LDL^\top$ Factorization
summary: This paper introduces numerical optimizations for maximizing throughput on GPU when solving large batches (10,000 to over 100,000) of sequential quadratic programming (SQP) iterations, where all problems have the same structure. The optimizations are implemented in a toolbox WarpMPC for model-predictive control (MPC) in JAX and Warp. Based on the insight that all MPC problem instances in a batch share the same sparsity in time, cost, and constraints, we propose unrolling sparse linear factorizations and solves, which dominate alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) solver runtime. We avoid memory access bottlenecks and wasting computations via optimized memory layout, padding-reducing segmentation of the unrolled factorization, and dependency level scheduled backsolves, additionally accelerating sensitivity computation. We achieve throughputs of 8,000 to 250,000 SQP iterations per second on nonlinear cartpole, quadrotor, and humanoid robot benchmarks, outperforming baselines by 3$\times$ to 25$\times$. We illustrate practical usefulness by synthesizing a dataset and training a neural network approximation of an MPC in under 4 minutes that stabilizes a nano quadrotor in hardware experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对GPU上大规模批处理序贯二次规划（SQP）迭代的数值优化方法，在WarpMPC工具箱中实现，通过利用批量问题共享稀疏结构的特性，展开稀疏线性分解与求解，优化内存布局和依赖调度，实现了比基线快3-25倍的吞吐量（8000-250000次SQP迭代/秒），并在纳米四旋翼硬件实验中展示了实际应用价值。
AI.motivation: 现有批量MPC求解在GPU上因内存访问瓶颈和冗余计算导致吞吐量受限，需要针对大规模问题（10000-100000+）的高效并行求解方法以加速训练和部署。
AI.method: 基于批量MPC问题共享相同的时间、代价和约束稀疏结构这一洞察，展开ADMM求解器中占主导地位的稀疏线性分解与求解过程；通过优化内存布局、填充缩减分段展开分解、依赖级别调度的回代求解来避免内存瓶颈和浪费计算；同时加速灵敏度计算。
AI.result: 在非线性倒立摆、四旋翼和人形机器人基准测试上实现8000-250000次SQP迭代/秒的吞吐量，比基线快3-25倍；在不到4分钟内合成数据集并训练神经网络近似MPC，成功在纳米四旋翼硬件实验中实现稳定控制。
AI.conclusion: 提出的批量GPU优化方法显著加速了MPC求解，使得快速数据合成和策略训练成为可能，具有实际机器人应用价值。

title: Spectral Heat Flow for Conservative Token Condensation in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are costly at inference time because they must process long sequences of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods often degrade under high compression by blindly discarding information, breaking spatial structure or collapsing diversity. We propose SpecFlow, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm from destructive pruning to conservative condensation, strictly enforcing spatial coverage and statistical conservation to ensure stability. Treating visual tokens as nodes in a $k$NN graph, SpecFlow (i) computes a stable importance field via spectral heat flow to preserve structural coherence, (ii) allocates budgets via adaptive spatial partitioning to guarantee coverage, and (iii) aggregates discarded information into coreset sinks to maintain statistical conservation. The method is plug-and-play, requires no fine-tuning, and is compatible with FlashAttention. Experiments confirm that our SpecFlow outperforms SOTA methods across tasks, VLM architectures, and pruning ratios. Notably, LLaVA-1.5 with SpecFlow retains 95.6\% of original performance despite pruning 88.9\% of visual tokens, offering an exceptional efficiency-accuracy balance. Code is available at https://github.com/Lzy-dot/SpecFlow

AI.tldr: SpecFlow提出了一种无需训练的训练框架，通过保守凝聚而非破坏性剪枝的方式处理视觉令牌，在保持空间覆盖和统计守恒的前提下，实现高效视觉令牌压缩，在剪枝88.9%令牌时仍保持95.6%的原始性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在推理时因视觉令牌序列过长而成本高昂，而现有剪枝方法在高压缩率下会盲目丢弃信息、破坏空间结构或导致多样性坍塌，无法兼顾效率与精度。
AI.method: SpecFlow将视觉令牌视为kNN图中的节点，通过谱热流计算稳定重要性场以保持结构一致性，采用自适应空间划分分配预算以确保空间覆盖，并将丢弃信息聚合成核心集汇点实现统计守恒，整个流程无需训练且兼容FlashAttention。
AI.result: 在多项任务、多种VLM架构和不同剪枝率下，SpecFlow均优于现有最优方法。LLaVA-1.5在剪枝88.9%视觉令牌时，仍保留95.6%的原始性能。
AI.conclusion: SpecFlow通过从破坏性剪枝转向保守凝聚的新范式，在不牺牲性能的前提下实现了视觉令牌的高效压缩，为多模态大模型推理加速提供了可行的解决方案。

title: MemDecay: Region-Aware KV Cache Eviction for Efficient LLM Agent Inference
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents accumulate heterogeneous context, including system instructions, plans, user turns, retrieved documents, tool outputs, and intermediate reasoning, whose key-value (KV) cache can become a major memory bottleneck. Existing eviction policies generally apply the same attention- or recency-based rule to every token, ignoring semantic structure already available to the agent orchestrator.
  We introduce MemDecay, a training-free, region-aware KV-cache eviction policy. MemDecay assigns tokens region-specific base priorities and decay rates, refreshes retention scores when tokens receive attention, and evicts the lowest-scoring pages under a fixed cache budget while allowing critical regions to be pinned. We also provide a procedure for calibrating decay rates from measured attention lifetimes.
  We evaluate MemDecay at approximately 450 and 1,700 token contexts using Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3B. Across all settings, attention lifetimes differ by an order of magnitude across regions: system-token half-lives range from 148 to 189 decoding steps, compared with 14 to 16 for scratchpad tokens. Pinning preserves system-region facts at full-cache accuracy in every setting, while no baseline preserves more than 13 of 24. Region-aware retention remains effective as context grows, whereas recency-based retention collapses. Accumulated-attention retention performs better on unpinned content, however, and ablations identify attention-score normalization as the main limitation of the current formulation. These results establish semantic prompt structure as a robust signal for KV-cache management while clarifying how it should be combined with attention-based importance.

AI.tldr: MemDecay是一种无需训练、区域感知的KV缓存驱逐策略，利用LLM智能体上下文中已有的语义结构（如系统指令、草稿板等不同区域），为不同区域分配不同的基础优先级和衰减率，在固定缓存预算下实现比统一规则更好的缓存管理效果。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体积累的异构上下文（系统指令、计划、用户轮次、检索文档、工具输出、中间推理等）导致KV缓存成为主要内存瓶颈，现有驱逐策略对所有token应用相同的注意力或基于新鲜度的规则，忽略了智能体编排器中已有的语义结构信息。
AI.method: MemDecay为token分配区域特定的基础优先级和衰减率，在token被关注时刷新其保留分数，在固定缓存预算下驱逐分数最低的页面，同时允许关键区域被固定（pinned）。还提供了一种从测量的注意力生命周期中校准衰减率的方法。
AI.result: 在约450和1700 token上下文中使用Qwen2.5-1.5B和3B评估。不同区域注意力生命周期相差一个数量级（系统token半衰期148-189步，草稿板token仅14-16步）。固定策略在所有设置中都能以全缓存精度保留系统区域事实，而所有基线最多保留13/24。区域感知保留在上下文增长时依然有效，基于新鲜度的保留则失效。累积注意力保留在非固定内容上表现更好，消融实验发现注意力分数归一化是当前公式的主要限制。
AI.conclusion: 语义提示结构是KV缓存管理的稳健信号，但需明确如何与基于注意力的重要性相结合才能发挥最佳效果。

title: From Checker to Forecaster: Code-Owned Evaluation of Model-Generated Strategic Routes Under Delayed Ground Truth
summary: Many evaluations of model outputs rely either on contracts checkable at evaluation time or on feedback that arrives within the operating loop. We study the complementary setting in which ground truth is delayed, censored, or private, so deterministic code cannot check correctness at scoring time and must instead issue a code-owned provisional forecast. RouteCast instantiates this regime for model-generated typed strategic routes: models propose candidate routes and structured factors; point-in-time evidence, reference classes, and deterministic transformations produce a provisional forecast-ranking; later outcomes evaluate the forecast. In a retrospective venture pilot on 21 binary-outcome cases (6 positive, 15 negative), the whole-packet RouteCast score showed preliminary retrospective discrimination (AUC 0.756, 95% CI [0.471,0.980]), while a blind LLM judge reached AUC 0.678 [0.419,0.897] and an identity-exposed LLM judge reached AUC 0.761 [0.515,0.944], consistent with recognition- or outcome-related leakage risk. A preregistered decomposition ablation on the same binary subset found that converting the identical inputs into typed staged routes was indistinguishable from the whole-packet score (Delta AUC = -0.144, 95% CI [-0.471,0.176]) and from a deterministic heuristic (Delta AUC = -0.089, 95% CI [-0.412,0.278]). The pilot establishes an auditable feasibility result and exposes failure modes; it does not establish prospective calibration, causal decision improvement, route-decomposition advantage, or cross-domain validity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RouteCast框架，用于在真实结果延迟、审查或私密的场景下，对模型生成的策略性路线进行可审计的临时预测与排名。在21个二元结果案例的回顾性试点中，全包RouteCast评分显示出初步的区分能力（AUC 0.756），但未建立前瞻性校准或因果决策改进。
AI.motivation: 现有模型评估大多依赖评估时可检查的合约或操作循环内的反馈，但缺乏处理真实结果延迟、审查或私密的场景；需要一种可审计的临时预测机制来评估模型输出。
AI.method: RouteCast框架：模型生成候选路线和结构化因素；利用时点证据、参考类别和确定性变换生成临时预测排名；后续结果用于评估预测。在21个二元结果案例上进行回顾性试点，并与盲LLM法官和身份暴露LLM法官对比。
AI.result: 全包RouteCast评分AUC为0.756（95% CI [0.471,0.980]），盲LLM法官AUC 0.678，身份暴露LLM法官AUC 0.761。分解消融实验表明，将相同输入转换为类型化分段路线与全包评分无显著差异（Delta AUC = -0.144），与确定性启发式也无显著差异（Delta AUC = -0.089）。
AI.conclusion: 试点建立了可审计的可行性结果并暴露了失败模式，但未建立前瞻性校准、因果决策改进、路线分解优势或跨领域有效性。

title: RAGU: A Multi-Step GraphRAG Engine with a Compact Domain-Adapted LLM
summary: Graph retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) enhances large language models with structured knowledge, yet existing systems construct knowledge graphs in a single extraction pass, producing noisy entities and brittle retrieval. RAGU, an open-source modular GraphRAG engine, addresses this by separating extraction from consolidation: entities and relations pass through two-stage typed extraction, DBSCAN-backed deduplication, LLM summarization, and Leiden community detection. A key insight motivates a compact extractor: the skills an in-pipeline LLM needs - comprehension, extraction, reasoning over context - are language skills that grow only weakly with model size, unlike factual world knowledge. Accordingly, we train Meno-Lite-0.1, a 7B model optimized for language skills, which outperforms Qwen2.5-32B on knowledge-graph construction (+12.5% relative harmonic mean) and matches it on English GraphRAG tasks. On GraphRAG-Bench (Medical), RAGU retrieves the most complete context at every factoid level (evidence recall up to 0.84 vs. $\leq$0.76) and overtakes HippoRAG2 on synthesis tasks; on multi-hop factoid QA, the apparent HippoRAG2 advantage is shown to be largely an answer-format artifact. RAGU is installable via $\texttt{pip install graph_ragu}$, runs on a single GPU, and is released under MIT. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/RaguTeam/RAGU, and the Meno-Lite-0.1 model can be obtained from https://huggingface.co/bond005/meno-lite-0.1.

AI.tldr: RAGU 是一个开源模块化 GraphRAG 引擎，通过将知识图谱构建拆分为两阶段类型化提取、DBSCAN 去重、LLM 摘要和 Leiden 社区检测，解决了现有系统噪声大、检索脆弱的问题。其核心洞察是提取器只需语言技能而非世界知识，因此训练了 7B 的 Meno-Lite-0.1 模型，性能匹敌甚至超越 Qwen2.5-32B。RAGU 在医学 GraphRAG-Bench 上取得了领先的检索与合成效果，支持单 GPU 运行，MIT 协议开源。
AI.motivation: 现有 GraphRAG 系统采用单次提取构建知识图谱，导致实体噪声大、检索结果不稳定，亟需一种更精细、模块化的知识图谱构建与检索方法。
AI.method: 提出 RAGU 模块化引擎，采用两阶段类型化提取（实体与关系分步提取）、DBSCAN 聚类去重、LLM 摘要聚合以及 Leiden 社区检测进行图结构优化；同时基于“语言技能随模型规模增长弱于世界知识”的洞察，训练了 7B 参数的语言技能优化模型 Meno-Lite-0.1 用于知识图谱构建。
AI.result: Meno-Lite-0.1 在知识图谱构建任务上超越 Qwen2.5-32B（调和平均相对提升 12.5%），在英文 GraphRAG 任务上与之持平；在医学 GraphRAG-Bench 上，RAGU 在所有事实层级上取得最高证据召回率（最高 0.84 vs. ≤0.76），在合成任务上超越 HippoRAG2；多跳事实验证 QA 中 HippoRAG2 的优势被证明主要是答案格式伪影。
AI.conclusion: RAGU 通过分离提取与合并阶段，结合轻量级专用模型，实现了更高效、更鲁棒的 GraphRAG 系统，且资源需求低（单 GPU 即可运行），为检索增强生成提供了实用且可复现的框架。

title: SKooP: Symmetric Koopman Predictions for Faster and More Generalizable Legged Robot Locomotion with Reinforcement Learning
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication at the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), Pittsburgh, USA, 2026
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms classically suffer from poor sample efficiency. In robotics, a recent line of work has emerged addressing this problem by encoding physics priors in the learning process. However, most of these approaches are validated on well-defined, low-dimensional benchmark systems rather than high-dimensional robots with complex nonlinear dynamics. In this paper, we introduce \textit{SKooP (Symmetric Koopman Predictions)}, an approach combining the advantages of morphological symmetries with those of a Koopman model learned via autoencoder to enhance policy learning. SKooP learns a Koopman model of the system dynamics alongside the policy. The resulting Koopman predictions are used as privileged observations for the critic, allowing the agent to learn based on smoother, more informative features. We also incorporate group symmetries into the actor, critic, encoder and decoder networks to produce a highly equivariant policy. The SKooP approach is validated via in-depth analysis of the learned Koopman models and symmetric policies to showcase how each of these influences the agent's performance. We also show that the learned policies are transferable to different simulation environments. Our results show that SKooP consistently reduces convergence time and increases the learned reward for multiple challenging bipedal locomotion tasks on a quadruped robot. Project page: https://evelyd.github.io/SymmetricKoopmanPredictions/

AI.tldr: 本文提出SKooP方法，将形态对称性与Koopman模型结合，通过自编码器学习系统动力学，利用Koopman预测作为评论家的特权观测，并在演员、评论家、编码器和解码器网络中引入群对称性，以提高强化学习在双足/四足机器人上的样本效率和策略性能。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习算法样本效率低下，现有编码物理先验的方法多局限于低维基准系统，缺乏对高维、复杂非线性动力学机器人的验证。
AI.method: SKooP方法：(1) 通过自编码器学习Koopman模型以预测系统动力学；(2) 将Koopman预测作为评论家的特权观测，提供更平滑、信息更丰富的特征；(3) 在演员、评论家、编码器和解码器网络中引入群对称性，构建高等变策略。
AI.result: 在多种具有挑战性的双足/四足机器人运动任务上，SKooP持续减少了收敛时间并提高了学习奖励；学习的策略可迁移到不同仿真环境。
AI.conclusion: 结合形态对称性与Koopman模型能有效提升高维机器人强化学习的样本效率和性能，且学得的策略具有良好的迁移性。

title: Answer-Conditioned Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Few-Shot Industrial Vision with Small VLMs
summary: Deploying AI-based visual inspection in manufacturing is hard because requirements change often, new defect types appear, and large labeled datasets are rarely available. We propose answer-conditioned chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation for rapidly adapting small vision-language models (VLMs) to new industrial tasks using minimal labeled data. A frontier VLM receives each training image along with its correct label and generates a justified visual explanation. A 3B-parameter model is then fine-tuned on these reasoning-augmented examples via LoRA. By conditioning on correct answers, we ensure all training reasoning is directed toward the correct conclusion, which is critical because frontier models score as low as 24.1% on our hardest task. We validate on four industrial classification tasks spanning three image modalities using only 18 to 30 labeled images per task. Across 4 seeds per task (32 training runs), our method outperforms direct fine-tuning on all 16 seed-task combinations, with mean improvements of +1.7 to +4.4 percentage points. A controlled equal-budget experiment confirms the improvement comes from reasoning quality, not additional training steps. An unconditioned baseline demonstrates that with out answer-conditioning, wrong reasoning degrades performance by 17.8 percentage points. On weld radiograph classification, the fine-tuned 3B model outperforms GPT-4.1 by 10.0pp using just 24 training images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于答案条件链式思维（CoT）蒸馏的方法，通过前沿VLM生成带正确标签的视觉解释，再微调3B参数的小型VLM，在仅18-30张标注图片的四个工业分类任务上，相比直接微调平均提升1.7-4.4个百分点，并在焊缝射线照片分类中以24张训练图片超越GPT-4.1达10个百分点。
AI.motivation: 工业环境中基于AI的视觉检测面临需求频繁变化、新缺陷类型不断出现以及大规模标注数据集稀缺的挑战，需要一种能够快速适应新工业任务且仅需少量标注数据的方法。
AI.method: 采用答案条件链式思维蒸馏：前沿VLM接收训练图像及其正确标签，生成带推理过程的视觉解释；随后使用LoRA在3B参数的小型VLM上对这些推理增强的样本进行微调。通过答案条件化确保训练推理始终导向正确结论。
AI.result: 在四个工业分类任务（涵盖三种图像模态）上，仅用18-30张标注图片，方法在所有16个种子-任务组合上均优于直接微调，平均提升1.7-4.4个百分点；在焊缝射线照片分类中，3B微调模型以24张训练图片超越GPT-4.1达10个百分点；无答案条件化基线性能下降17.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 答案条件化链式思维蒸馏是一种高效、数据节约的工业视觉检测模型适应方法，能够将大模型的推理能力有效迁移到小模型，且推理质量而非额外训练步骤是性能提升的关键。

title: Sharp Concentration Bounds for Bundle-Valued Statistics on Manifolds
summary: Many geometric statistics and manifold learning pipelines routinely produce observations -- such as tangent vectors or local frames -- whose natural home is a varying family of fibers attached to different points of a base manifold, rather than a single shared vector space. Forming empirical averages requires transporting these observations to a common reference fiber, thereby introducing curvature- and holonomy-driven effects that are absent from classical concentration theory. We develop a non-asymptotic concentration theory for such transported empirical means, deriving finite-sample, dimension-free Hoeffding- and Bernstein-type bounds via sharp Hilbert-space inequalities. When shortest paths to the reference point are non-unique, transport becomes path-dependent and introduces a deterministic holonomy bias; we isolate and quantify this bias through bundle curvature and loop geometry, with sharp closed-form formulas for the tangent bundle of a round sphere. The resulting bias-variance decomposition separates the stochastic fluctuation decaying at the classical $n^{-1/2}$ rate in sample size $n$, from a curvature-driven error floor that no amount of additional data can eliminate; minimax lower bounds confirm both terms are unavoidable. We further establish a robust median-of-means estimator achieving optimal rates under heavy tails and the central limit theorem in the reference fiber. Controlled experiments on the sphere validate all theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了传输经验均值的非渐近浓度理论，推导出Hoeffding型和Bernstein型界，揭示了曲率和和乐驱动的偏差-方差分解，其中随机波动以n^{-1/2}衰减，而曲率导致的误差地板无法通过增加数据消除，并给出了中位数均值估计量和中心极限定理。
AI.motivation: 流形学习中的观测（如切向量、局部标架）天然附着于底流形的不同点，在形成经验均值时需传输到公共参考点，这引入了曲率和和乐效应，而经典浓度理论无法处理此类场景。
AI.method: 利用Hilbert空间不等式推导非渐近浓度界；通过丛曲率和环路几何量化确定性和乐偏差；给出球面切丛的闭式公式；建立中位数均值估计量和中心极限定理。
AI.result: 得到了有限样本、维数无关的Hoeffding和Bernstein界；发现了偏差-方差分解：随机部分以n^{-1/2}衰减，曲率驱动的误差地板不可消除；极小极大下界验证了这两项均不可避免。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了几何统计中传输经验均值浓度的理论空白，为流形学习提供了偏差-方差权衡的严格刻画。

title: QwenPaw-Data: Bridging Facts, Methodology, and Execution for Autonomous Enterprise Data Analytics
summary: Enterprise data analysis is emerging as a distinct frontier for autonomous agents. Compared with general-purpose interaction and software engineering, it operates in an open, ambiguous, and continuously evolving environment. These characteristics call for a data-agent architecture that treats semantics, methodology, execution, and evolution as first-class system concerns. To this end, we introduce QwenPaw-Data, an agentic data system designed for enterprise intelligent data analysis. QwenPaw-Data consolidates heterogeneous assets from warehouses, dashboards, documents, interaction logs, and historical tasks into reusable, governable, and evolvable analysis assets, then turns natural-language requests into end-to-end analytical workflows spanning data understanding, retrieval, analysis, report generation, and decision support. Its architecture decomposes the problem into three collaborative subsystems: DataBridge provides trustworthy semantic grounding through interconnected metadata, knowledge, and trace graphs; Skill-Hub codifies expert analytical methodology into reusable and verifiable skills; and Host materializes these evidence and method assets into controllable, artifact-centric runtime execution. Across these subsystems, semantics, methods, traces, and feedback are continuously deposited back into the system, forming a self-evolving asset flywheel. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world industrial BI workloads show that QwenPaw-Data improves both verifiable data access capability and higher-level analytical quality, offering a practical foundation for reliable, traceable, and continuously improving enterprise data agents.

AI.tldr: QwenPaw-Data 是一个面向企业智能数据分析的自主代理系统，通过 DataBridge、Skill-Hub 和 Host 三个子系统分别处理语义基础、分析方法论和运行时执行，将异构资产转化为可重用、可治理的分析资产，在公共基准和工业 BI 负载上提升了数据访问能力和分析质量。
AI.motivation: 企业数据分析作为一个开放、模糊且持续演化的环境，与通用交互和软件工程不同，现有代理系统缺乏对语义、方法论、执行和演化的系统性关注，亟需一种将上述维度作为一等公民的数据代理架构。
AI.method: 架构分解为三个协作子系统：1) DataBridge——通过互连的元数据、知识和追踪图提供可信的语义基础；2) Skill-Hub——将专家分析方法论编码为可复用、可验证的技能；3) Host——将证据和方法资产物化为可控的、以工件为中心的运行时执行。三者持续沉淀语义、方法、追踪和反馈，形成自演进的资产飞轮。
AI.result: 在公共基准和真实工业 BI 负载上，QwenPaw-Data 在可验证的数据访问能力和更高层次的分析质量上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: QwenPaw-Data 为可靠、可追溯且持续改进的企业数据代理提供了实用的基础架构。

title: Production and Perception in LLMs: A Token Probability Approach
summary: The asymmetry between language production and perception has been well-documented in psycholinguistics. Whether large language models (LLMs) exhibit a functionally analogous distinction remains an open question, particularly given that LLMs rely on the same underlying mechanism (next-token prediction) for both input and output processing. In this exploratory study, we operationalize the production-perception distinction through direct token probability measurements rather than metalinguistic prompting. Using the base Llama-3.1-8B model, we generated poems under a production prompt and re-scored the same tokens under both rephrased production prompts and perception-oriented prompts. Across an extended experiment with four production and three perception prompts, production-perception distances consistently and substantially exceeded production-production distances, with non-overlapping ranges across conditions and an overall average ratio of approximately 1.8. Near-ceiling correlations in the production-production control confirm that the effect is specific to communicative framing rather than prompt surface variation, and we show the effect replicates across five open-weight models (Llama-3.1-8B, EuroLLM-9B, gemma-2-9b-it, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), spanning both base and instruction-tuned variants. Temporal analysis revealed that the perception prompt exerts its strongest influence at the beginning of the sequence, with divergence decaying as generated context accumulates, though the specific shape of this decay varies across prompt pairs. These findings suggest that prompt framing alone induces a production-perception distinction in LLM probability distributions, even within a decoder-only architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文通过直接测量token概率，发现仅通过提示框架（生产型 vs 感知型）即可在仅解码器LLM中诱发类似人类语言产生-感知的不对称性，该效应在多个模型上稳健复现，且感知提示的影响在序列起始处最强并随时间衰减。
AI.motivation: 心理语言学中语言产生与感知的不对称性已有充分记录，但LLM是否表现出功能上类似的区分仍是一个开放问题，尤其是因为LLM在输入和输出处理中依赖相同的底层机制（下一个token预测）。本研究旨在探究仅通过提示框架能否在LLM中诱发产生-感知区分。
AI.method: 使用Llama-3.1-8B基础模型，在生产提示下生成诗歌，然后在改述的生产提示和感知导向提示下重新评分相同token。扩展实验使用了4个生产提示和3个感知提示，计算产生-感知距离与产生-产生距离。在5个开源模型（Llama-3.1-8B, EuroLLM-9B, gemma-2-9b-it, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）上验证复现性，并进行时间序列分析。
AI.result: 产生-感知距离始终且显著大于产生-产生距离，非重叠范围条件下平均比率约1.8。产生-产生控制实验接近天花板相关性，确认效应归因于交际框架而非提示表面变化。该效应在5个模型上均复现。时间分析显示感知提示在序列起始处影响最强，随着生成上下文积累而衰减，但衰减形状因提示对而异。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过提示框架即可在仅解码器架构的LLM概率分布中诱发产生-感知区分，表明LLM在功能层面上模拟了人类语言产生与感知的不对称性。

title: Breaking the 15% Barrier: A Real-World Data-Driven System for Proactive Social Robot Triggered by User Nonverbal Cues
comment: 8 pages, accepted as a conference paper for IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS2026)
summary: Service robots in retail stores increasingly rely on cascaded speech pipelines (STT-LLM-TTS), yet many customer-robot interactions are initiated or guided by nonverbal behaviors such as approaching, waving, pointing, or showing items. This paper studies such cues in a real-world store deployment with a teleoperated humanoid robot and shows that a non-negligible portion of robot turns are triggered by nonverbal behaviors rather than spoken input, revealing a limitation of audio-only dialogue systems. In a 6-day in-the-wild deployment, 15.3\% of robot utterances were initiated by users' nonverbal behaviors rather than spoken input. Based on an analysis of observed customer behaviors, we define a set of frequent, service-relevant nonverbal cues and develop a real-time multi-person, multi-label recognizer that runs online from video. We then propose a dialogue framework that conditions LLM-based utterance generation on recognized nonverbal cue tokens, and optionally leverages a vision-language model when items are shown, enabling proactive robot responses without hand-crafted rules. We evaluate the approach offline on nonverbal-triggered turns and demonstrate an online prototype that reacts to users' nonverbal cues in real time.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了零售店服务机器人与顾客互动中非语言行为（如接近、挥手、指点、展示物品）的重要性，发现15.3%的机器人话语由用户非语言行为触发而非语音输入。作者定义了服务相关的非语言线索，开发了实时多标签识别器，并提出了基于LLM的非语言线索感知对话框架，实现了无需手工规则的主动响应。
AI.motivation: 现有服务机器人大多采用级联语音管道（STT-LLM-TTS），忽略了顾客-机器人交互中大量由非语言行为（接近、挥手、指点、展示物品）发起的交互，导致纯音频对话系统存在局限性。
AI.method: 在真实零售店中进行6天野外部署，通过遥操作人形机器人收集数据；分析顾客行为后定义频繁的服务相关非语言线索；开发实时多人多标签识别器（基于视频）；提出对话框架，将识别到的非语言线索令牌作为条件输入LLM生成话语，并在展示物品时利用视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 6天野外部署中15.3%的机器人话语由用户非语言行为触发；离线评估验证了方法有效性；在线原型展示了实时响应非语言线索的能力。
AI.conclusion: 非语言行为在人机交互中扮演重要角色，仅依赖音频的对话系统会遗漏大量交互机会；提出的非语言线索感知对话框架能有效提升服务机器人的响应能力。

title: HyperBank: A Differentiable Bank of Classical Priors for Few-Shot Spheroid Microscopy Segmentation
comment: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Xplore ICIP 2026 Workshop Proceedings, Computational Optical Microscopy Satellite Workshop of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP), Tampere, Finland
summary: Few-shot spheroid segmentation must adapt to new cell lines, microscopes, and illumination conditions from only a small set of annotated images. While foundation few-shot segmenters can be accurate, their large opaque backbones make it difficult to understand which visual cues drive success or failure. We study this question with HyperBank, a differentiable bank of classical image-processing operators combining Frangi vesselness, a Sauvola threshold pyramid, structure-tensor responses, gradient magnitude, and Laplacian-of-Gaussian filters. HyperBank is fitted on the annotated support images and evaluated on disjoint held-out images across three independently acquired spheroid datasets. We treat it not as a general replacement for foundation models, but as a compact, interpretable few-shot microscopy pipeline and an analytic-prior probe of which classical cues carry the few-shot signal. The results show that, adapted on the same few annotated support images, a compact bank of analytic priors is competitive with, and on small-cluster, contrast-driven data can outperform, much larger foundation models, while those models remain stronger on externally sourced, texture-dominated spheroids. Leave-one-family-out ablations indicate that the useful few-shot signal is distributed across operator families and strengthened by support-set-tuned morphology.

AI.tldr: HyperBank是一个由经典图像处理算子组成的可微分库，在少样本球体分割任务中，其性能可与大型基础模型竞争甚至超越，同时保持可解释性。
AI.motivation: 大型基础少样本分割模型虽然准确，但其庞大的不透明骨干网络使得难以理解哪些视觉线索驱动成功或失败，因此需要一种可解释的替代方案来探究经典视觉线索在少样本信号中的作用。
AI.method: 提出HyperBank，一个由Frangi血管增强、Sauvola阈值金字塔、结构张量响应、梯度幅度和高斯-拉普拉斯滤波器组成的可微分经典图像处理算子库。在标注的支持图像上拟合HyperBank，并在三个独立采集的球体数据集上评估其性能。
AI.result: 在相同少量标注支持下，HyperBank与大型基础模型竞争力相当；在小集群、对比度驱动数据上可超越大型模型；而在外部来源、纹理主导的球体数据上，大型模型仍更强。留一簇消融实验表明，有用信号分布在各个算子簇中，并通过支持集调优的形态学操作得到增强。
AI.conclusion: HyperBank作为一种紧凑、可解释的少样本显微镜流水线和分析先验探针，能够揭示经典线索在少样本分割中的贡献，并为特定数据场景提供优于大型黑箱模型的解决方案。

title: AutoNorm: Understanding Adaptive Normalization in Transformers through Differentiable Gating
summary: Normalization is a critical component for stabilizing Transformer training, yet the choice between static strategies such as Layer Normalization (LN) and adaptive alternatives remains largely task-dependent. In this paper, we investigate a key optimization challenge in differentiable normalization gating. Our experiments show that, on relatively stationary vision tasks, the high gradient variance introduced by Gumbel-Softmax gating can hinder convergence of the routing mechanism, causing learned gates to underperform simple random selection. In contrast, on non-stationary language modeling and classification tasks, sustained gating diversity enables the model to learn more effective layer-wise normalization policies. Motivated by these observations, we propose AutoNorm-S (Stabilized), a training strategy that mitigates optimization instability through a gate-freezing schedule. AutoNorm-S achieves competitive or improved performance across multiple benchmarks, outperforming adaptive normalization baselines on NLP datasets, including PTB and SST-2, while remaining competitive on standard vision benchmarks. These results suggest that decoupling normalization selection from optimization noise provides a practical and principled approach for adaptive normalization in Transformer architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoNorm-S，一种通过门控冻结策略缓解自适应归一化中优化不稳定性的方法，在语言任务上优于自适应基线，在视觉任务上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 归一化策略（如Layer Normalization与自适应方法）的选择高度依赖于任务，Gumbel-Softmax门控在平稳视觉任务中因梯度方差大导致收敛困难，门控性能甚至不如随机选择。
AI.method: 提出AutoNorm-S（Stabilized），通过门控冻结调度（gate-freezing schedule）来减轻优化不稳定性，将归一化选择与优化噪声解耦。
AI.result: 在NLP数据集（PTB、SST-2）上优于自适应归一化基线，在标准视觉基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将归一化选择与优化噪声解耦是一种实用且原则性的自适应归一化方法，对Transformer架构有效。

title: AdvNav: Behavior-Guided Black-Box Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Despite progress in Embodied AI, Vision-and-Language Navigation systems remain vulnerable to adversarial visual disturbances. Most existing methods rely on white-box access to target model gradients, which is often unrealistic for real-world deployed systems and computationally exhaustive due to recursive backpropagation for optimization, limiting their applicability. While previous black-box methods predominantly target single-step, instantaneous decision tasks, they struggle to handle the task complexities and temporal dependencies. This highlights the need for a gradient-free attack method that can effectively disrupt the multistep sequential perception-action loop using only observable inputs and outputs. Therefore, we propose AdvNav, a behavior-guided black-box adversarial attack framework that disturbs an agent's first-person views during navigation. To construct an informative surrogate objective for effective optimization guidance in gradient-free search under the black-box setting, we design a dual-granularity behavior-based feedback, aggregating a trajectory-level performance score representing overall navigation degradation, an action-level reward score considering the potential decision risk, and a deviation indicator, all of which are extracted from the agent's self-output behaviors. This feedback guides a hybrid optimization strategy that heuristically tunes perturbation strength via adaptive updates and evolves noise spatial structure genetically, to iteratively discover the most disruptive noise configuration. Evaluated against Transformer-based HAMT and LLM-based MapGPT with two types of backbones on R2R dataset, AdvNav achieves 49.70/65.96/87.30% Attack Success Rate. The result demonstrates the effectiveness and generality of AdvNav, reveals critical perception vulnerabilities and offers insights for the design of future resilient VLN models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdvNav，一种行为引导的黑盒对抗攻击框架，通过仅观察智能体的输入输出，利用双粒度行为反馈（轨迹级表现分数、动作级奖励分数、偏离指示器）指导混合优化策略，在无梯度条件下有效破坏视觉语言导航的多步感知-行动循环。在R2R数据集上对基于Transformer的HAMT和基于LLM的MapGPT进行测试，攻击成功率达49.70/65.96/87.30%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言导航系统的对抗攻击方法大多依赖白盒梯度访问，这在真实部署场景中不切实际且计算开销大；而现有黑盒方法主要针对单步即时决策任务，无法处理多步序列化导航中的时间依赖性和任务复杂性。
AI.method: AdvNav包含三个核心设计：(1) 双粒度行为反馈机制，包括轨迹级性能分数（整体导航退化程度）、动作级奖励分数（潜在决策风险）和偏离指示器，均从智能体自身输出行为中提取；(2) 混合优化策略，通过自适应更新启发式调整扰动强度，并以遗传方式演化噪声的空间结构；(3) 在完全黑盒设定下，仅利用可观测的输入输出进行梯度无关的对抗攻击。
AI.result: 在R2R数据集上，针对基于Transformer的HAMT和基于LLM的MapGPT两种骨干网络，AdvNav分别达到49.70%、65.96%、87.30%的攻击成功率，验证了其有效性和泛化性。
AI.conclusion: AdvNav揭示了VLN模型在感知层面的关键脆弱性，为未来构建更具鲁棒性的视觉语言导航模型提供了重要启示。

title: JobHop v2: A Large-Scale Career Trajectory Dataset from Unstructured Resumes
summary: Large-scale, richly annotated career trajectory data underpins workforce planning, job recommendation, and labour market analysis, yet publicly available datasets are either small, closed to independent use, or built from pre-standardized occupational codes with LLM-synthesized rather than authentic free text. We present JobHop~v2, an improved version of the publicly available JobHop dataset, constructed through end-to-end large language model (LLM) extraction from a corpus of ${\sim}440{,}000$ pseudonymized, multilingual resumes provided by VDAB, the Flemish Public Employment Service. The released dataset comprises $355{,}315$ career trajectories annotated with ESCO occupational codes, quarter-level temporal information, and normalized five-level education attainment, broadening both the coverage and the annotation richness of the original release. Relative to v1, JobHop~v2 introduces a redesigned extraction pipeline based on reasoning-controlled LLM inference with a retry mechanism (achieving a 100% JSON parse rate), a richer extraction schema, and a revised evaluation protocol scored against three complementary annotation baselines. Evaluated against these baselines, our best extractor comes closest to the inter-annotator agreement ceiling among all compared models, trailing it by only 1.1-2.7 percentage points. The dataset and code are publicly released to support reproducible career-trajectory research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JobHop v2，一个从约44万份匿名多语言简历中通过LLM端到端提取构建的大型公开职业轨迹数据集，包含355,315条轨迹，标注ESCO职业代码、季度时间信息和归一化教育水平，在提取流程、模式和评估协议上相比v1显著改进。
AI.motivation: 现有公开的职业轨迹数据集规模小、对独立使用不开放，或基于预标准化职业代码构建且使用LLM合成而非真实自由文本，缺乏大规模、丰富标注的真实职业轨迹数据。
AI.method: 采用基于推理控制的LLM推理配合重试机制构建提取流水线（实现100% JSON解析率），从VDAB提供的约44万份匿名多语言简历中端到端提取职业轨迹，标注ESCO职业代码、季度时间信息和五级归一化教育水平。
AI.result: 发布包含355,315条职业轨迹的数据集；最佳提取器在三个互补标注基线上的表现最接近标注者间一致性上限，差距仅1.1-2.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: JobHop v2提供了更大规模、更丰富标注的公开职业轨迹数据集，其提取方法接近人工标注一致性水平，可支持可复现的职业轨迹研究。

title: DA-Nav: Direction-Aware City-Scale Vision-Language Navigation
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: City-scale outdoor navigation is currently hindered by the heavy reliance on dense maps or costly navigation supervision. In this work, we introduce a novel paradigm for leveraging directional instructions from commercial navigation tools (e.g., Google Maps). To bridge the gap between commercial instructions and executable navigation actions, while mitigating long-horizon error accumulation through robust trajectory recovery, we propose DA-Nav, a Direction-Aware vision-language Navigation framework that reformulates navigation as a discrete spatial grounding problem on the egocentric 2D image plane. To achieve trajectory recovery, DA-Nav employs a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning process encompassing deviation assessment, action prediction, and target grid selection. We further introduce ReDA, a dataset that provides direction-aware instructions and recovery trajectories to enhance spatial grounding and support CoT recovery reasoning. Extensive experiments in CARLA demonstrate that DA-Nav achieves a high success rate of 56.16% in unseen urban environments, outperforming existing State-of-The-Art (SoTA) methods while maintaining a substantially stronger recovery capability. Furthermore, without fine-tuning, DA-Nav seamlessly adapts to both quadruped and humanoid robots, enabling stable kilometer-scale closed-loop outdoor navigation in complex real world environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DA-Nav框架，通过利用商业导航工具（如Google Maps）的方向指令，将导航重新定义为2D图像平面上的离散空间定位问题，并引入ReDA数据集和CoT推理机制实现轨迹恢复。在CARLA实验中达到56.16%的成功率，超越现有SOTA方法，并能无缝迁移到四足机器人和人形机器人上实现公里级闭环导航。
AI.motivation: 城市级户外导航目前严重依赖密集地图或昂贵的导航监督，缺乏利用商业导航工具中现成方向指令的有效方法，且现有方法难以克服长程误差累积问题。
AI.method: 提出DA-Nav框架，将导航重新表述为第一人称2D图像平面上的离散空间定位问题；采用Chain-of-Thought（CoT）推理过程，包含偏差评估、动作预测和目标网格选择三个步骤实现轨迹恢复；并构建ReDA数据集，提供方向感知指令和恢复轨迹以增强空间定位能力。
AI.result: 在CARLA仿真中，DA-Nav在未见过的城市环境中达到56.16%的成功率，优于现有SOTA方法，且具有更强的轨迹恢复能力。无需微调即可迁移到四足机器人和人形机器人，在真实复杂环境中实现公里级闭环户外导航。
AI.conclusion: DA-Nav通过利用商业导航工具的方向指令，有效解决了城市级户外导航中的地图依赖和误差累积问题，在仿真和真实场景中均验证了其优越性能和强泛化能力。

title: Incremental Online Scene Reconstruction by 3D Gaussian Triangulation
summary: Incremental scene reconstruction is essential for real-world applications. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting shows strong potential, most existing approaches require offline conversion of the optimized Gaussians into an intermediate implicit field for explicit mesh extraction, which hinders seamless integration with downstream tasks. To address this limitation, we propose a novel online framework that incrementally reconstructs and updates high-fidelity explicit meshes by directly triangulating a dense geometric Gaussian representation, which supports both high-quality rendering and incremental surface reconstruction. Moreover, we present a direct meshing algorithm that efficiently extracts and updates the mesh from the Gaussian set. To ensure mesh accuracy, we enforce a plane-based pulling constraint that dynamically aligns 3D Gaussian primitives to the approximated local surface. Furthermore, our framework significantly reduces memory and computational overhead during long-sequence processing by dynamically freezing fully optimized historical regions. Experiments on public datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms conventional Gaussian-based methods on both rendering quality and reconstruction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在线增量式三维重建框架，通过直接三角化稠密几何高斯表示，实现从高斯集合中高效提取和更新显式网格，并采用平面拉动约束确保几何精度，在渲染质量和重建精度上超越传统高斯方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D高斯泼溅的增量场景重建方法大多需要离线将优化后的高斯转换为隐式场再进行网格提取，无法与下游任务无缝集成，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 1) 直接三角化稠密几何高斯表示以在线重建和更新显式网格；2) 提出直接网格提取算法高效从高斯集提取和更新网格；3) 采用基于平面的拉动约束，将3D高斯原语动态对齐到近似局部表面；4) 动态冻结完全优化的历史区域以降低长序列处理的内存和计算开销。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，该方法在渲染质量和重建精度上均优于传统基于高斯的方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种支持高质量渲染和增量表面重建的在线显式网格重建框架，解决了高斯泼溅方法无法在线输出显式几何的局限，显著降低了长序列处理开销。

title: M+Adam: Low-Precision Training via Additive-Multiplicative Optimization
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 45 pages
summary: Training with quantized weights can reduce costs but often results in degraded accuracy, especially when optimization is carried out in low precision, without storing high-precision copies. We identify a key failure mode: under low precision, standard optimizers can get stuck and not make progress, especially at large weight magnitudes due to coarse mantissa resolution. To overcome this, multiplicative updates have been previously proposed, in place of additive updates in standard optimizers. While successful under extremely low precision, such as under the logarithmic number system, they suffer from failures near zero and across sign changes. The failure modes of additive and multiplicative updates are therefore complementary. To exploit this, we propose M+Adam, which combines both update types: additive steps handle sign changes and small magnitudes, while multiplicative steps ensure progress at large magnitudes when additive updates are zeroed out under rounding. We prove monotone descent for M+Adam under standard smoothness assumptions. Across LLaMA-style pretraining with 60M-1B models, 1x-8x Chinchilla budgets, and using only BF16, FP8, and FP4 master weights, M+Adam consistently improves low-precision training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出M+Adam优化器，通过结合加法更新和乘法更新来解决低精度训练中的停滞问题，在BF16/FP8/FP4精度下均能提升LLaMA预训练效果。
AI.motivation: 低精度量化训练会降低精度，尤其是在不存储高精度副本的情况下。标准优化器在低精度下会因尾数分辨率不足而在大权重幅度时陷入停滞，无法继续优化。
AI.method: 提出M+Adam，同时结合加法更新（处理符号变化和小幅度）和乘法更新（确保大权重幅度下加法更新被舍入清零时仍能进步），并证明了在标准光滑假设下的单调下降性。
AI.result: 在60M-1B参数的LLaMA风格预训练中，使用BF16、FP8和FP4主权重，在1x-8x Chinchilla预算下，M+Adam consistently能提升低精度训练效果。
AI.conclusion: 加法更新和乘法更新的失败模式是互补的，M+Adam通过结合两者有效克服了低精度训练中的停滞问题，是一种通用的低精度训练优化方案。

title: Are LLMs Ready for Scientific Discovery? A Capability-Oriented Benchmark for AI Scientists
summary: Existing benchmarks for scientific data analysis evaluate LLMs primarily on code execution or workflow completion, overlooking that scientific analysis serves to support distinct types of scientific claims: hypothesis exploration, statistical inference, mechanistic explanation, each with different assumptions and validity criteria. We introduce SDABench, a benchmark that reorganizes evaluation around six capabilities (descriptive, exploratory, inferential, predictive, causal, and mechanistic) across five domains (Biology, Chemistry, Environment, Geography, Physics). SDABench comprises 527 real-data instances (SDA-Real) and 6000 synthetic instances (SDA-Synth), each in both multiple-choice and open-ended formats, constructed through an automated pipeline. Evaluating 15 representative LLMs, we find that models handle descriptive analysis well but degrade sharply on tasks requiring assumption selection, latent-process modeling, or mechanistic reasoning. SDABench further provides a five-stage error analysis framework that locates where LLMs fail: more advanced models more reliably identify the relevant scope and variables, but still struggle to select appropriate analytical procedures, model variable relationships, and draw valid conclusions.

AI.tldr: SDABench是一个针对科学数据分析的LLM评估基准，将评估重新组织为六种能力（描述、探索、推断、预测、因果、机制），涵盖五个领域，包含527个真实数据实例和6000个合成实例。评估15个代表性LLM发现，模型在描述性分析上表现良好，但在假设选择、潜在过程建模和机制推理方面表现不佳。该基准还提供了一个五阶段错误分析框架，定位了LLM的失败环节。
AI.motivation: 现有科学数据分析基准主要评估代码执行或工作流完成，忽视了科学分析的不同类型（假设探索、统计推断、机制解释）各自有不同的假设和有效性标准，需要针对性的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建了SDABench基准，包含SDA-Real（527个真实数据实例）和SDA-Synth（6000个合成实例），采用选择题和开放式两种格式，通过自动化流水线构建。评估了15个代表性LLM，并设计了五阶段错误分析框架。
AI.result: LLM在描述性分析任务上表现良好，但在需要假设选择、潜在过程建模或机制推理的任务上性能显著下降。更先进的模型能可靠地识别相关范围和变量，但在选择适当分析程序、建模变量关系和得出有效结论方面仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 现有的LLM在科学数据分析的高阶推理能力上存在系统性不足，SDABench提供了一个细粒度的评估框架来定位这些缺陷，为未来提升LLM科学分析能力指明了方向。

title: STEP: Career-Path Recommendation via Temporal and Educational Trajectory Modeling
summary: Career paths encode decades of skill acquisition, role transitions, and educational investment, and understanding them at scale underpins workforce planning, labor market policy, and job recommendation. Resumes are a rich source of information about career paths: they contain detailed descriptions of work experience, education, and skills. Yet their unstructured, heterogeneous, and multilingual nature has long prevented large-scale systematic analysis. With the advent of large language models (LLMs), it is now possible to source rich career trajectory data containing temporal and educational signals from unstructured resumes, enabling new opportunities for career-path recommendation. Exploiting this opportunity, we present STEP (Sequential Trajectory of Employment Prediction), a novel career-path recommendation system that leverages temporal and educational signals to predict the next job in a career trajectory. STEP integrates a time-decay Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) cell to model temporal dynamics, Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) conditioned on educational attainment, and attention-based sequence pooling to select relevant features for next job prediction. To improve internal occupation representation for STEP, we introduce ROUTE, a two-stage contrastive procedure that first adapts a multilingual encoder to the career domain via unsupervised denoising autoencoding, then performs supervised contrastive fine-tuning with guided negative selection. We evaluate STEP on four datasets of career trajectories, including an improved version of our publicly available JobHop dataset, and show that it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in next job prediction. The dataset and code are publicly released to support reproducible career-trajectory research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STEP系统，利用时间衰减GRU、FiLM和注意力池化从非结构化简历中预测职业轨迹中的下一份工作，并引入ROUTE对比学习框架优化职业表示，在多个数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 简历包含丰富的职业轨迹信息（工作经验、教育、技能），但其非结构化、异构和多语言的特性长期以来阻碍了大规模系统分析。随着大语言模型的发展，现在可以从非结构化简历中提取带有时间和教育信号的高质量职业轨迹数据，从而推动职业路径推荐的新机遇。
AI.method: 提出STEP（Sequential Trajectory of Employment Prediction）系统，核心包括：(1) 时间衰减GRU单元建模时间动态；(2) 基于教育程度的特征线性调制（FiLM）；(3) 基于注意力的序列池化选择相关特征。同时提出ROUTE，一个两阶段对比学习流程：先通过无监督去噪自编码将多语言编码器适应到职业领域，再通过有监督对比微调（含引导式负样本选择）优化职业表征。
AI.result: 在四个职业轨迹数据集上（包括改进版JobHop数据集）评估，STEP在下一份工作预测任务上超越了现有最优基线方法。
AI.conclusion: STEP系统有效利用时间动态和教育信号实现了职业轨迹的下一份工作预测，数据集和代码已公开以支持可复现的职业轨迹研究。

title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
summary: Recent foundation image and video generation models offer strong generalization and controllability, but their direct application to embodied scenarios is limited by requirements for multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, and robot embodiment constraints. Existing methods typically adapt foundation models with limited robot data, often sacrificing visual knowledge acquired during large-scale pre-training. We present Xiaomi-Robotics-U0, a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive model for unified embodied synthesis. It treats embodied generation as an extension of foundation image and video generation and jointly optimizes text-to-image generation, image editing, embodied scene generation, embodied transfer, and embodied video generation. This unified framework preserves the generalization of the pre-trained world foundation model while adapting it to embodied settings. Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 is the first model to support high-quality multi-view scene generation across multiple robot embodiments and to introduce structured, controllable embodied transfer for fine-grained editing while preserving multi-view consistency and interaction dynamics. It achieves state-of-the-art results on single-step and sequential generation tasks, outperforming GPT-Image-2.0 in human evaluations of embodied scene generation and transfer, ranking first on World Arena for embodied video generation, and improving the out-of-distribution success rate of pi_0.5 from 36.9% to 63.2% on challenging real-world manipulation tasks. These results show that foundation world models can serve both as embodied world models and scalable data engines for embodied intelligence. Code and checkpoints are available at https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-u0.html.

AI.tldr: 小米机器人团队提出 Xiaomi-Robotics-U0，一个380亿参数的多模态自回归模型，统一处理文本到图像生成、图像编辑、具身场景生成、具身迁移和具身视频生成等任务，在保持基础世界模型泛化能力的同时适应具身场景，在多项任务上达到SOTA，并将真实世界操控任务的成功率从36.9%提升至63.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有的基础图像和视频生成模型虽具备强泛化性和可控性，但直接应用于具身场景受限于多视角一致性、几何一致性和机器人具身约束。现有方法通常用小规模机器人数据微调基础模型，牺牲了大规模预训练中获得的视觉知识。
AI.method: 提出Xiaomi-Robotics-U0，一个380亿参数的多模态自回归模型。将具身生成视为基础图像和视频生成的扩展，联合优化五个任务：文本到图像生成、图像编辑、具身场景生成、具身迁移和具身视频生成。通过统一框架保留预训练世界基础模型的泛化能力，同时适配具身场景。
AI.result: 在单步和序列生成任务上达到SOTA，在具身场景生成和迁移的人工评估中优于GPT-Image-2.0；在World Arena具身视频生成任务中排名第一；将pi_0.5在真实世界操控任务上的分布外成功率从36.9%提升至63.2%。
AI.conclusion: 基础世界模型既可以作为具身世界模型，也可以作为具身智能的可扩展数据引擎。

title: Effective Synthetic Image Detection via Noise Residual Clustering
summary: The rapid advancement of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has made synthetic images remarkably realistic, posing security threats such as misinformation and fraud. It is significant to detect the synthetic image in the manner of passive and blind image authentication. Most existing detectors rely on supervised training with large labeled datasets, leading to high costs and degraded performance on unknown generative models. To attenuate such deficiencies, we propose a training-free detection method. Specifically, noise residual fingerprints are first extracted by a simple yet effective pre-trained Noiseprint++ model. Then multi-scale features are further extracted from such residual by a frozen Vision Transformer (ViT), followed by adaptive weighted fusion. Only a few real image samples are used needed to initialize the clustering centers for unsupervised K-Means, distinguishing real and synthetic images without training. Extensive evaluations on four benchmark datasets show that our proposed scheme achieves an average accuracy of 82.2%, outperforming the state-of-the-art detectors on generalization ability. Superior performance is gained on the popular diffusion type of synthetic images, and the effectiveness of each module is validated by ablation studies. Source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/multimediaFor/NoiseCluSID.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于噪声残差指纹和聚类（K-Means）的无训练深度伪造图像检测方法，无需大量标注数据即可实现高泛化性能，在四个基准数据集上平均准确率达82.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI合成图像检测方法依赖大规模标注数据监督训练，成本高昂且在未知生成模型上性能退化严重，亟需一种无需训练、泛化能力强的检测方案。
AI.method: (1) 使用预训练的Noiseprint++模型提取噪声残差指纹；(2) 通过冻结的Vision Transformer (ViT)提取多尺度特征；(3) 进行自适应加权融合；(4) 仅需少量真实图像样本初始化聚类中心，利用无监督K-Means区分真实与合成图像。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上平均准确率82.2%，优于现有最先进检测器的泛化能力；对扩散模型生成的图像表现尤为突出；消融实验验证了各模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的无训练检测方法有效解决了有监督方法的成本高、泛化性差问题，尤其对主流的扩散模型合成图像检测效果优异。

title: modelDNA: Calibrated Lineage Verification and Merge Decomposition from Sampled Weight Fingerprints
summary: The lineage graph of open-weight language models is self-reported: Hugging Face's base_model metadata field is optional and unverified, and over 60% of Hub models document no parentage at all. Methods for detecting lineage from weights exist in the research literature, but each ships as paper code tied to one signal and one experiment; when a provenance dispute breaks, the analysis is redone by hand. This report describes modelDNA, a tool that fingerprints a model from roughly 100-300 MB of ranged HTTP reads (instead of a full 15 GB download for a 7B model), compares the fingerprint against a reference database of foundation models across four published signal families, and returns one of eight verdict classes with a calibrated probability, preferring honest abstention to confident error. On a benchmark of 15 real Hub models with org-documented parentage, judged against 8 candidate bases (13 positives, 107 hard negatives), the system achieves AUROC 1.0, zero false positives at its reporting threshold, and 13/13 correct top-1 parent attribution. The report's second contribution is merge decomposition. Every mainstream weight-merging method is (near-)linear per tensor, and fingerprint sample positions are deterministic functions of tensor identity, so a merged model's fingerprint is the same linear combination of its parents' fingerprints. Mixture weights can therefore be recovered from fingerprints alone by sum-to-one constrained least squares. Against merges with published mergekit configurations as ground truth, the method recovers a slerp merge's layer-interpolation curves at r = 0.999 and a dare_ties merge's mixture weights to within 0.011 of the published values, without downloading any weights beyond the fingerprints. All fingerprints, benchmarks, and the inferred lineage graph of 55 models are public and reproducible offline.

AI.tldr: 模型DNA（modelDNA）是一个轻量级的开源工具，通过指纹技术（仅需100-300 MB HTTP范围读取，而非完整15 GB下载）实现开放权重语言模型的谱系检测与合并分解。系统基于四种信号家族进行指纹比对，在15个真实模型基准上达到AUROC 1.0、零假阳性、13/13正确父代归因。同时提出合并分解方法，能从指纹中通过约束最小二乘恢复合并模型的混合权重（slerp插值曲线r=0.999，dare_ties混合权重误差在0.011以内），所有指纹、基准和55个模型的谱系图均公开可复现。
AI.motivation: Hugging Face上开放权重语言模型的谱系图依赖自我声明（base_model字段可选且未经验证），超过60%的Hub模型未记录父代信息。现有谱系检测方法分散在不同论文代码中，每种只针对单一信号和实验，发生归属争议时需要手工重新分析，缺乏统一、轻量、可复现的工具。
AI.method: 1) 指纹提取：通过约100-300 MB的HTTP范围读取替代完整模型下载，对模型进行指纹计算；2) 指纹比对：将待测模型指纹与包含四种已发表信号家族的参考数据库进行比对，输出8类判定结果并附带校准概率，倾向诚实弃权而非自信错误；3) 合并分解：利用主流权重合并方法在每个张量上呈（近）线性，指纹采样位置是张量身份的确定性函数，因此合并模型的指纹是其父代指纹的线性组合，通过总和为1的约束最小二乘从指纹中恢复混合权重。
AI.result: 在15个真实Hub模型（组织文档标注了父代）的基准测试中，以8个候选基础模型为判定目标（13个正例、107个困难负例），系统达到AUROC 1.0、报告阈值下零假阳性、13/13正确top-1父代归因。在合并分解方面，对已发布mergekit配置的合并模型，方法恢复了slerp合并的层间插值曲线（r=0.999），dare_ties合并的混合权重与发布值误差在0.011以内，且无需下载指纹以外的任何权重。
AI.conclusion: modelDNA提供了一种高效、可复现的模型谱系检测与合并分析方案，解决了当前开放权重模型生态中谱系信息缺失和归因困难的问题。所有指纹数据、基准测试结果以及55个模型的推断谱系图均已公开，支持离线复现。

title: NVAITC AI Scientist: A Governed End-to-End Research System -- A Hypertension GWAS Case Study
summary: Agentic research systems are emerging as a new paradigm for coordinating scientific workflows beyond isolated model inference, code generation, or statistical analysis. However, deployment in institutional biomedical environments requires governed mechanisms for research planning, data access, workflow orchestration, evidence tracking, reproducibility, and human oversight. We present NVAITC AI Scientist (NAIS), a governed end-to-end agentic research system designed to support domain-general scientific workflows while keeping protected data within institutional privacy boundaries. NAIS integrates proposal review, execution planning, governed computational routing, reproducible workflow orchestration, evidence generation, and scientist-in-the-loop oversight. We validate NAIS in a real-world hypertension genome-wide association study (GWAS) using hospital-linked genotype and electronic health record (EHR) data from 286,422 individuals under an aggregate-only data policy. The agent planned cohort extraction, orchestrated GWAS execution, generated quality-control summaries, and drafted publication-oriented outputs. Human-AI review identified phenotype discrepancies and enabled iterative refinement of the hypertension definition. After reconciliation, the agent-orchestrated GWAS reproduced established hypertension loci, including FGF5, ATP2B1, CNNM2, FTO, and GRB14, with the strongest signal at FGF5 reaching $-\log_{10}(p) \sim 70$. As a secondary demonstration, NAIS also supported a drug-induced liver injury prediction workflow, achieving a multimodal graph neural network AUC of 0.842. These results demonstrate that governed agentic research systems can support scalable AI-assisted biomedical discovery while producing outputs comparable to expert-led workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NVAITC AI Scientist (NAIS)，一个受治理的端到端自主科研系统，在保护机构隐私边界的前提下支持通用科学工作流。通过在真实高血压GWAS研究（286,422人）和药物性肝损伤预测任务中的验证，NAIS成功复现了已知高血压基因位点，并达到与专家主导工作流相当的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有自主科研系统多局限于模型推理、代码生成或统计分析等孤立环节，缺乏在生物医学机构环境中部署所需的治理机制（如研究规划、数据访问控制、工作流编排、证据追踪、可重复性和人类监督）。
AI.method: NAIS采用受治理的端到端自主研究框架，集成提案评审、执行规划、受控计算路由、可重复工作流编排、证据生成和科学家参与监督等模块。在遵守聚合数据政策的前提下，使用286,422个个体的基因型和电子健康记录数据执行GWAS流程。
AI.result: 在高血压GWAS中，自主系统复现了FGF5、ATP2B1、CNNM2、FTO、GRB14等已知高血压位点，最强信号FGF5的-log10(p)约70。人机协作审查发现了表型定义不一致问题并进行了迭代优化。在药物性肝损伤预测任务中，多模态图神经网络AUC达0.842。
AI.conclusion: 受治理的自主科研系统能够在保护数据隐私的前提下支持可扩展的AI辅助生物医学发现，产出与专家主导工作流相当的结果。

title: MET: Theory-Grounded and Culture-Aware Multilingual Moral Reasoning
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
summary: Language models are increasingly used for moral decision-making across diverse linguistic and cultural contexts, yet existing work overlooks multilinguality on three aspects: 1) multilingual evaluation benchmarks use direct translation, failing to adapt culture-specific items; 2) inference-time methods for moral reasoning rely on static, English-centric scaffolds and lack grounding in moral theory; 3) training methods for moral decision-making typically require expensive supervision from stronger models or human annotators. We address these gaps with three contributions. First, we introduce MCLASH, a multilingual moral decision-making benchmark to capture culturally situated moral intuitions and social norms across languages. Second, we propose MET (Multilingual Ethics with Theory-grounded reasoning), a two-step prompting method built on expert-curated, theory-based grounds drawn from psychology and philosophy: the model first selects situation- and culture-specific grounds, then reasons over them in the native language of the user. Third, we introduce MET-D (MET-Distillation), which enhances the second step through a self-distillation training stage that requires no external supervision. MET-D improves macro-F1 over the base model on all three models of different sizes and families (Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Gemma3-4B), by an average of 3.71 points on MCLASH and 4.23 on MMoralExceptQA, with a peak MCLASH gain of 12.94 points for Malay on Qwen3-8B. We further reveal that MET-D increases native-language reasoning by 62.13 points on average, and that beneficial grounds differ systematically across cultures. Together, these contributions open the path for culture-aligned, theory-grounded multilingual moral reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了MCLASH基准、MET推理方法和MET-D自蒸馏训练，三者共同构建了面向多语言、文化对齐且理论驱动的道德决策框架，在多个模型上取得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有工作在多语言道德决策的三个层面存在不足：1) 多语言评估基准依赖直译，未能适配文化特异性项目；2) 推理方法依赖静态的英语中心支架且缺乏道德理论基础；3) 训练方法需要昂贵的强模型或人工标注监督。论文旨在填补这些空白。
AI.method: 1) MCLASH：多语言道德决策基准，捕捉跨语言的文化情境道德直觉和社会规范；2) MET：基于心理学和哲学专家构建的理论基础的两步提示方法，先选择情境和特定文化的基础，再以用户母语进行推理；3) MET-D：通过自蒸馏训练增强MET第二步，无需外部监督。
AI.result: MET-D在Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma3-4B三种模型上，MCLASH宏F1平均提升3.71，MMoralExceptQA平均提升4.23；马来语在Qwen3-8B上MCLASH最高提升12.94；母语推理平均提升62.13；不同文化中有益的基础存在系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 这些贡献为文化对齐的、理论驱动的多语言道德推理开辟了道路。

title: Coordinated Incremental Trajectory Tracking of a Tailsitter Drone
summary: This paper derives an analytical differential flatness transform for a tailsitter Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) under coordinated flight conditions using a simplified aerodynamic model. The proposed framework is formulated exclusively using rotation matrices, avoiding the ambiguities inherent to Euler angle representations. The method extends the applicability of an existing state-of-the-art differential flatness-based controller to flight regimes involving a significant vertical velocity component, where the previous approach becomes inapplicable. The proposed framework is validated experimentally with trajectories that highlight its advantages in these regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对尾座式无人机在协调飞行条件下，利用简化气动模型推导出一种解析微分平坦变换，该变换完全基于旋转矩阵构建，避免了欧拉角的模糊性。该方法将现有最先进的微分平坦控制器扩展到包含显著垂直速度分量的飞行状态，并通过实验验证了其优势。
AI.motivation: 现有基于微分平坦的控制器在尾座式无人机存在显著垂直速度分量的飞行状态下失效，需要一种新的解析变换来扩展其适用性。
AI.method: 采用简化气动模型，在协调飞行条件下推导解析微分平坦变换；全程使用旋转矩阵构建框架，避免欧拉角奇异性。
AI.result: 实验验证表明该方法在垂直速度分量显著的飞行轨迹中相比先前方法具有性能优势。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架成功扩展了微分平坦控制器的适用范围，且旋转矩阵表示法提升了数值稳定性。

title: Traj-VLN: Learning Pixel-Space Interaction via Autoregressive Trajectory Generation
summary: Benefiting from the powerful priors embedded in large-scale pre-training data and the emerging commonsense reasoning ability, large language models (LLMs) have shown unprecedented generalization capabilities in many research fields. Recently, projecting visual embeddings into the language space via vision-language models (VLMs) to achieve sim-toreal and cross-scene generalization has become a prevailing paradigm in the field of Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE). VLN requires an embodied agent to navigate through unseen environments following natural linguistic instructions. We emphasize that a VLN task can be decomposed into a sequence of sub-tasks, each corresponding to a process of 3D spatial interaction with the environments described by instructions such as "walk to the end of the sofa and turn left." However, such spatial interactions involving moving into the image along the direction of depth sensing are puzzling for VLMs as they were predominantly trained on conversations with RGB images. Rather than incorporating depth or 3D geometric information-which VLMs rarely encounter during pretrainingwe propose an alternative approach: fine-tuning VLMs to learn navigation interactions directly in 2D pixel space through autoregressive trajectory generation. Given a linguistic instruction and historical observations, our model sequentially predicts a series of pixel coordinates, drawing a trajectory from the bottom center of the current observation. While prior work has proved that pixel-goal supervision outperforms learning of discrete actions, our experiments further verify that the supervision of pixel-space trajectory significantly enhances VLN performance. Moreover, we demonstrate that our flagship model achieves state-of-the-art level performance with relatively limited computational resources and training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种替代方案：不引入深度或3D几何信息，而是通过自回归轨迹生成的方式，在2D像素空间中微调视觉语言模型（VLM）以直接学习导航交互。模型根据语言指令和历史观测，在当前观测的底部中心位置依次预测一系列像素坐标，形成导航轨迹。实验证明，像素空间轨迹监督显著提升了VLN性能，且该模型在有限计算资源和训练数据下达到了SOTA水平。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN-CE方法通过视觉语言模型（VLM）将视觉嵌入投影到语言空间以实现跨场景泛化，但VLN任务中包含的3D空间交互（如沿深度方向移动）对VLM而言是陌生的，因为VLM主要在RGB图像对话数据上预训练，难以理解深度或3D几何信息。
AI.method: 不引入深度或3D几何信息，而是通过自回归轨迹生成的方式，在2D像素空间中微调VLM。模型根据语言指令和历史观测，从当前观测的底部中心开始，依次预测一系列像素坐标，生成完整的导航轨迹。
AI.result: 实验证明，像素空间轨迹监督显著优于离散动作学习和像素目标监督方法，并且在有限的计算资源和训练数据下达到了SOTA水平。
AI.conclusion: 在2D像素空间通过自回归轨迹生成来微调VLM是解决VLN任务中3D空间交互问题的有效方法，能够充分利用VLM的强先验和常识推理能力，同时避免引入VLM不熟悉的深度/3D信息。

title: Auditing Construct Overlap in Explainable Machine Learning: Evidence from Burnout-Depression Prediction Across Student Cohorts
summary: Explainable machine learning (XML) pipelines applied to composite mental health outcomes can produce apparently-robust, cross-population-stable risk hierarchies that are largely artefacts of how the outcome was constructed. We demonstrate this using an ElasticNet pipeline applied to 886 medical students at the University of Lausanne (primary cohort, 2022), validated across 2,580 longitudinal observations at three time points and 701 non-medical students from eight faculties; all three datasets share identical instruments. The pipeline produces a hierarchy in which trait anxiety and health satisfaction dominate wherever the outcome is measured, with Kendall $τ= 1.0$ for the top-two positions across all five evaluation sets and consistent transfer performance ($R^2$: 0.41-0.49). Two residualization experiments, which isolate shared variance between correlated variables via regression, reveal the mechanism: when trait anxiety (STAI-T) is residualized against the co-included depression subscale (CES-D, $r = 0.72$), model $R^2$ drops from 0.41 to 0.16 and STAI-T falls from rank 1 to rank 6; when burnout subscales are residualized against CES-D, $R^2$ collapses to 0.016. Prediction intervals average 35.4 units on a 0-100 scale (2.4 outcome standard deviations), independently ruling out individual-level deployment. The residualization protocol is the paper's transferable contribution: any XAI study combining correlated predictor and outcome constructs should apply this check before interpreting apparent stability as a finding.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示可解释机器学习应用于复合心理健康结局时，产生的跨人群稳定风险层级很可能是结局构建方式的人为产物。通过弹性网络管道在医学生（n=886）及验证集（n=2580+701）中展示，特质焦虑和健康满意度始终主导预测。残差化实验表明，当控制共线性变量后，模型R²从0.41骤降至0.016，预测区间达35.4个单位（2.4个标准差），完全排除个体层面应用。残差化协议是论文的可迁移贡献。
AI.motivation: 揭示可解释机器学习（XML）在复合心理健康结局中产生的"稳定"风险层级可能只是结局构建方式的人为假象，警示研究者不要将表面稳定性误认为真实发现。
AI.method: 使用弹性网络（ElasticNet）管道，在洛桑大学886名医学生（2022年主队列）及两个验证集（2580次纵向观测+701名非医学生）上分析。通过两次残差化实验隔离共享方差：①将特质焦虑（STAI-T）对抑郁分量表（CES-D）残差化；②将倦怠子量表对CES-D残差化。
AI.result: 原始管道中特质焦虑和健康满意度在5个评估集上始终位列前二（Kendall τ=1.0），R²=0.41-0.49。残差化后：实验①R²降至0.16，STAI-T从第1跌至第6；实验②R²坍缩至0.016。预测区间平均35.4单位（2.4个标准差），排除个体级部署。
AI.conclusion: 复合结局构建方式会系统性扭曲特征重要性排序，产生看似稳健实则虚假的跨群体稳定性。建议任何结合相关预测变量与结局构念的XAI研究，在解释表面稳定性前应用残差化检验。

title: OS-Pruner: Pruning Chains-of-Thought of Reasoning Models via Optimal Stopping
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. However, these models often exhibit "computational overthinking," generating redundant reasoning steps that increase latency and cost without improving accuracy. Recent studies suggest that CoT trajectories can be significantly pruned, yet existing methods often rely on forcing a static thinking budget, heuristic filtering, sub-optimal early exit via classification, or expensive re-training. In this paper, we introduce OS-Pruner, a lightweight plug-in framework that formulates chain-of-thought pruning as an optimal stopping problem. Given a reasoning prefix, OS-Pruner learns whether further reasoning is worth its token cost by optimizing an explicit utility that trades off final-answer accuracy against generated length. Our novel formulation enables the model to dynamically assess the sufficient point of termination for a reasoning chain. OS-Pruner is designed to be lightweight during both training and inference, and to provide users with fine-grained control over the reasoning-effort vs. accuracy trade-off. On diverse reasoning benchmarks and base models, OS-Pruner achieves 20-60\% reduction in generation length with minimal accuracy sacrifice.

AI.tldr: 提出OS-Pruner，将思维链剪枝建模为最优停止问题，通过轻量级插件框架动态决定推理终止点，在不显著牺牲准确率的情况下减少20-60%的生成长度。
AI.motivation: LLM在复杂推理中常出现"计算过度思考"现象，产生冗余推理步骤，增加延迟和成本但未提升准确率。现有剪枝方法依赖静态预算、启发式过滤、次优早期退出分类或昂贵重训练，缺乏灵活高效的动态剪枝方案。
AI.method: 将思维链剪枝形式化为最优停止问题，学习一个轻量级插件框架OS-Pruner，通过优化显式效用函数（权衡最终答案准确率与生成长度），动态评估推理链的充分终止点。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准和基础模型上，OS-Pruner实现20-60%的生成长度缩减，且准确率损失极小。
AI.conclusion: OS-Pruner提供了一种轻量、高效、可细粒度控制的推理剪枝方案，实现了推理效率与准确率之间的灵活权衡。

title: How Temperature Shapes Ideological Discourse in Retrieval-Augmented Generation?
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has been increasingly adopted to reduce hallucinations and strengthen the factual grounding of large language models (LLMs). While robustness to errors in the retrieval process has been explored, the impact of ideological bias on LLM outputs has been overlooked. For instance, if the retrieved material contains ideological positions, the RAG may transmit, amplify, or suppress such ideological discourses in its outputs. In this study, we address this issue by examining the influence of the RAG framework, comprising ideological discourses, in LLM-generated answers. To this end, we applied Lexical Multidimensional Analysis (LMDA) on a corpus of 1,117 COVID-19 treatment articles, identifying three ideological discourses. This corpus is then used as the external knowledge source for the RAG. We assessed several LLMs by having the models answer ideological questions at different sampling temperatures. The generated texts were assessed semantically and lexically based on their similarities with ideological reference texts. Our findings show that the RAG framework is prone to transferring ideological discourses into LLM responses, with sampling temperature having a measurable impact on the strength of this transfer. Discoursive alignment between generated answers and the reference text is highest at moderate temperatures, where models balance stochasticity with retrieval grounding, and drops at low temperatures, indicating that overly deterministic sampling suppresses discourse transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了检索增强生成（RAG）框架在引入带有意识形态偏见的检索材料时，会将这些意识形态话语传递、放大或抑制到LLM输出中。通过对1,117篇COVID-19治疗文章进行词汇多维度分析，识别出三种意识形态话语，并测试了不同采样温度下LLM的回答，发现RAG确实容易传递意识形态话语，且在中等温度下话语对齐最强，低温下最弱。
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究关注RAG对检索错误的鲁棒性，但检索材料中的意识形态偏见对LLM输出的影响被忽视了。本研究旨在填补这一空白，系统考察RAG框架如何传递意识形态话语。
AI.method: 采用词汇多维度分析（LMDA）对1,117篇COVID-19治疗文章构建语料库，识别三种意识形态话语。将该语料库作为RAG外部知识源，让多个LLM在不同采样温度下回答意识形态相关问题，并从语义和词汇两个维度与意识形态参考文本进行相似度评估。
AI.result: RAG框架容易将意识形态话语传递到LLM回答中；采样温度对此传递强度有显著影响：中等温度下话语对齐程度最高（模型在随机性与检索依据之间取得平衡），低温下对齐程度最低（过于确定的采样抑制了话语传递）。
AI.conclusion: RAG框架存在意识形态话语传递风险，采样温度是影响该传递强度的关键因素。中等温度最易增强意识形态话语的对齐，低温可部分抑制该传递。

title: A Model for Mediating Multi-Modal Human Intent into Safe Maneuvers for UAVs
summary: Direct human interaction with autonomous UAV systems can be enabled through modalities such as speech, gestures, and graphical interfaces. However, interpreting such inputs as directly executable commands introduces safety risks in dynamic environments. Operator requests may conflict with terrain constraints, inter-UAV separation requirements, or flight-envelope limitations. In this paper, we present a requirements-governed maneuver-response model that mediates multi-modal human intent into safe UAV maneuvers by treating operator inputs as bounded maneuver requests rather than direct commands. Requested maneuvers are mapped to constrained motion primitives and processed through a structured request-evaluate-execute pipeline. Each request is interpreted with associated confidence, validated against terrain, separation, workspace, and flight-envelope constraints, and either constrained, rejected, or executed under continuous runtime monitoring. We further formalize the approach as a requirements-based specification model in which maneuver primitives are associated with explicit preconditions, invariants, guard conditions, and postconditions governing admissibility, execution safety, and emergency handling. These requirements support runtime verification and future reactive synthesis approaches. We present an initial lab-based validation demonstrating that voice and GUI-based inputs can be reliably interpreted and safely executed as constrained maneuver requests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于需求驱动的机动-响应模型，将操作员的多模态输入（如语音、手势、图形界面）视为有界机动请求而非直接命令，通过请求-评估-执行的流水线处理，结合地形、间隔、工作空间和飞行包线等约束进行验证，最终实现安全的UAV机动控制。
AI.motivation: 直接解释多模态输入作为可执行命令在动态环境中存在安全风险，操作员请求可能与地形约束、无人机间分离要求或飞行包线限制相冲突。
AI.method: 提出需求驱动的机动-响应模型：将操作员输入视为有界机动请求，映射为约束运动基元，通过请求-评估-执行流水线处理；每个请求被解释并评估置信度，经地形、间隔、工作空间和飞行包线约束验证后，执行约束、拒绝或执行操作；形式化为基于需求的规格模型，机动基元关联显式的前置条件、不变式、守卫条件和后置条件。
AI.result: 初步实验室验证表明，基于语音和GUI的输入可以被可靠解释并作为有界机动请求安全执行。
AI.conclusion: 该模型支持运行时验证和未来的反应式综合方法，为人机交互中的UAV安全控制提供了形式化保障框架。

title: Water Reflection Detection Using Symmetric Attention
summary: Reflections of water pose a significant challenge for computer vision systems, as standard deep learning models frequently confuse objects with their mirror images, producing spurious false positives and negatives in tasks such as object detection and semantic segmentation. As a result, detecting reflection axes in natural-water scenes is pivotal for reliable object detection and scene understanding. To mitigate this issue, we leverage the intrinsic imperfect reflective symmetry of water and introduce a Symmetry-Aware Water Reflection Detection Network, namely, SAWRD-Net, that couples dihedral group-equivariant convolutions with a matrix-decomposition decoder in an end-to-end framework. First, dihedral group convolutional layers extract geometry-consistent feature maps that explicitly encode both rotational and mirror symmetries. A Multi-scale Reflection Equivariant block then aggregates features across scales and employs a symmetric-attention mechanism to highlight reflection-relevant regions. The proposed matrix-decomposition decoder factorizes high-dimensional features into compact low-rank parameter and confidence spaces, after which the network directly regresses keypoints on the reflection axis. Then a robust principal component analysis fits the final axis. Evaluated on the largest available water reflection scene data set, SAWRD-Net achieves a true-positive rate of 0.890 against human annotations, outperforming all existing water reflection detectors.

AI.tldr: 针对水面反射导致目标检测与语义分割性能下降的问题，本文提出SAWRD-Net网络，利用水的非完美反射对称性，结合二面体群等变卷积与矩阵分解解码器，端到端地检测水面反射轴，在最大公开数据集上达到0.890的真阳性率，超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 水面反射会使深度学习模型将物体与其镜像混淆，产生大量假阳性和假阴性，影响目标检测与场景理解；因此检测水面反射轴成为关键问题。
AI.method: 提出SAWRD-Net：1) 二面体群等变卷积提取旋转和镜像对称的几何一致特征；2) 多尺度反射等变模块聚合多尺度特征并采用对称注意力机制突出反射相关区域；3) 矩阵分解解码器将高维特征分解为低秩参数和置信度空间，直接回归反射轴关键点；4) 鲁棒主成分分析拟合最终反射轴。
AI.result: 在最大公开水面反射场景数据集上，SAWRD-Net的真阳性率达0.890，优于所有现有水面反射检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用水的非完美反射对称性，结合群等变卷积与矩阵分解解码器，能有效检测水面反射轴，显著提升检测精度。

title: Modernizing HEBO: a robust Bayesian optimization baseline for practical heteroskedastic and non-stationary problems
summary: Bayesian optimization is increasingly used to guide data-efficient experimentation in chemistry, materials science, and related laboratory settings, but its practical performance depends strongly on how well surrogate-model assumptions match the geometry and noise structure of the underlying objective. We introduce tidyHEBO, a robust Bayesian optimization model inspired by heteroskedastic evolutionary Bayesian optimization (HEBO) for single-objective, sequential optimization. tidyHEBO reconstructs the HEBO design philosophy in BoTorch and revises surrogate training, output-warping selection, acquisition function evaluation, and Pareto-front search. We benchmarked tidyHEBO on synthetic functions, Olympus emulators, fully experimental reaction-optimization datasets, needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) materials problems, and Bayesmark hyperparameter optimization tasks. On these tasks tidyHEBO achieved competitive to superior performance and improvement in robustness across repeated optimization runs. We therefore propose tidyHEBO as a practical tool for sequential experimentations and a strong general-purpose benchmark for future Bayesian optimization research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了tidyHEBO，一个基于异方差进化贝叶斯优化（HEBO）的稳健贝叶斯优化模型，在BoTorch中重构了HEBO设计理念，并在合成函数、实验反应优化、材料科学等多项基准测试中取得了具有竞争力甚至更优的性能，同时提升了多次优化运行的稳健性。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化在实际实验室环境中的性能高度依赖于代理模型假设与目标函数几何结构和噪声结构的匹配程度，现有方法在稳健性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 在BoTorch中重构HEBO设计哲学，对代理训练、输出扭曲选择、采集函数评估和Pareto前沿搜索进行了修订。
AI.result: 在合成函数、Olympus模拟器、实验反应优化数据集、NIAH材料问题及Bayesmark超参数优化任务上，tidyHEBO取得了具有竞争力乃至更优的性能，并在多次重复优化运行中表现出更高的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: tidyHEBO可作为序列实验的实用工具，并作为未来贝叶斯优化研究的通用基准。

title: A Formal Hierarchical Architecture for Agentic Orchestration with Stack-Based Execution and Lazy Discovery
summary: The rapid expansion of capabilities in Large Language Model (LLM) agents has exposed a critical architectural bottleneck: when agents are given access to a flat, monolithic registry of tools, the model must evaluate hundreds or thousands of options simultaneously. This leads to decision-space explosion, context window saturation, and degraded routing accuracy. To address these limitations, this paper presents a hierarchical, skill-based architecture for agentic orchestration. Capabilities are organized as a rooted tree where internal nodes make routing decisions and leaf nodes execute deterministic tasks. The runtime enforces a single-step execution loop governed by a Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) stack, giving the agent a form of memory akin to a Pushdown Automaton, therefore enabling it to track nested execution contexts and resume deterministically from any depth. Capability discovery follows a manifest-driven, lazy-loading protocol: only the immediate children of the active node are loaded, so memory and prompt costs scale with the explored path rather than the global registry. By replacing global memory with localized stack frames, the architecture prevents outputs from one execution branch from leaking into another, establishing the isolation guarantees required for deployment in regulated enterprise environments. We also discuss UPI Help, an AI-powered digital payments support product, as a motivating production deployment context. We provide a mathematical formalization of the orchestration state, detailed algorithmic analysis of the execution loop, and controlled benchmarks comparing flat and hierarchical routing under increasing tool catalogs, multi-step workflow pressure, and visible schema-token exposure per LLM call.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于层级化技能架构的大语言模型代理编排方法，通过树状工具组织、LIFO栈执行和延迟加载协议，解决扁平工具注册表导致的决策空间爆炸和上下文窗口饱和问题，并在企业级支付支持产品中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理采用扁平、单一的工具注册表，导致模型需同时评估成百上千个选项，引发决策空间爆炸、上下文窗口饱和及路由准确率下降，亟需一种能控制搜索空间并保障执行隔离性的架构。
AI.method: 构建带根树状能力组织，内部节点负责路由决策、叶子节点执行确定性任务；运行时采用LIFO栈实现单步执行循环（类似下推自动机）；能力发现遵循清单驱动的懒加载协议，仅加载活跃节点的直接子节点；通过局部栈帧替代全局内存实现执行分支隔离。
AI.result: 提供编排状态的数学形式化、执行循环的详细算法分析，并在工具目录规模增长、多步工作流压力及每次LLM调用的可见模式-令牌暴露量等维度，进行了扁平路由与层级路由的受控基准对比实验。
AI.conclusion: 层级化技能架构能有效扩展代理的工具处理能力，同时保持决策准确性和内存效率，其隔离特性满足受监管企业环境的部署要求。

title: Introducing Human-Centeredness in AI-Assisted Lexicography
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the XXII EURALEX International Congress 2026
summary: This paper proposes a human-centered artificial intelligence (HCAI) framework for AI-assisted lexicography. While generative AI offers significant opportunities to enhance lexicographic work, it also raises concerns regarding the future role of lexicographers and the preservation of linguistic and cultural diversity. Drawing on HCAI principles and previous applications in other language professions, the paper identifies four interrelated dimensions through which AI integration in lexicography can be understood and critically examined: the augmented lexicographer, the sociotechnical context of AI integration, bias, and the design of AI-powered lexicographic tools. The framework argues that AI should augment rather than replace lexicographers, combining high levels of automation with meaningful human control. It further emphasizes the importance of preserving professional agency, mitigating AI-generated biases, and designing tools around the needs of lexicographers. By doing so, the paper provides a foundation for future research and the beneficial integration of AI into lexicographic workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）框架，用于AI辅助词典编纂，强调AI应增强而非取代词典编纂者，在自动化与人类控制之间取得平衡，并关注偏见缓解、专业自主性和工具设计。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI为词典编纂工作带来巨大机遇，但也引发了对词典编纂者未来角色以及语言文化多样性保护的担忧，亟需一个指导性的理论框架。
AI.method: 基于HCAI原则及在其他语言专业中的应用经验，识别并整合了四个相互关联的维度：增强型词典编纂者、AI整合的社会技术语境、偏见问题、以及AI驱动的词典工具设计。
AI.result: 提出了一个四维HCAI框架，主张AI应增强而非取代人类，实现高水平自动化与有意义的人类控制相结合，强调保护专业自主性、减轻AI偏见、以词典编纂者需求为中心设计工具。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为未来研究及将AI有益地整合到词典编纂工作流程中提供了理论基础。

title: Trajectory Planning and Certification for 3-DOF Robot Manipulators Using Real Quantifier Elimination Based on Comprehensive Gröbner Systems
summary: We propose an algorithm and its implementation for trajectory planning and certification for 3-DOF robot manipulators. The method uses Real Quantifier Elimination (QE) based on Comprehensive Gröbner Systems (CGS), also known as the CGS-QE method. The main advantage of the proposed method is its efficiency in trajectory planning and solution certification. This efficiency comes from the effective use of the CGS. First, for trajectory planning, we solve the inverse kinematics problem at each point along the trajectory via Gröbner basis computation. This usually requires recalculating the Gröbner basis at every point, which is time-consuming. We avoid this by computing the CGS for a parametric system. Here, the end-effector coordinates are parameters. This approach streamlines the algorithm. Second, for solution certification, the CGS-QE method certifies that an inverse kinematics solution exists at any point along the end-effector's trajectory. Our method also certifies solutions for trajectories composed of line segments and cubic natural splines. The algorithm is implemented within the computer algebra system Risa/Asir.
