AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于综合Gröbner系统与实量词消去（CGS-QE）的3自由度机器人轨迹规划与解认证算法，通过参数化系统避免逐点重新计算Gröbner基，并认证沿轨迹（含直线段和三次自然样条）逆运动学解的存在性，在Risa/Asir中实现。
AI.motivation: 传统Gröbner基方法在轨迹规划中需在每个路径点重新计算，计算成本高昂；同时缺乏对整条轨迹上逆运动学解存在性的系统认证手段。
AI.method: 采用CGS-QE方法：1）将末端执行器坐标作为参数，计算参数系统的综合Gröbner基（CGS），避免逐点重复计算；2）利用实量词消去（QE）认证沿整个轨迹（包括直线段和三次自然样条）逆运动学解的存在性。在计算机代数系统Risa/Asir中实现。
AI.result: 有效提升了轨迹规划与解认证的计算效率；能够对由直线段和三次自然样条构成的轨迹进行解存在性认证。
AI.conclusion: CGS-QE方法通过参数化Gröbner基计算与实量词消去，为3-DOF机器人提供了高效的轨迹规划与可证明安全的解认证框架。

title: TriCons-Pose: Triangle-Invariant Geometric Consistency Learning for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
summary: Category-level object pose estimation is a crucial yet challenging task in both academia and industry, and has achieved remarkable success by leveraging keypoint-based correspondence paradigms. However, most existing methods increasingly rely on stronger feature learning while overlooking whether the established correspondences are geometrically stable across diverse perturbations. This often results in fragile pose recovery under intra-class shape variations and occlusions. To tackle this challenge, we develop a novel Triangle-Invariant Geometric Consistency Learning for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation (TriCons-Pose) to anchor stable keypoints and aggregate pose-invariant cues, yielding reliable canonical mapping and accurate pose estimation. Specifically, a Structure-Consistent Keypoint Detector (SCKD) is designed to identify robust keypoints by enforcing cross-view structural consistency via normalized pairwise distance matching. Moreover, we propose a Pose-Invariant Geometric Aggregator (PIGA) to augment keypoint representations by injecting triangle-based pose-invariant descriptors into a local-to-global attention mechanism. The proposed framework is optimized using standard objective functions while incorporating an additional geometry consistency loss. Extensive experiments on REAL275, CAMERA25, and HouseCat6D datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TriCons-Pose方法，通过三角不变的几何一致性学习实现类别级物体姿态估计，核心包括结构一致关键点检测器(SCKD)和姿态不变几何聚合器(PIGA)，在多个数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有基于关键点对应的类别级物体姿态估计方法过度依赖特征学习，忽略了几何稳定性，导致在类内形状变化和遮挡下姿态估计脆弱。
AI.method: 提出TriCons-Pose框架，包含：(1) SCKD通过归一化对距离匹配实现跨视图结构一致性，检测稳定关键点；(2) PIGA通过注入基于三角的姿变不变描述子，结合局部到全局注意力机制增强关键点表示；(3) 引入额外的几何一致性损失进行优化。
AI.result: 在REAL275、CAMERA25和HouseCat6D数据集上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 三角不变的几何一致性学习能够锚定稳定关键点并聚合姿态不变线索，从而提升类别级姿态估计的鲁棒性和准确性。

title: From Self-Attention to Connection Laplacian: A Unified Operator View of Transformers
summary: Self-attention is a ubiquitous primitive in modern sequence models, yet its operator-level geometry is only partially understood. We view a token sequence as a vector field over the token-position graph and identify attention as a connection walk: messages are aggregated by a nonnegative walk matrix while being transported along each edge by a learned linear map. Within this framework, we prove that single-head attention (SHA) is exactly a connection propagation step with constant transport, and that multi-head attention (MHA) is exactly a single edge-dependent connection walk whose effective transport is an attention-gated mixture of headwise transports. We further clarify the conditions under which the corresponding generator reduces to a random-walk connection Laplacian, highlighting the roles of stochasticity, reversibility, and metric-compatible transports. Empirically, we find that trained Transformers across scales (from 124M to 8B) and structures (encoder/decoder) exhibit geometric structure consistent with our theory: effective attention graphs converge to stable geometric operators in deeper layers, learned transports self-organize into approximate scaled isometries, and both phenomena strengthen consistently with scale. Overall, the paper provides a precise connection-walk formalism that links self-attention to classical geometric operators, along with a set of operator-level tools for analyzing transformer models from a geometric perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文将自注意力机制建模为基于连接游走（connection walk）的图算子：将token序列视为向量场，注意力聚合对应于带学习线性映射的非负游走矩阵。证明单头注意力（SHA）是常值传输的连接传播步骤，多头注意力（MHA）是逐边依赖的连接游走。阐明了对应生成器退化为随机游走连接拉普拉斯算子的条件（随机性、可逆性、度量兼容）。实验表明，训练后的Transformer（124M到8B）在深层中注意力图收敛为稳定几何算子，学习到的传输自组织为近似缩放等距结构，且随规模扩大而增强。
AI.motivation: 自注意力是现代序列模型的核心操作，但其算子级别的几何结构尚未被充分理解。本文旨在建立一种精确的形式化框架，将自注意力与经典图几何算子（如连接拉普拉斯）联系起来，从而为分析Transformer模型提供几何视角的工具。
AI.method: 将token序列视为token-位置图上的向量场，将注意力识别为"连接游走"：消息通过非负游走矩阵聚合，同时沿每条边由学习的线性映射（传输）进行变换。在此框架下，SHA被证明为常值传输的连接传播步，MHA为逐边依赖的连接游走，其有效传输是以注意力门控方式混合各头传输的结果。进一步推导了生成器退化为随机游走连接拉普拉斯的条件。
AI.result: 在124M到8B参数的多种Transformer架构（编码器/解码器）上发现：1）深层有效注意力图收敛为稳定几何算子；2）学习到的传输自组织为近似缩放等距结构；3）这些几何特性随模型规模增大而一致增强。
AI.conclusion: 提出了精确的连接游走形式化体系，将自注意力与经典几何算子联系起来，并提供了一套算子级别的分析工具，可从几何角度理解和解释Transformer模型的行为与扩展规律。

title: NextFund: A Unified Performance Tracking Platform for Agentic Portfolio Management
summary: Large language models (LLMs) based agents are beginning to participate in portfolio construction and market analysis, where decisions must be justified under evolving information and risk constraints. Current assessment practice, however, remains poorly aligned with this setting: many studies rely on static examinations or report only terminal portfolio returns, while the intermediate evidence, analyst judgments, and execution steps that produced those returns stay largely invisible. We introduce NextFund, an evaluation platform that makes financial-agent behavior observable under live market conditions. The platform couples time-consistent market access, coordinated multi-agent analysis, and persistent logging of the full decision path from observation to trade. Through an interactive Trading Arena, users can compare models across markets, inspect equity curves, and drill from leaderboard outcomes down to individual justifications. We present NextFund on Hong Kong, U.S., and China A-share equities, illustrating how inspectable decision histories enable fairer benchmarking and more actionable diagnosis. Our demo is available at https://paradoox.cn/nextfund/.

AI.tldr: NextFund是一个评估平台，通过在实时市场条件下记录从观察到交易的全决策路径，使金融智能体的行为可观察，实现更公平的基准测试和可操作的诊断。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的金融智能体评估方式存在缺陷：依赖静态考试或仅报告最终投资组合收益，而中间证据、分析师判断和执行步骤不可见，与动态信息约束下的实际决策场景不匹配。
AI.method: 构建NextFund评估平台，包含：时间一致的市场访问、协调的多智能体分析、全决策路径持久化日志记录（从观察到交易），以及交互式交易竞技场（支持模型比较、权益曲线检查、结果下钻至个体理由）。
AI.result: 在香港、美国和中国A股市场进行了演示，展示了可检查的决策历史如何实现更公平的基准测试和更可操作的诊断。
AI.conclusion: 可检查的决策历史能够实现更公平的基准测试和更可操作的诊断，建议未来金融智能体评估应关注过程透明性而非仅关注结果。

title: AdvancedMathBench: A Benchmark Suite for Advanced Mathematical Proof Generation and Verification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on high-school and olympiad-style mathematics, yet their capabilities on advanced mathematics remain poorly understood. Existing benchmarks, however, fall short in both scope and evaluation granularity: they provide limited disciplinary coverage and often rely on final-answer correctness or coarse judgments, leaving the validity of the reasoning process inadequately assessed. To bridge this gap, we introduce AdvancedMathBench, a benchmark suite designed to evaluate advanced mathematical reasoning capabilities. Its core proof-generation benchmark, ProverBench, contains 296 problems spanning undergraduate and doctoral qualifying-exam levels. To provide reliable evaluation of the proofs, we develop a dedicated automatic verification pipeline trained on large-scale expert annotations to produce both correctness verdicts and fine-grained assessments of proof errors, which exhibits strong agreement with human experts on held-out proof trajectories. We further introduce VerifierBench, consisting of 888 model-generated proof trajectories paired with expert ground truth, to evaluate whether models can correctly judge proof validity and provide sound verification rationales. Experiments show that AdvancedMathBench remains challenging for frontier models. On proof generation, the best-performing model, GPT-5.5-xhigh, achieves only 75.8 and 66.1 on the UGD and QE splits, respectively, indicating substantial room for improvement on advanced mathematical proof construction. On proof verification, the best model attains a Balanced F1 of only 65.1, and models generally exhibit low true negative rates, suggesting that critical error detection remains a major bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdvancedMathBench基准套件，包含ProverBench（296道高阶数学证明题）和VerifierBench（888条带专家标注的模型证明轨迹），用于评估大语言模型在高等数学中的证明生成与验证能力。实验表明现有顶级模型表现有限，证明验证环节尤其薄弱。
AI.motivation: 现有数学推理基准在高等数学领域覆盖不足，通常只考察中学或竞赛级数学，且评估粒度粗（仅依赖最终答案正确性或粗略判断），无法有效评估推理过程的正确性。
AI.method: 1) 构建ProverBench，包含296道从本科到博士资格考试级别的高等数学证明题；2) 开发基于大规模专家标注的自动验证流水线，对证明过程进行正确性判定和细粒度错误评估；3) 构建VerifierBench，包含888条模型生成的证明轨迹及专家标注，用于评估模型的证明验证能力。
AI.result: 最佳模型GPT-5.5-xhigh在证明生成任务上，UGD和QE分项分别仅达75.8和66.1；在证明验证任务上，最佳模型Balanced F1仅为65.1，且模型普遍真负率偏低，表明关键错误检测仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 高等数学证明任务对当前最强LLM仍具显著挑战性，尤其在证明验证环节，模型难以可靠识别错误，未来亟需提升模型在严谨数学推理上的验证能力。

title: Self-Healing Visual Recovery for Autonomous Ground Vehicles Using Camera-Only Visual Odometry
summary: Low-cost unmanned ground vehicles are often used in indoor places like warehouses, inspection corridors, and farm rows, where painted floor lines guide the robot. Line following is useful because it only needs one camera and little computing power, but it can fail when the line is blocked or turns sharply and goes out of view. Sensor-rich platforms tolerate this through hardware redundancy (LiDAR, GPS, multiple cameras), but camera-only systems must recover at runtime with no additional infrastructure. This paper presents a lightweight, two-stage recovery approach that restores guideline tracking without LiDAR, GPS, or a GPU. When the line is lost, the robot first turns in place while slowly relaxing its color checks and waiting for confirmation across multiple frames (Stage 1). If the line is still not found, monocular visual odometry moves the robot back to saved breadcrumb positions before it tries again (Stage 2). The system uses a depth-gated HSV line tracker, a YOLOv8n obstacle detector, and a visual odometry breadcrumb mapper, and it runs at 20 Hz on CPU-only hardware. The controller embeds a complete MAPE-K loop within a single 50 ms control tick, with no external adaptation manager required. The approach is evaluated across 119 fault-injected episodes on three Webots simulation courses. The method was successful in 86.6% of cases, with a median recovery time of 3.26 seconds. These results demonstrate that reliable visual recovery is feasible on camera-only UGVs within practical cost and computational limits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级的两阶段恢复方法，使仅配备单目摄像头的低成本无人地面车辆在丢失地面引导线后能够自主恢复跟踪，无需LiDAR、GPS或GPU，在CPU上以20Hz运行，实验成功率达86.6%，中位恢复时间3.26秒。
AI.motivation: 低成本无人地面车辆在室内环境依赖于地面引导线导航，但在引导线被遮挡或出现急转弯时容易丢失目标。传感器丰富的平台可通过硬件冗余应对，而仅依赖摄像头的系统缺乏额外传感器辅助，需要在运行时自恢复，现有方案缺乏轻量级、可部署于低算力平台的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用两阶段恢复策略：Stage 1中，机器人原地旋转并逐步放松颜色检测阈值，经多帧确认后尝试重新锁定引导线；若失败则进入Stage 2，利用单目视觉里程计将机器人回溯至已保存的"面包屑"位置后再重新尝试。系统集成深度门控HSV线跟踪器、YOLOv8n障碍物检测器和视觉里程计面包屑映射器，控制循环内嵌完整MAPE-K自主计算环路，所有模块均在CPU上以20Hz运行。
AI.result: 在Webots仿真环境中的三个课程上进行了119次故障注入实验，方法成功率为86.6%，中位恢复时间为3.26秒。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，在仅依赖摄像头的低成本无人地面车辆上，通过轻量级视觉方法即可实现可靠的自主恢复，证明在实用成本和计算能力限制下实现视觉恢复是可行的。

title: TOLiD: Bridging the Architecture Gap in Vision Foundation Model to LiDAR Pretraining via Token Lifting for Distillation
comment: Accepted to The IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: Cross-modal distillation from Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to LiDAR backbones has recently emerged as a self-supervised pretraining strategy that reduces reliance on dense point-wise annotation for 3D scene understanding. However, existing distillation pipelines typically treat the VFM as a frozen feature source and train a heterogeneous 3D backbone to match fixed image embeddings, forcing the student to bridge both the modality gap and the cross-architecture gap between dense ViT token representations and sparse 3D encoders. We propose TOLiD, a self-supervised pretraining method for LiDAR representation learning that addresses this gap by coupling a LiDAR backbone with a student Vision Transformer (ViT) initialized from a frozen VFM teacher and applying supervision over compatible patch-token representations. TOLiD converts the set of point features within each image patch frustum into a token using Frustum Pooling followed by Frustum Attention, and performs token-level distillation with visibility masking. For LiDAR-only deployment, we lift token features back to per-point representations using masked bilinear sampling to avoid patches that have limited LiDAR points. We extensively evaluate TOLiD on five heterogeneous LiDAR datasets and four cross-sensor adaptation pairs, demonstrating improved transfer with frozen backbones and lightweight heads.

AI.tldr: TOLiD是一种自监督预训练方法，通过从冻结的视觉基础模型教师蒸馏兼容的patch-token表征到学生Vision Transformer，再经Frustum Pooling和Frustum Attention将点特征转换为token，使用可见性掩蔽进行token级蒸馏，最后通过掩蔽双线性采样将token特征提升为逐点表征，在五个异构LiDAR数据集和四个跨传感器适配对中表现出优越的迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态蒸馏流水线将视觉基础模型视为冻结特征源，训练异构3D骨干网络匹配固定图像嵌入，迫使学生模型同时弥合模态鸿沟和跨架构鸿沟（密集ViT token表示与稀疏3D编码器之间）。
AI.method: 1) 将LiDAR骨干网络与学生Vision Transformer耦合，学生ViT从冻结的VFM教师初始化；2) 使用Frustum Pooling和Frustum Attention将每个图像patch视锥内的点特征集合转换为token；3) 引入可见性掩蔽进行token级蒸馏；4) 使用掩蔽双线性采样将token特征提升回逐点表示，避免LiDAR点稀疏的patch区域。
AI.result: 在五个异构LiDAR数据集和四个跨传感器适配对上，使用冻结骨干网络和轻量级头部实现了改进的迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: TOLiD通过设计兼容patch-token表示的蒸馏方案，有效弥合了模态鸿沟与架构鸿沟，是一种有效的LiDAR自监督预训练方法。

title: LayerNorm as Implicit Gain Control in Looped Transformers
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Code available at https://github.com/clojure-finance/mythjure/tree/paper-v1
summary: In pre-LayerNorm looped transformers, LayerNorm inside the recurrent block acts as an implicit gain controller: by coupling the block's local Lipschitz constant inversely to the activation scale, it renders the recurrence Jacobian non-normal -- asymptotically contractive at every verified fixed point even where its operator norm exceeds 1 -- so the true stability budget is the spectral margin, not an operator-norm bound. That margin depletes as the carry $ρ\to 1$, and a minority of initializations never converge to a fixed point at all, so the diagonal carry constraint $ρ(\bar{A}) < 1$ is necessary but not sufficient for convergence of the full recurrence. Training experiments across six tasks, including a controlled ablation, reveal that the linear carry is not the depth-memory mechanism: gradient descent routes memory through the block's more expressive nonlinear recurrence and leaves the stability-constrained carry at rest -- the carry's role is stabilization, not memory. We characterize the boundary of this claim: on tasks with axis-aligned per-channel structure, gradient descent does recruit the carry. All results are derived analytically and verified in a from-scratch, CPU-scale implementation; verification at larger scale is needed.

AI.tldr: 在预层归一化循环Transformer中，LayerNorm通过将局部Lipschitz常数与激活尺度成反比耦合，充当隐式增益控制器，使循环Jacobian非正态——即在每个验证的固定点处渐进收缩（即使算子范数超过1）。线性载体的对角约束ρ(Ā)<1是必要但不充分的收敛条件。实验表明梯度下降将路由内存通过更富表达力的非线性循环，而稳定性受限的载体保持静止——载体的角色是稳定化而非记忆。仅当任务具有轴向对齐的每通道结构时，梯度下降才会征用载体。
AI.motivation: 探究预层归一化循环Transformer中LayerNorm对循环动力学稳定性的影响，澄清线性载体（linear carry）在深度-记忆机制中的真实作用，并界定梯度下降何时会利用载体进行记忆。
AI.method: 理论分析推导LayerNorm的增益控制效应和循环Jacobian的非正态性；在六个任务上进行训练实验，包括受控消融实验，并在从头实现的CPU规模实现中验证理论结果。
AI.result: LayerNorm使循环Jacobian在算子范数超过1时仍可在固定点处收缩；线性载体的对角约束ρ(Ā)<1是必要但不充分的收敛条件；梯度下降通常将记忆路由到非线性循环中，载体仅用于稳定化；仅在轴向对齐的每通道结构任务中，梯度下降才会征用载体进行记忆。
AI.conclusion: 预层归一化循环Transformer中，载体的真实作用是稳定化而非深度记忆机制，但这一结论存在边界条件（每通道结构任务除外）。更大规模的验证仍需进行。

title: The Hidden Footprint: Making Storage a First-Class Metric for LLM Agent Evaluation
summary: LLM agent benchmarks measure task completion, reliability, and inference cost, but not the persistent data an agent run leaves on disk, including logs, context snapshots, checkpoints, and debug traces. We introduce AgentFootprint, a cross-framework benchmark of post-run agent storage footprint. Its serialization-aware metric suite measures total retention, channel composition, duplication, growth, compressibility, and conversation-history reconstructability. It addresses a measurement trap: naive byte-level measurement understates duplication by an order of magnitude because database paging and JSON escaping obscure repeated content. A fixed-trace control separates agent-generated logical volume from persistence-layer amplification: replaying the same trajectory through seven persisting frameworks yields a 6.7x spread. Under identical models, tools, and tasks, configurations with 100% accuracy differ by 15.7x in retained bytes, although their defaults support different recovery and audit capabilities. Three full-history configurations grow superlinearly on a repeated-observation stress task. Exported trajectories from 108 instance-normalized SWE-bench Verified submissions span three orders of magnitude per instance, with no detectable correlation with resolve rate. A content-addressed store reduces retention by 4.8x-32.7x while preserving every reconstructability score. These results establish persistent storage as a resource metric to report jointly with accuracy and reconstructability.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentFootprint基准，评估LLM agent运行后的持久化存储足迹（日志、检查点等），发现不同框架间存储差异达6.7-15.7倍，且与任务准确率无相关性，内容寻址存储可减少4.8-32.7倍存储量。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM agent基准只衡量任务完成度、可靠性和推理成本，忽略了agent运行后留在磁盘上的持久化数据（日志、上下文快照、检查点、调试追踪等），需要建立统一的存储足迹评估方法。
AI.method: 提出AgentFootprint跨框架基准，包含序列化感知的度量套件（总保留量、通道组成、重复度、增长性、可压缩性、对话历史可重构性）。采用固定轨迹控制实验分离agent生成逻辑体积与持久化层放大效应，使用108个SWE-bench Verified提交进行大规模验证。
AI.result: 1) 相同轨迹经七个持久化框架回放，存储差异达6.7x；2) 相同模型、工具和任务下，100%准确率的配置间保留字节差异达15.7x；3) 三个全历史配置在重复观测压力任务上呈超线性增长；4) 108个SWE-bench提交的导出轨迹每实例跨越三个数量级，与解决率无相关性；5) 内容寻址存储减少4.8x-32.7x保留量，同时保持所有可重构性分数。
AI.conclusion: 持久化存储应作为与准确率和可重构性并列的报告指标，内容寻址存储可在不损失可重构性的前提下大幅降低存储开销。

title: A Durability and Cross-Language Transfer Benchmark for a Validated Teaching-Feedback Classification Protocol
summary: Institutions collect far more open-ended teaching-evaluation feedback than they read. A prior study introduced a validated protocol for classifying such comments by thematic category and sentiment, built from a documented annotation guide, an intra-annotator reliability measurement, stratified cross-validation, and a held-out evaluation on a Spanish institutional corpus with a frozen-encoder design. Two questions limit its reuse: whether a protocol fixed to 2019-era frozen embeddings stays competitive as representation methods advance, and whether it transfers to a second language. We re-run it on the original Spanish data across three representation generations, sparse lexical features, frozen transformer embeddings, and prompted large language models, and transfer its sentiment task to English with a balanced 45,000-comment corpus checked against an aspect-labeled education dataset. Treating paired comparisons as descriptive, we find the protocol durable: a 2026 frontier model posts the highest thematic F1 on the hardest Spanish task, yet shows no sentiment advantage over a cheap model and no descriptive separation from it on English, so model choice is a deployment decision, not a property of the method.

AI.tldr: 本研究复现并扩展了一个已有的教学评价反馈分类协议，在西班牙语和英语数据上比较了三代文本表示方法（稀疏特征、冻结Transformer嵌入、大语言模型提示）。发现该协议具有持久性：前沿模型在西班牙语主题分类上表现最佳，但在情感分析上并未显著优于低成本模型，模型选择因此成为部署决策而非方法属性。
AI.motivation: 原有教学评价反馈分类协议发布于2019年，存在两个开放问题：(1) 固定冻结嵌入的方法是否随表示学习进步而保持竞争力；(2) 该协议能否从西班牙语迁移到其他语言（英语）。本研究旨在检验该协议的持久性和跨语言迁移能力。
AI.method: 在原始西班牙语语料上复现协议，对比三代表示方法：稀疏词特征、冻结Transformer嵌入和提示式大语言模型。同时将情感分析任务迁移至英语，使用45,000条平衡评论语料，并对照面向方面标注的教育数据集进行验证。采用描述性配对比较方法分析结果。
AI.result: 2026年的前沿模型在最难的西班牙语主题分类任务上取得了最高F1值，但在情感分析任务上相较于廉价模型并无优势；在英语任务上，二者也无描述性差异。模型选择更多是部署决策问题，而非方法本身的固有属性。
AI.conclusion: 原有协议具有持久性和跨语言可迁移性。性能差异主要体现在主题分类的复杂任务上，情感分析任务不同模型间差异不显著。实际部署中，模型选择应基于成本和效率权衡，而非单纯追求前沿模型。

title: Automated Synthesis of Facial Mechanisms for Conversational Animatronic Robots
summary: Animatronic faces are a central component of socially interactive robots, enabling rich nonverbal communication through facial articulation. However, state-of-the-art animatronic faces are typically tailored systems: each new facial geometry requires extensive manual mechanical redesign, making large-scale personalization prohibitively slow and costly. In this work, we pursue automated and scalable mechanical face synthesis, aiming to rapidly generate a physically realizable facial mechanism for a wide range of facial geometries. We introduce a parametric, linkage-driven mechanical face template whose topology and actuator layout are explicitly parameterized to support systematic scaling and retargeting across diverse facial morphologies. Building on this template, we propose a hierarchical automatic design algorithm that takes a single 2D portrait as input, reconstructs a target 3D face, and synthesizes a collision-free, manufacturable internal mechanism. The algorithm combines anatomy-guided feasible motion volumes, Action Unit (AU)-derived trajectory-based expressiveness objectives, and a collision-driven outer-loop refinement strategy. Beyond hardware synthesis, we argue that future mechanical faces deployed at scale must engage in bidirectional, multi-turn conversation rather than functioning solely as speaking or listening heads. To this end, we develop a dual-identity conversational facial motion synthesis framework that jointly models speaking and listening behaviors from audio, producing temporally coherent 3D facial motion suitable for physical execution. We validate our system through extensive experiments, including (i) quantitative evaluation of automatic mechanism synthesis across diverse facial geometries, (ii) comparisons against manual mechanical design, (iii) benchmarks on conversational facial motion synthesis and real-time deployment, and (iv) perceptual user studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种参数化连杆驱动机器人脸模板及分层自动设计算法，能从单张2D肖像快速生成可制造、无碰撞的内部机械结构，并结合双身份对话面部运动合成框架，实现规模化个性定制的社交机器人面部。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人脸是定制化系统，每种面部几何都需要大量手动机械重新设计，导致大规模个性化速度慢、成本高。本文旨在实现自动化、可扩展的机械面部合成，快速生成可物理实现的面部机构。
AI.method: 提出参数化连杆驱动机器人脸模板（拓扑和驱动器布局可参数化），结合分层自动设计算法：输入单张2D肖像→重建3D目标人脸→合成无碰撞可制造内部机构。算法融合解剖引导的可运动体积、AU导出的轨迹表达性目标、碰撞驱动外层优化。同时提出双身份对话面部运动合成框架，联合建模听说行为生成时序连贯的3D面部运动。
AI.result: 通过自动机构合成定量评估（多种面部几何）、与手动设计对比、对话面部运动合成与实时部署基准测试、感知用户研究等实验验证了系统有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了从单张肖像到物理可实现的社交机器人脸的端到端自动化设计，为大规模个性化社交机器人部署提供了可行路径。

title: RED-Sphere: Hyperspherical Residual Edge Debiasing for Cross-Population Fundus Disease Domain Generalization
summary: Medical image classifiers are often trained within one source population, yet clinical deployment requires robustness to patients whose appearance, acquisition style, and disease prevalence differ from the source cohort. Existing fairness and robustness methods often require group supervision or treat appearance variation as an undifferentiated nuisance, which is insufficient when population-correlated low-level cues and lesion evidence share edge and texture structure. We study a strict source-only cross-population setting, where external populations are unseen during optimization, validation, scheduling, hyperparameter and model selection. We propose RED-Sphere, a plug-and-play robustness framework for image classification under unseen population shifts. It estimates shortcut-sensitive nuisance responses with an edge and feature energy prior, attenuates dominant responses through residual soft gating, regularizes masked nuisance views with counterfactual-inspired consistency and separation losses, and predicts labels with normalized spherical prototypes. It favours angular semantic evidence over source-correlated activation magnitude while preserving lesion structure. Although demonstrated on 2D Scanning Laser Ophthalmoscopy (SLO) fundus classification for Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD) and Diabetic Retinopathy (DR), RED-Sphere is not tied to retinal anatomy: the same principle can be adapted with modality-specific nuisance priors wherever appearance shortcuts and semantic evidence are entangled. Under a strict White-only Harvard-FairVision protocol, RED-Sphere improves held-out macro-F1 across all 20 task and backbone comparisons, with average gains of 1.28 and 2.98 F1 points on AMD and DR. Gains in AUC and PR-AUC, visual diagnostics, ablations, and sensitivity analyses further support stronger external semantic alignment and more stable angular disease geometry.

AI.tldr: RED-Sphere是一种即插即用的鲁棒性框架，通过估计并衰减捷径敏感性扰动、引入反事实一致性损失和归一化球面原型，在严格源域独训、未见目标域场景下提升医学图像分类器对人群迁移的鲁棒性，在AMD和DR任务上平均F1提升1.28和2.98个点。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分类器通常在单一源人群上训练，但临床部署需面对外观、采集风格和疾病流行率均不同的外部人群。现有公平性与鲁棒性方法需群体监督，或将外观变化视为无差别噪声，而在底层线索与病灶证据共享边缘和纹理结构时，这些方法效果不足。
AI.method: 提出RED-Sphere框架：1) 利用边缘与特征能量先验估计捷径敏感扰动；2) 通过残差软门控衰减主导响应；3) 对掩蔽后的干扰视图施加反事实一致性与分离损失进行正则化；4) 使用归一化球面原型预测标签，偏好角度语义证据而非源相关的激活幅度。
AI.result: 在严格White-only Harvard-FairVision协议下，RED-Sphere在全部20个任务与骨干网络对比中提升了留出集macro-F1，AMD和DR平均提升1.28和2.98个F1点；AUC、PR-AUC、可视化诊断、消融与敏感性分析进一步支持更强的外部语义对齐和更稳定的角度疾病几何结构。
AI.conclusion: RED-Sphere在眼科SLO眼底图像分类上有效，但其原理可适配至其他模态——只要存在外观捷径与语义证据纠缠的问题，即可通过模态特定的扰动先验进行扩展。

title: Learning to Fine-tune Foundation Models under Resource Limitations
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, accepted and presented at ICMLCN 2026
summary: We study the problem of optimal continual fine-tuning for a pre-trained Foundation Model deployed at a resource-limited device. At each time slot, a new batch of training data arrives, and the controller is faced with two options: either use the data to fine-tune the model and incur a compute cost, or do not fine-tune the model and discard the data. After the decision, the performance of the current model is measured in terms of an application-specific performance metric such as classification accuracy. Our objective is to learn an optimal policy that determines \emph{when to fine-tune the model} on a single task (e.g., sentiment analysis), under a finite compute budget. We formulate this online decision-making problem as a constrained Markov Decision Process, where the system state captures three essential aspects: (\textit{i}) model's performance, (\textit{ii}) computational budget, and (\textit{iii}) data distribution relevance to historic data encountered up to that point. The transition to the next state is stochastic and therefore, we propose a reinforcement learning-based method to solve this problem, namely the \emph{actor-critic} algorithm. We also consider the special case where the performance of fine-tuning for a given model can be predicted or estimated prior to decision; in this case the problem becomes a Dynamic Programming one. Experiments with a large pre-trained model on a widely-used text classification dataset demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms fine-tuning approaches with the same compute budget by more than $4\%$ in terms of accuracy and achieves $97\%$ of full-parameter fine-tuning accuracy while requiring only $25\%$ of the fine-tuning steps.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在资源受限设备上对预训练基础模型进行最优持续微调的问题，通过强化学习方法（Actor-Critic）学习一个在有限计算预算下决定何时微调模型的最优策略，实验表明该方法在相同计算预算下准确率提升超过4%，且仅需25%的微调步骤即可达到全参数微调97%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限设备上部署预训练基础模型时，持续微调面临计算预算有限与数据不断到达的矛盾，需要决定何时进行微调以在计算预算约束下最大化模型性能。
AI.method: 将问题建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），状态包含模型性能、计算预算和数据分布相关性三个维度；采用Actor-Critic强化学习算法求解；对于微调性能可预测的特殊情况，转化为动态规划问题处理。
AI.result: 在文本分类数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在相同计算预算下比常规微调方法准确率提升超过4%，仅需25%的微调步骤即可达到全参数微调97%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的强化学习框架能有效解决资源受限设备上的持续微调决策问题，在显著降低计算开销的同时保持较高的模型性能。

title: STAMP: Provenance-Guided Credit Assignment for Deep Search Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning for deep-search agents has largely focused on trajectory-level scoring -- outcome correctness, citation-aware rewards, and evidence coverage. Yet the actions that expose supporting documents receive no targeted credit, a gap we call the reward-credit mismatch. We propose STAMP, in which a reference-based verifier judges whether each cited document supports an entity or relation in a training-time evidence graph, and first-exposure attribution traces each supported citation back to the action that first surfaced it. This step credit is injected through sign-preserving advantage modulation, which redistributes advantage across steps without changing the trajectory-level reward or the relative ranking of trajectories within each group. On BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, and xbench-DS, STAMP improves the GRPO baseline by +2.0/+5.5/+3.0 points under matched SFT initialization, training data, and search tools, and composes with both outcome-only and citation-rubric base rewards. Component ablations confirm that the provenance-based credit signal and the sign-preserving advantage modulation each contribute to the gains.

AI.tldr: STAMP通过基于引用验证器的步骤级信用分配和符号保留优势调节，解决了强化学习中深度搜索智能体的奖励-信用不匹配问题，在多个基准上提升了GRPO基线性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法仅对轨迹级别（如结果正确性、引用覆盖率）进行奖励，但暴露支持文档的具体动作并未获得针对性信用，存在奖励-信用不匹配问题。
AI.method: 提出STAMP方法：1）基于引用的验证器判断每个被引文档是否支持证据图中的实体或关系；2）首次曝光归因将每个被支持的引用追溯到首次暴露它的动作；3）通过符号保留优势调制将步骤级信用注入，在不改变轨迹级奖励或组内轨迹相对排序的前提下重新分配优势值。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH和xbench-DS上，STAMP相对于GRPO基线分别提升+2.0/+5.5/+3.0个点，且能与纯结果奖励和引用评分奖励组合使用。消融实验证实了基于来源的信用信号和符号保留优势调制各自贡献了性能提升。
AI.conclusion: STAMP通过细粒度的步骤级信用分配有效改进了深度搜索智能体的强化学习效果，解决了奖励-信用不匹配问题，且与现有奖励设计方案兼容。

title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
summary: Metacognition is a foundational component of intelligence critical to effective learning, problem solving, decision-making, communication, and more. In recent years, it has become increasingly recognized as a cornerstone of capable, transparent AI systems. Yet while LLMs have made significant progress across diverse real-world tasks, it is not yet clear when, how, or to what extent they can exhibit or be endowed with effective metacognitive abilities, nor how such abilities can be adapted to advance the fundamental capabilities, reliability, and intelligence of AI systems. This paper bridges this gap by presenting the first comprehensive overview of the current state of knowledge on metacognition for LLMs. We analyze and taxonomize the landscape of this emerging field and summarize recent technical advancements, including methods and benchmarks to measure and evaluate LLMs' metacognitive abilities, techniques to elicit, improve, and apply metacognition in LLMs, and findings and implications of ongoing research. We also discuss applications, open questions and challenges, and promising directions for future work. Our aim is to provide a detailed and up-to-date review of this topic and stimulate meaningful research and discussion. An organized list of papers can be found at https://github.com/yale-nlp/LLM-Metacognition.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面综述了大型语言模型（LLM）的元认知能力，系统梳理了该新兴领域的研究现状，包括评估基准、增强技术、应用场景及未来方向。
AI.motivation: 元认知是智能的基础组成部分，对学习、推理、决策等至关重要，也是构建透明AI系统的关键。尽管LLM在许多任务上取得了显著进展，但它们在多大程度上具备或能被赋予有效的元认知能力尚不清楚，亟需系统性的梳理与总结。
AI.method: 作者通过系统性综述的方法，对该新兴领域的文献进行梳理和分类，涵盖LLM元认知能力的测量与评估基准、提升与应用的技术方法、以及相关研究发现与启示。
AI.result: 呈现了LLM元认知领域的系统化分类图谱，总结了当前技术进展（包括评价方法和增强技术），并指出了开放问题与未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为LLM元认知研究提供了全面的知识总结，旨在推动相关研究发展。相关论文列表已开源在GitHub上。

title: From World Action Models to Embodied Brains: A Roadmap for Open-World Physical Intelligence
summary: Artificial general intelligence ultimately requires agents that can reason and act in the physical world. Action models, vision-language-action policies, and world models have advanced this goal, while World Action Models (WAMs) are particularly promising because they connect candidate interventions with predicted consequences. However, progress remains fragmented: models use incompatible action spaces and prediction targets, datasets and tasks follow different conventions, and runtime systems expose limited interfaces for reuse and evaluation. We review the evolution toward WAMs and organize these limitations into three coupled gaps: model roles and representations, objectives and standardization, and system composition. Building on this analysis, we propose a co-evolution roadmap for physical intelligence centered on the \emph{embodied brain}, a long-term model target for integrating multimodal context, comparing candidate interventions, and issuing state-transition or capability requests rather than direct actuator commands. WAMs provide promising prototypes for its predictive functions, while a physical harness grounds model outputs through tools, controllers, verification, and trace logging. Shared contracts align heterogeneous models, data, tasks, and embodiments, and closed-loop post-training converts verified interaction into reusable experience. Together, these components define a modular physical-intelligence stack for adaptive and self-improving embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了通向通用人工智能的物理智能——世界动作模型（WAMs）的发展现状，指出其在角色表示、目标标准化和系统组合方面存在三个耦合缺口，并提出以"具身大脑"为核心、物理框架为支撑的协同进化路线图，构建模块化的物理智能堆栈以实现自适应和自我改进的具身智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）虽然有望连接候选干预与预测后果，但进展分散：模型使用不兼容的动作空间和预测目标，数据集和任务遵循不同规范，运行时系统暴露的接口有限，导致难以复用和评估。需要系统性地梳理这些碎片化问题并提出统一的发展路线。
AI.method: 首先回顾了WAMs的发展演变，将现有局限性归纳为三个耦合缺口：模型角色与表示、目标与标准化、系统组合。在此基础上提出协同进化路线图，核心组件包括：（1）具身大脑——整合多模态上下文、比较候选干预、发出状态转换或能力请求的长期目标模型；（2）物理框架——通过工具、控制器、验证和跟踪日志对模型输出进行接地；（3）共享契约——对齐异构模型、数据、任务和具身形态；（4）闭环后训练——将验证后的交互转化为可复用的经验。
AI.result: 提出了一个模块化的物理智能堆栈，WAMs为其预测功能提供有前景的原型，物理框架负责输出接地，共享契约实现异构组件的对齐，闭环后训练实现自适应改进，共同构成面向自适应和自我改进具身智能体的完整体系架构。
AI.conclusion: 物理智能的发展需要从碎片化的模型、数据和系统走向协同进化，以具身大脑为核心目标，通过物理框架、共享契约和闭环后训练等组件构建统一的模块化堆栈，最终实现能够在物理世界中推理和行动的通用智能体。

title: Is Energy Guidance All You Need? Training-Free Norm Injection for Driving World Models
comment: Accepted to Robotics: Science and Systems 2026 Robot World Models Workshop
summary: Driving world models built on large video-diffusion backbones generate realistic scenes but are hard to control: enforcing a traffic norm typically means retraining the backbone or conditioning it on hand-built layouts. We ask whether controllability requires training at all. Our experiment shows that a rectified-flow driving world model, which jointly generates future video and a planned ego trajectory, can have its planned trajectory steered entirely at sampling time by differentiable energy functions that encode driving norms, without knowledge-specific retraining of the diffusion backbone. Concretely, we demonstrate that a world model built on Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT backbone can be steered to brake at a counterfactual target by injecting energy guidance at sampling time. However, we find that the generated video does not yet follow the steered trajectory through the backbone's joint self-attention and identify the cross-stream coupling as a crucial requirement for end-to-end-controllable rollouts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需重新训练扩散模型主干网络，即可在采样时通过可微能量函数引导视频扩散世界模型生成符合交通规范的行为轨迹的方法。实验基于Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT骨干网络，验证了在逆流场景下通过能量引导实现刹车控制，但发现生成的视频尚未完全跟随引导轨迹，指出跨流耦合是实现端到端可控滚动的关键需求。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大规模视频扩散主干网络的世界模型生成场景逼真但难以控制：强制执行交通规范通常需要重新训练主干网络或依赖手工构建的布局。作者探究是否无需训练即可实现可控性。
AI.method: 采用整流流（rectified-flow）驱动的世界模型，联合生成未来视频和规划的自我轨迹，通过在采样时注入可微能量函数来编码交通规范，实现轨迹引导，无需针对特定知识重新训练扩散主干网络。
AI.result: 基于Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT骨干网络，在反事实场景中成功通过能量引导让模型刹车；但生成的视频尚未完全跟随引导轨迹，表明跨流耦合不足。
AI.conclusion: 采样时能量引导可在不重新训练的情况下实现一定程度的可控性，但跨流耦合是端到端可控滚动的必要条件，当前骨干网络的自注意力机制不足以实现完全的轨迹跟随。

title: On the modality gap and the contrastive loss in multi-modal representation learning
summary: We study the modality gap in CLIP-style dual-encoder contrastive learning, where image and text embeddings remain misaligned despite being trained in a shared space. We argue that the gap is induced by a failure of the InfoNCE formulation with independent encoders. We conduct a uni-modal experiment with two independent encoders and identical initialization conditions and find that InfoNCE actively generates a gap at low temperatures. We provide a theoretical analysis of this phenomenon and show that the modality gap is indeed a mode-failure of InfoNCE, but only at low temperatures. We propose a simple modification called xNCE, which uses intermodal as well as intra-modality negative contrastive pairs. xNCE matches retrieval performance on MS-COCO while consistently reducing the gap even at low temperatures. Notably, xNCE improves zero-shot classification over the InfoNCE baseline across all benchmarks, whereas high-temperature InfoNCE and regularized InfoNCE both fail to do so, demonstrating that xNCE reduces the modality gap without sacrificing the discriminative geometry needed for transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了CLIP式双编码器对比学习中的模态间隙问题，指出InfoNCE在低温下会主动产生模态间隙，并提出xNCE方法（利用跨模态和同模态负样本）来减少间隙，同时提升零样本分类性能。
AI.motivation: CLIP式双编码器对比学习中，图像和文本嵌入在共享空间中训练后仍存在不对齐的模态间隙，作者试图揭示其成因并提出解决方案。
AI.method: 通过单模态实验（两个独立编码器、相同初始化）发现InfoNCE在低温下主动产生间隙；理论分析表明模态间隙是InfoNCE在低温下的模式失败；提出xNCE，在对比学习中引入跨模态和同模态负样本对。
AI.result: xNCE在MS-COCO上匹配原有检索性能，同时在低温下持续减小模态间隙；xNCE在所有基准上提升零样本分类性能，而高温InfoNCE和正则化InfoNCE均未能做到。
AI.conclusion: xNCE能有效减小模态间隙且不牺牲迁移所需的判别性几何结构，优于高温或正则化InfoNCE方案。

title: The Path to Self-Evolving Clinical Systems: Scaling Medical Agents from Assistance to Autonomy
summary: The growing ability of large language models and vision language models to jointly interpret and reason over images and text is reshaping medical agents, moving them from task specific predictors toward autonomous systems that perceive, reason, plan, remember, and act in clinical environments. This work departs from the capability first perspective of existing literature and instead begins from clinical deployment, asking what tasks, contamination resistant benchmarks, and interactive training environments are required before medical agents can be trusted in practice. Medical agents are formalized as sequential decision making systems under partial observability, together with a three level autonomy taxonomy spanning assisted, cooperative, and fully autonomous operation. The field is organized along a unified scaling spine consisting of framework scaling, capability scaling, and environment scaling. Within this framework, clinical environment scaling, the integration of tools, data, and clinical gyms, is identified as the most actionable yet underexplored direction for agents operating in PACS, EHR, and FHIR ecosystems. Clinical self evolution, where agents improve through interaction with their environments rather than parameter scaling alone, is further positioned as a key research frontier, drawing insights from self improving agents, agent gyms, and test time compute scaling. Applications across radiology, pathology, ophthalmology, and hospital workflows are examined together with deployment challenges including hallucination, cascading failures, and fairness. By consolidating more than 300 references, with particular emphasis on advances from 2025 to 2026, this work provides a roadmap toward trustworthy, self improving medical imaging systems for real clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 本文从临床部署出发，系统梳理了医疗智能体在部分可观测条件下的序列决策形式化框架、三级自主性分类法（辅助型、协作型、全自主型），以及框架、能力和环境三个维度的统一缩放脊柱。识别出临床环境缩放（PACS、EHR、FHIR生态系统中的工具、数据与临床健身房集成）是最具可操作性但研究不足的方向，并将临床自我进化（通过交互而非仅参数缩放实现智能体改进）定位为关键研究前沿。涵盖放射学、病理学、眼科和医院工作流程的应用，以及幻觉、级联故障和公平性等部署挑战，基于300余篇文献（重点为2025-2026年进展）构建了通往可信赖、自我进化的临床医疗影像系统的路线图。
AI.motivation: 现有文献多从能力优先视角出发，缺乏从临床部署实际需求反向推导的研究。本文旨在回答在何种任务、抗污染基准和交互训练环境下医疗智能体才能被临床信任，为医疗AI从任务特定预测器向自主临床系统的转变提供系统性路线图。
AI.method: 采用从临床部署反向推导的方法论，形式化医疗智能体为部分可观测条件下的序列决策系统，提出三级自主性分类法（辅助、协作、全自主），构建框架-能力-环境三维缩放脊柱，并引入临床自我进化机制（整合自改进智能体、智能体健身房、测试时计算缩放等思路）。
AI.result: 识别出临床环境缩放（PACS/EHR/FHIR生态系统中工具、数据与临床健身房的集成）是最具可操作性但研究最不足的方向；将临床自我进化定位为关键研究前沿；系统梳理了放射学、病理学、眼科及医院工作流中的应用及幻觉、级联故障、公平性等部署挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本文基于300余篇文献，为构建可用于真实临床实践的可信赖、自我进化的医疗影像系统提供了系统路线图，强调了从能力驱动向部署驱动的范式转变。

title: Narrix: Remixing Narrative Strategies from Examples for Story Writing
comment: 24 pages, 10 figures. To appear in CHI '26: Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems, April 13-17, 2026, Barcelona, Spain. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3772318.3790813
summary: Experienced storytellers decompose stories into local narrative strategies and how these strategies shape higher-level arcs. This decomposition helps writers recognize patterns in others' work and adapt those patterns to tell new stories. Novices, however, struggle to identify these strategies or to reuse them effectively. We present Narrix, a novel writing tool that helps novice writers recognize narrative strategies in example stories and repurpose these strategies in their own writing. Narrix analyzes strategies in example stories, highlights them with color-coded lexical cues and explanations, and situates them on an interactive story arc for exploration by emotional shifts and turning points. Writers then drag strategies onto multi-dimensional tracks and apply block-scoped edits to revise or continue their drafts through controlled generation steered by specified strategies. Through a within-subjects study (N=12), Narrix showed improved participants' retention, confidence, and creative adaptation of narrative strategies compared to a baseline chat-based writing interface.

AI.tldr: Narrix是一款帮助新手写作者识别、理解并复用故事叙述策略的写作工具，通过色标词汇线索、互动故事弧线及多维度轨道编辑，显著提升用户对叙事策略的保留、信心和创意改编能力。
AI.motivation: 经验丰富的故事讲述者能够将故事分解为局部叙事策略，并理解这些策略如何塑造更高层次的故事弧线，从而识别模式并创作新故事。然而，新手写作者难以识别或有效复用这些策略，因此需要工具辅助。
AI.method: Narrix分析示例故事中的策略，通过色标词汇线索和解释进行高亮展示，并将策略置于交互式故事弧线上，便于用户通过情感转折和转折点进行探索。用户可将策略拖拽到多维轨道上，通过受控生成应用块级编辑来修改或续写草稿。
AI.result: 通过N=12的受试者内研究，与基线聊天式写作界面相比，Narrix显著提升了参与者对叙事策略的保留率、信心以及创意改编能力。
AI.conclusion: Narrix通过可视化分析和交互式编辑有效降低了叙事策略的学习门槛，为新手写作者提供了结构化的创作辅助工具。

title: Toward Efficient Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation Using Only Low-Magnification Histopathological Images
summary: Whole-slide images (WSIs) provide rich tissue-level and cellular-level information, but storing and transmitting high-magnification pathology data is resource-intensive. Moreover, annotating WSIs at the pixel level is labor-intensive and time-consuming. Therefore, it is important to investigate whether low-magnification pathology images with limited annotations (i.e., image-level instead of pixel-level labels) can achieve performance comparable to high-magnification images. This paper presents a systematic benchmark study on weakly supervised histopathological image segmentation under different low-resolution storage settings. Starting from high-resolution image patches, we simulate lower-magnification inputs and reconstruct them to the original size using interpolation and deep learning-based reconstruction methods before applying the weakly-supervised segmentation pipeline. This framework enables a quantitative evaluation of how weakly supervised methods respond to different levels of resolution degradation. Experimental results show that reconstruction quality metrics alone are insufficient to predict downstream segmentation performance. In particular, the study identifies a critical degradation point where the localization of small-scale structures declines significantly. These findings provide practical guidance for designing efficient digital pathology storage systems while maintaining reliable automated analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/Dung-Dx/LowMagWSS

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了弱监督组织病理图像分割在不同低分辨率存储设置下的表现，发现仅靠重建质量指标不足以预测下游分割性能，并识别出小尺度结构定位显著下降的关键退化点，为设计高效的数字病理存储系统提供了实践指导。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像（WSIs）在高倍率下存储和传输资源消耗大，像素级标注耗时费力，因此需要探究低倍率病理图像配合有限标注（图像级而非像素级标签）是否能达到与高倍率图像相当的性能。
AI.method: 从高分辨率图像块开始，模拟低倍率输入，使用插值和基于深度学习的重建方法将其恢复至原始尺寸，然后应用弱监督分割流程进行定量评估。
AI.result: 重建质量指标不足以预测下游分割性能；存在一个关键退化点，在该点小尺度结构的定位性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 为设计兼顾存储效率与自动化分析可靠性的数字病理存储系统提供了实用指导。

title: Scaffold splits hide structural-frontier failures in ADMET models
summary: Molecular property models are commonly evaluated by holding out Bemis--Murcko scaffolds, yet a scaffold identifier is only one notion of chemical unfamiliarity. We introduce a label-free structural-frontier split that reserves the sparsest and most physicochemically remote scaffold groups, and evaluate it on six public experimental or curated ADMET tasks. Against a 70/10/20 scaffold control with identical acyclic grouping, the frontier inflates equally weighted primary error with a taskwise median of 87.0\% and a skew-sensitive mean of 130.3\% (descriptive task/seed bootstrap interval, 52.1--246.0\%). The mean falls to 75.9\% once BBB is removed; that endpoint is the one whose score ranking inverts at the frontier. A message-passing graph-network control still shows a large gap (mean 82.8\% over four tasks) and does not invert, so a low-capacity head does not explain the effect. We also test Multi-View Frontier Risk Extrapolation (\method), a count-adjusted tail-risk penalty over four molecular views, and treat it as a falsifiable probe. It changes normalized frontier error by only 0.16\% relative to empirical risk minimization for the perceptron head (interval, $-0.43$--0.84\%) and by $-1.9$\% for the graph network; three fixed robust-penalty controls are likewise inconclusive. Against the published Lo-Hi and DataSAIL splitters the frontier inflates error more on average, though no split is uniformly hardest. An audit of 31,561 marine natural products further shows that OOD status and agreement with legacy ADMET predictions depend on the molecular view, endpoint and teacher coverage. Split construction and label provenance are important evaluation constraints in their own right, and the tested training penalties do not resolve the frontier failures we observe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种标签无关的结构前沿划分方法，将最稀疏且理化性质最遥远的支架组保留为测试集，在六个ADMET任务上发现该方法比传统支架划分显著增加预测误差（中位数87.0%，均值130.3%），且现有的鲁棒性训练惩罚方法无法有效缓解这种前沿失败。
AI.motivation: 分子性质模型通常仅通过Bemis-Murcko支架留出法评估，但支架标识符只是化学陌生性的一种概念。现有评估策略忽略了更极端的结构前沿区域，缺乏对模型在稀疏且理化性质遥远区域泛化能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 1. 提出标签无关的结构前沿划分（structural-frontier split），保留最稀疏、理化性质最遥远的支架组作为测试集；2. 在六个公共ADMET任务上，以70/10/20的支架划分为对照，评估前沿划分的影响；3. 引入Multi-View Frontier Risk Extrapolation (MFRE)，一种基于四个分子视图的计数调整尾风险惩罚；4. 对比Lo-Hi和DataSAIL等现有划分方法；5. 在31,561个海洋天然产物上进行审计分析。
AI.result: 1. 前沿划分使加权主误差膨胀，任务中位数87.0%，均值130.3%（去掉BBB后降至75.9%）；2. 消息传递图网络仍存在较大差距（四任务均值82.8%）且未发生排名反转；3. MFRE对感知机头仅改变归一化前沿误差0.16%，对图网络改变-1.9%，三个固定鲁棒惩罚对照同样无显著效果；4. 与Lo-Hi和DataSAIL相比，前沿划分平均误差更大但并非所有任务都最难。
AI.conclusion: 划分构建和标签来源本身就是重要的评估约束条件，当前测试的训练惩罚方法无法解决前沿划分中观察到的失败。模型的OOD泛化能力在不同分子视图、任务和教师覆盖下表现不一致，需要更有效的解决方案。

title: SCALECUA: Scaling Computer Use Agents with Verifiable Task Synthesis and Efficient Online RL
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) are emerging as a powerful interface for automating complex digital workflows through visual perception and GUI execution. Online reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a key direction for scaling their capabilities. However, this paradigm is bottlenecked by verifiable data scarcity and online RL inefficiency. To break these barriers, we introduce ScaleCUA, a unified framework that scales online RL for CUAs via verifiable task synthesis and efficient training. At the data level, we design VeriGen, an end-to-end framework for generating verifiable RL tasks through iterative docker interactions and a multi-agent feedback loop. Scaled to 100+ concurrent agent workers via a shared docker interaction probe, this pipeline produces 24K+ verifiable tasks and nearly 3K high-quality RL tasks. To maximize sample efficiency, we propose Frontier Sampling, which tracks per-task capability and allocates rollouts to the current learning frontier. On the training side, we further design Visual Context Segmentation, a sliding window over recent visual context that balances rollout and training-engine pressure, yielding a 2.83x training speedup over step-wise decomposition. Together, ScaleCUA achieves 68.7% on OSWorld and 54.0% on ScienceBoard, establishing new state-of-the-art performance among open-source computer use agents. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/THUDM/SCALE-CUA.

AI.tldr: ScaleCUA 是一个通过可验证任务合成与高效训练来扩展计算机使用代理在线强化学习的统一框架，在 OSWorld 和 ScienceBoard 上分别取得 68.7% 和 54.0% 的最新开源性能。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习（RLVR）是提升计算机使用代理（CUA）能力的关键方向，但面临可验证数据稀缺和在线 RL 效率低下的双重瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 VeriGen 生成可验证 RL 任务（通过迭代 Docker 交互和多智能体反馈循环，产出 24K+ 可验证任务和近 3K 高质量 RL 任务）；Frontier Sampling 按能力前沿分配采样提升样本效率；Visual Context Segmentation 通过滑动窗口平衡训练压力，实现 2.83 倍训练加速。
AI.result: OSWorld 上达到 68.7%，ScienceBoard 上达到 54.0%，均创下开源 CUA 最新最优性能。
AI.conclusion: ScaleCUA 通过可验证任务合成和高效训练策略有效突破了数据稀缺与训练效率瓶颈，验证了该框架在扩展 CUA 在线强化学习方面的有效性。
